# `/var/www` EC2 Web Root

This directory is the live EC2 web root for the hosted sites on this server.

## Active AXIAMAX / APRO paths

- Public site root: `/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/`
- Admin dashboard: `/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/admin/`
- APRO application: `/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/admin/apro/`
- Shared environment file: `/var/www/.env.master`

## Environment file

The migrated AXIAMAX Admin and APRO solution reads secrets and configuration from:

```text
/var/www/.env.master
```

This file must remain outside the public site document root and should not be web-accessible.

Common variables include:

```text
ADMIN_USERNAME
ADMIN_PASSWORD or ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH
OPENAI_API_KEY
GITHUB_PAT
SYSTEM_API_KEY
APRO_SCAN_ROOT=/var/www
```

## Root behavior

For APRO local filesystem browsing, `/var/www` is the expected scan root unless explicitly overridden.

For Remote Server / HTTPS Agent browsing and publishing, the default root is the actual remote root `/` unless the admin user explicitly configures a different root in APRO.

## Public content warning

Do not replace public website content during admin/APRO maintenance unless specifically requested. The public homepage for `apro.maxflex.ai` is:

```text
/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/index.php

# aiflex.info

This directory is the product root for `aiflex.info`.

## Product Purpose
`aiflex.info` is planned as a public informational website about AI services, models, capabilities, and pricing.

## Current Approved Role in AI Model Discovery
For the current project phase, `aiflex.info` is a read-only display product.
It may display model catalog information retrieved from the private `api.maxflex.ai` service.

## Access Pattern
Although `aiflex.info` is public-facing, it must obtain model catalog data from the private API using authenticated server-to-server access with:
- `MF_ADMIN_API_KEY`

`aiflex.info` must not provide public refresh controls.
Only APRO may manually trigger refresh actions.

## Current Catalog Coverage
The current `api.maxflex.ai` implementation now publishes materially improved normalized metadata coverage for the major providers, especially:
- OpenAI
- Anthropic / Claude
- Gemini

The published snapshot now includes much broader support for:
- pricing
- input cutoff
- context window
- output cutoff
- curated capabilities
- field-level provenance
- field-level reliability

AIFLEX should present those fields clearly so users can make better model-selection decisions with primary attention to cost and secondary attention to context window and related limits.

## Approved AIFLEX Display Enhancement
AIFLEX is approved to use the existing published catalog payload from `/v1/catalog` and present the richer metadata now available.

The API response shape remains compatible with the current AIFLEX page.
AIFLEX should continue to fetch the full published catalog and apply filters locally. Filter facets should be derived from the unfiltered catalog so provider and other options do not disappear when a filter is active.

## Approved Filters
- Search
- Provider
- Availability
- Reliability
- Capabilities
- Known or missing limits
- Input Cutoff
- Context Window
- Output Cutoff
- Pricing
- Provenance and source type
- Enabled status
- Provider namespace
- Model family
- Model date

## Approved Measure Labels
| Display label | Source field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Input Cutoff | `limits.max_input_tokens` | Maximum number of input tokens accepted in one prompt or request |
| Context Window | `limits.max_context_tokens` | Total token working window available to the model |
| Output Cutoff | `limits.max_output_tokens` | Maximum number of tokens generated in one response |

Each measure filter should support optional minimum and optional maximum values.

Blank minimum means no lower bound.
Blank maximum means no upper bound.
Blank minimum and blank maximum mean no filtering on that measure.

Unknown measure values should display as Unknown or Not listed and should not be treated as numeric matches when a range is applied.

Important: Input Cutoff must not be inferred from Context Window. If `max_input_tokens` is missing, Input Cutoff is unknown even if Context Window is populated.

## Capability Grouping Notes
The API now exposes richer capability metadata, so AIFLEX should present user-friendly groups for fields such as:
- `structured_outputs`
- `code_execution`
- `batch`
- `citations`
- `pdf_input`
- `image_input`
- `thinking`
- `effort`

## Planned Early Scope
- Public page showing centralized AI model discovery information
- Read-only presentation of model data
- Display of timestamps, capabilities, limits, pricing, and reliability/provenance indicators
- Local filtering for the approved dimensions and measures
- Better family grouping for Claude, Gemini, GPT, and related lines where possible

## Future Scope
Possible future expansions include:
- historical pricing views
- blog content
- model/service reviews
- comments and richer public analysis features

## Security Note
Do not embed secrets in client-side code. Any authenticated calls to the private API should be handled server-side.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function aiflex_env_load(string $path): array
{
    static $cache = null;
    if (is_array($cache)) {
        return $cache;
    }
    $values = [];
    if (is_file($path) && is_readable($path)) {
        $lines = file($path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES);
        if (is_array($lines)) {
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $line = trim((string)$line);
                if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (str_starts_with($line, 'export ')) {
                    $line = trim(substr($line, 7));
                }
                $pos = strpos($line, '=');
                if ($pos === false) {
                    continue;
                }
                $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $pos));
                $value = trim(substr($line, $pos + 1));
                if ($key === '') {
                    continue;
                }
                if ($value !== '' && (($value[0] === '"' && substr($value, -1) === '"') || ($value[0] === "'" && substr($value, -1) === "'"))) {
                    $quote = $value[0];
                    $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
                    if ($quote === '"') {
                        $value = stripcslashes($value);
                    }
                }
                $values[$key] = $value;
                if (getenv($key) === false) {
                    putenv($key . '=' . $value);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    $cache = $values;
    return $cache;
}

function aiflex_env_get(string $key, ?string $default = null): ?string
{
    $values = aiflex_env_load('/var/www/.env.master');
    if (array_key_exists($key, $values) && $values[$key] !== '') {
        return $values[$key];
    }
    $env = getenv($key);
    if (is_string($env) && $env !== '') {
        return $env;
    }
    return $default;
}

function aiflex_api_base_url(): string
{
    return rtrim((string)aiflex_env_get('AIFLEX_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.maxflex.ai'), '/');
}

function aiflex_api_request(string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null): array
{
    $apiKey = (string)aiflex_env_get('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY', '');
    if ($apiKey === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY is not configured.');
    }
    $ch = curl_init(aiflex_api_base_url() . $path);
    if ($ch === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize HTTP client.');
    }
    $headers = [
        'Accept: application/json',
        'X-System-Api-Key: ' . $apiKey,
        'X-Caller-System: aiflex.info',
    ];
    $options = [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => strtoupper($method),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 120,
        CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 20,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
    ];
    if ($body !== null) {
        $encoded = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if (!is_string($encoded)) {
            curl_close($ch);
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode request body.');
        }
        $headers[] = 'Content-Type: application/json';
        $options[CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER] = $headers;
        $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $encoded;
    }
    curl_setopt_array($ch, $options);
    $raw = curl_exec($ch);
    $error = curl_error($ch);
    $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);
    if ($raw === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('API request failed: ' . $error);
    }
    $decoded = json_decode((string)$raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Invalid API response received.');
    }
    if ($status >= 400 || (($decoded['status'] ?? '') === 'error')) {
        throw new RuntimeException((string)($decoded['message'] ?? ('HTTP ' . $status)));
    }
    return is_array($decoded['data'] ?? null) ? $decoded['data'] : [];
}

function aiflex_h(mixed $value): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars((string)$value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

function aiflex_param(string $key): string
{
    $value = $_GET[$key] ?? '';
    if (is_array($value)) {
        $value = reset($value);
    }
    return trim((string)$value);
}

function aiflex_int_param(string $key): ?int
{
    $value = str_replace([',', ' '], '', aiflex_param($key));
    if ($value === '' || !is_numeric($value)) {
        return null;
    }
    return max(0, (int)$value);
}

function aiflex_float_param(string $key): ?float
{
    $value = str_replace([',', ' '], '', aiflex_param($key));
    if ($value === '' || !is_numeric($value)) {
        return null;
    }
    $number = (float)$value;
    return $number < 0 ? 0.0 : $number;
}

function aiflex_date_param(string $key): ?string
{
    $value = aiflex_param($key);
    if ($value === '') {
        return null;
    }
    $dt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', $value);
    if (!$dt instanceof DateTimeImmutable || $dt->format('Y-m-d') !== $value) {
        return null;
    }
    return $value;
}

function aiflex_limit_number(array $model, string $key): ?int
{
    $limits = is_array($model['limits'] ?? null) ? $model['limits'] : [];
    if (!array_key_exists($key, $limits) || $limits[$key] === null || $limits[$key] === '') {
        return null;
    }
    return is_numeric($limits[$key]) ? (int)$limits[$key] : null;
}

function aiflex_limit_display(array $model, string $key): string
{
    $value = aiflex_limit_number($model, $key);
    return $value === null ? 'Unknown' : number_format($value);
}

function aiflex_source_type(array $model, string $field): string
{
    $provenance = is_array($model['provenance'] ?? null) ? $model['provenance'] : [];
    $sources = is_array($provenance['field_sources'] ?? null) ? $provenance['field_sources'] : [];
    return strtolower(trim((string)($sources[$field]['source_type'] ?? 'unknown')));
}

function aiflex_namespace(array $model): string
{
    $modelId = (string)($model['model_id'] ?? '');
    $pos = strpos($modelId, '/');
    return $pos === false ? '' : strtolower(substr($modelId, 0, $pos));
}

function aiflex_model_families(array $model): array
{
    $text = strtolower((string)($model['label'] ?? '') . ' ' . (string)($model['model_id'] ?? '') . ' ' . (string)($model['canonical_model_id'] ?? ''));
    $families = [];
    $checks = [
        'Claude Haiku' => ['claude-haiku', 'claude haiku'],
        'Claude Sonnet' => ['claude-sonnet', 'claude sonnet'],
        'Claude Opus' => ['claude-opus', 'claude opus'],
        'Claude' => ['claude'],
        'Gemini Flash-Lite' => ['gemini flash-lite', 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite', 'gemini-flash-lite'],
        'Gemini Flash' => ['gemini flash', 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-3-flash', 'gemini-flash-latest'],
        'Gemini Pro' => ['gemini pro', 'gemini-1.5-pro', 'gemini-2.5-pro', 'gemini-3-pro', 'gemini-3.1-pro', 'gemini-pro-latest'],
        'Gemini' => ['gemini'],
        'GPT-4o' => ['gpt-4o'],
        'GPT-4.1' => ['gpt-4.1'],
        'GPT-5' => ['gpt-5'],
        'GPT-4' => ['gpt-4'],
        'GPT' => ['gpt'],
        'o-series' => ['o1', 'o3', 'o4'],
        'Gemma' => ['gemma'],
        'Imagen' => ['imagen'],
        'Veo' => ['veo'],
        'Lyria' => ['lyria'],
        'TTS' => ['tts', 'text to speech', 'text-to-speech', 'speech', 'voice'],
        'Embedding' => ['embedding', 'embed'],
        'Image generation' => ['image_generation', 'image generation', 'flux', 'imagen', 'nano banana'],
        'Video generation' => ['video_generation', 'video generation', 'veo', 'video'],
        'Llama' => ['llama'],
    ];
    foreach ($checks as $label => $needles) {
        foreach ($needles as $needle) {
            if (str_contains($text, $needle)) {
                $families[$label] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return array_keys($families);
}

function aiflex_model_capability_groups(array $model): array
{
    $capabilities = is_array($model['capabilities'] ?? null) ? $model['capabilities'] : [];
    $groups = [];
    $map = [
        'text' => ['text', 'supports_text'],
        'vision' => ['vision', 'image_input'],
        'audio' => ['audio'],
        'tools' => ['tools', 'supports_tools'],
        'json' => ['supports_json', 'structured_outputs'],
        'streaming' => ['supports_streaming'],
        'reasoning' => ['reasoning', 'thinking', 'effort'],
        'code_execution' => ['code_execution'],
        'batch' => ['batch'],
        'citations' => ['citations'],
        'pdf_input' => ['pdf_input'],
        'text_to_speech' => ['text_to_speech'],
        'image_generation' => ['image_generation'],
        'multilingual' => ['multilingual'],
        'low_latency' => ['low_latency'],
        'discovery_only' => ['discovery_only'],
    ];
    foreach ($map as $group => $keys) {
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!empty($capabilities[$key])) {
                $groups[$group] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return array_keys($groups);
}

function aiflex_has_any_limit(array $model): bool
{
    return aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_input_tokens') !== null || aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_context_tokens') !== null || aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_output_tokens') !== null;
}

function aiflex_measure_matches(array $model, string $key, ?int $min, ?int $max): bool
{
    if ($min === null && $max === null) {
        return true;
    }
    $value = aiflex_limit_number($model, $key);
    if ($value === null) {
        return false;
    }
    if ($min !== null && $value < $min) {
        return false;
    }
    if ($max !== null && $value > $max) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

function aiflex_badge(string $text, string $class = ''): string
{
    return '<span class="badge ' . aiflex_h($class) . '">' . aiflex_h($text) . '</span>';
}

function aiflex_selected(string $actual, string $expected): string
{
    return $actual === $expected ? ' selected' : '';
}

function aiflex_input_value(string $key): string
{
    return aiflex_h(aiflex_param($key));
}

function aiflex_pricing(array $model): array
{
    return is_array($model['pricing'] ?? null) ? $model['pricing'] : [];
}

function aiflex_pricing_has_value(array $model): bool
{
    foreach (aiflex_pricing($model) as $value) {
        if ($value !== null && $value !== '' && (is_numeric($value) || is_string($value))) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

function aiflex_pricing_values(array $model): array
{
    $pricing = aiflex_pricing($model);
    $values = [];
    foreach (['input_per_1m_usd', 'output_per_1m_usd', 'character_per_1k_usd', 'usd'] as $key) {
        if (isset($pricing[$key]) && is_numeric($pricing[$key])) {
            $values[] = (float)$pricing[$key];
        }
    }
    return $values;
}

function aiflex_pricing_matches(array $model, ?float $min, ?float $max): bool
{
    if ($min === null && $max === null) {
        return true;
    }
    $values = aiflex_pricing_values($model);
    if (empty($values)) {
        return false;
    }
    foreach ($values as $value) {
        if ($min !== null && $value < $min) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($max !== null && $value > $max) {
            continue;
        }
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

function aiflex_pricing_display(array $model): string
{
    $pricing = aiflex_pricing($model);
    if (empty($pricing)) {
        return 'Unknown';
    }

    $lines = [];

    if (isset($pricing['input_per_1m_usd']) && is_numeric($pricing['input_per_1m_usd'])) {
        $lines[] = 'Input: $' . aiflex_format_price_number((float)$pricing['input_per_1m_usd']) . '/1M';
    }
    if (isset($pricing['output_per_1m_usd']) && is_numeric($pricing['output_per_1m_usd'])) {
        $lines[] = 'Output: $' . aiflex_format_price_number((float)$pricing['output_per_1m_usd']) . '/1M';
    }
    if (isset($pricing['character_per_1k_usd']) && is_numeric($pricing['character_per_1k_usd'])) {
        $lines[] = 'Characters: $' . aiflex_format_price_number((float)$pricing['character_per_1k_usd']) . '/1K';
    }
    if (isset($pricing['usd']) && is_numeric($pricing['usd'])) {
        $unit = trim((string)($pricing['run_unit'] ?? 'run'));
        if ($unit === '') {
            $unit = 'run';
        }
        $lines[] = '$' . aiflex_format_price_number((float)$pricing['usd']) . '/' . $unit;
    }

    if (empty($lines)) {
        $pairs = [];
        foreach ($pricing as $key => $value) {
            if ($value === null || $value === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $pairs[] = str_replace('_', ' ', (string)$key) . ': ' . (string)$value;
        }
        return empty($pairs) ? 'Unknown' : implode(' · ', $pairs);
    }

    return implode(' · ', $lines);
}

function aiflex_format_price_number(float $value): string
{
    $formatted = number_format($value, 6, '.', '');
    return rtrim(rtrim($formatted, '0'), '.');
}

function aiflex_provider_created_at(array $model): ?string
{
    $timestamps = is_array($model['timestamps'] ?? null) ? $model['timestamps'] : [];
    $value = trim((string)($timestamps['provider_created_at'] ?? ''));
    return $value === '' ? null : $value;
}

function aiflex_date_only(?string $value): ?string
{
    if ($value === null || trim($value) === '') {
        return null;
    }
    try {
        $dt = new DateTimeImmutable($value);
        return $dt->format('Y-m-d');
    } catch (Throwable) {
        return null;
    }
}

function aiflex_published_age_options(): array
{
    return [
        '' => 'Any age',
        '30d' => 'Last 30 days',
        '90d' => 'Last 90 days',
        '6m' => 'Last 6 months',
        '12m' => 'Last 12 months',
        '24m' => 'Last 24 months',
    ];
}

function aiflex_age_cutoff_date(?string $age): ?string
{
    $age = trim((string)$age);
    if ($age === '') {
        return null;
    }

    $map = [
        '30d' => 'P30D',
        '90d' => 'P90D',
        '6m' => 'P6M',
        '12m' => 'P12M',
        '24m' => 'P24M',
    ];

    if (!isset($map[$age])) {
        return null;
    }

    $today = new DateTimeImmutable('today');
    return $today->sub(new DateInterval($map[$age]))->format('Y-m-d');
}

function aiflex_effective_date_from(?string $manualFrom, ?string $ageCutoff): ?string
{
    if ($manualFrom === null) {
        return $ageCutoff;
    }
    if ($ageCutoff === null) {
        return $manualFrom;
    }
    return $manualFrom >= $ageCutoff ? $manualFrom : $ageCutoff;
}

function aiflex_date_matches(array $model, ?string $from, ?string $to): bool
{
    if ($from === null && $to === null) {
        return true;
    }
    $date = aiflex_date_only(aiflex_provider_created_at($model));
    if ($date === null) {
        return false;
    }
    if ($from !== null && $date < $from) {
        return false;
    }
    if ($to !== null && $date > $to) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

$facets = [

];

$publishedAgeOptions = aiflex_published_age_options();
if (!array_key_exists($filters['published_age'], $publishedAgeOptions)) {
    $filters['published_age'] = '';
}
$ageCutoffDate = aiflex_age_cutoff_date($filters['published_age']);
$effectivePublishedDateFrom = aiflex_effective_date_from($filters['published_date_from'], $ageCutoffDate);
$effectivePublishedDateTo = $filters['published_date_to'];

try {
    $payload = aiflex_api_request('GET', '/v1/catalog');
    $catalog = is_array($payload['catalog'] ?? null) ? $payload['catalog'] : [];
    $summary = is_array($payload['summary'] ?? null) ? $payload['summary'] : aiflex_api_request('GET', '/v1/catalog/summary');

    foreach ($catalog as $model) {
        $provider = strtolower((string)($model['provider'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $availability = strtolower((string)($model['availability'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $reliability = strtolower((string)($model['reliability']['overall'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $namespace = aiflex_namespace($model);
        $facets['provider'][$provider] = true;
        $facets['availability'][$availability] = true;
        $facets['reliability'][$reliability] = true;
        $facets['label_source'][aiflex_source_type($model, 'label')] = true;
        $facets['limits_source'][aiflex_source_type($model, 'limits')] = true;
        $facets['capabilities_source'][aiflex_source_type($model, 'capabilities')] = true;
        $facets['pricing_source'][aiflex_source_type($model, 'pricing')] = true;
        if ($namespace !== '') {
            $facets['namespace'][$namespace] = true;
        }
        foreach (aiflex_model_capability_groups($model) as $capability) {
            $facets['capability'][$capability] = true;
        }
        foreach (aiflex_model_families($model) as $family) {
            $facets['family'][$family] = true;
        }
    }
    foreach ($facets as $key => $values) {
        $labels = array_keys($values);
        natcasesort($labels);
        $facets[$key] = array_values($labels);
    }

    foreach ($catalog as $model) {
        $provider = strtolower((string)($model['provider'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $availability = strtolower((string)($model['availability'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $reliability = strtolower((string)($model['reliability']['overall'] ?? 'unknown'));
        $enabled = !empty($model['enabled']) ? '1' : '0';
        $namespace = aiflex_namespace($model);
        $capabilityGroups = aiflex_model_capability_groups($model);
        $families = aiflex_model_families($model);

        if ($filters['provider'] !== '' && $provider !== $filters['provider']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['availability'] !== '' && $availability !== $filters['availability']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['reliability'] !== '' && $reliability !== $filters['reliability']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['enabled'] !== '' && $enabled !== $filters['enabled']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['capability'] !== '' && !in_array($filters['capability'], $capabilityGroups, true)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['label_source'] !== '' && aiflex_source_type($model, 'label') !== $filters['label_source']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits_source'] !== '' && aiflex_source_type($model, 'limits') !== $filters['limits_source']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['capabilities_source'] !== '' && aiflex_source_type($model, 'capabilities') !== $filters['capabilities_source']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['pricing_source'] !== '' && aiflex_source_type($model, 'pricing') !== $filters['pricing_source']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['namespace'] !== '' && $namespace !== $filters['namespace']) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['family'] !== '' && !in_array($filters['family'], $families, true)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits'] === 'known' && !aiflex_has_any_limit($model)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits'] === 'missing' && aiflex_has_any_limit($model)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits'] === 'input_known' && aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_input_tokens') === null) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits'] === 'context_known' && aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_context_tokens') === null) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['limits'] === 'output_known' && aiflex_limit_number($model, 'max_output_tokens') === null) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!aiflex_measure_matches($model, 'max_input_tokens', $filters['input_cutoff_min'], $filters['input_cutoff_max'])) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!aiflex_measure_matches($model, 'max_context_tokens', $filters['context_window_min'], $filters['context_window_max'])) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!aiflex_measure_matches($model, 'max_output_tokens', $filters['output_cutoff_min'], $filters['output_cutoff_max'])) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!aiflex_pricing_matches($model, $filters['pricing_min'], $filters['pricing_max'])) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!aiflex_date_matches($model, $effectivePublishedDateFrom, $effectivePublishedDateTo)) {
            continue;
        }
        if ($filters['q'] !== '') {
            $haystack = strtolower(implode(' ', [
                (string)($model['label'] ?? ''),
                (string)($model['model_id'] ?? ''),
                (string)($model['canonical_model_id'] ?? ''),
                (string)($model['provider'] ?? ''),
                implode(' ', $families),
                implode(' ', $capabilityGroups),
                $namespace,
                aiflex_pricing_display($model),
                aiflex_source_type($model, 'pricing'),
                (string)(aiflex_date_only(aiflex_provider_created_at($model)) ?? ''),
            ]));
            if (!str_contains($haystack, strtolower($filters['q']))) {
                continue;
            }
        }
        $filteredCatalog[] = $model;
    }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    $errorMessage = $e->getMessage();
}

$host = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? 'aiflex.info');
$advancedOpen = $filters['input_cutoff_min'] !== null
    || $filters['input_cutoff_max'] !== null
    || $filters['context_window_min'] !== null
    || $filters['context_window_max'] !== null
    || $filters['output_cutoff_min'] !== null
    || $filters['output_cutoff_max'] !== null
    || $filters['pricing_min'] !== null
    || $filters['pricing_max'] !== null
    || $filters['published_age'] !== ''
    || $filters['published_date_from'] !== null
    || $filters['published_date_to'] !== null
    || $filters['label_source'] !== ''
    || $filters['limits_source'] !== ''
    || $filters['capabilities_source'] !== ''
    || $filters['pricing_source'] !== ''
    || $filters['enabled'] !== ''
    || $filters['namespace'] !== ''
    || $filters['family'] !== '';

            <div class='filter-field'><label for='availability'>Availability</label><select id='availability' name='availability'><option value=''>All availability</option><?php foreach ($facets['availability'] as $value): ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['availability'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div>
            <div class='filter-field'><label for='reliability'>Reliability</label><select id='reliability' name='reliability'><option value=''>All reliability</option><?php foreach ($facets['reliability'] as $value): ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['reliability'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div>
            <div class='filter-field'><label for='capability'>Capability</label><select id='capability' name='capability'><option value=''>All capabilities</option><?php foreach ($facets['capability'] as $value): ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['capability'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h(str_replace('_', ' ', $value)); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div>

                    <div class='measure-box'><strong>Context Window</strong><div class='subtle'>Total token working window available to the model.</div><div class='measure-inputs'><input name='context_window_min' inputmode='numeric' value='<?php echo aiflex_input_value('context_window_min'); ?>' placeholder='No minimum'><input name='context_window_max' inputmode='numeric' value='<?php echo aiflex_input_value('context_window_max'); ?>' placeholder='No maximum'></div></div>

If both are used, the later minimum date is applied.</div><div class='measure-inputs'><select name='published_age'><option value=''>Any age</option><?php foreach ($publishedAgeOptions as $value => $label): ?><?php if ($value === '') { continue; } ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['published_age'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h($label); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div><div class='measure-inputs'><input type='date' name='published_date_from' value='<?php echo aiflex_input_value('published_date_from'); ?>' placeholder='Oldest date'><input type='date' name='published_date_to' value='<?php echo aiflex_input_value('published_date_to'); ?>' placeholder='Latest date'></div></div>

                    <div class='filter-field'><label for='label_source'>Label source</label><select id='label_source' name='label_source'><option value=''>Any source</option><?php foreach ($facets['label_source'] as $value): ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['label_source'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div>
                    <div class='filter-field'><label for='limits_source'>Limits source</label><select id='limits_source' name='limits_source'><option value=''>Any source</option><?php foreach ($facets['limits_source'] as $value): ?><option value='<?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?>'<?php echo aiflex_selected($filters['limits_source'], $value); ?>><?php echo aiflex_h($value); ?></option><?php endforeach; ?></select></div>

    <div class='table-wrap'>
        <table>
            <thead><tr><th>Model</th><th>Provider</th><th>Capabilities</th><th>Token cutoffs</th><th>Pricing</th><th>Availability</th><th>Reliability</th><th>Timestamps</th><th>Provenance</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
            <?php if (empty($filteredCatalog)): ?>
                <tr><td colspan='9'><?php echo $errorMessage === null ? 'No catalog records match the current filters.' : 'Catalog data could not be displayed.'; ?></td></tr>
            <?php else: ?>
                <?php foreach ($filteredCatalog as $model): ?>
                    <?php
                        $provider = (string)($model['provider'] ?? 'unknown');
                        $label = (string)($model['label'] ?? ($model['model_id'] ?? 'Unknown model'));
                        $modelId = (string)($model['model_id'] ?? '');
                        $canonicalId = (string)($model['canonical_model_id'] ?? '');
                        $availability = (string)($model['availability'] ?? 'unknown');
                        $enabled = !empty($model['enabled']);
                        $capabilities = is_array($model['capabilities'] ?? null) ? $model['capabilities'] : [];
                        $timestamps = is_array($model['timestamps'] ?? null) ? $model['timestamps'] : [];
                        $reliability = is_array($model['reliability'] ?? null) ? $model['reliability'] : [];
                        $provenance = is_array($model['provenance'] ?? null) ? $model['provenance'] : [];
                        $fieldSources = is_array($provenance['field_sources'] ?? null) ? $provenance['field_sources'] : [];
                        $families = aiflex_model_families($model);
                        $namespace = aiflex_namespace($model);
                        $pricingText = aiflex_pricing_display($model);
                    ?>
                    <tr>
                        <td>
                            <div class='cell-stack'>
                                <div>
                                    <div class='model-title'><?php echo aiflex_h($label); ?></div>
                                    <div class='code'><?php echo aiflex_h($canonicalId !== '' ? $canonicalId : $modelId); ?></div>
                                </div>
                                <?php if (!empty($families)): ?>
                                    <div class='badges'><?php foreach ($families as $family): ?><?php echo aiflex_badge($family); ?><?php endforeach; ?></div>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                                <?php if ($namespace !== ''): ?>
                                    <div class='subtle'>Namespace: <?php echo aiflex_h($namespace); ?></div>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class='cell-stack'>
                                <div><?php echo aiflex_badge($provider); ?></div>
                                <div class='subtle'><?php echo $enabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled'; ?></div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class='badges'><?php if (!empty($capabilities)): ?><?php foreach ($capabilities as $capability => $value): ?><?php if ($value): ?><?php echo aiflex_badge((string)$capability, 'ok'); ?><?php endif; ?><?php endforeach; ?><?php else: ?><?php echo aiflex_badge('none listed', 'warn'); ?><?php endif; ?></div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <ul class='kv-list'>
                                <li><strong>Input Cutoff:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h(aiflex_limit_display($model, 'max_input_tokens')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Context Window:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h(aiflex_limit_display($model, 'max_context_tokens')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Output Cutoff:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h(aiflex_limit_display($model, 'max_output_tokens')); ?></li>
                            </ul>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <div class='pricing-text<?php echo aiflex_pricing_has_value($model) ? '' : ' pricing-unknown'; ?>'><?php echo aiflex_h($pricingText); ?></div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <?php echo aiflex_badge($availability, $availability === 'available' || $availability === 'cataloged' ? 'ok' : 'warn'); ?>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <?php echo aiflex_badge((string)($reliability['overall'] ?? 'unknown'), ((string)($reliability['overall'] ?? '')) === 'high' ? 'ok' : 'warn'); ?>
                            <?php $reliabilityFields = is_array($reliability['fields'] ?? null) ? $reliability['fields'] : []; ?>
                            <?php if (!empty($reliabilityFields)): ?>
                                <ul class='kv-list' style='margin-top:8px'><?php foreach ($reliabilityFields as $fieldName => $fieldLevel): ?><li><strong><?php echo aiflex_h((string)$fieldName); ?>:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)$fieldLevel); ?></li><?php endforeach; ?></ul>
                            <?php endif; ?>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <ul class='kv-list'>
                                <li><strong>Collected:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($timestamps['collected_at'] ?? '—')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Verified:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($timestamps['verified_at'] ?? '—')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Provider Created:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($timestamps['provider_created_at'] ?? '—')); ?></li>
                            </ul>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                            <ul class='kv-list'>
                                <li><strong>Provider:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($provenance['provider'] ?? $provider)); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Label source:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($fieldSources['label']['source_type'] ?? 'unknown')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Limits source:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($fieldSources['limits']['source_type'] ?? 'unknown')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Capabilities source:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($fieldSources['capabilities']['source_type'] ?? 'unknown')); ?></li>
                                <li><strong>Pricing source:</strong> <?php echo aiflex_h((string)($fieldSources['pricing']['source_type'] ?? 'unknown')); ?></li>
                            </ul>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                <?php endforeach; ?>
            <?php endif; ?>
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <div class='footer-note'>This page performs authenticated server-side API requests only. No private API key is exposed to the browser. Refresh actions are intentionally restricted to APRO per project design.</div>
</div>
</body>
</html>

# AI Model Catalog Data Summary

## Purpose

This document summarizes the current published AI Model Discovery catalog served by `api.maxflex.ai` after the provider metadata normalization upgrades for Anthropic, Gemini, and OpenAI, including Gemini provider-created date remediation and Gemini pricing-source expansion.

This summary is intended to give developers, sponsors, UAT, and downstream consumers a concise understanding of the current catalog quality, coverage, provenance posture, and known limitations without requiring attachment of the full rendered AIFLEX catalog output.

## Current Snapshot Summary

- Published model count: 198
- Current published timestamp observed in catalog output: 2026-05-11T19:19:30+00:00 to 2026-05-11T19:19:33+00:00 collection window
- Current public read-only display surface: `aiflex.info`
- Current administrative control surface: `apro.maxflex.ai`
- Private data service: `api.maxflex.ai`
- Refresh authority: APRO only
- API visibility: private only
- Current catalog output shape includes:
  - normalized canonical ids
  - enabled state
  - availability
  - capabilities
  - normalized token limits
  - pricing
  - timestamps
  - field-level provenance
  - field-level reliability
  - raw provider payload

## Current Provider Distribution

| Provider | Row count | General notes |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| anthropic | 9 | All displayed Anthropic rows now show curated labels, curated capabilities, curated limits, curated pricing, and provider-created dates. |
| gemini | 50 | Gemini rows now all display a valid Model Date. Pricing is available for a meaningful curated subset plus some provider-pricing-derived rows, but many Gemini specialty/media/preview rows still remain unknown for pricing. |
| openai | 114 | OpenAI has broad provider catalog coverage with curated metadata concentrated on core GPT and o-series families; many peripheral audio/realtime/image variants still remain unknown for limits and pricing. |
| replicate | 25 | Discovery-only informational rows from provider API. Limits and pricing remain mostly unknown except where selectively curated. |
| elevenlabs | 0 standalone provider rows | ElevenLabs remains in provider scope, but no standalone `elevenlabs` catalog rows are present in the displayed snapshot. |

Provider row counts total 198.

## Current Availability Distribution

| Availability | Count | Notes |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| available | 171 | Main provider-available catalog rows |
| cataloged | 27 | Rows enriched and published with curated metadata posture |
| discovery_only | 25 | Informational discovery rows, especially Replicate-hosted specialty models |

Note: counts reflect the currently displayed catalog behavior and may vary slightly on later refreshes if provider catalogs change.

## Reliability Summary

The current catalog now has materially improved high-reliability coverage compared with the initial implementation.

### High-reliability pattern
Rows marked high now generally have:
- curated label metadata
- curated or normalized limits
- curated or authoritative pricing where available
- provenance showing `curated_metadata`, `provider_api`, `provider_pricing`, or `provider_pricing_derived`

### API-only pattern
Rows marked `api_only` still usually mean:
- label came from provider API
- limits may be unknown or only lightly normalized
- capabilities may be unknown
- pricing may be unknown

## Field-Level Provenance Model

The current catalog exposes provenance by field rather than by row only.

Common field sources now observed in the published catalog include:
- `provider_api`
- `curated_metadata`
- `provider_pricing`
- `provider_pricing_derived`
- `unknown`

This applies especially to:
- label source
- limits source
- capabilities source
- pricing source
- provider_created_at source

## Current Anthropic Summary

Anthropic is now strongly improved relative to the original state.

### Anthropic row count
- 9 rows

### Current Anthropic metadata posture
All displayed Anthropic rows now show:
- curated label metadata
- curated pricing
- curated normalized token limits
- curated capability metadata
- provider-created dates populated
- high overall reliability

### Anthropic cataloged families observed
- Claude Haiku 4.5
- Claude Opus 4.1
- Claude Opus 4
- Claude Opus 4.5
- Claude Opus 4.6
- Claude Opus 4.7
- Claude Sonnet 4
- Claude Sonnet 4.5
- Claude Sonnet 4.6

### Anthropic capabilities now observed in catalog
Depending on the specific Claude line, the current snapshot includes capability keys such as:
- `text`
- `vision`
- `tools`
- `reasoning`
- `structured_outputs`
- `code_execution`
- `batch`
- `citations`
- `pdf_input`
- `image_input`
- `thinking`
- `effort`

### Anthropic current limit coverage
Examples from current display:
- Haiku 4.5: input/context 200,000; output 64,000
- Opus 4.6 / 4.7: input/context 1,000,000; output 128,000
- Sonnet 4 / 4.5 / 4.6: input/context up to 1,000,000; output up to 128,000

### Anthropic current pricing coverage
Examples from current display:
- Claude Haiku 4.5: input $1/1M, output $5/1M
- Claude Sonnet family: input $3/1M, output $15/1M
- Claude Opus family: input $15/1M, output $75/1M

## Current Gemini Summary

Gemini has improved substantially from the original state, especially on model dates and on pricing for major Gemini text families.

### Gemini row count
- 50 rows

### Gemini model date status
The previous major defect where all Gemini rows displayed `Model Date: unknown` has been remediated.

All currently displayed Gemini rows now show a populated `Provider Created` date value, sourced by one of:
- curated metadata in `metadata/gemini_models.json`
- provider API fields when present
- provider-derived dating from model/version naming where necessary

### Gemini metadata posture by family
Gemini rows currently fall into several buckets:

1. **Core curated Gemini text families**
   - Gemini 2.0 Flash / Flash-Lite
   - Gemini 2.5 Flash / Flash-Lite / Pro
   - Gemini 3 Flash Preview
   - Gemini 3 Pro Preview
   - Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
   - Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
   - Gemini Flash Latest / Flash-Lite Latest / Pro Latest

   These generally show:
   - curated label
   - curated pricing
   - curated capabilities
   - curated limits
   - high reliability

2. **Provider-limits-only or partially enriched Gemini rows**
   - native audio preview rows
   - preview TTS rows
   - research preview rows
   - robotics preview rows
   - embeddings
   - Gemma rows
   - Veo / Imagen / Lyria / Nano Banana image/video/media rows

   These often show:
   - curated label
   - valid provider-created date
   - provider-derived limits from API token fields
   - unknown capabilities
   - unknown pricing for many rows

3. **Provider-pricing-derived Gemini rows**
   Some rows now show pricing source `provider_pricing_derived`, meaning pricing was inferred from authoritative Google pricing definitions at the family level when not explicitly curated per exact model id.

   Example observed rows:
   - `gemini:gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts`
   - `gemini:gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools`

### Gemini pricing source implementation now in product
Gemini pricing enrichment now uses the following hierarchy:
1. curated metadata in `metadata/gemini_models.json`
2. authoritative provider pricing ingestion from:
   - `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing`
   - `https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing`
3. family-level fallback mapping in provider logic
4. unknown if no confident pricing match is available

### Why many Gemini rows still show Unknown pricing
The current output still shows many Gemini rows with `Pricing: Unknown` because a large portion of the Gemini-discovered catalog consists of specialty, preview, media, embedding, robotics, or nonstandard variants such as:
- audio-native preview models
- TTS preview variants
- embedding models
- Imagen image-generation rows
- Veo video-generation rows
- Lyria media/audio rows
- Nano Banana image-family rows
- robotics preview models
- research preview rows

For many of these rows, the currently implemented authoritative pricing ingestion does not yet produce a confident exact-model pricing mapping in the live catalog, so the API intentionally leaves pricing unknown rather than inventing unsupported commercial metadata.

### Gemini pricing coverage observed in current display
The current AIFLEX output shows pricing on major text families such as:
- Gemini 2.0 Flash
- Gemini 2.0 Flash 001
- Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite
- Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite 001
- Gemini 2.5 Flash
- Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
- Gemini 2.5 Pro
- Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview TTS (provider_pricing_derived)
- Gemini 3 Flash Preview
- Gemini 3 Pro Preview
- Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
- Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
- Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Custom Tools (provider_pricing_derived)
- Gemini Flash Latest
- Gemini Flash-Lite Latest
- Gemini Pro Latest

Rows such as AQA, Deep Research previews, native audio previews, many TTS/image/video/media rows, embeddings, robotics, Veo, Imagen, Lyria, Gemma, and Nano Banana rows still show unknown pricing in the displayed catalog.

### Gemini limits coverage observed in current display
Gemini limit coverage is now much better than the original state because provider API token limits are normalized into:
- `limits.max_input_tokens`
- `limits.max_context_tokens`
- `limits.max_output_tokens`

This means even many Gemini rows with unknown pricing still have useful token cutoffs shown.

### Gemini family examples from current display
- Gemini 2.0 Flash: input/context 1,000,000, output 8,192, curated pricing
- Gemini 2.5 Flash: input/context 1,048,576, output 65,536, curated pricing
- Gemini 2.5 Pro: input/context 1,048,576, output 65,536, curated pricing
- Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview: input/context 1,048,576, output 65,536, curated pricing
- Imagen 4 / Veo / Lyria: limits often present from provider API, pricing often still unknown

## Current OpenAI Summary

OpenAI remains the largest provider in the current published catalog.

### OpenAI row count
- 114 rows

### Current OpenAI metadata posture
OpenAI currently shows two broad groups:

1. **Curated major runtime families**
   Examples include:
   - GPT-4.1
   - GPT-4.1 Mini
   - GPT-4.1 Nano
   - GPT-4o
   - GPT-4o Mini
   - GPT-5
   - GPT-5 Mini
   - GPT-5 Nano
   - o1
   - o1 Pro
   - o3
   - o3 Mini
   - o4 Mini

   These generally show:
   - curated label
   - curated limits
   - curated capabilities
   - curated pricing
   - high reliability

2. **Provider-catalog-only variants**
   Many OpenAI audio, image, realtime, search, and dated preview/version rows still remain:
   - provider_api labeled
   - unknown limits
   - unknown capabilities
   - unknown pricing
   - medium / api_only reliability

### OpenAI current pricing coverage
Pricing is now visible for many major OpenAI runtime families, especially core GPT and o-series models.

Examples from current display:
- GPT-4.1: input $2/1M, output $8/1M
- GPT-4o: input $5/1M, output $15/1M
- GPT-4o Mini: input $0.15/1M, output $0.6/1M
- GPT-5: input $10/1M, output $30/1M
- GPT-5 Mini: input $2/1M, output $8/1M
- GPT-5 Nano: input $0.5/1M, output $2/1M
- o1 / o3: input $15/1M, output $60/1M
- o1 Pro: input $150/1M, output $600/1M
- o3 Mini / o4 Mini: input $1.1/1M, output $4.4/1M

### OpenAI current limitations
Many OpenAI catalog variants still show unknown pricing and unknown limits because the current curated metadata set is concentrated on the main execution families rather than the full long tail of dated preview, audio, image, realtime, and search variants.

## Current Replicate Summary

Replicate rows remain discovery-only informational records.

### Replicate row count
- 25 rows

### Current Replicate metadata posture
Observed pattern from current display:
- availability is `discovery_only`
- reliability is `api_only`
- label source is usually `provider_api`
- limits source is usually `unknown`
- capabilities source is usually `unknown`
- pricing source is usually `unknown`

Replicate currently serves primarily as a broad discovery surface rather than a fully normalized cost-control catalog.

### Representative namespaces observed
- `deepseek-ai`
- `meta`
- `openai`
- `xai`
- `elevenlabs`
- `prunaai`
- `qwen`
- `sync`
- `lucataco`
- and others

## Current ElevenLabs Summary

### Standalone ElevenLabs rows
- none in currently displayed catalog

### Notes
- ElevenLabs remains in provider scope in the API
- ElevenLabs metadata file exists
- no standalone `elevenlabs` rows appear in the displayed catalog snapshot
- one Replicate-hosted ElevenLabs row is present under Replicate namespace

## Token Limit Labeling in Consumers

The currently published catalog supports the following normalized measure labels used by consumers:

| Technical field | Display label | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limits.max_input_tokens` | Input Cutoff | Maximum number of input tokens the model can accept in one prompt or request |
| `limits.max_context_tokens` | Context Window | Total token working window available to the model |
| `limits.max_output_tokens` | Output Cutoff | Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in one response |

Important rule still in force:
- Context Window must not be treated as a fake Input Cutoff when `max_input_tokens` is unknown.

## Current Catalog Strengths

The upgraded API now demonstrably provides:
- strong Anthropic coverage for major Claude families with curated pricing and limits
- strong Gemini date coverage for all displayed Gemini rows
- materially improved Gemini limits coverage
- materially improved Gemini pricing coverage for major Gemini text families
- strong OpenAI pricing and limit coverage for major GPT and o-series families
- field-level provenance for label, capabilities, limits, pricing, and provider-created dates
- reliable downstream rendering in AIFLEX and APRO without exposing secrets client-side

## Current Catalog Limitations

Despite the upgrades, the current catalog still has important limitations:

1. **Gemini specialty model pricing remains incomplete**
   Many Gemini media/image/video/audio/embedding/preview rows still show unknown pricing.

2. **OpenAI long-tail variant normalization remains incomplete**
   Many OpenAI preview/audio/image/realtime/search variants still show unknown pricing and unknown limits.

3. **Replicate remains mostly discovery-only**
   Replicate rows are useful for informational breadth but are not yet deeply normalized.

4. **Capabilities taxonomy is still heterogeneous across providers**
   AIFLEX and APRO consumers may still need local grouping for best UX.

5. **Some pricing source values are derived rather than exact per-model authoritative mappings**
   This is surfaced honestly via provenance using `provider_pricing_derived` where applicable.

## Security and Runtime Notes

- `api.maxflex.ai` remains private only.
- All catalog access requires authentication.
- Refresh remains restricted to APRO.
- Internal metadata, source, and storage paths are blocked via `.htaccess`.
- Existing catalog data remains available while refreshes run.
- Refresh remains asynchronous in intent with deterministic fallback on the current host.

## Current Bottom Line

The current API catalog is materially stronger than the original implementation and now supports real downstream cost-control workflows far better than before.

Most importantly:
- Anthropic is no longer effectively metadata-empty.
- Gemini no longer shows unknown model dates across the board.
- Gemini major text families now show much better pricing coverage through curated and authoritative-provider pricing integration.
- OpenAI major execution families show strong curated pricing and limit coverage.

However, the catalog is still not perfect:
- Gemini specialty/media/preview family pricing remains only partially mapped.
- Many long-tail OpenAI and Replicate rows remain unknown for pricing and/or limits.

This document should now be treated as the current authoritative summary of the upgraded `api.maxflex.ai` catalog posture reflected by the displayed AIFLEX output.

# api.maxflex.ai

This directory is the product root for the private `api.maxflex.ai` service.

## Product Purpose
`api.maxflex.ai` is the private backend service for Flex platform API capabilities, beginning with AI Model Discovery.

## Current Approved Role
For the current project, this product hosts the centralized AI Model Discovery subsystem that:
- discovers available AI models from approved providers
- normalizes provider model data into a shared schema
- stores results centrally using SQLite
- retains full historical snapshot runs indefinitely
- exposes authenticated endpoints for catalog reads and refresh control
- enriches models with curated and provider-sourced pricing, limits, timestamps, provenance, and reliability indicators where available

## Visibility and Access
This product is **private only**.
It must not expose public unauthenticated model catalog endpoints.

Approved callers include:
- `apro.maxflex.ai`
- `aiflex.info`

Both must authenticate using the shared environment variable:
- `MF_ADMIN_API_KEY`

The existing server-to-server header convention `X-System-Api-Key` may be reused.

## Phase-1 Provider Scope
- OpenAI
- Anthropic / Claude
- Gemini
- Replicate
- ElevenLabs

## Current Metadata Notes
- Replicate and ElevenLabs remain discovery-only for current platform runtime use.
- Refresh remains asynchronous in intent with deterministic synchronous fallback on the current host.
- Existing catalog data remains available while refresh runs.
- Catalog data includes source metadata, reliability indicators, timestamps, pricing, and max limits where available.
- Gemini pricing enrichment now supports authoritative provider pricing ingestion from Google pricing documentation in addition to curated metadata and family-level fallback rules.

## Gemini Pricing Sources
The Gemini provider uses the Gemini model catalog endpoint for model discovery and supplements pricing from authoritative Google-owned pricing sources:
- `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing`
- `https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing`

These pricing definitions are normalized onto catalog models alongside curated metadata from `metadata/gemini_models.json`.

## Expected Environment Source
Shared runtime configuration is expected from:
- `/var/www/.env.master`

## Important Security Note
Do not place secrets directly in this document root.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

abstract class ApiAbstractProvider implements ApiProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        protected ApiHttpClient $httpClient,
        protected ApiEnv $env,
        protected string $metadataPath
    ) {
    }

    protected function readMetadata(): array
    {
        if (!is_file($this->metadataPath) || !is_readable($this->metadataPath)) {
            return [];
        }
        $raw = file_get_contents($this->metadataPath);
        if (!is_string($raw) || trim($raw) === '') {
            return [];
        }
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
        return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
    }

    protected function normalizeRecord(string $provider, string $modelId, array $fields, array $fieldSources): array
    {
        $canonical = $provider . ':' . $modelId;
        $limits = is_array($fields['limits'] ?? null) ? $fields['limits'] : [];
        $normalizedLimits = [];
        foreach (['max_input_tokens', 'max_context_tokens', 'max_output_tokens'] as $key) {
            if (array_key_exists($key, $limits) && $limits[$key] !== null && $limits[$key] !== '') {
                $normalizedLimits[$key] = (int)$limits[$key];
            }
        }

        return [
            'provider' => $provider,
            'model_id' => $modelId,
            'canonical_model_id' => $canonical,
            'label' => (string)($fields['label'] ?? $modelId),
            'enabled' => isset($fields['enabled']) ? (bool)$fields['enabled'] : true,
            'availability' => (string)($fields['availability'] ?? 'available'),
            'capabilities' => is_array($fields['capabilities'] ?? null) ? $fields['capabilities'] : [],
            'limits' => $normalizedLimits,
            'pricing' => is_array($fields['pricing'] ?? null) ? $fields['pricing'] : [],
            'timestamps' => [
                'collected_at' => api_now(),
                'provider_created_at' => $fields['provider_created_at'] ?? null,
                'verified_at' => api_now(),
            ],
            'reliability' => [
                'overall' => (string)($fields['reliability_overall'] ?? 'mixed'),
                'fields' => is_array($fields['reliability_fields'] ?? null) ? $fields['reliability_fields'] : [],
            ],
            'provenance' => [
                'provider' => $provider,
                'field_sources' => $fieldSources,
            ],
            'raw' => is_array($fields['raw'] ?? null) ? $fields['raw'] : [],
        ];
    }

    protected function source(string $type, string $reference, string $reliability = 'high'): array
    {
        return [
            'source_type' => $type,
            'source_reference' => $reference,
            'reliability' => $reliability,
            'collected_at' => api_now(),
        ];
    }

    protected function curatedLimitsFromMetadata(array $curated): array
    {
        $limits = [];
        if (isset($curated['limits']) && is_array($curated['limits'])) {
            foreach (['max_input_tokens', 'max_context_tokens', 'max_output_tokens'] as $key) {
                if (isset($curated['limits'][$key]) && $curated['limits'][$key] !== null && $curated['limits'][$key] !== '') {
                    $limits[$key] = (int)$curated['limits'][$key];
                }
            }
        }
        foreach (['max_input_tokens', 'max_context_tokens', 'max_output_tokens', 'context_window'] as $key) {
            if (!isset($curated[$key]) || $curated[$key] === null || $curated[$key] === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if ($key === 'context_window') {
                $limits['max_context_tokens'] = (int)$curated[$key];
            } else {
                $limits[$key] = (int)$curated[$key];
            }
        }
        return $limits;
    }

    protected function reliabilityOverall(array $capabilities, array $limits, array $pricing, bool $hasCurated): string
    {
        if ($hasCurated && (!empty($capabilities) || !empty($limits) || !empty($pricing))) {
            return 'high';
        }
        return 'api_only';
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiAiGenerationService
{
    /** @var array<string, ApiAiRuntimeInterface> */
    private array $runtimes;

    public function __construct(
        private ApiHttpClient $httpClient,
        private ApiEnv $env,
        private ApiAiResponseParser $parser,
        array $runtimes
    ) {
        $this->runtimes = [];
        foreach ($runtimes as $runtime) {
            if ($runtime instanceof ApiAiRuntimeInterface) {
                $this->runtimes[strtolower($runtime->provider())] = $runtime;
            }
        }
    }

    public function generate(array $payload, string $callerSystem): array
    {
        $caller = strtolower(trim($callerSystem));
        if ($caller === '') {
            $caller = 'unknown';
        }

        $normalized = $this->normalizeRequest($payload, $caller);
        $runtime = $this->resolveRuntime($normalized['model']['provider']);
        $template = $this->loadPromptTemplate();
        $assembledPrompt = $this->assemblePrompt($template, $normalized);

        $runtimeResponse = $runtime->generateFiles([
            'provider' => $normalized['model']['provider'],
            'model_id' => $normalized['model']['model_id'],
            'assembled_prompt' => $assembledPrompt,
            'request' => $normalized,
        ]);

        $rawAiResponse = trim((string)($runtimeResponse['raw_ai_response'] ?? ''));
        $parse = $this->parser->parseGeneratedFiles($rawAiResponse);

        return [
            'generation_id' => api_uuid_like_id('gen'),
            'provider' => $normalized['model']['provider'],
            'model_id' => $normalized['model']['model_id'],
            'parse_status' => (string)($parse['parse_status'] ?? 'failed'),
            'generated_files' => is_array($parse['generated_files'] ?? null) ? $parse['generated_files'] : [],
            'raw_ai_response' => $rawAiResponse,
            'warnings' => is_array($parse['warnings'] ?? null) ? $parse['warnings'] : [],
            'usage' => is_array($runtimeResponse['usage'] ?? null) ? $runtimeResponse['usage'] : [
                'input_tokens' => 0,
                'output_tokens' => 0,
                'total_tokens' => 0,
            ],
            'request_meta' => [
                'caller_system' => $caller,
                'selected_count' => (int)$normalized['context']['selected_count'],
                'resolved_file_count' => (int)$normalized['context']['resolved_file_count'],
            ],
            'provider_response' => is_array($runtimeResponse['provider_response'] ?? null) ? $runtimeResponse['provider_response'] : [],
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeRequest(array $payload, string $callerSystem): array
    {
        $prompt = trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? ''));
        if ($prompt === '' && isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && trim((string)$payload['prompt_b64']) !== '') {
            $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
            if ($decoded === false) {
                api_error_response('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
            }
            $prompt = trim($decoded);
        }
        if ($prompt === '') {
            api_error_response('prompt is required.', 400);
        }

        $selectedFiles = $this->normalizeSelectedFiles($payload['selected_files'] ?? null);
        if ($selectedFiles === []) {
            api_error_response('selected_files must be a non-empty array.', 400);
        }

        $model = $this->normalizeModel($payload['model'] ?? null);

        $context = is_array($payload['context'] ?? null) ? $payload['context'] : [];
        $selectedCount = isset($context['selected_count']) && is_numeric((string)$context['selected_count'])
            ? (int)$context['selected_count']
            : count($selectedFiles);
        $resolvedFileCount = isset($context['resolved_file_count']) && is_numeric((string)$context['resolved_file_count'])
            ? (int)$context['resolved_file_count']
            : count($selectedFiles);

        return [
            'prompt' => $prompt,
            'selected_files' => $selectedFiles,
            'model' => $model,
            'context' => [
                'source_system' => trim((string)($context['source_system'] ?? $callerSystem)),
                'selected_count' => $selectedCount,
                'resolved_file_count' => $resolvedFileCount,
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeSelectedFiles(mixed $input): array
    {
        if (!is_array($input) || $input === []) {
            return [];
        }

        $files = [];
        foreach ($input as $row) {
            if (!is_array($row)) {
                continue;
            }
            $path = trim((string)($row['path'] ?? $row['file_path'] ?? ''));
            $content = (string)($row['content'] ?? '');
            if ($path === '' || $content === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $files[] = [
                'path' => $path,
                'encoding' => strtolower(trim((string)($row['encoding'] ?? 'text'))) === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text',
                'truncated' => !empty($row['truncated']),
                'size_bytes' => isset($row['size_bytes']) && is_numeric((string)$row['size_bytes']) ? (int)$row['size_bytes'] : strlen($content),
                'line_count' => isset($row['line_count']) && is_numeric((string)$row['line_count']) ? (int)$row['line_count'] : null,
                'content' => $content,
            ];
        }

        return $files;
    }

    private function normalizeModel(mixed $input): array
    {
        if (!is_array($input)) {
            api_error_response('model is required.', 400);
        }

        $provider = strtolower(trim((string)($input['provider'] ?? '')));
        $modelId = trim((string)($input['model_id'] ?? $input['id'] ?? ''));
        $canonicalId = trim((string)($input['catalog_canonical_id'] ?? ''));
        $label = trim((string)($input['label'] ?? ''));

        if ($provider === '' && $canonicalId !== '' && strpos($canonicalId, ':') !== false) {
            $provider = strtolower(trim((string)substr($canonicalId, 0, strpos($canonicalId, ':'))));
        }
        if ($modelId === '' && $canonicalId !== '' && strpos($canonicalId, ':') !== false) {
            $modelId = trim((string)substr($canonicalId, strpos($canonicalId, ':') + 1));
        }

        if ($provider === '' || $modelId === '') {
            api_error_response('model.provider and model.model_id are required.', 400);
        }

        return [
            'provider' => $provider,
            'model_id' => $modelId,
            'catalog_canonical_id' => $canonicalId,
            'label' => $label,
        ];
    }

    private function resolveRuntime(string $provider): ApiAiRuntimeInterface
    {
        $key = strtolower(trim($provider));
        if (isset($this->runtimes[$key])) {
            return $this->runtimes[$key];
        }
        api_error_response('Unsupported runtime provider: ' . $provider, 400);
    }

    private function loadPromptTemplate(): string
    {
        $path = __DIR__ . '/prompts/generate_files_template.txt';
        if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Generate files prompt template is missing.');
        }
        $template = file_get_contents($path);
        if (!is_string($template) || trim($template) === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Generate files prompt template is empty.');
        }
        return trim($template);
    }

    private function assemblePrompt(string $template, array $request): string
    {
        $lines = [];
        $lines[] = $template;
        $lines[] = '';
        $lines[] = 'USER REQUEST:';
        $lines[] = $request['prompt'];
        $lines[] = '';
        $lines[] = 'REQUEST CONTEXT:';
        $lines[] = '- Source system: ' . (string)$request['context']['source_system'];
        $lines[] = '- Selected item count: ' . (string)$request['context']['selected_count'];
        $lines[] = '- Resolved file count: ' . (string)$request['context']['resolved_file_count'];
        $lines[] = '- Target provider: ' . (string)$request['model']['provider'];
        $lines[] = '- Target model: ' . (string)$request['model']['model_id'];
        $lines[] = '';

        foreach ($request['selected_files'] as $index => $file) {
            $lines[] = 'FILE ' . ($index + 1) . ':';
            $lines[] = 'Path: ' . (string)$file['path'];
            $lines[] = 'Encoding: ' . (string)$file['encoding'];
            $lines[] = 'Truncated: ' . (!empty($file['truncated']) ? 'yes' : 'no');
            $lines[] = 'Size bytes: ' . (string)($file['size_bytes'] ?? 0);
            if (isset($file['line_count']) && $file['line_count'] !== null) {
                $lines[] = 'Line count: ' . (string)$file['line_count'];
            }
            $lines[] = 'Content:';
            $lines[] = (string)$file['content'];
            $lines[] = '';
        }

        return implode("\n", $lines);
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiAiResponseParser
{
    public function parseGeneratedFiles(string $rawText): array
    {
        $text = trim($rawText);
        if ($text === '') {
            return [
                'parse_status' => 'failed',
                'generated_files' => [],
                'warnings' => ['AI response was empty.'],
            ];
        }

        $candidates = [];
        $candidates[] = $this->stripCodeFence($text);

        $extractedObject = $this->extractFirstJsonObject($text);
        if ($extractedObject !== null) {
            $candidates[] = $extractedObject;
        }

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            $decoded = json_decode($candidate, true);
            if (!is_array($decoded)) {
                continue;
            }
            $normalized = $this->normalizeDecodedPayload($decoded);
            if ($normalized['generated_files'] !== []) {
                return [
                    'parse_status' => 'success',
                    'generated_files' => $normalized['generated_files'],
                    'warnings' => $normalized['warnings'],
                ];
            }
            if (($decoded['generated_files'] ?? null) === []) {
                return [
                    'parse_status' => 'success',
                    'generated_files' => [],
                    'warnings' => $normalized['warnings'],
                ];
            }
        }

        return [
            'parse_status' => 'failed',
            'generated_files' => [],
            'warnings' => ['AI response did not conform to the required generated_files schema.'],
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeDecodedPayload(array $decoded): array
    {
        $warnings = [];
        $rawFiles = [];

        if (isset($decoded['generated_files']) && is_array($decoded['generated_files'])) {
            $rawFiles = $decoded['generated_files'];
        } elseif ($this->isList($decoded)) {
            $rawFiles = $decoded;
            $warnings[] = 'AI returned a top-level array instead of the preferred generated_files object wrapper.';
        } elseif (isset($decoded['files']) && is_array($decoded['files'])) {
            $rawFiles = $decoded['files'];
            $warnings[] = 'AI returned files instead of generated_files; synonym mapping was applied.';
        }

        $generated = [];
        foreach ($rawFiles as $row) {
            $file = $this->normalizeFileRow($row);
            if ($file !== null) {
                $generated[] = $file;
            }
        }

        return [
            'generated_files' => $generated,
            'warnings' => $warnings,
        ];
    }

    private function normalizeFileRow(mixed $row): ?array
    {
        if (!is_array($row)) {
            return null;
        }

        $path = $this->firstString($row, ['file_path', 'path', 'target_path']);
        $content = $this->firstContent($row, ['file_content', 'content']);
        if ($path === '' || $content === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $operation = strtoupper($this->firstString($row, ['operation', 'op', 'action']));
        if (!in_array($operation, ['ADD', 'REPLACE'], true)) {
            $operation = 'REPLACE';
        }

        $summary = $this->firstString($row, ['file_revision_summary', 'revision_summary', 'summary', 'reason']);

        return [
            'file_path' => $this->normalizePath($path),
            'operation' => $operation,
            'file_content' => $content,
            'file_revision_summary' => $summary,
        ];
    }

    private function firstString(array $row, array $keys): string
    {
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!array_key_exists($key, $row)) {
                continue;
            }
            $value = $row[$key];
            if (is_string($value) || is_numeric($value)) {
                $text = trim((string)$value);
                if ($text !== '') {
                    return $text;
                }
            }
        }
        return '';
    }

    private function firstContent(array $row, array $keys): ?string
    {
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!array_key_exists($key, $row)) {
                continue;
            }
            $value = $row[$key];
            if (is_string($value) || is_numeric($value)) {
                return (string)$value;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function normalizePath(string $path): string
    {
        $normalized = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path));
        $normalized = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $normalized) ?: $normalized;
        if ($normalized !== '' && $normalized[0] !== '/') {
            $normalized = '/' . ltrim($normalized, '/');
        }
        return $normalized;
    }

    private function stripCodeFence(string $text): string
    {
        $text = preg_replace('/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i', '', $text);
        $text = preg_replace('/\r?\n?```\s*$/i', '', (string)$text);
        return trim((string)$text);
    }

    private function extractFirstJsonObject(string $text): ?string
    {
        $length = strlen($text);
        $start = null;
        $depth = 0;
        $inString = false;
        $escape = false;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
            $ch = $text[$i];

            if ($start === null) {
                if ($ch === '{') {
                    $start = $i;
                    $depth = 1;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($inString) {
                if ($escape) {
                    $escape = false;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($ch === '\\') {
                    $escape = true;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($ch === '"') {
                    $inString = false;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($ch === '"') {
                $inString = true;
                continue;
            }

            if ($ch === '{') {
                $depth++;
                continue;
            }

            if ($ch === '}') {
                $depth--;
                if ($depth === 0 && $start !== null) {
                    return substr($text, $start, $i - $start + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function isList(array $array): bool
    {
        if (function_exists('array_is_list')) {
            return array_is_list($array);
        }
        return array_keys($array) === range(0, count($array) - 1);
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function api_async_enqueue_refresh(string $requestedBy, array $payload): array
{
    $job = api_repository()->createRefreshJob($requestedBy, $payload);
    $jobId = (string)$job['job_id'];
    $jobRowId = (int)$job['id'];

    $launched = api_async_launch_refresh_worker($jobId);

    if ($launched) {
        $verified = api_async_verify_refresh_worker_started($jobId, 1200, 100);
        if (!$verified) {
            $launched = false;
        }
    }

    if (!$launched) {
        $freshJob = api_repository()->getRefreshJobByPublicId($jobId);
        $currentStatus = is_array($freshJob) ? (string)($freshJob['status'] ?? 'queued') : 'queued';

        if ($currentStatus === 'queued') {
            api_repository()->markJobRunning($jobRowId);
        }

        try {
            api_refresh_service()->runJob($jobRowId);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            api_repository()->markJobComplete($jobRowId, 'error', false, $e->getMessage(), null);
            api_error_response('Refresh worker failed: ' . $e->getMessage(), 500);
        }
    }

    $freshJob = api_repository()->getRefreshJobByPublicId($jobId);
    $status = is_array($freshJob) ? (string)($freshJob['status'] ?? '') : '';
    if ($status === '') {
        $status = $launched ? 'queued' : 'success';
    }

    return [
        'job_id' => $jobId,
        'status' => $status,
        'requested_by' => $requestedBy,
        'created_at' => $job['created_at'],
    ];
}

function api_async_launch_refresh_worker(string $jobId): bool
{
    $php = PHP_BINARY ?: 'php';
    $script = realpath(__DIR__ . '/../index.php');

    if ($script === false || $script === '') {
        return false;
    }

    $phpEscaped = escapeshellarg($php);
    $scriptEscaped = escapeshellarg($script);
    $jobIdEscaped = escapeshellarg($jobId);
    $workingDir = dirname($script);

    $detachedCommand = sprintf(
        'cd %s && nohup %s %s worker refresh-job %s > /dev/null 2>&1 &',
        escapeshellarg($workingDir),
        $phpEscaped,
        $scriptEscaped,
        $jobIdEscaped
    );

    if (!function_exists('exec')) {
        return false;
    }

    $output = [];
    $rc = 1;
    @exec($detachedCommand, $output, $rc);

    return (int)$rc === 0;
}

function api_async_verify_refresh_worker_started(string $jobId, int $maxWaitMs = 1200, int $stepMs = 100): bool
{
    $maxWaitMs = max(0, $maxWaitMs);
    $stepMs = max(50, $stepMs);
    $deadline = microtime(true) + ($maxWaitMs / 1000);

    do {
        $job = api_repository()->getRefreshJobByPublicId($jobId);
        if (is_array($job)) {
            $status = (string)($job['status'] ?? '');
            if (in_array($status, ['running', 'success', 'partial_success', 'error'], true)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        if (microtime(true) >= $deadline) {
            break;
        }

        usleep($stepMs * 1000);
    } while (true);

    return false;
}
