<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function api_auth_provided_key(): string
{
    $provided = '';

    if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_SYSTEM_API_KEY'])) {
        $provided = trim((string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_SYSTEM_API_KEY']);
    }

    if ($provided === '' && isset($_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])) {
        $auth = trim((string)$_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']);
        if (stripos($auth, 'Bearer ') === 0) {
            $provided = trim(substr($auth, 7));
        }
    }

    return $provided;
}

function api_require_auth(): void
{
    $expected = api_env()->require('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY');
    $provided = api_auth_provided_key();

    if ($provided === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $provided)) {
        api_error_response('Authentication required.', 401);
    }
}

function api_request_caller_system(): string
{
    if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CALLER_SYSTEM'])) {
        return strtolower(trim((string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_CALLER_SYSTEM']));
    }
    return '';
}

function api_require_refresh_authority(): string
{
    $caller = api_request_caller_system();
    if ($caller !== 'apro.maxflex.ai') {
        api_error_response('Refresh authority restricted to APRO.', 403);
    }
    return $caller;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiCatalogRepository
{
    public function __construct(private PDO $pdo)
    {
    }

    public function createRefreshJob(string $requestedBy, array $payload): array
    {
        $publicId = api_uuid_like_id('job');
        $now = api_now();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO refresh_jobs (public_id, status, requested_by, trigger_payload_json, created_at) VALUES (:public_id, :status, :requested_by, :payload, :created_at)');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':public_id' => $publicId,
            ':status' => 'queued',
            ':requested_by' => $requestedBy,
            ':payload' => api_json_encode($payload),
            ':created_at' => $now,
        ]);
        return $this->getRefreshJobById((int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId());
    }

    public function getRefreshJobById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM refresh_jobs WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch();
        return $row ? $this->mapJob($row) : null;
    }

    public function getRefreshJobByPublicId(string $publicId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM refresh_jobs WHERE public_id = :public_id');
        $stmt->execute([':public_id' => $publicId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch();
        return $row ? $this->mapJob($row) : null;
    }

    public function markJobRunning(int $jobId): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE refresh_jobs SET status = :status, started_at = :started_at WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => 'running',
            ':started_at' => api_now(),
            ':id' => $jobId,
        ]);
    }

    public function markJobComplete(int $jobId, string $status, bool $partialFailure, ?string $errorMessage, ?int $publishedRunId): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE refresh_jobs SET status = :status, completed_at = :completed_at, partial_failure = :partial_failure, error_message = :error_message, published_run_id = :published_run_id WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':completed_at' => api_now(),
            ':partial_failure' => $partialFailure ? 1 : 0,
            ':error_message' => $errorMessage,
            ':published_run_id' => $publishedRunId,
            ':id' => $jobId,
        ]);
    }

    public function createRun(int $jobId): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO catalog_runs (refresh_job_id, status, started_at) VALUES (:refresh_job_id, :status, :started_at)');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':refresh_job_id' => $jobId,
            ':status' => 'running',
            ':started_at' => api_now(),
        ]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function completeRun(int $runId, string $status, int $modelCount, bool $partialFailure, ?string $errorMessage, bool $published): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE catalog_runs SET status = :status, completed_at = :completed_at, discovered_model_count = :count, partial_failure = :partial_failure, error_message = :error_message, published = :published WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':completed_at' => api_now(),
            ':count' => $modelCount,
            ':partial_failure' => $partialFailure ? 1 : 0,
            ':error_message' => $errorMessage,
            ':published' => $published ? 1 : 0,
            ':id' => $runId,
        ]);
    }

    public function createProviderRun(int $jobId, int $runId, string $provider): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO refresh_job_providers (refresh_job_id, catalog_run_id, provider, status, started_at, provider_meta_json) VALUES (:refresh_job_id, :catalog_run_id, :provider, :status, :started_at, :provider_meta_json)');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':refresh_job_id' => $jobId,
            ':catalog_run_id' => $runId,
            ':provider' => $provider,
            ':status' => 'running',
            ':started_at' => api_now(),
            ':provider_meta_json' => api_json_encode([]),
        ]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function completeProviderRun(int $providerRunId, string $status, int $count, ?string $errorMessage, array $meta): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE refresh_job_providers SET status = :status, completed_at = :completed_at, discovered_model_count = :count, error_message = :error_message, provider_meta_json = :provider_meta_json WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':status' => $status,
            ':completed_at' => api_now(),
            ':count' => $count,
            ':error_message' => $errorMessage,
            ':provider_meta_json' => api_json_encode($meta),
            ':id' => $providerRunId,
        ]);
    }

    public function replaceRunModels(int $runId, array $models): void
    {
        $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM run_models WHERE catalog_run_id = :run_id')->execute([':run_id' => $runId]);
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO run_models (catalog_run_id, provider, model_id, canonical_model_id, payload_json, created_at) VALUES (:catalog_run_id, :provider, :model_id, :canonical_model_id, :payload_json, :created_at)');
        $now = api_now();
        foreach ($models as $model) {
            $stmt->execute([
                ':catalog_run_id' => $runId,
                ':provider' => (string)$model['provider'],
                ':model_id' => (string)$model['model_id'],
                ':canonical_model_id' => (string)$model['canonical_model_id'],
                ':payload_json' => api_json_encode($model),
                ':created_at' => $now,
            ]);
        }
    }

    public function publishRun(int $runId): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE published_catalog SET catalog_run_id = :catalog_run_id, updated_at = :updated_at WHERE id = 1');
        $stmt->execute([
            ':catalog_run_id' => $runId,
            ':updated_at' => api_now(),
        ]);
    }

    public function getPublishedSummary(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query('SELECT pc.updated_at, pc.catalog_run_id, cr.status, cr.started_at, cr.completed_at, cr.discovered_model_count, cr.partial_failure, rj.public_id AS job_public_id FROM published_catalog pc LEFT JOIN catalog_runs cr ON cr.id = pc.catalog_run_id LEFT JOIN refresh_jobs rj ON rj.id = cr.refresh_job_id WHERE pc.id = 1');
        $row = $stmt->fetch();
        if (!$row) {
            return [
                'published_run_id' => null,
                'published_at' => null,
                'model_count' => 0,
                'job_id' => null,
            ];
        }
        return [
            'published_run_id' => isset($row['catalog_run_id']) ? ($row['catalog_run_id'] !== null ? (int)$row['catalog_run_id'] : null) : null,
            'published_at' => $row['updated_at'] ?: null,
            'run_status' => $row['status'] ?: null,
            'run_started_at' => $row['started_at'] ?: null,
            'run_completed_at' => $row['completed_at'] ?: null,
            'model_count' => isset($row['discovered_model_count']) ? (int)$row['discovered_model_count'] : 0,
            'partial_failure' => !empty($row['partial_failure']),
            'job_id' => $row['job_public_id'] ?: null,
        ];
    }

    public function getPublishedCatalog(?string $provider = null): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query('SELECT catalog_run_id FROM published_catalog WHERE id = 1');
        $row = $stmt->fetch();
        if (!$row || empty($row['catalog_run_id'])) {
            return [];
        }
        $sql = 'SELECT payload_json FROM run_models WHERE catalog_run_id = :run_id';
        $params = [':run_id' => (int)$row['catalog_run_id']];
        if ($provider !== null) {
            $sql .= ' AND provider = :provider';
            $params[':provider'] = $provider;
        }
        $sql .= ' ORDER BY provider ASC, model_id ASC';
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        $items = [];
        while ($modelRow = $stmt->fetch()) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$modelRow['payload_json'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $items[] = $decoded;
            }
        }
        return $items;
    }

    public function listRuns(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query('SELECT cr.*, rj.public_id AS job_public_id FROM catalog_runs cr INNER JOIN refresh_jobs rj ON rj.id = cr.refresh_job_id ORDER BY cr.id DESC');
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll();
        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $out[] = [
                'run_id' => (int)$row['id'],
                'job_id' => (string)$row['job_public_id'],
                'status' => (string)$row['status'],
                'started_at' => $row['started_at'],
                'completed_at' => $row['completed_at'],
                'discovered_model_count' => (int)$row['discovered_model_count'],
                'partial_failure' => !empty($row['partial_failure']),
                'published' => !empty($row['published']),
                'error_message' => $row['error_message'],
            ];
        }
        return $out;
    }

    public function getRunDetail(int $runId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT cr.*, rj.public_id AS job_public_id FROM catalog_runs cr INNER JOIN refresh_jobs rj ON rj.id = cr.refresh_job_id WHERE cr.id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $runId]);
        $run = $stmt->fetch();
        if (!$run) {
            return null;
        }

        $providerStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM refresh_job_providers WHERE catalog_run_id = :run_id ORDER BY provider ASC');
        $providerStmt->execute([':run_id' => $runId]);
        $providers = [];
        while ($row = $providerStmt->fetch()) {
            $providers[] = [
                'provider' => (string)$row['provider'],
                'status' => (string)$row['status'],
                'started_at' => $row['started_at'],
                'completed_at' => $row['completed_at'],
                'discovered_model_count' => (int)$row['discovered_model_count'],
                'error_message' => $row['error_message'],
                'meta' => json_decode((string)$row['provider_meta_json'], true) ?: [],
            ];
        }

        $models = [];
        $modelStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT payload_json FROM run_models WHERE catalog_run_id = :run_id ORDER BY provider ASC, model_id ASC');
        $modelStmt->execute([':run_id' => $runId]);
        while ($row = $modelStmt->fetch()) {
            $decoded = json_decode((string)$row['payload_json'], true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $models[] = $decoded;
            }
        }

        return [
            'run_id' => (int)$run['id'],
            'job_id' => (string)$run['job_public_id'],
            'status' => (string)$run['status'],
            'started_at' => $run['started_at'],
            'completed_at' => $run['completed_at'],
            'discovered_model_count' => (int)$run['discovered_model_count'],
            'partial_failure' => !empty($run['partial_failure']),
            'published' => !empty($run['published']),
            'error_message' => $run['error_message'],
            'providers' => $providers,
            'models' => $models,
        ];
    }

    private function mapJob(array $row): array
    {
        return [
            'id' => (int)$row['id'],
            'job_id' => (string)$row['public_id'],
            'status' => (string)$row['status'],
            'requested_by' => (string)$row['requested_by'],
            'payload' => json_decode((string)$row['trigger_payload_json'], true) ?: [],
            'created_at' => $row['created_at'],
            'started_at' => $row['started_at'],
            'completed_at' => $row['completed_at'],
            'error_message' => $row['error_message'],
            'partial_failure' => !empty($row['partial_failure']),
            'published_run_id' => $row['published_run_id'] !== null ? (int)$row['published_run_id'] : null,
        ];
    }
}

{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(string $path)
    {
        $dir = dirname($path);

            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create storage directory: ' . $dir);
        }

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $path);
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE, PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $this->pdo->exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
        $this->pdo->exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL');
        $this->pdo->exec('PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL');
        $this->migrate();
    }

    {

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiEnv
{
    private string $path;
    private array $values = [];
    private bool $loaded = false;

    public function __construct(string $path)
    {
        $this->path = $path;
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $default = null): ?string
    {
        $this->load();
        if (array_key_exists($key, $this->values) && $this->values[$key] !== '') {
            return $this->values[$key];
        }
        $value = getenv($key);
        if (is_string($value) && $value !== '') {
            return $value;
        }
        return $default;
    }

    public function require(string $key): string
    {
        $value = $this->get($key);
        if ($value === null || $value === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Missing required environment variable: ' . $key);
        }
        return $value;
    }

    private function load(): void
    {
        if ($this->loaded) {
            return;
        }

        $this->loaded = true;
        if (!is_file($this->path) || !is_readable($this->path)) {
            return;
        }

        $lines = file($this->path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES);
        if (!is_array($lines)) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $line = trim((string)$line);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            if (str_starts_with($line, 'export ')) {
                $line = trim(substr($line, 7));
            }
            $pos = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($pos === false) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $pos));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $pos + 1));
            if ($key === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if ($value !== '' && (($value[0] === '"' && substr($value, -1) === '"') || ($value[0] === "'" && substr($value, -1) === "'"))) {
                $quote = $value[0];
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
                if ($quote === '"') {
                    $value = stripcslashes($value);
                }
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
            if (getenv($key) === false) {
                putenv($key . '=' . $value);
            }
            if (!isset($_ENV[$key])) {
                $_ENV[$key] = $value;
            }
            if (!isset($_SERVER[$key])) {
                $_SERVER[$key] = $value;
            }
        }
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function api_http_request(): array
{
    $uri = (string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/');
    $parsed = parse_url($uri);
    $path = isset($parsed['path']) ? (string)$parsed['path'] : '/';
    $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    $query = [];
    if (!empty($parsed['query'])) {
        parse_str((string)$parsed['query'], $query);
    }
    return [
        'method' => strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET')),
        'path' => $path,
        'query' => $query,
    ];
}

function api_json_body(): array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if (!is_string($raw) || trim($raw) === '') {
        return [];
    }
    $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded)) {
        api_error_response('Invalid JSON body.', 400);
    }
    return $decoded;
}

function api_json_response(array $payload, int $status = 200): void
{
    if (!headers_sent()) {
        http_response_code($status);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
    }
    echo json_encode([
        'status' => 'success',
        'data' => $payload,
    ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

function api_error_response(string $message, int $status = 400, array $data = []): void
{
    if (!headers_sent()) {
        http_response_code($status);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
    }
    echo json_encode([
        'status' => 'error',
        'message' => $message,
        'data' => $data,
    ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiHttpClient
{
    public function getJson(string $url, array $headers = []): array
    {
        return $this->requestJson('GET', $url, $headers, null);
    }

    public function requestJson(string $method, string $url, array $headers = [], ?array $body = null): array
    {
        $response = $this->request($method, $url, $headers, $body);
        $decoded = json_decode($response['body'], true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Non-JSON response from ' . $url);
        }

        if ($response['status'] >= 400) {
            $message = isset($decoded['error']['message'])
                ? (string)$decoded['error']['message']
                : ((string)($decoded['message'] ?? ('HTTP ' . $response['status'])));
            throw new RuntimeException($message);
        }

        return $decoded;
    }

    public function getText(string $url, array $headers = []): string
    {
        $response = $this->request('GET', $url, $headers, null);
        if ($response['status'] >= 400) {
            throw new RuntimeException('HTTP ' . $response['status'] . ' from ' . $url);
        }
        return $response['body'];
    }

    public function request(string $method, string $url, array $headers = [], ?array $body = null): array
    {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize cURL.');
        }

        $httpHeaders = ['Accept: application/json,text/html;q=0.9,text/plain;q=0.8,*/*;q=0.5'];
        foreach ($headers as $key => $value) {
            $httpHeaders[] = $key . ': ' . $value;
        }

        $options = [
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $httpHeaders,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60,
            CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 20,
            CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => strtoupper($method),
            CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
            CURLOPT_USERAGENT => 'api.maxflex.ai/1.0 (+https://api.maxflex.ai)',
        ];

        if ($body !== null) {
            $encoded = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            if (!is_string($encoded)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode JSON request body.');
            }
            $httpHeaders[] = 'Content-Type: application/json';
            $options[CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER] = $httpHeaders;
            $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $encoded;
        }

        curl_setopt_array($ch, $options);
        $responseBody = curl_exec($ch);
        $error = curl_error($ch);
        $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        $contentType = (string)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_CONTENT_TYPE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($responseBody === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('HTTP request failed: ' . $error);
        }

        return [
            'status' => $status,
            'body' => (string)$responseBody,
            'content_type' => $contentType,
        ];
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiRefreshService
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApiCatalogRepository $repository,
        private ApiProviderRegistry $providers
    ) {
    }

    public function runJob(int $jobId): void
    {
        $job = $this->repository->getRefreshJobById($jobId);
        if ($job === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Refresh job not found.');
        }

        $status = (string)($job['status'] ?? '');
        if (in_array($status, ['success', 'partial_success', 'error'], true)) {
            return;
        }

        if ($status !== 'running') {
            $this->repository->markJobRunning($jobId);
        }

        $runId = $this->repository->createRun($jobId);

        $allModels = [];
        $partialFailure = false;
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($this->providers->all() as $provider) {
            $providerRunId = $this->repository->createProviderRun($jobId, $runId, $provider->name());

            try {
                $models = $provider->discover();

                $this->repository->completeProviderRun($providerRunId, 'success', count($models), null, [
                    'provider' => $provider->name(),
                    'completed_at' => api_now(),
                ]);

                foreach ($models as $model) {
                    $allModels[] = $model;
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $partialFailure = true;
                $errors[] = $provider->name() . ': ' . $e->getMessage();

                $this->repository->completeProviderRun($providerRunId, 'error', 0, $e->getMessage(), [
                    'provider' => $provider->name(),
                    'completed_at' => api_now(),
                ]);
            }
        }

        usort($allModels, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
            $providerCompare = strcmp((string)($a['provider'] ?? ''), (string)($b['provider'] ?? ''));
            if ($providerCompare !== 0) {
                return $providerCompare;
            }
            return strcmp((string)($a['model_id'] ?? ''), (string)($b['model_id'] ?? ''));
        });

        $published = false;
        $finalStatus = 'error';
        $errorMessage = empty($errors) ? null : implode(' | ', $errors);

        if (!empty($allModels)) {
            $this->repository->replaceRunModels($runId, $allModels);
            $this->repository->publishRun($runId);
            $published = true;
            $finalStatus = $partialFailure ? 'partial_success' : 'success';
        }

        if (!$published && $errorMessage === null) {
            $errorMessage = 'No providers succeeded.';
        }

        $this->repository->completeRun(
            $runId,
            $finalStatus,
            count($allModels),
            $partialFailure,
            $errorMessage,
            $published
        );

        $this->repository->markJobComplete(
            $jobId,
            $finalStatus,
            $partialFailure,
            $errorMessage,
            $published ? $runId : null
        );
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function api_uuid_like_id(string $prefix): string
{
    return $prefix . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
}

function api_now(): string
{
    return gmdate('c');
}

function api_json_encode(mixed $value): string
{
    $json = json_encode($value, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    if (!is_string($json)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode JSON value.');
    }
    return $json;
}

function api_iso_from_unix(?int $timestamp): ?string
{
    if ($timestamp === null || $timestamp <= 0) {
        return null;
    }
    return gmdate('c', $timestamp);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/Env.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/Http.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/Auth.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/Util.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/Database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/CatalogRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/HttpClient.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/ProviderInterface.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AbstractProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/providers/OpenAIProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/providers/AnthropicProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/providers/GeminiProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/providers/ReplicateProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/providers/ElevenLabsProvider.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/ProviderRegistry.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/RefreshService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AsyncJob.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AiRuntimeInterface.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AiResponseParser.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/AiGenerationService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/runtime/OpenAiRuntime.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/runtime/GeminiRuntime.php';

function api_bootstrap_handle_request(): void
{
    if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli') {
        api_bootstrap_handle_cli();
        return;
    }

    api_bootstrap_handle_http();
}

function api_bootstrap_handle_cli(): void
{
    $argv = $_SERVER['argv'] ?? [];
    if (!is_array($argv)) {
        $argv = [];
    }

    if (count($argv) >= 3 && $argv[1] === 'worker' && $argv[2] === 'refresh-job') {
        $jobId = isset($argv[3]) ? trim((string)$argv[3]) : '';
        if ($jobId === '') {
            fwrite(STDERR, "Missing refresh job id\n");
            exit(1);
        }
        api_run_refresh_worker($jobId);
        exit(0);
    }
}

function api_bootstrap_handle_http(): void
{
    $request = api_http_request();
    $method = $request['method'];
    $path = $request['path'];

    api_require_auth();

    if ($path === '/health') {
        api_json_response([
            'status' => 'ok',
            'service' => 'api.maxflex.ai',
            'time' => gmdate('c'),
        ]);
    }

    if ($path === '/' || $path === '') {
        api_json_response([
            'service' => 'ai-model-discovery',
            'private' => true,
            'time' => gmdate('c'),
            'endpoints' => [
                'GET /health',
                'GET /v1/catalog',
                'GET /v1/catalog/summary',
                'GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}',
                'GET /v1/runs',
                'GET /v1/runs/{run_id}',
                'POST /v1/refresh',
                'POST /v1/generate-files',
            ],
        ]);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/v1/catalog') {
        $provider = isset($request['query']['provider']) ? trim((string)$request['query']['provider']) : '';
        $repo = api_repository();
        api_json_response([
            'catalog' => $repo->getPublishedCatalog($provider !== '' ? $provider : null),
            'summary' => $repo->getPublishedSummary(),
        ]);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/v1/catalog/summary') {
        api_json_response(api_repository()->getPublishedSummary());
    }

    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/v1/refresh') {
        $payload = api_json_body();
        $requestedBy = api_require_refresh_authority();
        $job = api_async_enqueue_refresh($requestedBy, $payload);
        api_json_response($job, 202);
    }

    if ($method === 'POST' && $path === '/v1/generate-files') {
        $payload = api_json_body();
        $result = api_generate_files_service()->generate($payload, api_request_caller_system());
        api_json_response($result, 200);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && preg_match('#^/v1/jobs/([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)$#', $path, $matches)) {
        $jobId = $matches[1];
        $job = api_repository()->getRefreshJobByPublicId($jobId);
        if ($job === null) {
            api_error_response('Job not found.', 404);
        }
        api_json_response($job);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && $path === '/v1/runs') {
        api_json_response([
            'runs' => api_repository()->listRuns(),
        ]);
    }

    if ($method === 'GET' && preg_match('#^/v1/runs/(\d+)$#', $path, $matches)) {
        $runId = (int)$matches[1];
        $run = api_repository()->getRunDetail($runId);
        if ($run === null) {
            api_error_response('Run not found.', 404);
        }
        api_json_response($run);
    }

    api_error_response('Not found.', 404);
}

function api_env(): ApiEnv
{
    static $env = null;
    if (!$env instanceof ApiEnv) {
        $env = new ApiEnv('/var/www/.env.master');
    }
    return $env;
}

function api_db(): ApiDatabase
{
    static $db = null;
    if (!$db instanceof ApiDatabase) {
        $dbPath = __DIR__ . '/../storage/catalog.sqlite';
        $db = new ApiDatabase($dbPath);
    }
    return $db;
}

function api_repository(): ApiCatalogRepository
{
    static $repo = null;
    if (!$repo instanceof ApiCatalogRepository) {
        $repo = new ApiCatalogRepository(api_db()->pdo());
    }
    return $repo;
}

function api_http_client(): ApiHttpClient
{
    static $client = null;
    if (!$client instanceof ApiHttpClient) {
        $client = new ApiHttpClient();
    }
    return $client;
}

function api_provider_registry(): ApiProviderRegistry
{
    static $registry = null;
    if (!$registry instanceof ApiProviderRegistry) {
        $env = api_env();
        $client = api_http_client();
        $metadataDir = __DIR__ . '/../metadata';
        $registry = new ApiProviderRegistry([
            new ApiOpenAIProvider($client, $env, $metadataDir . '/openai_models.json'),
            new ApiAnthropicProvider($client, $env, $metadataDir . '/anthropic_models.json'),
            new ApiGeminiProvider($client, $env, $metadataDir . '/gemini_models.json'),
            new ApiReplicateProvider($client, $env, $metadataDir . '/replicate_models.json'),

    }

}

function api_refresh_service(): ApiRefreshService
{

    if (!$service instanceof ApiRefreshService) {
        $service = new ApiRefreshService(api_repository(), api_provider_registry());

}

{

}

function api_ai_runtime_registry(): array
{

    if ($registry === null) {

        $registry = [
            'openai' => new ApiOpenAiRuntime($client, $env),
            'gemini' => new ApiGeminiRuntime($client, $env),

}

function api_generate_files_service(): ApiAiGenerationService

function api_run_refresh_worker(string $jobPublicId): void

    if ($job === null) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Refresh job not found: ' . $jobPublicId);

    api_refresh_service()->runJob((int)$job['id']);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiGeminiProvider extends ApiAbstractProvider
{
    private const GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models';
    private const GEMINI_PRICING_URL = 'https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing';
    private const VERTEX_PRICING_URL = 'https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/pricing';

    public function name(): string
    {
        return 'gemini';
    }

    public function discover(): array
    {
        $apiKey = $this->env->require('GEMINI_API_KEY');
        $metadata = $this->readMetadata();
        $metadataModels = is_array($metadata['models'] ?? null) ? $metadata['models'] : [];

        $authoritativePricing = $this->loadAuthoritativePricingCatalog();
        if (!empty($authoritativePricing)) {
            foreach ($authoritativePricing as $modelId => $pricing) {
                if (!isset($metadataModels[$modelId]) || !is_array($metadataModels[$modelId])) {
                    $metadataModels[$modelId] = [];
                }
                if (empty($metadataModels[$modelId]['pricing']) && !empty($pricing)) {
                    $metadataModels[$modelId]['pricing'] = $pricing;
                }
            }
        }

        $response = $this->httpClient->getJson(self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT . '?key=' . rawurlencode($apiKey));
        $rawModels = is_array($response['models'] ?? null) ? $response['models'] : [];
        $records = [];

        foreach ($rawModels as $raw) {
            if (!is_array($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = trim((string)($raw['name'] ?? ''));
            if ($name === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $modelId = str_starts_with($name, 'models/') ? substr($name, 7) : $name;
            if ($modelId === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $curated = is_array($metadataModels[$modelId] ?? null) ? $metadataModels[$modelId] : [];
            $curatedLimits = $this->curatedLimitsFromMetadata($curated);
            $limits = $curatedLimits;

            if (empty($limits)) {
                if (isset($raw['inputTokenLimit']) && is_numeric((string)$raw['inputTokenLimit'])) {
                    $limits['max_input_tokens'] = (int)$raw['inputTokenLimit'];
                    $limits['max_context_tokens'] = (int)$raw['inputTokenLimit'];
                }
                if (isset($raw['outputTokenLimit']) && is_numeric((string)$raw['outputTokenLimit'])) {
                    $limits['max_output_tokens'] = (int)$raw['outputTokenLimit'];
                }
            }

            $capabilities = is_array($curated['capabilities'] ?? null) ? $curated['capabilities'] : [];
            $pricing = $this->resolvePricing($modelId, $curated, $authoritativePricing);
            $hasCurated = !empty($curated);
            $hasPricing = $this->hasPricing($pricing);
            $hasCuratedCapabilities = !empty($capabilities);
            $hasCuratedLimits = !empty($curatedLimits);
            $providerCreatedAt = $this->resolveProviderCreatedAt($modelId, $raw, $curated);
            $providerCreatedAtSource = $this->resolveProviderCreatedAtSource($modelId, $raw, $curated);
            $pricingSource = $this->resolvePricingSource($curated, $pricing, $authoritativePricing, $modelId);

            $fields = [
                'label' => (string)($curated['label'] ?? ($raw['displayName'] ?? $modelId)),
                'enabled' => isset($curated['enabled']) ? (bool)$curated['enabled'] : true,
                'availability' => (string)($curated['availability'] ?? 'available'),
                'capabilities' => $capabilities,
                'limits' => $limits,
                'pricing' => $pricing,
                'provider_created_at' => $providerCreatedAt,
                'reliability_overall' => $this->reliabilityOverall($capabilities, $limits, $pricing, $hasCurated || $hasPricing),
                'reliability_fields' => [
                    'label' => $hasCurated ? 'high' : 'medium',
                    'capabilities' => $hasCuratedCapabilities ? 'high' : 'unknown',
                    'limits' => !empty($limits) ? ($hasCuratedLimits ? 'high' : 'medium') : 'unknown',
                    'pricing' => $hasPricing ? ($pricingSource['reliability'] ?? 'high') : 'unknown',
                ],
                'raw' => $raw,
            ];

            $fieldSources = [
                'model_id' => $this->source('provider_api', self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT, 'high'),
                'label' => $hasCurated
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('provider_api', self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT, 'medium'),
                'capabilities' => $hasCuratedCapabilities
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'limits' => !empty($limits)
                    ? ($hasCuratedLimits
                        ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                        : $this->source('provider_api', self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT, 'medium'))
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'pricing' => $pricingSource,
                'provider_created_at' => $providerCreatedAtSource,
            ];

            $records[] = $this->normalizeRecord('gemini', $modelId, $fields, $fieldSources);
        }

        return $records;
    }

    private function resolvePricing(string $modelId, array $curated, array $authoritativePricing): array
    {
        $pricing = is_array($curated['pricing'] ?? null) ? $curated['pricing'] : [];
        if ($this->hasPricing($pricing)) {
            return $pricing;
        }

        if (isset($authoritativePricing[$modelId]) && $this->hasPricing($authoritativePricing[$modelId])) {
            return $authoritativePricing[$modelId];
        }

        $resolved = $this->inferPricingFromModelId($modelId);
        return $resolved ?? [];
    }

    private function resolvePricingSource(array $curated, array $pricing, array $authoritativePricing, string $modelId): array
    {
        if ($this->hasPricing(is_array($curated['pricing'] ?? null) ? $curated['pricing'] : [])) {
            return $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high');
        }

        if (isset($authoritativePricing[$modelId]) && $this->hasPricing($authoritativePricing[$modelId])) {
            return $this->source('provider_pricing', self::GEMINI_PRICING_URL . ' | ' . self::VERTEX_PRICING_URL, 'high');
        }

        if ($this->hasPricing($pricing)) {
            return $this->source('provider_pricing_derived', self::GEMINI_PRICING_URL . ' | ' . self::VERTEX_PRICING_URL, 'medium');
        }

        return $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown');
    }

    private function hasPricing(array $pricing): bool
    {
        foreach (['input_per_1m_usd', 'output_per_1m_usd', 'character_per_1k_usd', 'usd'] as $key) {
            if (array_key_exists($key, $pricing) && $pricing[$key] !== null && $pricing[$key] !== '' && is_numeric((string)$pricing[$key])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function inferPricingFromModelId(string $modelId): ?array
    {
        $id = strtolower(trim($modelId));
        if ($id === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (preg_match('/^gemini-(?:2\.0|2\.5|3(?:\.1)?)-flash(?:-001)?$/', $id)) {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.3,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 2.5,
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^gemini-(?:2\.0|2\.5|3(?:\.1)?)-flash-lite(?:-001)?$/', $id)) {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.2,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 1.0,
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^gemini-(?:2\.5|3(?:\.1)?)-pro(?:-preview(?:-customtools|-tts)?)?$/', $id) || $id === 'gemini-pro-latest') {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 1.25,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 10.0,
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^gemini-(?:1\.5)-pro$/', $id)) {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 3.5,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 10.5,
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^gemini-(?:1\.5)-flash$/', $id)) {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.35,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 1.05,
            ];
        }

        if ($id === 'gemini-flash-latest') {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.3,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 2.5,
            ];
        }

        if ($id === 'gemini-flash-lite-latest') {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.2,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 1.0,
            ];
        }

        if ($id === 'gemini-2.0-flash' || $id === 'gemini-2.0-flash-001') {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.1,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 0.4,
            ];
        }

        if ($id === 'gemini-2.0-flash-lite' || $id === 'gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001') {
            return [
                'input_per_1m_usd' => 0.075,
                'output_per_1m_usd' => 0.3,
            ];
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function resolveProviderCreatedAt(string $modelId, array $raw, array $curated): ?string
    {
        $curatedDate = $this->normalizeDateValue($curated['provider_created_at'] ?? null);
        if ($curatedDate !== null) {
            return $curatedDate;
        }

        $candidates = [
            $raw['created_at'] ?? null,
            $raw['createTime'] ?? null,
            $raw['create_time'] ?? null,
            $raw['updateTime'] ?? null,
            $raw['update_time'] ?? null,
            $raw['versionCreateTime'] ?? null,
            $raw['version_create_time'] ?? null,
            $raw['releaseDate'] ?? null,
            $raw['release_date'] ?? null,
        ];

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            $normalized = $this->normalizeDateValue($candidate);
            if ($normalized !== null) {
                return $normalized;
            }
        }

        $parsed = $this->parseDateFromModelIdOrVersion($modelId, $raw);
        if ($parsed !== null) {
            return $parsed;
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function resolveProviderCreatedAtSource(string $modelId, array $raw, array $curated): array
    {
        if ($this->normalizeDateValue($curated['provider_created_at'] ?? null) !== null) {
            return $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high');
        }

        $providerFields = [
            'created_at',
            'createTime',
            'create_time',
            'updateTime',
            'update_time',
            'versionCreateTime',
            'version_create_time',
            'releaseDate',
            'release_date',
        ];
        foreach ($providerFields as $field) {
            if ($this->normalizeDateValue($raw[$field] ?? null) !== null) {
                return $this->source('provider_api', self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT, 'high');
            }
        }

        if ($this->parseDateFromModelIdOrVersion($modelId, $raw) !== null) {
            return $this->source('provider_api', self::GEMINI_MODELS_ENDPOINT . '#derived_from_model_id_or_version', 'medium');
        }

        return $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown');
    }

    private function normalizeDateValue(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_int($value) || (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^\d+$/', trim($value)))) {
            $timestamp = (int)$value;
            if ($timestamp > 0) {
                return gmdate('c', $timestamp);
            }
        }

        $string = trim((string)$value);
        if ($string === '') {
            return null;
        }

        $timestamp = strtotime($string);
        if ($timestamp === false || $timestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return gmdate('c', $timestamp);
    }

    private function parseDateFromModelIdOrVersion(string $modelId, array $raw): ?string
    {
        $sources = [$modelId];
        if (isset($raw['version']) && is_string($raw['version'])) {
            $sources[] = $raw['version'];
        }
        if (isset($raw['displayName']) && is_string($raw['displayName'])) {
            $sources[] = $raw['displayName'];
        }
        if (isset($raw['description']) && is_string($raw['description'])) {
            $sources[] = $raw['description'];
        }

        foreach ($sources as $source) {
            $date = $this->parseMonthYearDate($source);
            if ($date !== null) {
                return $date;
            }

            if (preg_match('/(?:^|[^0-9])((?:19|20)\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:[^0-9]|$)/', $source, $matches)) {
                $year = (int)$matches[1];
                $month = (int)$matches[2];
                $day = (int)$matches[3];
                if (checkdate($month, $day, $year)) {
                    return gmdate('c', gmmktime(0, 0, 0, $month, $day, $year));
                }
            }

            if (preg_match('/(?:^|[^0-9])(\d{2})-(\d{4})(?:[^0-9]|$)/', $source, $matches)) {
                $month = (int)$matches[1];
                $year = (int)$matches[2];
                if ($month >= 1 && $month <= 12) {
                    return gmdate('c', gmmktime(0, 0, 0, $month, 1, $year));
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function parseMonthYearDate(string $text): ?string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*[- ]?(\d{1,2})[- ]?(\d{4})\b/i', $text, $matches)) {
            return null;
        }

        $monthMap = [
            'jan' => 1,
            'feb' => 2,
            'mar' => 3,
            'apr' => 4,
            'may' => 5,
            'jun' => 6,
            'jul' => 7,
            'aug' => 8,
            'sep' => 9,
            'oct' => 10,
            'nov' => 11,
            'dec' => 12,
        ];

        $monthKey = strtolower(substr($matches[1], 0, 3));
        $month = $monthMap[$monthKey] ?? null;
        $day = (int)$matches[2];
        $year = (int)$matches[3];
        if ($month === null || !checkdate($month, $day, $year)) {
            return null;
        }

        return gmdate('c', gmmktime(0, 0, 0, $month, $day, $year));
    }

    private function loadAuthoritativePricingCatalog(): array
    {
        $catalog = [];

        try {
            $geminiPricingHtml = $this->httpClient->getText(self::GEMINI_PRICING_URL);
            $catalog = array_merge($catalog, $this->parsePricingTablesFromHtml($geminiPricingHtml));
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }

        try {
            $vertexPricingHtml = $this->httpClient->getText(self::VERTEX_PRICING_URL);
            $catalog = array_merge($catalog, $this->parsePricingTablesFromHtml($vertexPricingHtml));
        } catch (Throwable) {
        }

        return $catalog;
    }

    private function parsePricingTablesFromHtml(string $html): array
    {
        $catalog = [];
        if (trim($html) === '') {
            return $catalog;
        }

        $patterns = [
            '/gemini-2\.5-pro[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-2.5-pro'],
            '/gemini-2\.5-flash-lite[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-2.5-flash-lite', 'gemini-flash-lite-latest', 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite'],
            '/gemini-2\.5-flash[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-flash-latest', 'gemini-3-flash-preview'],
            '/gemini-2\.0-flash-lite[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-2.0-flash-lite', 'gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001'],
            '/gemini-2\.0-flash[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-2.0-flash-001'],
            '/gemini-1\.5-pro[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-1.5-pro'],
            '/gemini-1\.5-flash[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?input[^<\n\r]*?(\$\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*\/\s*1M[^<\n\r]*?output/i' => ['gemini-1.5-flash'],
        ];

        foreach ($patterns as $pattern => $modelIds) {
            if (!preg_match($pattern, $html, $matches)) {
                continue;
            }
            $input = $this->parseUsdValue($matches[1] ?? null);
            $output = $this->parseUsdValue($matches[2] ?? null);
            if ($input === null || $output === null) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ($modelIds as $modelId) {
                $catalog[$modelId] = [
                    'input_per_1m_usd' => $input,
                    'output_per_1m_usd' => $output,
                ];
            }
        }

        return $catalog;
    }

    private function parseUsdValue(mixed $value): ?float
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $string = trim((string)$value);
        if ($string === '') {
            return null;
        }
        $string = preg_replace('/[^0-9.]/', '', $string);
        if ($string === null || $string === '' || !is_numeric($string)) {
            return null;
        }
        return (float)$string;
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiOpenAIProvider extends ApiAbstractProvider
{
    public function name(): string
    {
        return 'openai';
    }

    public function discover(): array
    {
        $apiKey = $this->env->require('OPENAI_API_KEY');
        $metadata = $this->readMetadata();
        $metadataModels = is_array($metadata['models'] ?? null) ? $metadata['models'] : [];
        $response = $this->httpClient->getJson('https://api.openai.com/v1/models', [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $apiKey,
        ]);
        $rawModels = is_array($response['data'] ?? null) ? $response['data'] : [];
        $records = [];

        foreach ($rawModels as $raw) {
            if (!is_array($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $modelId = trim((string)($raw['id'] ?? ''));
            if ($modelId === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!preg_match('/^(gpt|o[0-9])/i', $modelId)) {
                continue;
            }

            $curated = is_array($metadataModels[$modelId] ?? null) ? $metadataModels[$modelId] : [];
            $capabilities = [];
            foreach (['supports_text', 'supports_json', 'supports_tools', 'supports_streaming'] as $flag) {
                if (array_key_exists($flag, $curated)) {
                    $capabilities[$flag] = (bool)$curated[$flag];
                }
            }
            $limits = $this->curatedLimitsFromMetadata($curated);
            $pricing = is_array($curated['pricing'] ?? null) ? $curated['pricing'] : [];
            $hasCurated = !empty($curated);
            $hasCuratedPricing = !empty($pricing);

            $fields = [
                'label' => (string)($curated['name'] ?? $curated['label'] ?? $modelId),
                'enabled' => isset($curated['enabled']) ? (bool)$curated['enabled'] : true,
                'availability' => (string)($curated['availability'] ?? 'available'),
                'capabilities' => $capabilities,
                'limits' => $limits,
                'pricing' => $pricing,
                'provider_created_at' => api_iso_from_unix(isset($raw['created']) && is_numeric((string)$raw['created']) ? (int)$raw['created'] : null),
                'reliability_overall' => $this->reliabilityOverall($capabilities, $limits, $pricing, $hasCurated),
                'reliability_fields' => [
                    'label' => $hasCurated ? 'high' : 'medium',
                    'limits' => !empty($limits) ? 'high' : 'unknown',
                    'capabilities' => !empty($capabilities) ? 'high' : 'unknown',
                    'pricing' => $hasCuratedPricing ? 'high' : 'unknown',
                ],
                'raw' => $raw,
            ];

            $fieldSources = [
                'model_id' => $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/models', 'high'),
                'label' => $hasCurated
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/models', 'medium'),
                'capabilities' => !empty($capabilities)
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'limits' => !empty($limits)
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'pricing' => $hasCuratedPricing
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'high')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'provider_created_at' => $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/models', 'high'),
            ];

            $records[] = $this->normalizeRecord('openai', $modelId, $fields, $fieldSources);
        }

        return $records;
    }
}

final class ApiReplicateProvider extends ApiAbstractProvider

    public function discover(): array
    {
        $apiToken = $this->env->require('REPLICATE_API_TOKEN');
        $metadata = $this->readMetadata();
        $metadataModels = is_array($metadata['models'] ?? null) ? $metadata['models'] : [];

            'Authorization' => 'Token ' . $apiToken,
        ]);

        $records = [];

        foreach ($rawModels as $raw) {
            if (!is_array($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $owner = trim((string)($raw['owner'] ?? ''));
            $name = trim((string)($raw['name'] ?? ''));
            if ($owner === '' || $name === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $modelId = $owner . '/' . $name;
            $curated = is_array($metadataModels[$modelId] ?? null) ? $metadataModels[$modelId] : [];
            $limits = $this->curatedLimitsFromMetadata($curated);
            $pricing = is_array($curated['pricing'] ?? null) ? $curated['pricing'] : [];
            $hasCurated = !empty($curated);

            $hasCuratedCapabilities = !empty($curated['capabilities'] ?? []);
            $hasCuratedLimits = !empty($limits);

            $fields = [
                'label' => (string)($curated['label'] ?? ($raw['description'] ?? $modelId)),
                'enabled' => isset($curated['enabled']) ? (bool)$curated['enabled'] : true,
                'availability' => (string)($curated['availability'] ?? 'discovery_only'),

                'limits' => $limits,
                'pricing' => $pricing,
                'provider_created_at' => $raw['created_at'] ?? null,
                'reliability_overall' => $hasCurated ? 'mixed' : 'api_only',
                'reliability_fields' => [
                    'label' => $hasCurated ? 'medium' : 'medium',
                    'capabilities' => $hasCuratedCapabilities ? 'medium' : 'unknown',
                    'limits' => $hasCuratedLimits ? 'low' : 'unknown',
                    'pricing' => $hasCuratedPricing ? 'medium' : 'unknown',
                ],
                'raw' => $raw,
            ];
            $fieldSources = [
                'model_id' => $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.replicate.com/v1/models', 'high'),
                'label' => $hasCurated
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'medium')
                    : $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.replicate.com/v1/models', 'medium'),
                'capabilities' => $hasCuratedCapabilities
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'medium')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'limits' => $hasCuratedLimits
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'low')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'pricing' => $hasCuratedPricing
                    ? $this->source('curated_metadata', basename($this->metadataPath), 'medium')
                    : $this->source('unknown', 'not_provided', 'unknown'),
                'provider_created_at' => $this->source('provider_api', 'https://api.replicate.com/v1/models', 'high'),
            ];
            $records[] = $this->normalizeRecord('replicate', $modelId, $fields, $fieldSources);
        }

        return $records;
    }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiGeminiRuntime implements ApiAiRuntimeInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApiHttpClient $httpClient,
        private ApiEnv $env
    ) {
    }

    public function provider(): string
    {
        return 'gemini';
    }

    public function generateFiles(array $request): array
    {
        $apiKey = $this->env->require('GEMINI_API_KEY');
        $modelId = trim((string)($request['model_id'] ?? ''));
        $prompt = (string)($request['assembled_prompt'] ?? '');
        if ($modelId === '' || $prompt === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Gemini runtime request is missing model_id or assembled_prompt.');
        }

        $url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/' . rawurlencode($modelId) . ':generateContent?key=' . rawurlencode($apiKey);
        $body = [
            'contents' => [
                [
                    'role' => 'user',
                    'parts' => [
                        [
                            'text' => $prompt,
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $response = $this->httpClient->requestJson('POST', $url, [], $body);

        return [
            'raw_ai_response' => $this->extractResponseText($response),
            'provider_response' => $response,
            'usage' => $this->normalizeUsage($response['usageMetadata'] ?? null),
        ];
    }

    private function extractResponseText(array $response): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        $candidates = $response['candidates'] ?? null;
        if (is_array($candidates)) {
            foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
                if (!is_array($candidate)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $content = $candidate['content'] ?? null;
                if (!is_array($content)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $contentParts = $content['parts'] ?? null;
                if (!is_array($contentParts)) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($contentParts as $part) {
                    if (is_array($part) && isset($part['text']) && is_string($part['text'])) {
                        $parts[] = $part['text'];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return trim(implode("\n", $parts));
    }

    private function normalizeUsage(mixed $usage): array
    {
        if (!is_array($usage)) {
            return [
                'input_tokens' => 0,
                'output_tokens' => 0,
                'total_tokens' => 0,
            ];
        }

        $input = isset($usage['promptTokenCount']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['promptTokenCount']) ? (int)$usage['promptTokenCount'] : 0;
        $output = isset($usage['candidatesTokenCount']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['candidatesTokenCount']) ? (int)$usage['candidatesTokenCount'] : 0;
        $total = isset($usage['totalTokenCount']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['totalTokenCount']) ? (int)$usage['totalTokenCount'] : ($input + $output);

        return [
            'input_tokens' => $input,
            'output_tokens' => $output,
            'total_tokens' => $total,
        ];
    }
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class ApiOpenAiRuntime implements ApiAiRuntimeInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private ApiHttpClient $httpClient,
        private ApiEnv $env
    ) {
    }

    public function provider(): string
    {
        return 'openai';
    }

    public function generateFiles(array $request): array
    {
        $apiKey = $this->env->require('OPENAI_API_KEY');
        $modelId = trim((string)($request['model_id'] ?? ''));
        $prompt = (string)($request['assembled_prompt'] ?? '');
        if ($modelId === '' || $prompt === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('OpenAI runtime request is missing model_id or assembled_prompt.');
        }

        $body = [
            'model' => $modelId,
            'input' => [
                [
                    'role' => 'user',
                    'content' => [
                        [
                            'type' => 'input_text',
                            'text' => $prompt,
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $response = $this->httpClient->requestJson('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $apiKey,
        ], $body);

        return [
            'raw_ai_response' => $this->extractResponseText($response),
            'provider_response' => $response,
            'usage' => $this->normalizeUsage($response['usage'] ?? null),
        ];
    }

    private function extractResponseText(array $response): string
    {
        if (isset($response['output_text']) && is_string($response['output_text']) && trim($response['output_text']) !== '') {
            return trim($response['output_text']);
        }

        $parts = [];
        $output = $response['output'] ?? null;
        if (is_array($output)) {
            foreach ($output as $item) {
                if (!is_array($item)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $content = $item['content'] ?? null;
                if (!is_array($content)) {
                    continue;
                }
                foreach ($content as $contentItem) {
                    if (is_array($contentItem) && isset($contentItem['text']) && is_string($contentItem['text'])) {
                        $parts[] = $contentItem['text'];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return trim(implode("\n", $parts));
    }

    private function normalizeUsage(mixed $usage): array
    {
        if (!is_array($usage)) {
            return [
                'input_tokens' => 0,
                'output_tokens' => 0,
                'total_tokens' => 0,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'input_tokens' => isset($usage['input_tokens']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['input_tokens']) ? (int)$usage['input_tokens'] : 0,
            'output_tokens' => isset($usage['output_tokens']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['output_tokens']) ? (int)$usage['output_tokens'] : 0,
            'total_tokens' => isset($usage['total_tokens']) && is_numeric((string)$usage['total_tokens']) ? (int)$usage['total_tokens'] : 0,
        ];
    }
}

CONTENT:
# APRO Admin Tool

APRO is the file-aware AI workspace for the AXIAMAX Admin solution hosted at:

- `https://apro.maxflex.ai/admin/apro/`
- Filesystem path: `/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/admin/apro/`

## Environment

The application reads environment variables from:

- `/var/www/.env.master`

Required values depend on the features being used, but normally include:

- `ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` or compatible fallback credential names
- `OPENAI_API_KEY`
- `GITHUB_PAT` if GitHub publishing is used
- `SYSTEM_API_KEY` or HTTPS-agent API keys if remote server publishing is used
- `APRO_SCAN_ROOT` only if overriding the default `/var/www`

## Single-user access model

This installation is intended for one authenticated admin user. There are no roles, no master-admin gate, and no special privilege tiers inside APRO. Authentication is required, but once signed in the admin user can use all APRO features.

## Filesystem roots

For the EC2 migration, the local APRO filesystem scan root is `/var/www` unless overridden by `APRO_SCAN_ROOT`.

Remote Server / HTTPS Agent browsing and publishing should default to the actual remote root `/` unless a different root is explicitly configured by the admin user in the Server Connect modal.

GoDaddy shared-hosting browsing and publishing use runtime-selected cPanel account credentials and the selected account root path, typically `/public_html`.

## Main capabilities

- File tree browsing across the configured scan root
- Prompt-driven AI requests with selected file context
- File system analysis
- Feature analysis
- Implementation planning
- Publishable file generation, review, approval, and publishing
- Local file publishing with `.archive` rotation
- GitHub file reading and publishing
- Remote Server publishing through the HTTPS Agent
- GoDaddy shared-hosting file reading and publishing through runtime-selected cPanel accounts
- GoDaddy replacement publishing with `.archive` rotation
- Archive review and restore workflows
- GoDaddy selected-file archive review and restore workflows

## Important operational notes

- Public site content is separate from APRO and must not be changed unless explicitly requested.
- The restored public homepage is `/var/www/apro.maxflex.ai/index.php`.

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

function apro_ai_model_discovery_env(string $key, string $default = ''): string
{
    $value = apro_env_value($key, $default);
    return is_string($value) ? trim($value) : $default;
}

function apro_ai_model_discovery_api_base_url(): string
{
    $base = apro_ai_model_discovery_env('AIFLEX_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.maxflex.ai');
    return rtrim($base, '/');
}

function apro_ai_model_discovery_request(string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null): array
{
    $apiKey = apro_ai_model_discovery_env('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY');
    if ($apiKey === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY is not configured.');
    }

    $url = apro_ai_model_discovery_api_base_url() . $path;
    $ch = curl_init($url);
    if ($ch === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize discovery API request.');
    }

    $headers = [
        'Accept: application/json',
        'X-System-Api-Key: ' . $apiKey,
        'X-Caller-System: apro.maxflex.ai',
    ];

    $options = [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => strtoupper($method),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 120,
        CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 20,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
    ];

    if ($body !== null) {
        $encoded = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if (!is_string($encoded)) {
            curl_close($ch);
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode discovery API request body.');
        }
        $headers[] = 'Content-Type: application/json';
        $options[CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER] = $headers;
        $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $encoded;
    }

    curl_setopt_array($ch, $options);
    $raw = curl_exec($ch);
    $error = curl_error($ch);
    $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($raw === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Discovery API request failed: ' . $error);
    }

    $decoded = json_decode((string)$raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Discovery API returned non-JSON response.');
    }

    if ($status >= 400 || (($decoded['status'] ?? '') === 'error')) {
        $message = (string)($decoded['message'] ?? ('HTTP ' . $status));
        throw new RuntimeException($message);
    }

    return is_array($decoded['data'] ?? null) ? $decoded['data'] : [];
}

$method = strtoupper((string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET'));

try {
    if ($method === 'GET') {
        $action = trim((string)($_GET['action'] ?? 'summary'));

        if ($action === 'summary') {
            apro_json_success(apro_ai_model_discovery_request('GET', '/v1/catalog/summary'));
        }

        if ($action === 'catalog') {
            apro_json_success(apro_ai_model_discovery_request('GET', '/v1/catalog'));
        }

        if ($action === 'job_status') {
            $jobId = trim((string)($_GET['job_id'] ?? ''));
            if ($jobId === '') {
                apro_json_error('job_id is required.', 400);
            }
            apro_json_success(apro_ai_model_discovery_request('GET', '/v1/jobs/' . rawurlencode($jobId)));
        }

        if ($action === 'runs') {
            apro_json_success(apro_ai_model_discovery_request('GET', '/v1/runs'));
        }

        apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
    }

    if ($method === 'POST') {
        $payload = apro_read_request_json();
        $action = trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? 'refresh'));

        if ($action === 'refresh') {
            $body = [];
            if (isset($payload['source'])) {
                $body['source'] = (string)$payload['source'];
            }
            if (isset($payload['note'])) {
                $body['note'] = (string)$payload['note'];
            }
            apro_json_success(apro_ai_model_discovery_request('POST', '/v1/refresh', $body), 202);
        }

        apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
    }

    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$pathInput = $payload['path'] ?? '';
$normalizedPath = str_replace('\\', '/', trim((string)$pathInput));

if ($normalizedPath === '' || $normalizedPath === '/') {
    apro_json_error('A valid file path is required for archiving.', 400);
}

if ($normalizedPath[0] !== '/') {
    $normalizedPath = '/' . $normalizedPath;
}

if (apro_fs_is_archive_path($normalizedPath)) {
    apro_json_error('Archive files cannot be archived again.', 400);
}

try {
    $result = apro_fs_archive_file($normalizedPath);
    apro_json_success($result);
} catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
    $message = $exception->getMessage();
    $statusCode = 400;

    if (stripos($message, 'Selected path does not exist') !== false) {
        $statusCode = 404;
    } elseif (stripos($message, 'Failed') === 0) {
        $statusCode = 500;
    }

    apro_json_error($message, $statusCode);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}
