<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/privileged_publish.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

function apro_archives_is_archive_path(string $relativePath): bool
{
    return (bool)preg_match('/\.\d+\.archive$/', $relativePath);
}

function apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path(string $archiveRelativePath): string
{
    $livePath = preg_replace('/\.\d+\.archive$/', '', $archiveRelativePath);
    return is_string($livePath) ? $livePath : $archiveRelativePath;
}

function apro_archives_extract_version_number(string $archiveRelativePath): ?int
{
    if (preg_match('/\.(\d+)\.archive$/', $archiveRelativePath, $matches)) {
        return (int)$matches[1];
    }
    return null;
}

function apro_archives_count_lines(string $content): int
{
    if ($content === '') {
        return 0;
    }
    return substr_count($content, "\n") + 1;
}

function apro_archives_next_archive_absolute_path(string $liveAbsolutePath): string
{
    $archiveN = 1;
    while (true) {
        $candidate = $liveAbsolutePath . '.' . $archiveN . '.archive';
        if (!file_exists($candidate)) {
            return $candidate;
        }
        $archiveN++;
    }
}

function apro_archives_read_file_payload(string $relativePath): array
{
    $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($relativePath);
    if (!is_file($absolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('File not found: ' . $relativePath);
    }

    $content = file_get_contents($absolutePath);
    if ($content === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to read file: ' . $relativePath);
    }

    return [
        'path' => $relativePath,
        'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($absolutePath) ?: 0),
        'line_count' => apro_archives_count_lines($content),
        'modified_time' => @filemtime($absolutePath) ?: null,
        'content' => $content,
    ];
}

function apro_archives_get_file_permissions(string $absolutePath): ?int
{
    if (!file_exists($absolutePath)) {
        return null;
    }

    $perms = @fileperms($absolutePath);
    if ($perms === false) {
        return null;
    }

    return $perms & 0777;
}

function apro_archives_apply_file_permissions(string $absolutePath, ?int $permissions): void
{
    if ($permissions === null || !file_exists($absolutePath)) {
        return;
    }

    @chmod($absolutePath, $permissions);
}

function apro_archives_restore(string $archiveRelativePath): array
{
    if ($archiveRelativePath === '' || !apro_archives_is_archive_path($archiveRelativePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('A valid archive path is required for restore.');
    }

    $archiveAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($archiveRelativePath);
    if (!is_file($archiveAbsolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive file not found: ' . $archiveRelativePath);
    }

    $liveRelativePath = apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path($archiveRelativePath);
    $liveAbsolutePath = apro_priv_pub_absolute_path($liveRelativePath);

    $archiveContent = file_get_contents($archiveAbsolutePath);
    if ($archiveContent === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to read archive content.');
    }

    $existingPermissions = null;
    $backupArchiveAbsolutePath = null;
    if (is_file($liveAbsolutePath)) {
        $existingPermissions = apro_archives_get_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath);
        try {
            $archiveInfo = apro_priv_pub_archive_existing_file($liveAbsolutePath);
        } catch (Throwable $archiveError) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to archive the current live file before restore. ' . $archiveError->getMessage());
        }
        $backupArchiveAbsolutePath = (string)($archiveInfo['archive_absolute_path'] ?? '');
        if ($existingPermissions === null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '') {
            $existingPermissions = apro_archives_get_file_permissions($backupArchiveAbsolutePath);
        }
    }

    try {
        apro_priv_pub_install_content($archiveContent, $liveAbsolutePath);
    } catch (Throwable $writeError) {
        if ($backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '' && is_file($backupArchiveAbsolutePath) && !is_file($liveAbsolutePath)) {
            apro_priv_pub_restore_archived_file($backupArchiveAbsolutePath, $liveAbsolutePath);
            apro_archives_apply_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath, $existingPermissions);
        }
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to write restored content to the live file. ' . $writeError->getMessage());
    }

    apro_archives_apply_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath, $existingPermissions);

    return [
        'restored_live_path' => $liveRelativePath,
        'source_archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
        'backup_archive_path' => $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '' ? apro_fs_to_relative_path($backupArchiveAbsolutePath) : null,
        'restored_permissions' => $existingPermissions !== null ? sprintf('0%o', $existingPermissions) : null,
        'version' => apro_archives_extract_version_number($archiveRelativePath),
    ];
}

function apro_archives_scan_all(): array
{
    $scanRoot = apro_real_scan_root();
    $rii = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
        new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($scanRoot, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
        RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
    );

    $archives = [];
    foreach ($rii as $fileInfo) {
        if (!$fileInfo instanceof SplFileInfo) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!$fileInfo->isFile() || $fileInfo->isLink()) {
            continue;
        }

        $filename = $fileInfo->getFilename();
        if (!preg_match('/\.(\d+)\.archive$/', $filename, $matches)) {
            continue;
        }

        $archiveAbsolutePath = str_replace('\\', '/', $fileInfo->getPathname());
        $archiveRelativePath = apro_fs_to_relative_path($archiveAbsolutePath);
        $liveRelativePath = apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path($archiveRelativePath);

        $content = file_get_contents($archiveAbsolutePath);
        if ($content === false) {
            $content = '';
        }

        $liveExists = false;
        try {
            $liveAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($liveRelativePath);
            $liveExists = is_file($liveAbsolutePath);
        } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
            $liveExists = false;
        }

        $archives[] = [
            'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
            'live_path' => $liveRelativePath,
            'relative_dir' => dirname($archiveRelativePath),
            'live_exists' => $liveExists,
            'version' => (int)$matches[1],
            'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($archiveAbsolutePath) ?: 0),
            'line_count' => apro_archives_count_lines($content),
            'modified_time' => @filemtime($archiveAbsolutePath) ?: null,
        ];
    }

    usort($archives, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
        $dirCmp = strnatcasecmp((string)($a['live_path'] ?? ''), (string)($b['live_path'] ?? ''));
        if ($dirCmp !== 0) {
            return $dirCmp;
        }
        $verCmp = ((int)($b['version'] ?? 0)) <=> ((int)($a['version'] ?? 0));
        if ($verCmp !== 0) {
            return $verCmp;
        }
        return strnatcasecmp((string)($a['archive_path'] ?? ''), (string)($b['archive_path'] ?? ''));
    });

    return $archives;
}

function apro_archives_validate_archive_paths(array $archivePaths): array
{
    $validated = [];
    foreach ($archivePaths as $path) {
        $path = trim((string)$path);
        if ($path === '') {
            continue;
        }
        if (!apro_archives_is_archive_path($path)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid archive path in request: ' . $path);
        }
        $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($path);
        if (!is_file($absolutePath) || is_link($absolutePath)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Archive file not found: ' . $path);
        }
        $validated[$path] = $absolutePath;
    }
    return $validated;
}

function apro_archives_rehome(array $archivePaths, string $targetDirRelative): array
{
    $validated = apro_archives_validate_archive_paths($archivePaths);
    if (empty($validated)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('At least one valid archive path is required.');
    }

    $targetDirRelative = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $targetDirRelative));
    if ($targetDirRelative === '' || $targetDirRelative === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A target directory path is required for rehome.');
    }
    if ($targetDirRelative[0] !== '/') {
        $targetDirRelative = '/' . $targetDirRelative;
    }

    $targetAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($targetDirRelative . '/__placeholder__', true);
    $targetAbsoluteDir = dirname($targetAbsolutePath);
    if (!is_dir($targetAbsoluteDir)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Target rehome directory could not be created: ' . $targetDirRelative);
    }
    if (!is_writable($targetAbsoluteDir)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Target rehome directory is not writable: ' . $targetDirRelative);
    }

    $moved = [];
    $skipped = [];
    $errors = [];

    foreach ($validated as $archiveRelativePath => $archiveAbsolutePath) {
        try {
            $baseName = basename($archiveAbsolutePath);
            $destinationAbsolutePath = $targetAbsoluteDir . '/' . $baseName;
            $destinationRelativePath = apro_fs_to_relative_path($destinationAbsolutePath);

            if (str_replace('\\', '/', dirname($archiveAbsolutePath)) === str_replace('\\', '/', $targetAbsoluteDir)) {
                $skipped[] = [
                    'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
                    'reason' => 'Archive is already located in the target directory.'
                ];
                continue;
            }

            if (file_exists($destinationAbsolutePath)) {
                $skipped[] = [
                    'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
                    'reason' => 'A file with the same archive name already exists at the destination: ' . $destinationRelativePath
                ];
                continue;
            }

            if (!rename($archiveAbsolutePath, $destinationAbsolutePath)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to move archive to target directory.');
            }

            $moved[] = [
                'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
                'new_archive_path' => $destinationRelativePath
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
            $errors[] = [
                'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
                'message' => $throwable->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }

    return [
        'target_dir' => $targetDirRelative,
        'moved' => $moved,
        'skipped' => $skipped,
        'errors' => $errors,
    ];
}

function apro_archives_zip_selected(array $archivePaths, string $zipRelativePath): array
{
    $validated = apro_archives_validate_archive_paths($archivePaths);
    if (empty($validated)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('At least one valid archive path is required.');
    }

    $zipRelativePath = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $zipRelativePath));
    if ($zipRelativePath === '' || $zipRelativePath === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A ZIP output file path is required.');
    }
    if ($zipRelativePath[0] !== '/') {
        $zipRelativePath = '/' . $zipRelativePath;
    }
    if (strtolower(substr($zipRelativePath, -4)) !== '.zip') {
        throw new RuntimeException('ZIP output path must end with .zip');
    }

    $zipAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($zipRelativePath, true);
    $zipDir = dirname($zipAbsolutePath);
    if (!is_dir($zipDir) || !is_writable($zipDir)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('ZIP output directory is not writable: ' . dirname($zipRelativePath));
    }

    if (class_exists('ZipArchive')) {
        try {
            $zip = new ZipArchive();
            $openResult = $zip->open($zipAbsolutePath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE);
            if ($openResult !== true) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to open ZIP output for writing.');
            }

            $entryCount = 0;
            foreach ($validated as $archiveRelativePath => $archiveAbsolutePath) {
                $entryName = ltrim($archiveRelativePath, '/');
                if (!$zip->addFile($archiveAbsolutePath, $entryName)) {
                    $zip->close();
                    throw new RuntimeException('Failed to add archive to ZIP: ' . $archiveRelativePath);
                }
                $entryCount++;
            }

            if (!$zip->close()) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to finalize ZIP output.');
            }

            return [
                'zip_path' => $zipRelativePath,
                'entry_count' => $entryCount,
                'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($zipAbsolutePath) ?: 0),
            ];
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
        }
    }

    $tarPath = preg_replace('/\.zip$/i', '.tar', $zipAbsolutePath);
    if (!is_string($tarPath) || $tarPath === '') {
        $tarPath = $zipAbsolutePath . '.tar';
    }
    $gzPath = $tarPath . '.gz';
    try {
        if (file_exists($tarPath)) { @unlink($tarPath); }
        if (file_exists($gzPath)) { @unlink($gzPath); }
        $tar = new PharData($tarPath);
        foreach ($validated as $archiveRelativePath => $archiveAbsolutePath) {
            $tar->addFile($archiveAbsolutePath, ltrim($archiveRelativePath, '/'));
        }
        $tar->compress(Phar::GZ);
        unset($tar);
        @unlink($tarPath);
        return [
            'zip_path' => apro_fs_to_relative_path($gzPath),
            'entry_count' => count($validated),
            'size_bytes' => (int) (@filesize($gzPath) ?: 0)
        ];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $cmd = 'zip -j -q ' . escapeshellarg($zipAbsolutePath) . ' ' . implode(' ', array_map('escapeshellarg', array_values($validated)));
        @exec($cmd, $out, $rc);
        if ($rc === 0 && is_file($zipAbsolutePath)) {
            return [
                'zip_path' => $zipRelativePath,
                'entry_count' => count($validated),
                'size_bytes' => (int) (@filesize($zipAbsolutePath) ?: 0)
            ];
        }
        throw new RuntimeException('ZIP not available and PharData/system zip failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
    }
}

function apro_archives_make_timestamped_dir_name(): string
{
    $ts = gmdate('YmdHis');
    return '/apro.archive.' . $ts;
}

function apro_archives_delete_dir_recursive(string $absoluteDir): void
{
    $root = apro_real_scan_root();
    $dir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $absoluteDir), '/');
    if ($dir === '' || $dir === '/' || strpos($dir, $root) !== 0) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to delete a directory outside the scan root.');
    }
    if (!is_dir($dir)) {
        return;
    }
    $items = scandir($dir);
    if (is_array($items)) {
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if ($item === '.' || $item === '..') { continue; }
            $path = $dir . '/' . $item;
            if (is_dir($path) && !is_link($path)) {
                apro_archives_delete_dir_recursive($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
    }
    @rmdir($dir);
}

function apro_archives_rehome_and_zip(array $archivePaths, bool $deleteDirAfterZip = true): array
{
    $folderRelative = apro_archives_make_timestamped_dir_name();
    $placeholder = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($folderRelative . '/__placeholder__', true);
    $folderAbsolute = dirname($placeholder);

    $rehomeResult = apro_archives_rehome($archivePaths, $folderRelative);
    $moved = is_array($rehomeResult['moved'] ?? null) ? $rehomeResult['moved'] : [];

    $movedRelativePaths = [];
    foreach ($moved as $row) {
        if (!empty($row['new_archive_path'])) {
            $movedRelativePaths[] = (string)$row['new_archive_path'];
        }
    }
    if (empty($movedRelativePaths)) {
        $movedRelativePaths = array_values(array_map('strval', array_keys(apro_archives_validate_archive_paths($archivePaths))));
    }

    $zipRelative = $folderRelative . '.zip';
    $zipData = apro_archives_zip_selected($movedRelativePaths, $zipRelative);

    $deleted = false;
    if ($deleteDirAfterZip) {
        try {
            apro_archives_delete_dir_recursive($folderAbsolute);
            $deleted = !is_dir($folderAbsolute);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $deleted = false;
        }
    }

    return [
        'target_dir' => $folderRelative,
        'moved' => $moved,
        'zip_path' => (string)($zipData['zip_path'] ?? $zipRelative),
        'entry_count' => (int)($zipData['entry_count'] ?? 0),
        'size_bytes' => (int)($zipData['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
        'deleted_dir' => $deleted,
    ];
}

$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';

if ($method === 'GET') {
    $action = trim((string)($_GET['action'] ?? 'list_all'));
    $path = trim((string)($_GET['path'] ?? ''));

    try {
        if ($action === 'list_all') {

                'archives' => apro_archives_scan_all(),
            ]);
        }

        if ($action === 'get_archive') {
            if ($path === '' || !apro_archives_is_archive_path($path)) {
                apro_json_error('A valid archive path is required.', 400);

            $payload = apro_archives_read_file_payload($path);
            $payload['archive_path'] = $payload['path'];
            unset($payload['path']);
            $payload['live_path'] = apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path($path);
            $payload['version'] = apro_archives_extract_version_number($path);
            apro_json_success($payload);

        if ($action === 'get_current') {
            if ($path === '' || $path === '/' || apro_archives_is_archive_path($path)) {
                apro_json_error('A valid live file path is required.', 400);
            }
            apro_json_success(apro_archives_read_file_payload($path));
        }

        apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
    }
}

if ($method !== 'POST') {

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

// --- Utility: Strip Markdown Code Block ---
function apro_strip_markdown_code_block(string $text): string {
    $text = preg_replace('/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9]*\s*\r?\n?/i', '', $text);
    $text = preg_replace('/\r?\n?```\s*$/i', '', $text);
    return trim($text);
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

// Transport-safe prompt handling (supports prompt_b64 or plain prompt)
$prompt = '';
if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && $payload['prompt_b64'] !== '') {
    $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
    if ($decoded === false) {
        apro_json_error('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
    }
    $prompt = trim($decoded);
} else {
    $prompt = trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? ''));
}

$selectedPaths = $payload['selected_paths'] ?? [];
$serviceId = trim((string)($payload['service_id'] ?? ''));
$analysisMode = (string)($payload['analysis_mode'] ?? 'prompt');

if ($prompt === '' && (!is_array($selectedPaths) || count($selectedPaths) === 0)) {
    apro_json_error('Either prompt or at least one selected file is required.', 400);
}
if ($serviceId === '') {
    apro_json_error('AI Service ID is required.', 400);
}
if (!in_array($analysisMode, ['prompt', 'files', 'both'], true)) {
    apro_json_error('analysis_mode must be "prompt", "files" or "both".', 400);
}

try {
    $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($serviceId);
    if ($service === null) {
        apro_json_error('Selected AI service is not available.', 400);
    }

    $provider = apro_ai_provider_from_service($service);

    $includePaths = $analysisMode === 'files' || $analysisMode === 'both';
    $includeContents = $analysisMode === 'files' || $analysisMode === 'both';

    $selectedItems = [];
    if ($includePaths && is_array($selectedPaths) && count($selectedPaths) > 0) {
        // Defensive validation: server accepts ONLY file paths (no directory nodes).
        foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
            $p = trim((string)$p);
            if ($p === '') continue;
            try {
                $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($p);
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                apro_json_error('Selected path is invalid or does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
            }
            if (!is_file($abs)) {
                apro_json_error('Selected paths must be file paths only. Do not send directory nodes: ' . $p, 400);
            }
        }

        $selectedItemsArr = apro_fs_collect_selected_items($selectedPaths, true, true);
        $selectedItems = $selectedItemsArr['items'];
    }
    $selectedCount = is_array($selectedItems) ? count($selectedItems) : 0;

    // Load the prompt template for feature extraction
    $promptFile = APRO_PROMPTS_DIR . '/feature_analysis.txt';
    if (!file_exists($promptFile) || !is_readable($promptFile)) {
        apro_json_error('System misconfiguration: feature_analysis.txt prompt missing.', 500);
    }
    $featurePrompt = trim(file_get_contents($promptFile));

    // Compose the full user message (prompt + files, as fits the mode)
    $userMessageLines = [];
    $userMessageLines[] = 'PRIMARY USER PROMPT:';
    $userMessageLines[] = $featurePrompt;
    $userMessageLines[] = '';
    $userMessageLines[] = 'REQUEST CONTEXT:';
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Feature extraction mode: ' . $analysisMode;
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Prompt field input: ' . ($prompt !== '' ? '(present)' : '(empty)');
    $userMessageLines[] = '- File selection count: ' . count($selectedPaths);
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Resolved file count: ' . $selectedCount;
    $userMessageLines[] = '';
    if ($prompt !== '') {
        $userMessageLines[] = 'PROMPT FIELD INPUT:';
        $userMessageLines[] = $prompt;
        $userMessageLines[] = '';
    }
    if ($selectedCount > 0) {
        foreach ($selectedItems as $index => $item) {
            $userMessageLines[] = 'FILE ' . ($index + 1) . ':';
            if (isset($item['path'])) {
                $userMessageLines[] = 'Path: ' . (string)$item['path'];
            }
            if (isset($item['encoding'])) { $userMessageLines[] = 'Encoding: ' . (string)$item['encoding']; }
            if (isset($item['truncated'])) { $userMessageLines[] = 'Truncated: ' . ($item['truncated'] ? 'yes' : 'no'); }
            if (isset($item['content'])) {
                $userMessageLines[] = 'Content:';
                $userMessageLines[] = (string)$item['content'];
            }
            $userMessageLines[] = '';
        }
    }
    $fullPrompt = implode("\n", $userMessageLines);

    // Let provider template if it wants
    $finalPromptText = '';
    if (method_exists($provider, 'buildUserMessage')) {
        $finalPromptText = $provider->buildUserMessage($featurePrompt . "\n\n" . $prompt, $selectedItems, [
            'selected_count' => $selectedCount,
            'resolved_file_count' => $selectedCount
        ]);
    } else {
        $finalPromptText = $fullPrompt;
    }

    $result = $provider->sendRequest(
        $service,
        $finalPromptText,
        $selectedItems,
        [
            'analysis_mode' => $analysisMode,
            'prompt_field' => $prompt,
        ]
    );

    $responseText = $result['response_text'] ?? '';
    $providerResponse = $result['provider_response'] ?? null;

    // --- Robust: Strip markdown code blocks before JSON extraction ---
    $cleanText = apro_strip_markdown_code_block($responseText);
    // Extract JSON array of features defensively
    $jsonStart = strpos($cleanText, '[');
    $jsonEnd = strrpos($cleanText, ']');
    $features = [];
    if ($jsonStart !== false && $jsonEnd !== false && $jsonStart < $jsonEnd) {
        $jsonBlock = substr($cleanText, $jsonStart, $jsonEnd - $jsonStart + 1);
        $parsed = json_decode($jsonBlock, true);
        if (is_array($parsed)) {
            $features = $parsed;
        }
    }
    // Fallback: try whole block
    if (empty($features)) {
        $parsed = json_decode($cleanText, true);
        if (is_array($parsed)) {
            $features = $parsed;
        }
    }

    apro_json_success([
        'features' => $features,
        'ai_response_text' => $responseText,
        'provider_response' => $providerResponse
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/privileged_publish.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

function apro_archives_is_archive_path(string $relativePath): bool
{
    return (bool)preg_match('/\.\d+\.archive$/', $relativePath);
}

function apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path(string $archiveRelativePath): string
{
    $livePath = preg_replace('/\.\d+\.archive$/', '', $archiveRelativePath);
    return is_string($livePath) ? $livePath : $archiveRelativePath;
}

function apro_archives_extract_version_number(string $archiveRelativePath): ?int
{
    if (preg_match('/\.(\d+)\.archive$/', $archiveRelativePath, $matches)) {
        return (int)$matches[1];
    }
    return null;
}

function apro_archives_count_lines(string $content): int
{
    if ($content === '') {
        return 0;
    }
    return substr_count($content, "\n") + 1;
}

function apro_archives_next_archive_absolute_path(string $liveAbsolutePath): string
{
    $archiveN = 1;
    while (true) {
        $candidate = $liveAbsolutePath . '.' . $archiveN . '.archive';
        if (!file_exists($candidate)) {
            return $candidate;
        }
        $archiveN++;
    }
}

function apro_archives_read_file_payload(string $relativePath): array
{
    $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($relativePath);
    if (!is_file($absolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('File not found: ' . $relativePath);
    }

    $content = file_get_contents($absolutePath);
    if ($content === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to read file: ' . $relativePath);
    }

    return [
        'path' => $relativePath,
        'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($absolutePath) ?: 0),
        'line_count' => apro_archives_count_lines($content),
        'modified_time' => @filemtime($absolutePath) ?: null,
        'content' => $content,
    ];
}

function apro_archives_resolve_live_lookup_context(string $liveRelativePath): array
{
    if ($liveRelativePath === '' || $liveRelativePath === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A live file path is required.');
    }
    if (apro_archives_is_archive_path($liveRelativePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Use a live file path, not an archive path, when listing archives.');
    }

    $normalizedRelativePath = str_replace('\\', '/', trim($liveRelativePath));
    if ($normalizedRelativePath === '' || $normalizedRelativePath === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A live file path is required.');
    }
    if ($normalizedRelativePath[0] !== '/') {
        $normalizedRelativePath = '/' . $normalizedRelativePath;
    }

    $liveAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($normalizedRelativePath, false);
    $scanRoot = apro_real_scan_root();
    $absoluteDirectory = dirname($liveAbsolutePath);
    $baseName = basename($liveAbsolutePath);

    $normalizedDirectory = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $absoluteDirectory), '/');
    if ($normalizedDirectory === '') {
        $normalizedDirectory = '/';
    }

    if ($normalizedDirectory !== $scanRoot && strpos($normalizedDirectory, $scanRoot . '/') !== 0) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Selected path is outside the allowed scan root: ' . $normalizedRelativePath);
    }

    if (!is_dir($normalizedDirectory) || !is_readable($normalizedDirectory)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Directory for live file does not exist or is not readable: ' . $normalizedRelativePath);
    }

    return [
        'live_relative_path' => $normalizedRelativePath,
        'live_absolute_path' => $liveAbsolutePath,
        'directory' => $normalizedDirectory,
        'basename' => $baseName,
        'live_exists' => is_file($liveAbsolutePath),
    ];
}

function apro_archives_list_for_live_file(string $liveRelativePath): array
{
    $context = apro_archives_resolve_live_lookup_context($liveRelativePath);
    $directory = $context['directory'];
    $baseName = $context['basename'];
    $liveRelativePath = $context['live_relative_path'];

    $entries = scandir($directory);
    if (!is_array($entries)) {
        return [];
    }

    $archives = [];
    foreach ($entries as $entry) {
        if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
            continue;
        }

        if (!preg_match('/^' . preg_quote($baseName, '/') . '\.(\d+)\.archive$/', $entry, $matches)) {
            continue;
        }

        $archiveAbsolutePath = $directory . '/' . $entry;
        if (!is_file($archiveAbsolutePath) || is_link($archiveAbsolutePath)) {
            continue;
        }

        $archiveRelativePath = apro_fs_to_relative_path($archiveAbsolutePath);
        $content = file_get_contents($archiveAbsolutePath);
        if ($content === false) {
            $content = '';
        }

        $archives[] = [
            'archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
            'live_path' => $liveRelativePath,
            'live_exists' => (bool)$context['live_exists'],
            'version' => (int)$matches[1],
            'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($archiveAbsolutePath) ?: 0),
            'line_count' => apro_archives_count_lines($content),
            'modified_time' => @filemtime($archiveAbsolutePath) ?: null,
        ];
    }

    usort($archives, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
        return ((int)($b['version'] ?? 0)) <=> ((int)($a['version'] ?? 0));
    });

    return $archives;
}

function apro_archives_get_file_permissions(string $absolutePath): ?int
{
    if (!file_exists($absolutePath)) {
        return null;
    }

    $perms = @fileperms($absolutePath);
    if ($perms === false) {
        return null;
    }

    return $perms & 0777;
}

function apro_archives_apply_file_permissions(string $absolutePath, ?int $permissions): void
{
    if ($permissions === null || !file_exists($absolutePath)) {
        return;
    }

    @chmod($absolutePath, $permissions);
}

function apro_archives_restore(string $archiveRelativePath): array
{
    if ($archiveRelativePath === '' || !apro_archives_is_archive_path($archiveRelativePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('A valid archive path is required for restore.');
    }

    $archiveAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($archiveRelativePath);
    if (!is_file($archiveAbsolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive file not found: ' . $archiveRelativePath);
    }

    $liveRelativePath = apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path($archiveRelativePath);
    $liveAbsolutePath = apro_priv_pub_absolute_path($liveRelativePath);

    $archiveContent = file_get_contents($archiveAbsolutePath);
    if ($archiveContent === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to read archive content.');
    }

    $existingPermissions = null;
    $backupArchiveAbsolutePath = null;
    if (is_file($liveAbsolutePath)) {
        $existingPermissions = apro_archives_get_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath);
        try {
            $archiveInfo = apro_priv_pub_archive_existing_file($liveAbsolutePath);
        } catch (Throwable $archiveError) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to archive the current live file before restore. ' . $archiveError->getMessage());
        }
        $backupArchiveAbsolutePath = (string)($archiveInfo['archive_absolute_path'] ?? '');
        if ($existingPermissions === null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '') {
            $existingPermissions = apro_archives_get_file_permissions($backupArchiveAbsolutePath);
        }
    }

    try {
        apro_priv_pub_install_content($archiveContent, $liveAbsolutePath);
    } catch (Throwable $writeError) {
        if ($backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '' && is_file($backupArchiveAbsolutePath) && !is_file($liveAbsolutePath)) {
            apro_priv_pub_restore_archived_file($backupArchiveAbsolutePath, $liveAbsolutePath);
            apro_archives_apply_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath, $existingPermissions);
        }
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to write restored content to the live file. ' . $writeError->getMessage());
    }

    apro_archives_apply_file_permissions($liveAbsolutePath, $existingPermissions);

    return [
        'restored_live_path' => $liveRelativePath,
        'source_archive_path' => $archiveRelativePath,
        'backup_archive_path' => $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== null && $backupArchiveAbsolutePath !== '' ? apro_fs_to_relative_path($backupArchiveAbsolutePath) : null,
        'restored_permissions' => $existingPermissions !== null ? sprintf('0%o', $existingPermissions) : null,
        'version' => apro_archives_extract_version_number($archiveRelativePath),
    ];
}

$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';

if ($method === 'GET') {
    $action = trim((string)($_GET['action'] ?? 'list'));
    $path = trim((string)($_GET['path'] ?? ''));

    try {
        if ($action === 'list') {
            apro_json_success([
                'path' => $path,
                'archives' => apro_archives_list_for_live_file($path),
            ]);
        }

        if ($action === 'get_archive') {
            if ($path === '' || !apro_archives_is_archive_path($path)) {
                apro_json_error('A valid archive path is required.', 400);
            }
            $payload = apro_archives_read_file_payload($path);
            $payload['archive_path'] = $payload['path'];
            unset($payload['path']);
            $payload['live_path'] = apro_archives_extract_live_relative_path($path);
            $payload['version'] = apro_archives_extract_version_number($path);
            apro_json_success($payload);
        }

        if ($action === 'get_current') {
            if ($path === '' || $path === '/' || apro_archives_is_archive_path($path)) {
                apro_json_error('A valid live file path is required.', 400);
            }
            apro_json_success(apro_archives_read_file_payload($path));
        }

        apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
    }
}

if ($method !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$action = trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? ''));

try {
    if ($action === 'restore') {
        $archivePath = trim((string)($payload['archive_path'] ?? ''));
        apro_json_success(apro_archives_restore($archivePath));
    }

    apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

function apro_file_types_normalize_extension(string $extension): string
{
    $extension = strtolower(trim($extension));
    if ($extension === '') { return ''; }
    return $extension[0] === '.' ? $extension : '.' . $extension;
}

function apro_file_types_extensions_from_value(mixed $value): array
{
    if (is_string($value)) { return [apro_file_types_normalize_extension($value)]; }
    if (!is_array($value)) { return []; }
    if (array_is_list($value)) {
        return array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map(static fn($v): string => is_string($v) ? apro_file_types_normalize_extension($v) : '', $value))));
    }

    $out = [];
    foreach (['extensions', 'text_extensions', 'binary_extensions', 'ext', 'extension'] as $key) {
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $value)) { continue; }
        $raw = $value[$key];
        if (is_string($raw)) { $out[] = apro_file_types_normalize_extension($raw); }
        if (is_array($raw)) {
            foreach ($raw as $item) {
                if (is_string($item)) { $out[] = apro_file_types_normalize_extension($item); }
            }
        }
    }
    return array_values(array_unique(array_filter($out)));
}

function apro_file_types_add_group_extension(array &$groups, string $group, string $extension): void
{
    $group = trim($group) !== '' ? trim($group) : 'Other';
    $extension = apro_file_types_normalize_extension($extension);
    if ($extension === '') { return; }
    if (!isset($groups[$group]) || !is_array($groups[$group])) { $groups[$group] = []; }
    if (!in_array($extension, $groups[$group], true)) { $groups[$group][] = $extension; }
}

function apro_file_types_normalize(array $config): array
{
    $groups = [];
    $types = [];
    $textExtensions = [];
    $binaryExtensions = [];

    foreach (($config['text_extensions'] ?? []) as $extension) {
        if (is_string($extension)) { $textExtensions[] = apro_file_types_normalize_extension($extension); }
    }
    foreach (($config['binary_extensions'] ?? []) as $extension) {
        if (is_string($extension)) { $binaryExtensions[] = apro_file_types_normalize_extension($extension); }
    }

    foreach (($config['groups'] ?? []) as $group => $value) {
        foreach (apro_file_types_extensions_from_value($value) as $extension) { apro_file_types_add_group_extension($groups, (string)$group, $extension); }
    }
    foreach (($config['categories'] ?? []) as $group => $value) {
        foreach (apro_file_types_extensions_from_value($value) as $extension) { apro_file_types_add_group_extension($groups, (string)$group, $extension); }
    }

    foreach (($config['types'] ?? []) as $key => $value) {
        if (!is_array($value)) { continue; }
        $extensions = apro_file_types_extensions_from_value($value);
        $extension = $extensions[0] ?? apro_file_types_normalize_extension((string)$key);
        if ($extension === '') { continue; }
        $category = (string)($value['category'] ?? $value['group'] ?? 'Other');
        $label = (string)($value['label'] ?? $value['name'] ?? strtoupper(ltrim($extension, '.')));
        $mime = $value['mime'] ?? $value['mime_type'] ?? null;
        $isText = (bool)($value['text'] ?? $value['is_text'] ?? in_array($extension, $textExtensions, true));
        $isBinary = (bool)($value['binary'] ?? $value['is_binary'] ?? in_array($extension, $binaryExtensions, true));
        foreach (array_unique(array_merge($extensions, [$extension])) as $ext) {
            apro_file_types_add_group_extension($groups, $category, $ext);
            if ($isText && !in_array($ext, $textExtensions, true)) { $textExtensions[] = $ext; }
            if ($isBinary && !in_array($ext, $binaryExtensions, true)) { $binaryExtensions[] = $ext; }
        }
        $types[ltrim($extension, '.')] = [
            'extension' => $extension,
            'label' => $label,
            'category' => $category,
            'mime' => $mime,
            'text' => $isText,
            'binary' => $isBinary,
        ];
    }

    if (!$groups) {
        $groups = [
            'Coding' => ['.css', '.html', '.htaccess', '.ini', '.js', '.json', '.md', '.php', '.py', '.sh', '.sql', '.txt', '.xml', '.yml', '.yaml'],
            'Image' => ['.avif', '.gif', '.ico', '.jpeg', '.jpg', '.png', '.svg', '.webp'],
            'Document' => ['.csv', '.doc', '.docx', '.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.rtf', '.xls', '.xlsx'],
            'Archive' => ['.7z', '.gz', '.rar', '.tar', '.tgz', '.zip'],
            'Audio' => ['.aac', '.flac', '.m4a', '.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav'],
            'Video' => ['.avi', '.m4v', '.mov', '.mp4', '.mpeg', '.webm'],
        ];
    }

    foreach ($groups as $group => $extensions) {
        $groups[$group] = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('apro_file_types_normalize_extension', $extensions))));
        sort($groups[$group], SORT_STRING);
        foreach ($groups[$group] as $extension) {
            $key = ltrim($extension, '.');
            if (!isset($types[$key])) {
                $types[$key] = [
                    'extension' => $extension,
                    'label' => strtoupper($key),
                    'category' => $group,
                    'mime' => null,
                    'text' => in_array($extension, $textExtensions, true) || !in_array($extension, $binaryExtensions, true),
                    'binary' => in_array($extension, $binaryExtensions, true),
                ];
            }
        }
    }

    ksort($groups, SORT_NATURAL | SORT_FLAG_CASE);
    ksort($types, SORT_NATURAL | SORT_FLAG_CASE);
    $textExtensions = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('apro_file_types_normalize_extension', $textExtensions))));
    $binaryExtensions = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map('apro_file_types_normalize_extension', $binaryExtensions))));
    sort($textExtensions, SORT_STRING);
    sort($binaryExtensions, SORT_STRING);

    $allExtensions = [];
    $byExtension = [];
    foreach ($groups as $group => $extensions) {
        foreach ($extensions as $extension) {
            $allExtensions[] = $extension;
            $byExtension[$extension] = $group;
        }
    }
    $allExtensions = array_values(array_unique($allExtensions));
    sort($allExtensions, SORT_STRING);

    return [
        'schema' => 'apro-file-types-normalized-v1',
        'version' => $config['version'] ?? null,
        'groups' => $groups,
        'categories' => $groups,
        'byGroup' => $groups,
        'byExtension' => $byExtension,
        'types' => $types,
        'extensions' => $allExtensions,
        'text_extensions' => $textExtensions,
        'binary_extensions' => $binaryExtensions,
        'raw' => $config,
    ];
}

$configPath = __DIR__ . '/../config/file_types.json';
if (!is_file($configPath) || !is_readable($configPath)) { apro_json_error('File type configuration not found.', 404); }
$config = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configPath), true);
if (!is_array($config)) { apro_json_error('Invalid file type configuration JSON.', 500); }

$normalized = apro_file_types_normalize($config);
if (isset($_GET['legacy']) && $_GET['legacy'] !== '0') {
    if (!headers_sent()) { header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8'); }
    echo json_encode($normalized['groups'], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

apro_json_success($normalized);

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'GET') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$allowMissing = isset($_GET['allow_missing']) && filter_var($_GET['allow_missing'], FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);

$rawRelPath = (string)($_GET['path'] ?? '');
$trimmedPath = trim($rawRelPath);
if ($trimmedPath === '' || $trimmedPath === '/') {
    apro_json_error('File path is required.', 400);
}

$normalizedRelPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $trimmedPath);
$normalizedRelPath = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $normalizedRelPath);
if ($normalizedRelPath[0] !== '/') {
    $normalizedRelPath = '/' . $normalizedRelPath;
}
if ($normalizedRelPath === '/') {
    apro_json_error('File path is required.', 400);
}

try {
    if ($allowMissing) {
        $candidateAbsolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($normalizedRelPath, false);

        if (!file_exists($candidateAbsolutePath)) {
            apro_json_success([
                'path' => $normalizedRelPath,
                'exists' => false,
            ]);
        }

        if (!is_file($candidateAbsolutePath) || is_link($candidateAbsolutePath)) {
            apro_json_error('Not a regular file: ' . $normalizedRelPath, 400);
        }

        $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($normalizedRelPath);
    } else {
        $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($normalizedRelPath);
    }

    if (!is_file($absolutePath) || is_link($absolutePath)) {
        apro_json_error('Not a regular file: ' . $normalizedRelPath, 400);
    }

    $sizeBytes = (int)(@filesize($absolutePath) ?: 0);

    $fileData = apro_fs_read_file_for_ai($absolutePath);
    $encoding = (string)($fileData['encoding'] ?? 'text');
    $content = (string)($fileData['content'] ?? '');
    $truncated = (bool)($fileData['truncated'] ?? false);

    $lineCount = null;
    if ($encoding === 'text') {
        if ($content === '') {
            $lineCount = 0;
        } else {
            $lineCount = substr_count($content, "\n") + 1;
        }
    }

    $payload = [
        'path' => $normalizedRelPath,
        'size_bytes' => $sizeBytes,
        'encoding' => $encoding,
        'truncated' => $truncated,
        'content' => $content,
        'exists' => true,
    ];

    if ($lineCount !== null) {
        $payload['line_count'] = $lineCount;
    }

    apro_json_success($payload);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    $message = $e->getMessage();

    if ($allowMissing && strpos($message, 'Selected path does not exist') !== false) {
        apro_json_success([
            'path' => $normalizedRelPath,
            'exists' => false,
        ]);
    }

    if (strpos($message, 'Selected path does not exist') !== false) {
        apro_json_error('File path not found: ' . $normalizedRelPath, 404);
    }

    apro_json_error($message, 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/server/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/godaddy/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

function apro_generate_files_env(string $key, string $default = ''): string
{
    $value = apro_env_value($key, $default);
    return is_string($value) ? trim($value) : $default;
}

function apro_generate_files_api_base_url(): string
{
    $base = apro_generate_files_env('AIFLEX_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.maxflex.ai');
    return rtrim($base, '/');
}

function apro_generate_files_private_api_request(string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null): array
{
    $apiKey = apro_generate_files_env('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY');
    if ($apiKey === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('MF_ADMIN_API_KEY is not configured.');
    }

    $url = apro_generate_files_api_base_url() . $path;
    $ch = curl_init($url);
    if ($ch === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize private API request.');
    }

    $headers = [
        'Accept: application/json',
        'X-System-Api-Key: ' . $apiKey,
        'X-Caller-System: apro.maxflex.ai',
    ];

    $options = [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => strtoupper($method),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 180,
        CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 20,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
    ];

    if ($body !== null) {
        $encoded = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if (!is_string($encoded)) {
            curl_close($ch);
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode private API request body.');
        }
        $headers[] = 'Content-Type: application/json';
        $options[CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER] = $headers;
        $options[CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS] = $encoded;
    }

    curl_setopt_array($ch, $options);
    $raw = curl_exec($ch);
    $error = curl_error($ch);
    $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($raw === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Private API request failed: ' . $error);
    }

    $decoded = json_decode((string)$raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Private API returned non-JSON response.');
    }

    if ($status >= 400 || (($decoded['status'] ?? '') === 'error')) {
        $message = (string)($decoded['message'] ?? ('HTTP ' . $status));
        throw new RuntimeException($message);
    }

    return is_array($decoded['data'] ?? null) ? $decoded['data'] : [];
}

function apro_generate_files_prompt(array $payload): string
{
    if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && trim((string)$payload['prompt_b64']) !== '') {
        $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            apro_json_error('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
        }
        return trim($decoded);
    }

    return trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? ''));
}

function apro_generate_files_normalize_selected_paths(mixed $raw): array
{
    if (!is_array($raw)) {
        return [];
    }

    $out = [];
    foreach ($raw as $path) {
        if (!is_string($path) && !is_numeric($path)) {
            continue;
        }
        $value = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', (string)$path));
        $value = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $value) ?: $value;
        if ($value === '' || $value === '/') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($value[0] !== '/') {
            $value = '/' . ltrim($value, '/');
        }
        $out[] = $value;
    }

    return array_values(array_unique($out));
}

function apro_generate_files_resolve_selected_items(array $selectedPaths, array $payload): array
{
    $github = $payload['github'] ?? null;
    $remote = $payload['remote'] ?? null;
    $godaddy = $payload['godaddy'] ?? null;

    $usingGithub = is_array($github)
        && trim((string)($github['owner'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($github['repo'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($github['branch'] ?? '')) !== '';

    $usingRemote = is_array($remote)
        && trim((string)($remote['server_url'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($remote['api_key'] ?? '')) !== '';

    $usingGoDaddy = is_array($godaddy)
        && trim((string)($godaddy['base_url'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($godaddy['username'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($godaddy['api_token'] ?? '')) !== '';

    if ($usingGithub) {
        $owner = trim((string)$github['owner']);
        $repo = trim((string)$github['repo']);
        $branch = trim((string)$github['branch']);
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $path) {
            if ($path[0] !== '/') {
                apro_json_error('Selected GitHub file path must start with "/": ' . $path, 400);
            }
            if (strpos($path, '..') !== false) {
                apro_json_error('Selected GitHub file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $path, 400);
            }
            $repoPath = ltrim($path, '/');
            $file = apro_github_fetch_file_content($owner, $repo, $branch, $repoPath);
            $content = (string)($file['content'] ?? '');
            $total += strlen($content);
            if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                apro_json_error('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
            }
            $item = [
                'path' => (string)($file['path'] ?? ('/' . $repoPath)),
                'size_bytes' => (int)($file['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                'encoding' => (string)($file['encoding'] ?? 'text'),
                'truncated' => !empty($file['truncated']),
                'content' => $content,
            ];
            if (isset($file['line_count'])) {
                $item['line_count'] = (int)$file['line_count'];
            }
            $items[] = $item;
        }

        return [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $total,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    }

    if ($usingRemote) {
        $serverUrl = trim((string)$remote['server_url']);
        $apiKey = trim((string)$remote['api_key']);
        $insecure = (bool)($remote['insecure'] ?? false);
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $path) {
            if ($path[0] !== '/') {
                apro_json_error('Selected remote file path must start with "/": ' . $path, 400);
            }
            if (strpos($path, '..') !== false) {
                apro_json_error('Selected remote file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $path, 400);
            }
            $file = apro_server_fetch_file_payload($serverUrl, $apiKey, $path, $insecure, false);
            if (($file['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                apro_json_error('Selected remote path does not exist: ' . $path, 400);
            }
            $content = (string)($file['content'] ?? '');
            $total += strlen($content);
            if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                apro_json_error('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
            }
            $item = [
                'path' => (string)($file['path'] ?? $path),
                'size_bytes' => (int)($file['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                'encoding' => (string)($file['encoding'] ?? 'text'),
                'truncated' => !empty($file['truncated']),
                'content' => $content,
            ];
            if (isset($file['line_count'])) {
                $item['line_count'] = (int)$file['line_count'];
            }
            $items[] = $item;
        }

        return [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $total,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    }

    if ($usingGoDaddy) {
        $baseUrl = trim((string)$godaddy['base_url']);
        $username = trim((string)$godaddy['username']);
        $apiToken = trim((string)$godaddy['api_token']);
        $insecure = apro_godaddy_bool($godaddy['insecure'] ?? false, false);
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $path) {
            if ($path[0] !== '/') {
                apro_json_error('Selected GoDaddy file path must start with "/": ' . $path, 400);
            }
            if (strpos($path, '..') !== false) {
                apro_json_error('Selected GoDaddy file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $path, 400);
            }
            $file = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload($baseUrl, $username, $apiToken, $path, $insecure);
            if (($file['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                apro_json_error('Selected GoDaddy path does not exist: ' . $path, 400);
            }
            $content = (string)($file['content'] ?? '');
            $total += strlen($content);
            if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                apro_json_error('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
            }
            $item = [
                'path' => (string)($file['path'] ?? $path),
                'size_bytes' => (int)($file['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                'encoding' => (string)($file['encoding'] ?? 'text'),
                'truncated' => !empty($file['truncated']),
                'content' => $content,
            ];
            if (isset($file['line_count'])) {
                $item['line_count'] = (int)$file['line_count'];
            }
            $items[] = $item;
        }

        return [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $total,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    }

    foreach ($selectedPaths as $path) {
        try {
            $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($path);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            apro_json_error('Selected path is invalid or does not exist: ' . $path, 400);
        }
        if (!is_file($abs)) {
            apro_json_error('Selected paths must be file paths only. Do not send directory nodes: ' . $path, 400);
        }
    }

    return apro_fs_collect_selected_items($selectedPaths, true, true);
}

function apro_generate_files_model_payload(array $payload): array
{
    $model = $payload['model'] ?? null;
    if (is_array($model)) {
        $provider = strtolower(trim((string)($model['provider'] ?? '')));
        $modelId = trim((string)($model['model_id'] ?? $model['id'] ?? ''));
        $canonical = trim((string)($model['catalog_canonical_id'] ?? ''));
        $label = trim((string)($model['label'] ?? ''));

        if ($provider === '' && $canonical !== '' && strpos($canonical, ':') !== false) {
            $provider = strtolower(trim((string)substr($canonical, 0, strpos($canonical, ':'))));
        }
        if ($modelId === '' && $canonical !== '' && strpos($canonical, ':') !== false) {
            $modelId = trim((string)substr($canonical, strpos($canonical, ':') + 1));
        }

        if ($provider !== '' && $modelId !== '') {
            return [
                'provider' => $provider,
                'model_id' => $modelId,
                'catalog_canonical_id' => $canonical,
                'label' => $label,
            ];
        }
    }

    $serviceId = trim((string)($payload['service_id'] ?? ''));
    $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($serviceId);
    if ($service === null) {
        $service = apro_get_effective_ai_service();
    }
    if ($service === null) {
        apro_json_error('Unable to resolve selected AI model.', 400);
    }

    $provider = strtolower(trim((string)($service['provider'] ?? 'openai')));
    $modelId = trim((string)($service['model'] ?? $service['id'] ?? ''));
    if ($modelId === '') {
        apro_json_error('Unable to resolve selected AI model id.', 400);
    }

    return [
        'provider' => $provider,
        'model_id' => $modelId,
        'catalog_canonical_id' => $provider !== '' ? ($provider . ':' . $modelId) : '',
        'label' => trim((string)($service['label'] ?? $service['name'] ?? $modelId)),
    ];
}

$payload = apro_read_request_json();
if (!is_array($payload) || $payload === []) {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$prompt = apro_generate_files_prompt($payload);
$selectedPaths = apro_generate_files_normalize_selected_paths($payload['selected_paths'] ?? []);

if ($prompt === '') {
    apro_json_error('Prompt is required.', 400);
}
if ($selectedPaths === []) {
    apro_json_error('At least one selected file is required.', 400);
}

try {
    $selectedItems = apro_generate_files_resolve_selected_items($selectedPaths, $payload);
    if ((int)($selectedItems['resolved_file_count'] ?? 0) === 0) {
        apro_json_error('No selected files could be resolved.', 400);
    }

    $modelPayload = apro_generate_files_model_payload($payload);

    $requestBody = [
        'prompt' => $prompt,
        'selected_files' => array_values($selectedItems['items'] ?? []),
        'model' => $modelPayload,
        'context' => [
            'source_system' => 'apro.maxflex.ai',
            'selected_count' => (int)($selectedItems['selected_count'] ?? count($selectedPaths)),
            'resolved_file_count' => (int)($selectedItems['resolved_file_count'] ?? 0),
        ],
    ];

    $apiResult = apro_generate_files_private_api_request('POST', '/v1/generate-files', $requestBody);

    apro_json_success($apiResult);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$owner = trim((string)($payload['owner'] ?? ''));
$repo = trim((string)($payload['repo'] ?? ''));
$branch = trim((string)($payload['branch'] ?? ''));
$path = trim((string)($payload['path'] ?? ''));
$content = (string)($payload['content'] ?? '');
$commitMessage = trim((string)($payload['commit_message'] ?? ''));
$encoding = strtolower((string)($payload['encoding'] ?? 'text'));

if ($owner === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub owner is required.', 400); }
if ($repo === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub repository name is required.', 400); }
if ($branch === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub branch is required.', 400); }
if ($path === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub target path is required.', 400); }
if ($commitMessage === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub commit message is required.', 400); }

try {
    // For binary tiles, payload.content is expected to be base64; decode to raw bytes before calling publish helper
    if ($encoding === 'base64' && $content !== '') {
        $decoded = base64_decode($content, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            apro_json_error('Invalid base64 content for binary publish.', 400);
        }
        $content = $decoded;
    }

    $result = apro_github_publish_file($owner, $repo, $branch, $path, $content, $commitMessage);

    if (empty($result['success'])) {
        apro_json_error((string)($result['error'] ?? 'GitHub publish failed.'), 500, [
            'step' => $result['step'] ?? null,
            'owner' => $owner,
            'repo' => $repo,
            'branch' => $branch,
            'path' => $path,
        ]);
    }

    apro_json_success([
        'owner' => $result['owner'],
        'repo' => $result['repo'],
        'branch' => $result['branch'],
        'path' => $result['path'],
        'created' => (bool)$result['created'],
        'updated' => (bool)$result['updated'],
        'content_sha' => $result['content_sha'],
        'previous_sha' => $result['previous_sha'],
        'commit_sha' => $result['commit_sha'],
        'commit_url' => $result['commit_url'],
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($raw === false || trim($raw) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($raw, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$owner = trim((string)($payload['owner'] ?? ''));
$repo = trim((string)($payload['repo'] ?? ''));
$branch = trim((string)($payload['branch'] ?? ''));
$commitMessage = trim((string)($payload['commit_message'] ?? ''));
$files = $payload['files'] ?? [];

if ($owner === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub owner is required.', 400); }
if ($repo === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub repository name is required.', 400); }
if ($branch === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub branch is required.', 400); }
if ($commitMessage === '') { apro_json_error('GitHub commit message is required.', 400); }
if (!is_array($files) || empty($files)) { apro_json_error('files must be a non-empty array.', 400); }

// Normalize files: allow either direct content or server-read mode
$normalized = [];
foreach ($files as $f) {
    if (!is_array($f)) { continue; }
    $p = trim((string)($f['path'] ?? ''));
    $c = (string)($f['content'] ?? '');
    $enc = strtolower((string)($f['encoding'] ?? 'text'));
    $serverRead = !empty($f['server_read']);
    $serverLocalPath = (string)($f['server_local_path'] ?? '');

    if ($p === '') {
        apro_json_error('Each file must include a non-empty path.', 400);
    }

    if (!$serverRead) {
        if ($enc !== 'base64' && $enc !== 'text' && $enc !== '') {
            apro_json_error('Invalid encoding for file ' . $p . '. Use "text" or "base64".', 400);
        }
    }

    $row = ['path' => $p];

    if ($serverRead) {
        $row['server_read'] = true;
        $row['server_local_path'] = ($serverLocalPath !== '' ? $serverLocalPath : $p);
    } else {
        $row['content'] = $c;
        $row['encoding'] = ($enc === 'base64') ? 'base64' : 'text';
    }

    $normalized[] = $row;
}

try {
    // Resolve any server_read entries into actual content bytes + encoding
    $resolved = [];
    foreach ($normalized as $row) {
        if (!empty($row['server_read'])) {
            $localRel = (string)($row['server_local_path'] ?? $row['path'] ?? '');
            if ($localRel === '') {
                throw new RuntimeException('server_read flagged but no server_local_path/path given.');
            }
            $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($localRel);
            $fileData = apro_fs_read_file_for_ai($abs); // ['content','encoding','truncated']
            $resolved[] = [
                'path' => (string)$row['path'],
                'content' => (string)($fileData['content'] ?? ''),
                'encoding' => ((string)($fileData['encoding'] ?? 'text')) === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text'
            ];
        } else {
            $resolved[] = [
                'path' => (string)$row['path'],
                'content' => (string)($row['content'] ?? ''),
                'encoding' => ((string)($row['encoding'] ?? 'text')) === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text'
            ];
        }
    }

    $res = apro_github_publish_files_bulk($owner, $repo, $branch, $resolved, $commitMessage);

    apro_json_success([
        'owner' => $owner,
        'repo' => $repo,
        'branch' => $branch,
        'files_count' => (int)($res['files_count'] ?? count($resolved)),
        'commit_sha' => (string)($res['commit_sha'] ?? ''),
        'tree_sha' => (string)($res['tree_sha'] ?? ''),
        'commit_url' => (string)($res['commit_url'] ?? '')
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    apro_json_error($e->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$owner = trim((string)($payload['owner'] ?? ''));
$repo = trim((string)($payload['repo'] ?? ''));
$branch = trim((string)($payload['branch'] ?? 'main'));
$rootPath = trim((string)($payload['root_path'] ?? ''));
$fileTypes = $payload['file_types'] ?? null;

// Validate
if ($owner === '' || $repo === '' || $branch === '') {
    apro_json_error('GitHub owner, repo, and branch are required.', 400);
}

// Normalize extension filter if provided
$allowedExtensions = null;
if (is_array($fileTypes) && count($fileTypes) > 0) {
    $allowedExtensions = [];
    foreach ($fileTypes as $ext) {
        $ext = trim((string)$ext);
        if ($ext !== '') {
            $allowedExtensions[$ext] = true;
        }
    }
    if (count($allowedExtensions) === 0) {
        $allowedExtensions = null;
    }
}

try {
    $treeRes = apro_github_get_repo_tree($owner, $repo, $branch, true);
    if (empty($treeRes['success'])) {
        $msg = (string)($treeRes['error'] ?? 'Failed to load GitHub repository tree.');
        apro_json_error($msg, 500);
    }
    $entries = is_array($treeRes['tree'] ?? null) ? $treeRes['tree'] : [];

    // Optional: filter by prefix if rootPath provided
    $prefix = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
    $usePrefix = $prefix !== '';

    // Build nested tree structure compatible with local api/tree.php
    $root = [
        'name' => '/',
        'path' => '/',
        'type' => 'directory',
        'expanded' => true,
        'size' => 0,
        'children' => []
    ];

    // Return extension for a given file path using shared helper
    $getExt = function (string $filePath): string {
        $base = basename($filePath);
        return apro_fs_get_file_extension($base);
    };

    // Insert file node and accumulate sizes upward (no by-reference traps)
    $addFile = function (array &$rootNode, string $repoRelPath, int $fileSize) use ($getExt, $allowedExtensions) {
        if (is_array($allowedExtensions)) {
            $ext = $getExt($repoRelPath);
            if (!isset($allowedExtensions[$ext])) {
                return;
            }
        }

        $parts = explode('/', trim($repoRelPath, '/'));
        $cursor =& $rootNode;
        $accPath = '';

        for ($i = 0; $i < count($parts) - 1; $i++) {
            $part = $parts[$i];
            $accPath .= '/' . $part;

            // Ensure children array exists
            if (!isset($cursor['children']) || !is_array($cursor['children'])) {
                $cursor['children'] = [];
            }
            $children =& $cursor['children'];

            // Find existing directory by name
            $foundIndex = -1;
            $cl = count($children);
            for ($ci = 0; $ci < $cl; $ci++) {
                if (is_array($children[$ci]) && (($children[$ci]['type'] ?? '') === 'directory') && (($children[$ci]['name'] ?? '') === $part)) {
                    $foundIndex = $ci;
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Create if missing
            if ($foundIndex === -1) {
                $children[] = [
                    'name' => $part,
                    'path' => $accPath === '' ? '/' : $accPath,
                    'type' => 'directory',
                    'expanded' => false,
                    'size' => 0,
                    'children' => []
                ];
                $foundIndex = count($children) - 1;
            }

            // Descend into that directory node
            $cursor =& $children[$foundIndex];
        }

        $fileName = $parts[count($parts) - 1];
        $filePath = '/' . trim($repoRelPath, '/');

        if (!isset($cursor['children']) || !is_array($cursor['children'])) {
            $cursor['children'] = [];
        }
        $cursor['children'][] = [
            'name' => $fileName,
            'path' => $filePath,
            'type' => 'file',
            'size' => $fileSize
        ];

        // Bubble size up the dirs including root
        $walker =& $rootNode;
        $walker['size'] += $fileSize;
        $accPath = '';
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($parts) - 1; $i++) {
            $part = $parts[$i];
            $accPath .= '/' . $part;
            $children =& $walker['children'];
            if (!is_array($children)) {
                break;
            }
            for ($ci = 0; $ci < count($children); $ci++) {
                if (is_array($children[$ci]) && (($children[$ci]['type'] ?? '') === 'directory') && (($children[$ci]['name'] ?? '') === $part)) {
                    if (!isset($children[$ci]['size'])) { $children[$ci]['size'] = 0; }
                    $children[$ci]['size'] += $fileSize;
                    $walker =& $children[$ci];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    };

    foreach ($entries as $node) {
        if (!is_array($node)) continue;
        $type = (string)($node['type'] ?? '');
        $path = (string)($node['path'] ?? '');
        if ($path === '' || $type === '') continue;
        if ($type !== 'blob') continue; // only files

        if ($usePrefix) {
            if ($path === $prefix) {
                // exact match OK
            } elseif (strpos($path, $prefix . '/') !== 0) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        $size = (int)($node['size'] ?? 0);
        $addFile($root, $path, $size);
    }

    // Defense-in-depth: prune any malformed/null children
    $pruneTree = function (&$dirNode) use (&$pruneTree) {
        if (!isset($dirNode['children']) || !is_array($dirNode['children'])) return;
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($dirNode['children'] as $child) {
            if (is_array($child) && isset($child['type'], $child['name'], $child['path'])) {
                $clean[] = $child;
            }
        }
        $dirNode['children'] = $clean;
        foreach ($dirNode['children'] as &$child) {
            if (($child['type'] ?? '') === 'directory') {
                $pruneTree($child);
            }
        }
    };
    $pruneTree($root);

    // Sort directories/files naturally within each dir
    $sortTree = function (&$dirNode) use (&$sortTree) {
        if (!isset($dirNode['children']) || !is_array($dirNode['children'])) return;
        $dirs = [];
        $files = [];
        foreach ($dirNode['children'] as $child) {
            if (($child['type'] ?? '') === 'directory') $dirs[] = $child; else $files[] = $child;
        }
        usort($dirs, function ($a, $b) { return strnatcasecmp((string)$a['name'], (string)$b['name']); });
        usort($files, function ($a, $b) { return strnatcasecmp((string)$a['name'], (string)$b['name']); });
        $dirNode['children'] = array_merge($dirs, $files);
        foreach ($dirNode['children'] as &$child) {
            if (($child['type'] ?? '') === 'directory') {
                $sortTree($child);
            }
        }
    };
    $sortTree($root);

    apro_json_success([
        'tree' => $root,
        'meta' => [
            'owner' => $owner,
            'repo' => $repo,
            'branch' => $branch,
            'prefix' => $usePrefix ? $prefix : '',
            'truncated' => (bool)($treeRes['truncated'] ?? false)
        ]
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    apro_json_error($e->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/godaddy/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if (!in_array($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET', ['GET', 'POST'], true)) {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

function apro_godaddy_archives_read_payload(): array
{
    if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'GET') {
        return $_GET ?? [];
    }
    $payload = apro_read_request_json();
    return is_array($payload) ? $payload : [];
}

function apro_godaddy_archives_require_client(array $payload): AproCpanelClient
{
    $baseUrl = trim((string)($payload['base_url'] ?? ''));
    $username = trim((string)($payload['username'] ?? ''));
    $apiToken = trim((string)($payload['api_token'] ?? ''));
    $insecure = apro_godaddy_bool($payload['insecure'] ?? false, false);

    if ($baseUrl === '' || $username === '' || $apiToken === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('base_url, username, and api_token are required.');
    }

    return apro_godaddy_build_client($baseUrl, $username, $apiToken, $insecure);
}

$payload = apro_godaddy_archives_read_payload();
$action = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'GET' ? 'list' : ''))));
$path = trim((string)($payload['path'] ?? ''));

try {
    $client = apro_godaddy_archives_require_client($payload);

    if ($action === 'list') {
        if ($path === '' || $path === '/' || apro_godaddy_is_archive_path($path)) {
            apro_json_error('A valid live file path is required.', 400);
        }
        $livePath = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($path, '/');
        apro_json_success([
            'path' => $livePath,
            'archives' => apro_godaddy_list_archives_for_live_file($client, $livePath),
        ]);
    }

    if ($action === 'get_archive') {
        if ($path === '' || !apro_godaddy_is_archive_path($path)) {
            apro_json_error('A valid archive path is required.', 400);
        }
        $archivePath = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($path, '/');
        $archivePayload = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload_with_client($client, $archivePath);
        $archivePayload['archive_path'] = $archivePayload['path'];
        unset($archivePayload['path']);
        $archivePayload['live_path'] = apro_godaddy_extract_live_path_from_archive($archivePath);
        $archivePayload['version'] = apro_godaddy_extract_archive_version($archivePath);
        apro_json_success($archivePayload);
    }

    if ($action === 'get_current') {
        if ($path === '' || $path === '/' || apro_godaddy_is_archive_path($path)) {
            apro_json_error('A valid live file path is required.', 400);
        }
        $currentPath = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($path, '/');
        $currentPayload = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload_with_client($client, $currentPath);
        apro_json_success($currentPayload);
    }

    if ($action === 'restore') {
        $archivePath = trim((string)($payload['archive_path'] ?? ''));
        if ($archivePath === '' || !apro_godaddy_is_archive_path($archivePath)) {
            apro_json_error('A valid archive path is required for restore.', 400);
        }
        apro_json_success(apro_godaddy_restore_archive($client, $archivePath));
    }

    apro_json_error('Unsupported action.', 400);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    $message = $throwable->getMessage();
    $status = stripos($message, 'not found') !== false ? 404 : 500;
    apro_json_error($message, $status);
}
