<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/godaddy/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/publish/tiles.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_decode_content(array $fileSpec, string $targetPath): string
{
    $encoding = strtolower(trim((string)($fileSpec['encoding'] ?? 'text')));
    $rawContent = (string)($fileSpec['content'] ?? '');

    if ($encoding === 'base64') {
        $decoded = base64_decode($rawContent, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid base64 content for ' . $targetPath);
        }
        return $decoded;
    }

    return function_exists('apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block')
        ? apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block($rawContent)
        : trim($rawContent);
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_raw_file_content(AproCpanelClient $client, string $path): string
{
    $payload = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload_with_client($client, $path);
    $encoding = strtolower((string)($payload['encoding'] ?? 'text'));
    $content = (string)($payload['content'] ?? '');

    if ($encoding === 'base64') {
        $decoded = base64_decode($content, true);
        return $decoded === false ? '' : $decoded;
    }

    return $content;
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_parent_path(string $path): string
{
    $normalized = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($path, '/');
    $parent = dirname($normalized);
    if ($parent === '' || $parent === '.') {
        return '/';
    }
    return apro_godaddy_normalize_path($parent, '/');
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_verify_parent_readable(AproCpanelClient $client, string $targetPath): void
{
    $parent = apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_parent_path($targetPath);
    if ($parent === '/') {
        return;
    }

    try {
        apro_godaddy_list_directory_rows($client, $parent, true);
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Target parent directory is not accessible through cPanel and this GoDaddy host does not support Fileman create_dir. Parent: ' .
            $parent . '. ' . $throwable->getMessage()
        );
    }
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_archive_existing_file(AproCpanelClient $client, string $targetPath): array
{
    $normalizedTarget = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($targetPath, '/');
    if (!apro_godaddy_file_exists($client, $normalizedTarget)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('File not found for archive: ' . $normalizedTarget);
    }

    $archiveInfo = apro_godaddy_next_archive_path($client, $normalizedTarget);
    $archivePath = (string)($archiveInfo['archive_path'] ?? '');
    $archiveVersion = isset($archiveInfo['archive_version']) ? (int)$archiveInfo['archive_version'] : null;

    if ($archivePath === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to determine archive path for: ' . $normalizedTarget);
    }

    $archiveContent = apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_raw_file_content($client, $normalizedTarget);
    $client->saveFile($archivePath, $archiveContent);

    if (!apro_godaddy_file_exists($client, $archivePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive file could not be verified after write: ' . $archivePath);
    }

    return [
        'archive_path' => $archivePath,
        'archive_version' => $archiveVersion,
    ];
}

function apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_publish_file(AproCpanelClient $client, array $fileSpec): array
{
    $origPath = function_exists('apro_publish_normalize_path_slash')
        ? apro_publish_normalize_path_slash($fileSpec['path'] ?? '')
        : apro_godaddy_normalize_path((string)($fileSpec['path'] ?? ''), '');
    $targetPath = function_exists('apro_publish_normalize_path_slash')
        ? apro_publish_normalize_path_slash($fileSpec['target_path'] ?? $origPath)
        : apro_godaddy_normalize_path((string)($fileSpec['target_path'] ?? $origPath), '');
    $operation = strtoupper(trim((string)($fileSpec['operation'] ?? '')));

    if ($origPath === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('File path is required.');
    }
    if ($targetPath === '' || $targetPath === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A valid target_path is required.');
    }
    if (!in_array($operation, ['ADD', 'REPLACE'], true)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('operation must be ADD or REPLACE for ' . $targetPath);
    }

    $targetPath = apro_godaddy_normalize_path($targetPath, '/');
    $contentToWrite = apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_decode_content($fileSpec, $targetPath);
    $targetExisted = apro_godaddy_file_exists($client, $targetPath);
    $archivePath = null;
    $archiveVersion = null;

    if ($targetExisted) {
        $archiveInfo = apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_archive_existing_file($client, $targetPath);
        $archivePath = (string)($archiveInfo['archive_path'] ?? '');
        $archiveVersion = isset($archiveInfo['archive_version']) ? (int)$archiveInfo['archive_version'] : null;
    } else {
        apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_verify_parent_readable($client, $targetPath);
    }

    try {
        $client->saveFile($targetPath, $contentToWrite);
        $verified = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload_with_client($client, $targetPath);
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to write file: ' . $targetPath . '. ' . $throwable->getMessage());
    }

    return [
        'path' => $targetPath,
        'operation' => $operation,
        'published' => true,
        'created' => !$targetExisted,
        'overwrote_existing' => $targetExisted,
        'archive_path' => $archivePath !== '' ? $archivePath : null,
        'archive_version' => $archiveVersion,
        'verified_size_bytes' => (int)($verified['size_bytes'] ?? strlen($contentToWrite)),
    ];
}

$payload = apro_read_request_json();
$baseUrl = trim((string)($payload['base_url'] ?? ''));
$username = trim((string)($payload['username'] ?? ''));
$apiToken = trim((string)($payload['api_token'] ?? ''));
$insecure = apro_godaddy_bool($payload['insecure'] ?? false, false);
$action = trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? 'publish_bulk'));
$filesInput = $payload['files'] ?? [];

if ($baseUrl === '' || $username === '' || $apiToken === '') {
    apro_json_error('base_url, username, and api_token are required.', 400);
}

if (!in_array($action, ['publish', 'publish_bulk'], true)) {
    apro_json_error('Unsupported publish action.', 400);
}

if (!is_array($filesInput)) {
    apro_json_error('files must be an array.', 400);
}
if ($action === 'publish' && !apro_publish_array_is_list($filesInput)) {
    $filesInput = [$filesInput];
}
if (count($filesInput) === 0) {
    apro_json_error('No files provided for publish action.', 400);
}

try {
    $client = apro_godaddy_build_client($baseUrl, $username, $apiToken, $insecure);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 400);
}

$published = [];
$skipped = [];
$errors = [];

foreach ($filesInput as $fileSpec) {
    try {
        if (!is_array($fileSpec)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Each file specification must be an object.');
        }
        $published[] = apro_godaddy_publish_endpoint_publish_file($client, $fileSpec);
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        $errors[] = [
            'path' => isset($fileSpec['target_path']) ? (string)$fileSpec['target_path'] : ((string)($fileSpec['path'] ?? '')),
            'message' => $throwable->getMessage(),
        ];
    }
}

apro_json_success([
    'published' => $published,
    'skipped' => $skipped,
    'errors' => $errors,
]);

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

function apro_impl_strip_code_fence(string $text): string
{
    $text = trim(str_replace(chr(13), '', $text));
    if ($text === '') { return ''; }
    if (preg_match('/^```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[[:space:]]*([\s\S]*?)[[:space:]]*```$/', $text, $matches)) {
        return trim((string)$matches[1]);
    }
    $text = preg_replace('/^[[:space:]]*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*[[:space:]]*/', '', $text);
    $text = preg_replace('/[[:space:]]*```[[:space:]]*$/', '', (string)$text);
    return trim((string)$text);
}

function apro_impl_normalize_path(string $path): string
{
    $path = trim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $path));
    $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;
    if ($path !== '' && $path[0] !== '/') { $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/'); }
    return strlen($path) > 1 ? rtrim($path, '/') : $path;
}

function apro_impl_read_payload(): array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || trim($raw) === '') { apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400); }
    $decoded = json_decode($raw, true);
    if (!is_array($decoded)) { apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400); }
    return $decoded;
}

function apro_impl_prompt(array $payload): string
{
    if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && trim((string)$payload['prompt_b64']) !== '') {
        $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
        if ($decoded === false) { apro_json_error('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400); }
        return trim($decoded);
    }
    return trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? $payload['request'] ?? $payload['message'] ?? $payload['user_request'] ?? ''));
}

function apro_impl_first_string($input, array $keys): string
{
    if (is_object($input)) { $input = (array)$input; }
    if (!is_array($input)) { return ''; }
    foreach ($keys as $key) {
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $input)) { continue; }
        $value = $input[$key];
        if (is_string($value) || is_numeric($value)) {
            $value = trim((string)$value);
            if ($value !== '') { return $value; }
        }
    }
    return '';
}

function apro_impl_operation($value): string
{
    $op = strtoupper(trim((string)$value));
    if (in_array($op, ['ADD', 'CREATE', 'NEW', 'INSERT'], true)) { return 'ADD'; }
    return 'REPLACE';
}

function apro_impl_list($payload): array
{
    if (is_object($payload)) { $payload = (array)$payload; }
    if (!is_array($payload)) { return []; }
    if (function_exists('array_is_list') ? array_is_list($payload) : array_keys($payload) === range(0, count($payload) - 1)) { return $payload; }
    foreach (['implementation_plan', 'implementationPlan', 'plan', 'items', 'files', 'changes', 'data'] as $key) {
        if (array_key_exists($key, $payload)) {
            $nested = apro_impl_list($payload[$key]);
            if ($nested) { return $nested; }
        }
    }
    $out = [];
    foreach ($payload as $key => $value) {
        if (is_object($value)) { $value = (array)$value; }
        if (is_array($value)) {
            if (!isset($value['path']) && is_string($key) && $key !== '') { $value['path'] = $key; }
            $out[] = $value;
        }
    }
    return $out;
}

function apro_impl_extract_json_array(string $text): ?string
{
    $len = strlen($text); $start = null; $depth = 0; $in = false; $esc = false;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $ch = $text[$i];
        if ($start === null) { if ($ch === '[') { $start = $i; $depth = 1; } continue; }
        if ($in) { if ($esc) { $esc = false; continue; } if ($ch === chr(92)) { $esc = true; continue; } if ($ch === '"') { $in = false; } continue; }
        if ($ch === '"') { $in = true; continue; }
        if ($ch === '[') { $depth++; continue; }
        if ($ch === ']') { $depth--; if ($depth === 0) { return substr($text, $start, $i - $start + 1); } }
    }
    return null;
}

function apro_impl_raw_items_from_text(string $text): array
{
    $clean = apro_impl_strip_code_fence($text);
    $decoded = json_decode($clean, true, 512, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
    if (is_array($decoded)) { $items = apro_impl_list($decoded); if ($items) { return $items; } }
    $arrayText = apro_impl_extract_json_array($clean);
    if ($arrayText !== null) {
        $decoded = json_decode($arrayText, true, 512, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
        if (is_array($decoded)) { return apro_impl_list($decoded); }
    }
    return [];
}

function apro_impl_parse_plain_text(string $text): array
{
    $items = [];
    if (!preg_match_all('/Path[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(?<path>.+?)(?:\r?\n|$)(?<body>.*?)(?=(?:\n[[:space:]]*Path[[:space:]]*:)|\z)/is', $text, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER)) { return $items; }
    foreach ($matches as $match) {
        $spec = ['path' => trim((string)$match['path'])];
        $body = (string)$match['body'];
        if (preg_match('/Operation[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z]+)/i', $body, $m)) { $spec['operation'] = strtoupper(trim($m[1])); }
        if (preg_match('/Summary[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(.+)/i', $body, $m)) { $spec['summary'] = trim($m[1]); }
        if (preg_match('/Rationale[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(.+)/i', $body, $m)) { $spec['rationale'] = trim($m[1]); }
        if ($spec['path'] !== '') { $items[] = $spec; }
    }
    return $items;
}

function apro_impl_coerce_item($input): ?array
{
    if (is_object($input)) { $input = (array)$input; }
    if (!is_array($input)) { return null; }
    $path = apro_impl_normalize_path(apro_impl_first_string($input, ['path', 'file', 'file_path', 'filepath', 'full_path', 'relative_path', 'location', 'target', 'destination', 'name']));
    if ($path === '' && isset($input[0]) && (is_string($input[0]) || is_numeric($input[0]))) { $path = apro_impl_normalize_path((string)$input[0]); }
    if ($path === '') { return null; }
    $operation = apro_impl_operation(apro_impl_first_string($input, ['operation', 'op', 'action', 'mode', 'verb', 'type']));
    $summary = apro_impl_strip_code_fence(apro_impl_first_string($input, ['summary', 'title', 'description', 'change_summary', 'what']));
    $rationale = apro_impl_strip_code_fence(apro_impl_first_string($input, ['rationale', 'reason', 'why', 'justification', 'notes']));
    if ($summary === '') { $summary = ($operation === 'ADD' ? 'Add ' : 'Replace ') . basename($path); }
    if ($rationale === '') { $rationale = 'Identified by implementation plan analysis as required for the requested change.'; }
    return ['path' => $path, 'operation' => $operation, 'summary' => $summary, 'rationale' => $rationale];
}

function apro_impl_normalize_plan(array $items): array
{
    $out = []; $seen = [];
    foreach ($items as $item) {
        $normalized = apro_impl_coerce_item($item);
        if ($normalized === null) { continue; }
        $key = strtolower($normalized['path']);
        if (isset($seen[$key])) { continue; }
        $seen[$key] = true;
        if ($normalized['operation'] === 'REPLACE') {
            try { $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($normalized['path']); if (is_file($abs)) { $normalized['existing_size_bytes'] = (int)(@filesize($abs) ?: 0); } } catch (Throwable $ignored) {}
        }
        $out[] = $normalized;
    }
    return $out;
}

function apro_impl_flatten_context($value): string
{
    if (is_string($value) || is_numeric($value)) { return trim((string)$value); }
    if (is_object($value)) { $value = (array)$value; }
    if (!is_array($value)) { return ''; }
    $encoded = json_encode($value, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
    return is_string($encoded) ? trim($encoded) : '';
}

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') { apro_json_error('Method not allowed. Use POST.', 405); }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/publish/tiles.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/server/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/godaddy/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

final class AproPublishAnalyzeException extends RuntimeException
{
    private int $httpStatus;

    public function __construct(string $message, int $httpStatus = 400)
    {
        parent::__construct($message);
        $this->httpStatus = $httpStatus;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return $this->httpStatus;
    }
}

function apro_publish_analyze_job_dir(): string
{
    $configured = function_exists('apro_env_value') ? (string)apro_env_value('APRO_ASYNC_JOB_DIR', '') : '';
    $dir = trim($configured) !== '' ? trim($configured) : rtrim(sys_get_temp_dir(), '/\\') . '/apro_async_jobs';
    $dir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $dir), '/');
    if (!is_dir($dir)) {
        if (!mkdir($dir, 0700, true) && !is_dir($dir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create async job directory.');
        }
    }
    @chmod($dir, 0700);
    return $dir;
}

function apro_publish_analyze_job_path(string $jobId): string
{
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/', $jobId)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Invalid async job id.', 400);
    }
    return apro_publish_analyze_job_dir() . '/publish_analyze_' . $jobId . '.json';
}

function apro_publish_analyze_read_job(string $jobId): array
{
    $path = apro_publish_analyze_job_path($jobId);
    if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Async analysis job was not found.', 404);
    }
    $raw = file_get_contents($path);
    $decoded = is_string($raw) ? json_decode($raw, true) : null;
    if (!is_array($decoded)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Async analysis job file is invalid.', 500);
    }
    return $decoded;
}

function apro_publish_analyze_write_job(string $jobId, array $job): void
{
    $path = apro_publish_analyze_job_path($jobId);
    $job['updated_at'] = gmdate('c');
    $encoded = json_encode($job, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT);
    if (!is_string($encoded)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode async job state.');
    }
    if (file_put_contents($path, $encoded, LOCK_EX) === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to write async job state.');
    }
    @chmod($path, 0600);
}

function apro_publish_analyze_spawn_worker(string $jobId): void
{
    if (!function_exists('proc_open')) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Async worker launch is unavailable because proc_open is disabled.', 500);
    }
    $php = PHP_BINARY ?: 'php';
    $cmd = escapeshellarg($php) . ' ' . escapeshellarg(__FILE__) . ' --apro-publish-analyze-job ' . escapeshellarg($jobId);
    $descriptor = [
        0 => ['pipe', 'r'],
        1 => ['file', '/dev/null', 'a'],
        2 => ['file', '/dev/null', 'a'],
    ];
    $process = @proc_open($cmd, $descriptor, $pipes, __DIR__);
    if (!is_resource($process)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Failed to launch async analysis worker.', 500);
    }
    foreach ($pipes as $pipe) {
        if (is_resource($pipe)) {
            fclose($pipe);
        }
    }
    proc_close($process);
}

function apro_publish_analyze_start_job(array $payload): array
{
    $jobId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    unset($payload['async'], $payload['action'], $payload['job_id']);
    $job = [
        'id' => $jobId,
        'type' => 'publish_analyze',
        'status' => 'queued',
        'created_at' => gmdate('c'),
        'updated_at' => gmdate('c'),
        'started_at' => null,
        'completed_at' => null,
        'payload' => $payload,
        'result' => null,
        'error' => null,
    ];
    apro_publish_analyze_write_job($jobId, $job);
    apro_publish_analyze_spawn_worker($jobId);
    return [
        'async' => true,
        'job_id' => $jobId,
        'status' => 'queued',
    ];
}

function apro_publish_analyze_worker(string $jobId): void
{
    @set_time_limit(0);
    @ini_set('max_execution_time', '0');
    $job = apro_publish_analyze_read_job($jobId);
    $job['status'] = 'running';
    $job['started_at'] = gmdate('c');
    $job['error'] = null;
    apro_publish_analyze_write_job($jobId, $job);
    try {
        $result = apro_publish_analyze_execute(is_array($job['payload'] ?? null) ? $job['payload'] : []);
        $job['status'] = 'done';
        $job['completed_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $job['result'] = $result;
        $job['error'] = null;
    } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
        $job['status'] = 'error';
        $job['completed_at'] = gmdate('c');
        $job['result'] = null;
        $job['error'] = $throwable->getMessage();
    }
    apro_publish_analyze_write_job($jobId, $job);
}

function apro_publish_analyze_normalize_selected_paths($selectedPathsRaw): array
{
    $selectedPaths = [];
    if (!is_array($selectedPathsRaw)) {
        return $selectedPaths;
    }
    foreach ($selectedPathsRaw as $p) {
        if (!is_string($p) && !is_numeric($p)) {
            continue;
        }
        $s = (string)$p;
        $s = str_replace('\\', '/', $s);
        $s = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $s) ?: $s;
        $s = trim($s);
        if ($s === '' || $s === '/') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($s[0] !== '/') {
            $s = '/' . ltrim($s, '/');
        }
        $selectedPaths[] = $s;
    }
    return array_values(array_unique($selectedPaths));
}

function apro_publish_analyze_prompt(array $payload): string
{
    if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && $payload['prompt_b64'] !== '') {
        $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
        }
        return trim($decoded);
    }
    return trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? ''));
}

function apro_publish_analyze_resolve_service(array $payload): array
{
    $model = $payload['model'] ?? null;
    if (is_array($model)) {
        $provider = strtolower(trim((string)($model['provider'] ?? '')));
        $modelId = trim((string)($model['model_id'] ?? $model['id'] ?? ''));
        $canonical = trim((string)($model['catalog_canonical_id'] ?? ''));
        $label = trim((string)($model['label'] ?? ''));

        if ($provider === '' && $canonical !== '' && strpos($canonical, ':') !== false) {
            $provider = strtolower(trim((string)substr($canonical, 0, strpos($canonical, ':'))));
        }
        if ($modelId === '' && $canonical !== '' && strpos($canonical, ':') !== false) {
            $modelId = trim((string)substr($canonical, strpos($canonical, ':') + 1));
        }

        if ($provider !== '' && $modelId !== '') {
            $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($modelId);
            if ($service === null) {
                $service = apro_get_effective_ai_service();
            }
            if ($service === null) {
                throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Unable to resolve selected AI model.', 400);
            }
            $service['id'] = $modelId;
            $service['model'] = $modelId;
            $service['provider'] = $provider;
            if ($label !== '') {
                $service['label'] = $label;
            }
            return $service;
        }
    }

    $serviceId = trim((string)($payload['service_id'] ?? ''));
    $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($serviceId);
    if ($service === null) {
        $service = apro_get_effective_ai_service();
    }
    if ($service === null) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Unable to resolve selected AI model.', 400);
    }

    return $service;
}

function apro_publish_analyze_execute(array $payload): array
{
    $prompt = apro_publish_analyze_prompt($payload);
    $selectedPathsRaw = $payload['selected_paths'] ?? [];
    $analysisMode = strtolower((string)($payload['analysis_mode'] ?? 'prompt'));
    $github = $payload['github'] ?? null;
    $remote = $payload['remote'] ?? null;
    $godaddy = $payload['godaddy'] ?? null;

    if (!in_array($analysisMode, ['prompt', 'files', 'both'], true)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('analysis_mode must be prompt, files or both.', 400);
    }
    if ($prompt === '' && (!is_array($selectedPathsRaw) || count($selectedPathsRaw) === 0)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Either prompt or at least one selected file is required.', 400);
    }

    $selectedPaths = apro_publish_analyze_normalize_selected_paths($selectedPathsRaw);
    $includePaths = ($analysisMode === 'files' || $analysisMode === 'both');
    $includeContents = ($analysisMode === 'files' || $analysisMode === 'both');

    $usingGithub = false;
    $ghOwner = '';
    $ghRepo = '';
    $ghBranch = '';
    if (is_array($github)) {
        $ghOwner = trim((string)($github['owner'] ?? ''));
        $ghRepo = trim((string)($github['repo'] ?? ''));
        $ghBranch = trim((string)($github['branch'] ?? ''));
        $usingGithub = ($ghOwner !== '' && $ghRepo !== '' && $ghBranch !== '');
    }

    $usingRemote = false;
    $remoteServerUrl = '';
    $remoteApiKey = '';
    $remoteInsecure = false;
    if (is_array($remote)) {
        $remoteServerUrl = trim((string)($remote['server_url'] ?? ''));
        $remoteApiKey = trim((string)($remote['api_key'] ?? ''));
        $remoteInsecure = (bool)($remote['insecure'] ?? false);
        $usingRemote = ($remoteServerUrl !== '' && $remoteApiKey !== '');
    }

    $usingGoDaddy = false;
    $godaddyBaseUrl = '';
    $godaddyUsername = '';
    $godaddyApiToken = '';
    $godaddyInsecure = false;
    if (is_array($godaddy)) {
        $godaddyBaseUrl = trim((string)($godaddy['base_url'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyUsername = trim((string)($godaddy['username'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyApiToken = trim((string)($godaddy['api_token'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyInsecure = apro_godaddy_bool($godaddy['insecure'] ?? false, false);
        $usingGoDaddy = ($godaddyBaseUrl !== '' && $godaddyUsername !== '' && $godaddyApiToken !== '');
    }

    $service = apro_publish_analyze_resolve_service($payload);
    $provider = apro_ai_provider_from_service($service);

    $selectedItems = [];
    $selectedCount = 0;

    if ($includePaths && !empty($selectedPaths)) {
        if ($usingGithub) {
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                if ($p[0] !== '/') {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected GitHub file path must start with /: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (strpos($p, '..') !== false) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected GitHub file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            }
            $items = [];
            $totalContentBytes = 0;
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                $repoRel = ltrim((string)$p, '/');
                if ($repoRel === '') {
                    continue;
                }
                if ($includeContents) {
                    $ghFile = apro_github_fetch_file_content($ghOwner, $ghRepo, $ghBranch, $repoRel);
                    $content = (string)($ghFile['content'] ?? '');
                    $item = [
                        'path' => '/' . $repoRel,
                        'size_bytes' => (int)($ghFile['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                        'encoding' => (string)($ghFile['encoding'] ?? 'text'),
                        'truncated' => (bool)($ghFile['truncated'] ?? false),
                        'content' => $content,
                    ];
                    if (isset($ghFile['line_count'])) {
                        $item['line_count'] = (int)$ghFile['line_count'];
                    }
                    $items[] = $item;
                    $totalContentBytes += strlen($content);
                    if ($totalContentBytes > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                    }
                } else {
                    $items[] = ['path' => '/' . $repoRel];
                }
            }
            $selectedItems = $items;
            $selectedCount = count($items);
        } elseif ($usingRemote) {
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                if ($p[0] !== '/') {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected remote file path must start with /: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (strpos($p, '..') !== false) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected remote file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            }
            $items = [];
            $totalContentBytes = 0;
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                $remoteFile = apro_server_fetch_file_payload($remoteServerUrl, $remoteApiKey, $p, $remoteInsecure, false);
                if (($remoteFile['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected remote path does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                $item = [
                    'path' => (string)($remoteFile['path'] ?? $p),
                    'size_bytes' => (int)($remoteFile['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                ];
                if ($includeContents) {
                    $content = (string)($remoteFile['content'] ?? '');
                    $item['encoding'] = (string)($remoteFile['encoding'] ?? 'text');
                    $item['truncated'] = (bool)($remoteFile['truncated'] ?? false);
                    if (isset($remoteFile['line_count'])) {
                        $item['line_count'] = (int)$remoteFile['line_count'];
                    }
                    $item['content'] = $content;
                    $totalContentBytes += strlen($content);
                    if ($totalContentBytes > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                    }
                }
                $items[] = $item;
            }
            $selectedItems = $items;
            $selectedCount = count($items);
        } elseif ($usingGoDaddy) {
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                if ($p[0] !== '/') {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected GoDaddy file path must start with /: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (strpos($p, '..') !== false) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected GoDaddy file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            }
            $items = [];
            $totalContentBytes = 0;
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                $godaddyFile = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload($godaddyBaseUrl, $godaddyUsername, $godaddyApiToken, $p, $godaddyInsecure);
                if (($godaddyFile['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected GoDaddy path does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                $item = [
                    'path' => (string)($godaddyFile['path'] ?? $p),
                    'size_bytes' => (int)($godaddyFile['size_bytes'] ?? 0),
                ];
                if ($includeContents) {
                    $content = (string)($godaddyFile['content'] ?? '');
                    $item['encoding'] = (string)($godaddyFile['encoding'] ?? 'text');
                    $item['truncated'] = (bool)($godaddyFile['truncated'] ?? false);
                    if (isset($godaddyFile['line_count'])) {
                        $item['line_count'] = (int)$godaddyFile['line_count'];
                    }
                    $item['content'] = $content;
                    $totalContentBytes += strlen($content);
                    if ($totalContentBytes > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                    }
                }
                $items[] = $item;
            }
            $selectedItems = $items;
            $selectedCount = count($items);
        } else {
            foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
                try {
                    $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($p);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected path is invalid or does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (!is_file($abs)) {
                    throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Selected paths must be file paths only. Do not send directory nodes: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            }
            $selectedItemsData = apro_fs_collect_selected_items($selectedPaths, true, $includeContents);
            $selectedItems = is_array($selectedItemsData['items'] ?? null) ? $selectedItemsData['items'] : [];
            $selectedCount = count($selectedItems);
        }
    }

    $promptFile = APRO_PROMPTS_DIR . '/file_publish_analysis.txt';
    if (!is_file($promptFile) || !is_readable($promptFile)) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('System misconfiguration: file_publish_analysis.txt prompt missing.', 500);
    }
    $template = file_get_contents($promptFile);
    if ($template === false) {
        throw new AproPublishAnalyzeException('Failed to read file_publish_analysis.txt prompt.', 500);
    }
    $filePublishPrompt = trim((string)$template);

    $userMessageLines = [];
    $userMessageLines[] = 'PRIMARY USER PROMPT:';
    $userMessageLines[] = $filePublishPrompt;
    $userMessageLines[] = '';
    $userMessageLines[] = 'REQUEST CONTEXT:';
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Analysis mode: ' . $analysisMode;
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Prompt field input: ' . ($prompt !== '' ? '(present)' : '(empty)');
    $userMessageLines[] = '- File selection count: ' . count($selectedPaths);
    $userMessageLines[] = '- Resolved file count: ' . $selectedCount;
    $userMessageLines[] = '';
    if ($prompt !== '') {
        $userMessageLines[] = 'PROMPT FIELD INPUT:';
        $userMessageLines[] = $prompt;
        $userMessageLines[] = '';
    }
    foreach ($selectedItems as $index => $item) {
        $userMessageLines[] = 'FILE ' . ($index + 1) . ':';
        if (isset($item['path'])) {
            $userMessageLines[] = 'Path: ' . (string)$item['path'];
        }
        if (isset($item['encoding'])) {
            $userMessageLines[] = 'Encoding: ' . (string)$item['encoding'];
        }
        if (isset($item['truncated'])) {
            $userMessageLines[] = 'Truncated: ' . ($item['truncated'] ? 'yes' : 'no');
        }
        if (isset($item['content'])) {
            $userMessageLines[] = 'Content:';
            $userMessageLines[] = (string)$item['content'];
        }
        $userMessageLines[] = '';
    }
    $fullPrompt = implode(chr(10), $userMessageLines);

    if (method_exists($provider, 'buildUserMessage')) {
        $finalPromptText = $provider->buildUserMessage(
            $filePublishPrompt . chr(10) . chr(10) . $prompt,
            $selectedItems,
            [
                'selected_count' => $selectedCount,
                'resolved_file_count' => $selectedCount,
                'include_paths' => $includePaths,
                'include_contents' => $includeContents,
            ]
        );
    } else {
        $finalPromptText = $fullPrompt;
    }

    $providerResult = $provider->sendRequest(
        $service,
        $finalPromptText,
        $selectedItems,
        [
            'analysis_mode' => $analysisMode,
            'prompt_field' => $prompt,
        ]
    );

    $responseText = (string)($providerResult['response_text'] ?? '');
    $parseResult = apro_publish_deserialize_tiles_from_ai($responseText, $selectedItems);

    return [
        'publish_files' => $parseResult['tiles'],
        'ai_response_text' => $responseText,
        'provider_response' => $providerResult['provider_response'] ?? null,
        'fallback_used' => (bool)($parseResult['fallback_used'] ?? false),
    ];
}

if (PHP_SAPI === 'cli') {
    $argv = $_SERVER['argv'] ?? [];
    $idx = array_search('--apro-publish-analyze-job', $argv, true);
    if ($idx !== false && isset($argv[$idx + 1])) {
        apro_publish_analyze_worker((string)$argv[$idx + 1]);
        exit(0);
    }
}

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

try {
    $action = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? '')));
    if ($action === 'job_status') {
        $jobId = trim((string)($payload['job_id'] ?? ''));
        $job = apro_publish_analyze_read_job($jobId);
        apro_json_success([
            'async' => true,
            'job_id' => $jobId,
            'status' => (string)($job['status'] ?? 'unknown'),
            'created_at' => $job['created_at'] ?? null,
            'updated_at' => $job['updated_at'] ?? null,
            'started_at' => $job['started_at'] ?? null,
            'completed_at' => $job['completed_at'] ?? null,
            'result' => is_array($job['result'] ?? null) ? $job['result'] : null,
            'error' => $job['error'] ?? null,
        ]);
    }

    if (!empty($payload['async'])) {
        apro_json_success(apro_publish_analyze_start_job($payload));
    }

    apro_json_success(apro_publish_analyze_execute($payload));
} catch (AproPublishAnalyzeException $exception) {
    apro_json_error($exception->getMessage(), $exception->httpStatus());
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$action = (string)($payload['action'] ?? '');
if (!in_array($action, ['publish', 'publish_bulk'], true)) {
    apro_json_error('Unsupported publish action.', 400);
}

$filesInput = $payload['files'] ?? [];
if (!is_array($filesInput)) {
    apro_json_error('files must be an array.', 400);
}
if ($action === 'publish' && !apro_publish_array_is_list($filesInput)) {
    $filesInput = [$filesInput];
}

if (count($filesInput) === 0) {
    apro_json_error('No files provided for publish action.', 400);
}

$published = [];
$skipped = [];
$errors = [];

foreach ($filesInput as $fileSpec) {
    try {
        if (!is_array($fileSpec)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Each file specification must be an object.');
        }

        $origPath = apro_publish_normalize_path_slash($fileSpec['path'] ?? '');
        $targetPath = apro_publish_normalize_path_slash($fileSpec['target_path'] ?? $origPath);
        $operation = strtoupper(trim((string)($fileSpec['operation'] ?? '')));
        $encoding = strtolower(trim((string)($fileSpec['encoding'] ?? 'text')));
        $rawContent = (string)($fileSpec['content'] ?? '');

        if ($origPath === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('File path is required.');
        }
        if ($targetPath === '' || $targetPath === '/') {
            throw new RuntimeException('A valid target_path is required.');
        }
        if (!in_array($operation, ['ADD', 'REPLACE'], true)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('operation must be ADD or REPLACE for ' . $targetPath);
        }

        if ($encoding === 'base64') {
            $decoded = base64_decode($rawContent, true);
            if ($decoded === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Invalid base64 content for ' . $targetPath);
            }
            $contentToWrite = $decoded;
        } else {
            $contentToWrite = apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block($rawContent);
        }

        $absPath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($targetPath, true);
        $targetExisted = is_file($absPath);
        $archivePath = null;

        if ($targetExisted) {
            if (!is_file($absPath) || is_link($absPath)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Target exists but is not a regular file: ' . $targetPath);
            }

            $archivePath = apro_fs_next_archive_absolute_path($absPath);

            if (!@rename($absPath, $archivePath)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to archive existing file: ' . $targetPath);
            }
        }

        $parentDir = dirname($absPath);
        if (!is_dir($parentDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($parentDir, 0775, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create parent directories for: ' . $targetPath);
            }
        }

        if (@file_put_contents($absPath, $contentToWrite, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            if ($targetExisted && $archivePath !== null && is_file($archivePath) && !file_exists($absPath)) {
                @rename($archivePath, $absPath);
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to write file: ' . $targetPath);
        }

        @chmod($absPath, 0644);

        $published[] = [
            'path' => $targetPath,
            'operation' => $operation,
            'published' => true,
            'created' => !$targetExisted,
            'overwrote_existing' => $targetExisted,
            'archive_path' => $archivePath,
        ];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $errors[] = [
            'path' => isset($fileSpec['target_path']) ? (string)$fileSpec['target_path'] : ((string)($fileSpec['path'] ?? '')),
            'message' => $e->getMessage(),
        ];
    }
}

apro_json_success([
    'published' => $published,
    'skipped' => $skipped,
    'errors' => $errors,
]);

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if (!function_exists('apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block')) {
    function apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block(string $text): string
    {
        $text = preg_replace('/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9]*\s*\r?\n?/i', '', $text);
        $text = preg_replace('/\r?\n?```\s*$/i', '', $text);
        return trim($text);
    }
}

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$path = trim((string)($payload['path'] ?? ''));
$originalContent = (string)($payload['original_content'] ?? '');
$partialContent = (string)($payload['partial_content'] ?? '');
$serviceId = trim((string)($payload['service_id'] ?? ''));

if ($path === '' || $originalContent === '' || $partialContent === '' || $serviceId === '') {
    apro_json_error('path, service_id, original_content, and partial_content are required.', 400);
}

$promptOverride = '';
if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && $payload['prompt_b64'] !== '') {
    $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
    if ($decoded === false) {
        apro_json_error('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
    }
    $promptOverride = trim($decoded);
} elseif (isset($payload['prompt'])) {
    $promptOverride = trim((string)$payload['prompt']);
}

try {
    $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($serviceId);
    if ($service === null) {
        apro_json_error('Selected AI service is not available.', 400);
    }

    $provider = apro_ai_provider_from_service($service);

    $mergePromptFile = APRO_PROMPTS_DIR . '/file_publish_merge.txt';
    if (!is_file($mergePromptFile) || !is_readable($mergePromptFile)) {
        apro_json_error('System misconfiguration: file_publish_merge.txt prompt missing.', 500);
    }

    $template = file_get_contents($mergePromptFile);
    if (!is_string($template) || trim($template) === '') {
        apro_json_error('Merge prompt template is empty.', 500);
    }

    $mergePrompt = str_replace(
        ['{path}', '{partial}', '{original}'],
        [$path, $partialContent, $originalContent],
        $template
    );

    if ($promptOverride !== '') {
        $mergePrompt = $promptOverride . "\n\n" . $mergePrompt;
    }

    $result = $provider->sendRequest($service, $mergePrompt, [], []);
    $responseText = $result['response_text'] ?? '';
    $clean = apro_publish_strip_markdown_code_block($responseText);

    apro_json_success([
        'merged_content' => $clean,
        'ai_response_text' => $responseText,
        'provider_response' => $result['provider_response'] ?? null,
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');

    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

$responseText = '';
if (isset($payload['ai_response_text']) && $payload['ai_response_text'] !== '') {
    $responseText = trim((string)$payload['ai_response_text']);
} elseif (isset($payload['response_text']) && $payload['response_text'] !== '') {
    $responseText = trim((string)$payload['response_text']);
}

if ($responseText === '') {
    apro_json_error('ai_response_text (or response_text) is required.', 400);
}

$selectedItems = [];
if (isset($payload['selected_items']) && is_array($payload['selected_items'])) {
    foreach ($payload['selected_items'] as $item) {
        if (is_object($item)) {
            $item = (array)$item;
        }
        if (!is_array($item)) {
            continue;
        }
        if (isset($item['path'])) {
            $path = (string)$item['path'];
            $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', str_replace('\\', '/', trim($path)));
            if ($path !== '' && $path[0] !== '/') {
                $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
            }
            if ($path === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $item['path'] = $path;
        }
        $selectedItems[] = $item;
    }
}

if (empty($selectedItems) && isset($payload['selected_paths']) && is_array($payload['selected_paths'])) {
    foreach ($payload['selected_paths'] as $path) {
        $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', str_replace('\\', '/', trim((string)$path)));
        if ($path === '') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($path[0] !== '/') {
            $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }
        $selectedItems[] = ['path' => $path];
    }
}

try {
    $parseResult = apro_publish_deserialize_tiles_from_ai($responseText, $selectedItems);

    apro_json_success([
        'publish_files' => $parseResult['tiles'],
        'ai_response_text' => $responseText,
        'fallback_used' => (bool)$parseResult['fallback_used'],
        'selected_items_count' => count($selectedItems),
    ]);

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!function_exists('apro_json_success')) {
    function apro_json_success(array $data = [], int $statusCode = 200): void
    {
        if (!headers_sent()) {
            http_response_code($statusCode);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
        }

        echo json_encode([
            'status' => 'success',
            'data' => $data,
        ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        exit;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_json_error')) {
    function apro_json_error(string $message, int $statusCode = 400, array $data = []): void
    {
        if (!headers_sent()) {
            http_response_code($statusCode);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');

            'status' => 'error',
            'message' => $message,
            'data' => $data,
        ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        exit;
    }
}

function apro_agent_archives_unsupported(int $status, string $body, $json): bool
{
    if ($status === 404) {
        return true;
    }

    if (is_array($json)) {
        $message = (string)($json['message'] ?? $json['error'] ?? '');
        if (stripos($message, 'Unknown endpoint') !== false || stripos($message, 'Unknown') !== false || stripos($message, 'not found') !== false) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    return stripos($body, 'Unknown endpoint') !== false;
}

function apro_agent_archives_error_message(array $json, string $fallback): string
{
    $message = trim((string)($json['message'] ?? ''));
    if ($message !== '') {
        return $message;
    }

    $error = trim((string)($json['error'] ?? ''));
    if ($error !== '') {
        return $error;
    }

    return $fallback;
}

function apro_server_archives_read_json_body(): array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || trim($raw) === '') {
        apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);

    $action = strtolower(trim((string)($payload['action'] ?? 'list_all')));

    }

    $httpGet = function (string $url) use ($apiKey, $insecure): array {

    $httpPostJson = function (string $url, array $body) use ($apiKey, $insecure): array {

            }

            apro_json_success(is_array($fileJson['data'] ?? null) ? $fileJson['data'] : $fileJson);
        }

        apro_json_success(is_array($json['data'] ?? null) ? $json['data'] : $json);
    }

    if ($action === 'restore') {
        $archivePath = apro_server_normalize_remote_path((string)($payload['archive_path'] ?? ''));
        $response = $httpPostJson($baseUrl . '/admin-api/archives', [

    }

const APRO_SERVER_PUBLISH_DEFAULT_DEST = '/';

function apro_server_publish_read_json_body(): array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || trim($raw) === '') {
        apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);

    $payload = json_decode($raw, true);
    if (!is_array($payload)) {

    }

}

function apro_server_publish_clean_absolute_path(string $path, string $fallback = APRO_SERVER_PUBLISH_DEFAULT_DEST): string
{
    $path = trim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $path));
    if ($path === '') {
        $path = $fallback;
    }
    if ($path === '') {
        $path = APRO_SERVER_PUBLISH_DEFAULT_DEST;
    }
    if ($path[0] !== '/') {
        $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    $parts = [];
    foreach (explode('/', $path) as $part) {
        if ($part === '' || $part === '.') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($part === '..') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid destination path.');
        }
        $parts[] = $part;
    }

    return empty($parts) ? '/' : '/' . implode('/', $parts);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

if (!in_array($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET', ['GET', 'POST'], true)) {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

function apro_server_tree_read_input(): array
{
    if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') {
        return $_GET ?? [];
    }

    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    $decoded = json_decode($raw ?: '', true);
    return array_merge($_GET ?? [], is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : []);
}

function apro_server_tree_base_url(string $url): string
{
    $url = trim($url);
    if ($url === '') {
        return '';
    }
    if (preg_match('#^https?://[^/@:]+:[^/@:]+@#i', $url)) {
        return '';
    }
    if (!preg_match('#^https?://#i', $url)) {
        $url = 'https://' . ltrim($url, '/');
    }
    return rtrim($url, '/' . chr(92));
}

function apro_server_tree_get(string $url, string $apiKey, bool $insecure): array
{
    $ch = curl_init($url);
    if ($ch === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize cURL.');
    }

    curl_setopt_array($ch, [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
            'Accept: application/json',
            'X-System-Api-Key: ' . $apiKey,
        ],
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 5,
    ]);

    if ($insecure) {
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 0);
    }

    $body = curl_exec($ch);
    $error = curl_error($ch);
    $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    curl_close($ch);

    if ($body === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('HTTP request failed: ' . $error);
    }

    return ['status' => $status, 'body' => (string)$body];
}

function apro_server_tree_normalize_path(string $path): string
{
    $path = trim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $path));
    $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;

    if ($path === '') {
        return '/';
    }

    if ($path[0] !== '/') {
        $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    $parts = [];
    foreach (explode('/', $path) as $part) {
        if ($part === '' || $part === '.') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($part === '..') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Remote browse path may not contain traversal segments.');
        }
        $parts[] = $part;
    }

    return '/' . implode('/', $parts);
}

try {
    $input = apro_server_tree_read_input();
    $method = strtolower(trim((string)($input['method'] ?? 'https_agent')));

    if ($method !== 'https_agent') {
        apro_json_error('Only method=https_agent is supported by this endpoint.', 400);
    }

    $baseUrl = apro_server_tree_base_url((string)($input['server_url'] ?? ''));
    $apiKey = trim((string)($input['api_key'] ?? ''));
    $path = apro_server_tree_normalize_path((string)($input['path'] ?? '/'));
    $insecure = (bool)($input['insecure'] ?? false);

    if ($baseUrl === '' || $apiKey === '') {
        apro_json_error('server_url and api_key are required.', 400);
    }

    $response = apro_server_tree_get($baseUrl . '/admin-api/tree?path=' . rawurlencode($path), $apiKey, $insecure);
    $data = json_decode($response['body'], true);

    if (!is_array($data)) {
        apro_json_error('Agent returned non-JSON response (HTTP ' . $response['status'] . ').', 502, [
            'body_snippet' => substr($response['body'], 0, 1000),
            'status_code' => $response['status'],
        ]);
    }

    if ($response['status'] >= 400 || (($data['status'] ?? '') === 'error')) {
        apro_json_error((string)($data['message'] ?? 'Remote tree failed.'), $response['status'] ?: 502, [
            'raw' => $data,
            'status_code' => $response['status'],
        ]);
    }

    $agentData = is_array($data['data'] ?? null) ? $data['data'] : $data;
    $tree = is_array($agentData['tree'] ?? null) ? $agentData['tree'] : null;

    if ($tree === null) {
        apro_json_success([
            'raw' => $data,
            'status_code' => $response['status'],
            'requested_path' => $path,
        ]);
    }

    apro_json_success([
        'tree' => $tree,
        'meta' => is_array($agentData['meta'] ?? null) ? $agentData['meta'] : [
            'source' => 'https_agent',
            'requested_path' => $path,
            'default_root' => '/',
        ],
        'status_code' => $response['status'],
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/server/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/godaddy/common.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

final class AproSubmitException extends RuntimeException
{
    private int $httpStatus;

    public function __construct(string $message, int $httpStatus = 400)
    {
        parent::__construct($message);
        $this->httpStatus = $httpStatus;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return $this->httpStatus;
    }
}

function apro_submit_prompt(array $payload): string
{
    if (isset($payload['prompt_b64']) && $payload['prompt_b64'] !== '') {
        $decoded = base64_decode((string)$payload['prompt_b64'], true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            throw new AproSubmitException('Invalid base64 prompt payload.', 400);
        }
        return trim($decoded);
    }

    return trim((string)($payload['prompt'] ?? ''));
}

function apro_submit_normalize_selected_paths($raw): array
{
    if (!is_array($raw)) {
        throw new AproSubmitException('Selected paths must be an array.', 400);
    }

    $out = [];
    foreach ($raw as $path) {
        $path = trim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', (string)$path));
        $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;
        if ($path === '' || $path === '/') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($path[0] !== '/') {
            $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        }
        $out[] = $path;
    }

    return array_values(array_unique($out));
}

function apro_submit_execute(array $payload): array
{
    @set_time_limit(0);
    @ini_set('max_execution_time', '0');
    ignore_user_abort(true);

    $userPrompt = apro_submit_prompt($payload);
    $includeMode = (string)($payload['include_mode'] ?? 'both');
    $serviceId = trim((string)($payload['service_id'] ?? ''));
    $selectedPaths = apro_submit_normalize_selected_paths($payload['selected_paths'] ?? []);
    $github = $payload['github'] ?? null;
    $remote = $payload['remote'] ?? null;
    $godaddy = $payload['godaddy'] ?? null;

    if ($userPrompt === '') {
        throw new AproSubmitException('Prompt is required.', 400);
    }

    if (!in_array($includeMode, ['paths_only', 'contents_only', 'both'], true)) {
        throw new AproSubmitException('Invalid include mode.', 400);
    }

    $service = apro_find_ai_service_by_id($serviceId);
    if ($service === null) {
        throw new AproSubmitException('Selected AI service is not available.', 400);
    }

    $includePaths = $includeMode === 'paths_only' || $includeMode === 'both';
    $includeContents = $includeMode === 'contents_only' || $includeMode === 'both';

    $usingGithub = is_array($github)
        && trim((string)($github['owner'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($github['repo'] ?? '')) !== ''
        && trim((string)($github['branch'] ?? '')) !== '';

    $usingRemote = false;
    $remoteServerUrl = '';
    $remoteApiKey = '';
    $remoteInsecure = false;

    if (is_array($remote)) {
        $remoteServerUrl = trim((string)($remote['server_url'] ?? ''));
        $remoteApiKey = trim((string)($remote['api_key'] ?? ''));
        $remoteInsecure = (bool)($remote['insecure'] ?? false);
        $usingRemote = $remoteServerUrl !== '' && $remoteApiKey !== '';
    }

    $usingGoDaddy = false;
    $godaddyBaseUrl = '';
    $godaddyUsername = '';
    $godaddyApiToken = '';
    $godaddyInsecure = false;

    if (is_array($godaddy)) {
        $godaddyBaseUrl = trim((string)($godaddy['base_url'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyUsername = trim((string)($godaddy['username'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyApiToken = trim((string)($godaddy['api_token'] ?? ''));
        $godaddyInsecure = apro_godaddy_bool($godaddy['insecure'] ?? false, false);
        $usingGoDaddy = $godaddyBaseUrl !== '' && $godaddyUsername !== '' && $godaddyApiToken !== '';
    }

    if (($includePaths || $includeContents) && count($selectedPaths) > 0) {
        foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
            if ($usingGithub || $usingRemote || $usingGoDaddy) {
                if ($p[0] !== '/') {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected file path must start with /: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (strpos($p, '..') !== false) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected file path may not contain path traversal: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            } else {
                try {
                    $abs = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($p);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected path is invalid or does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
                }
                if (!is_file($abs)) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected paths must be file paths only. Do not send directory nodes: ' . $p, 400);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    $selectedItems = [
        'selected_count' => 0,
        'resolved_file_count' => 0,
        'total_content_bytes' => 0,
        'items' => [],
    ];

    if ($usingGithub) {
        $owner = trim((string)$github['owner']);
        $repo = trim((string)$github['repo']);
        $branch = trim((string)$github['branch']);
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
            $repoPath = ltrim($p, '/');
            if ($repoPath === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $gh = apro_github_fetch_file_content($owner, $repo, $branch, $repoPath);
            $item = [];

            if ($includePaths) {
                $item['path'] = '/' . $repoPath;
            }
            if (isset($gh['size_bytes'])) {
                $item['size_bytes'] = (int)$gh['size_bytes'];
            }
            if ($includeContents) {
                $content = (string)($gh['content'] ?? '');
                $item['encoding'] = (string)($gh['encoding'] ?? 'text');
                $item['truncated'] = (bool)($gh['truncated'] ?? false);
                if (isset($gh['line_count'])) {
                    $item['line_count'] = (int)$gh['line_count'];
                }
                $item['content'] = $content;
                $total += strlen($content);
                if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                }
            }

            $items[] = $item;
        }

        $selectedItems = [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $includeContents ? $total : 0,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    } elseif ($usingRemote) {
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
            $remoteFile = apro_server_fetch_file_payload($remoteServerUrl, $remoteApiKey, $p, $remoteInsecure, false);
            if (($remoteFile['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                throw new AproSubmitException('Selected remote path does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
            }

            $item = [];
            if ($includePaths) {
                $item['path'] = (string)($remoteFile['path'] ?? $p);
            }
            if (isset($remoteFile['size_bytes'])) {
                $item['size_bytes'] = (int)$remoteFile['size_bytes'];
            }
            if ($includeContents) {
                $content = (string)($remoteFile['content'] ?? '');
                $item['encoding'] = (string)($remoteFile['encoding'] ?? 'text');
                $item['truncated'] = (bool)($remoteFile['truncated'] ?? false);
                if (isset($remoteFile['line_count'])) {
                    $item['line_count'] = (int)$remoteFile['line_count'];
                }
                $item['content'] = $content;
                $total += strlen($content);
                if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                }
            }
            $items[] = $item;
        }

        $selectedItems = [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $includeContents ? $total : 0,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    } elseif ($usingGoDaddy) {
        $items = [];
        $total = 0;

        foreach ($selectedPaths as $p) {
            $godaddyFile = apro_godaddy_fetch_file_payload($godaddyBaseUrl, $godaddyUsername, $godaddyApiToken, $p, $godaddyInsecure);
            if (($godaddyFile['exists'] ?? true) === false) {
                throw new AproSubmitException('Selected GoDaddy path does not exist: ' . $p, 400);
            }

            $item = [];
            if ($includePaths) {
                $item['path'] = (string)($godaddyFile['path'] ?? $p);
            }
            if (isset($godaddyFile['size_bytes'])) {
                $item['size_bytes'] = (int)$godaddyFile['size_bytes'];
            }
            if ($includeContents) {
                $content = (string)($godaddyFile['content'] ?? '');
                $item['encoding'] = (string)($godaddyFile['encoding'] ?? 'text');
                $item['truncated'] = (bool)($godaddyFile['truncated'] ?? false);
                if (isset($godaddyFile['line_count'])) {
                    $item['line_count'] = (int)$godaddyFile['line_count'];
                }
                $item['content'] = $content;
                $total += strlen($content);
                if ($total > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                    throw new AproSubmitException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.', 400);
                }
            }
            $items[] = $item;
        }

        $selectedItems = [
            'selected_count' => count($selectedPaths),
            'resolved_file_count' => count($items),
            'total_content_bytes' => $includeContents ? $total : 0,
            'items' => $items,
        ];
    } else {
        $selectedItems = apro_fs_collect_selected_items($selectedPaths, $includePaths, $includeContents);
    }

    if ((int)$selectedItems['selected_count'] === 0) {
        throw new AproSubmitException('At least one file must be selected.', 400);
    }

    $provider = apro_ai_provider_from_service($service);
    $result = $provider->sendRequest($service, $userPrompt, $selectedItems['items'], [
        'include_paths' => $includePaths,
        'include_contents' => $includeContents,
        'selected_count' => $selectedItems['selected_count'],
        'resolved_file_count' => $selectedItems['resolved_file_count'],
        'total_content_bytes' => $selectedItems['total_content_bytes'],
    ]);

    return [
        'response_text' => $result['response_text'] ?? '',
        'service' => $service,
        'meta' => [
            'selected_count' => $selectedItems['selected_count'],
            'resolved_file_count' => $selectedItems['resolved_file_count'],
            'total_content_bytes' => $selectedItems['total_content_bytes'],
        ],
        'provider_response' => $result['provider_response'] ?? null,
    ];
}

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') !== 'POST') {
    apro_json_error('Method not allowed.', 405);
}

$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
if ($rawInput === false || trim($rawInput) === '') {
    apro_json_error('Request body is required.', 400);
}

$payload = json_decode($rawInput, true);
if (!is_array($payload)) {
    apro_json_error('Invalid JSON request body.', 400);
}

unset($payload['async'], $payload['job_id']);
if (isset($payload['action']) && strtolower((string)$payload['action']) === 'job_status') {
    unset($payload['action']);
}

try {
    apro_json_success(apro_submit_execute($payload));
} catch (AproSubmitException $exception) {
    apro_json_error($exception->getMessage(), $exception->httpStatus());
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/../includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/response_format.php';

require_admin_authentication();

// Returns GET (default: all) or POST with {"file_types": [".php", ...]}
$allowedExtensions = null;
if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
    $rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
    $payload = @json_decode($rawInput ?? '', true);
    if (is_array($payload) && isset($payload['file_types']) && is_array($payload['file_types'])) {
        // Clean: only use string extensions
        $allowedExtensions = [];
        foreach ($payload['file_types'] as $v) {
            $ext = trim((string)$v);
            if ($ext === '') continue;
            $allowedExtensions[$ext] = true;
        }
        if (count($allowedExtensions) === 0) {
            $allowedExtensions = null; // default to show all if empty
        }
    }
} elseif (isset($_GET['file_types'])) {
    // Accept comma-separated for GET fallback
    $arr = explode(',', (string)$_GET['file_types']);
    $allowedExtensions = [];
    foreach ($arr as $ext) {
        $ext = trim($ext);
        if ($ext === '') continue;
        $allowedExtensions[$ext] = true;
    }
    if (count($allowedExtensions) === 0) {
        $allowedExtensions = null;
    }
}

try {
    $tree = apro_fs_build_full_tree($allowedExtensions);

    apro_json_success([
        'tree' => $tree,
    ]);
} catch (Throwable $throwable) {
    apro_json_error($throwable->getMessage(), 500);
}
