/*
 * APRO - Base Styles
 *
 * Additional Comments:
 * - This stylesheet defines the primary visual system for the APRO admin UI.
 * - Sections are organized by feature area to make maintenance easier.
 * - Revision history is included at the top per request.
 *
 * Revision History:
 * - 2026-04-18: Added documentation comments and revision history header; preserved existing styles.
 * - 2026-04-22: Added styles for file viewer modal refinements, per-tile local destination path editor, binary badges, and small bulk/toolbar polish.
 * - 2026-05-10: Added APRO AI Model Discovery Control panel upgrade styles for AIFLEX-like filtering, richer catalog presentation, and APRO model selection workflow.
 * - 2026-05-12: Refined APRO AI Model Discovery Control layout for decision-first cost control, promoted primary filters, and added sorting-oriented presentation.
 * - 2026-05-12: Added visible multi-provider selection styling for the APRO AI Model Discovery Control primary filter experience.
 * - 2026-05-12: Replaced provider multiselect styling with provider toggle-row styling for a cleaner one-or-many provider picker.
 * - 2026-05-12: Promoted pricing-source selection into the primary discovery area using toggle-row controls that match provider toggles.
 * - 2026-05-12: Moved Newest Within and Sort By into the main toggle-button workflow and placed all remaining discovery filters inside the collapsible section.
 * - 2026-05-12: Added Capability to the main discovery toggle workflow and reorganized the top toggle controls for a cleaner, more streamlined presentation.
 * - 2026-05-12: Added GoDaddy runtime account selector styling for the fourth Tree Source option.
 * - 2026-05-13: Reworked GoDaddy recursive-expand affordances so the per-node recursive control is a real clickable inline control and remains stable through rerenders.
 */

/* =============================== */
/*        APRO - Base Styles       */
/* =============================== */

* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

:root {
    color-scheme: light dark;
    --bg: #020617;
    --panel: #0f172a;
    --panel-2: #111827;
    --border: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
    --text: #e2e8f0;
    --muted: #94a3b8;
    --accent: #38bdf8;
    --accent-dark: #082f49;
    --danger: #ef4444;
    --success: #22c55e;
    --warn: #f59e0b;
}

html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: 100%;
    font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
}

/* =============================== */
/*          Shell / Layout         */
/* =============================== */

.apro-shell {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.apro-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 20px 24px 28px;
}

/* =============================== */
/*            Header               */
/* =============================== */

.apro-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    background: var(--panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.apro-header h1 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 28px;
}

.apro-subtitle {
    margin: 8px 0 0;
    color: var(--muted);
}

.apro-header-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.apro-user {
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 14px;
}

.apro-header-right {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 6px;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .apro-header-right {
        align-items: flex-start;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

/* =============================== */
/*        Button Styles            */
/* =============================== */

.apro-link-button,
.apro-primary-button,
.apro-secondary-button,
.apro-mini-button,
.apro-inline-select-button {
    display: inline-block;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.apro-link-button,
.apro-secondary-button,
.apro-mini-button,
.apro-inline-select-button {
    background: #1e293b;
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.apro-link-button,
.apro-secondary-button {
    padding: 11px 14px;
}

.apro-primary-button {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-dark);
}

.apro-mini-button,
.apro-inline-select-button {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.apro-inline-select-button.is-selected {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55);
}

.apro-inline-select-button.is-disabled,
.apro-inline-select-button[disabled] {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

.apro-tree-row .apro-mini-button {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

/* =============================== */
/*        Panel Styles             */
/* =============================== */

.apro-panel {
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

.apro-panel-response {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.apro-panel-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.apro-panel-header h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 20px;
}

.apro-panel-tools,
.apro-response-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* =============================== */
/*         Form & Fields           */
/* =============================== */

.apro-field {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.apro-field label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.apro-field textarea,
.apro-field select,
.apro-field input[type="text"],
.apro-field input[type="search"],
.apro-field input[type="number"],
.apro-field input[type="date"] {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 15px;
}

.apro-field textarea {
    min-height: 256px;
    resize: vertical;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.apro-controls-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
}

.apro-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

/* =============================== */
/*       Status / Summary UI       */
/* =============================== */

.apro-selection-summary,
.apro-tree-meta,
.apro-status {
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    color: var(--muted);
}

.apro-status {
    margin-top: 12px;
    min-height: 46px;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.apro-status.is-error {
    color: #fecaca;
    border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.3);
    background: rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.35);
}

.apro-status.is-success {
    color: #bbf7d0;
    border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
    background: rgba(20, 83, 45, 0.35);
}

.apro-loading {
    color: var(--muted);
}

.subtle {
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

/* =============================== */
/*          Tree Styles            */
/* =============================== */

.apro-tree-container {
    margin-top: 12px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px;
    max-height: 512px;
    overflow: auto;
}

.apro-tree-list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding-left: 18px;
}

.apro-tree-list.apro-tree-root {
    padding-left: 0;
}

.apro-tree-item { margin: 4px 0; }

.apro-tree-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    min-height: 28px;
}

.apro-tree-toggle {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: #0b1220;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.apro-tree-toggle.is-hidden {
    visibility: hidden;
}

.apro-tree-checkbox {
    margin: 0;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.apro-tree-label {
    color: var(--text);
    word-break: break-word;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.apro-tree-label.apro-tree-directory {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #cbd5e1;
}

.apro-tree-label.apro-tree-file {
    color: #94a3b8;
}

.apro-tree-name {
    color: inherit;
}

.apro-tree-size {
    color: #7dd3fc;
    font-size: 12px;
    opacity: 0.9;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.apro-tree-label.apro-tree-directory .apro-tree-size {
    color: #93c5fd;
}

.apro-tree-label.apro-tree-file .apro-tree-size {
    color: #94a3b8;
}

.apro-tree-children.is-collapsed {
    display: none;
}

.apro-tree-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-left: auto;
}

.apro-tree-actions .apro-mini-button {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.apro-godaddy-directory-row {
    position: relative;
}

.apro-godaddy-directory-row:hover {
    background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
}

.apro-godaddy-tree-hint {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px dashed rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.38);
    background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.22);
    color: #7dd3fc;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
}

button.apro-godaddy-tree-hint {
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.22);
    color: #7dd3fc;
    border: 1px dashed rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.38);
    margin: 0;
}

button.apro-godaddy-tree-hint:hover,
button.apro-godaddy-tree-hint:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.32);
    border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.75);
    color: #e0f2fe;
    outline: none;
}

/* =============================== */
/*      AI Response Output         */
/* =============================== */

.apro-response-output {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px;
    min-height: 220px;
    max-height: 700px;
    overflow: auto;
    color: #e5e7eb;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
}

/* =============================== */
/*      AI Discovery Panel         */
/* =============================== */

.apro-discovery-shell {
    display: grid;
    gap: 16px;
}

.apro-discovery-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.apro-discovery-topbar .apro-selection-summary {
    flex: 1 1 560px;
    margin: 0;
}

.apro-discovery-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.apro-discovery-selected-model {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
    background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.28);
    color: #cfeeff;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.apro-discovery-selected-model strong {
    color: #e0f2fe;
}

.apro-discovery-metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
}

.apro-discovery-metric-card {
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-metric-card .subtle {
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.apro-discovery-metric-value {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #e2e8f0;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.apro-discovery-filters {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
    padding: 16px;
}

.apro-discovery-primary-stack {
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-search-compact {
    max-width: 520px;
}

.apro-discovery-toggle-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: stretch;
}

.apro-discovery-toggle-card {
    border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: rgba(11, 18, 32, 0.68);
    padding: 14px 14px 12px;
    min-width: 0;
    box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}

.apro-discovery-toggle-card .subtle {
    margin-top: 2px;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: start;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-grid-primary {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1.1fr) minmax(360px, 1.7fr) minmax(360px, 1.7fr) minmax(260px, 1.2fr) minmax(320px, 1.5fr);
}

.apro-discovery-filter-grid-secondary {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-grid.advanced {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
    margin-top: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-field {
    min-width: 0;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-field label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-field input,
.apro-discovery-filter-field select {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 42px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: #0b1220;
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 10px 11px;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-filter-field-search,
.apro-discovery-filter-field-provider,
.apro-discovery-filter-field-pricing-source,
.apro-discovery-filter-field-choice {
    align-self: stretch;
}

.apro-discovery-provider-toggle-row,
.apro-discovery-source-toggle-row,
.apro-discovery-choice-toggle-row,
.apro-discovery-capability-toggle-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 42px;
}

.apro-discovery-provider-toggle,
.apro-discovery-source-toggle,
.apro-discovery-choice-toggle,
.apro-discovery-capability-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 40px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.22);
    background: #0b1220;
    color: #dbeafe;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

.apro-discovery-provider-toggle:hover,
.apro-discovery-source-toggle:hover,
.apro-discovery-choice-toggle:hover,
.apro-discovery-capability-toggle:hover {
    border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
    color: #eff6ff;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.apro-discovery-provider-toggle.is-active,
.apro-discovery-source-toggle.is-active,
.apro-discovery-choice-toggle.is-active,
.apro-discovery-capability-toggle.is-active {
    background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.58);
    color: #dff7ff;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);
}

.apro-discovery-provider-toggle:focus-visible,
.apro-discovery-source-toggle:focus-visible,
.apro-discovery-choice-toggle:focus-visible,
.apro-discovery-capability-toggle:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.75);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

.apro-discovery-toggle-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.apro-discovery-toggle-actions .apro-mini-button {
    min-width: 64px;
}

.apro-discovery-sort-dir-inline {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 10px;
}

.apro-discovery-sort-dir-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.apro-discovery-sort-dir-toggle-row .apro-discovery-choice-toggle {
    min-width: 110px;
}

.apro-discovery-advanced-toggle {
    margin-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
    padding-top: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-advanced-toggle summary {
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #bfe8ff;
}

.apro-discovery-advanced-toggle summary::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
}

.apro-discovery-advanced-toggle summary::after {
    content: '+';
    float: right;
    color: #7dd3fc;
}

.apro-discovery-advanced-toggle[open] summary::after {
    content: '−';
}

.apro-discovery-measure-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-measure-card {
    border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.16);
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: #0b1220;
    padding: 14px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.apro-discovery-measure-card strong {
    color: #e2e8f0;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.apro-discovery-measure-inputs {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.apro-discovery-measure-inputs > input:only-child {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.apro-discovery-measure-card.full-width {
    grid-column: span 2;
}

.apro-discovery-actions-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 16px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.apro-discovery-result-count {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #dbeafe;
}

.apro-discovery-table-wrap {
    overflow: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
}

.apro-discovery-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    table-layout: fixed;
    min-width: 1680px;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th,
.apro-discovery-table td {
    text-align: left;
    padding: 11px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
    vertical-align: top;
}

.apro-discovery-table th {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background: #0b1220;
    z-index: 1;
    color: #cbd5e1;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(1),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(1) {
    width: 180px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(2),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(2) {
    width: 250px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(3),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(3) {
    width: 130px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(4),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(4) {
    width: 220px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(5),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(5) {
    width: 220px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(6),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(6) {
    width: 180px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(7),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(7) {
    width: 140px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(8),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(8) {
    width: 120px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(9),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(9) {
    width: 170px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(10),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(10) {
    width: 190px;
}

.apro-discovery-table th:nth-child(11),
.apro-discovery-table td:nth-child(11) {
    width: 210px;
}

.apro-discovery-model-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #f8fafc;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    line-height: 1.35;
}

.apro-discovery-code {
    font-family: Consolas, Monaco, monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #94a3b8;
    word-break: break-word;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.apro-discovery-cell-stack {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

.apro-discovery-badges,
.badges {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
}

.badge,
.apro-discovery-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
    color: #e2e8f0;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.2;
    max-width: 100%;
    white-space: normal;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.badge.ok,
.apro-discovery-badge.ok {
    background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12);
    border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
    color: #bbf7d0;
}

.badge.warn,
.apro-discovery-badge.warn {
    background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.14);
    border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28);
    color: #fde68a;
}

.apro-discovery-kv-list,
.kv-list {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
}

.apro-discovery-kv-list li,
.kv-list li {
    margin: 0 0 7px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.apro-discovery-kv-list li:last-child,
.kv-list li:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

.apro-discovery-price {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #e2e8f0;
}

.apro-discovery-price.is-unknown {
    color: var(--muted);
}

.apro-discovery-model-picker {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    min-width: 0;
}

.apro-discovery-select-button {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: normal;
}

.apro-discovery-select-button.is-selected {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
}

.apro-discovery-select-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.apro-discovery-empty {
    padding: 22px;
    color: var(--muted);
}

/* =============================== */
/*       GoDaddy Tree Source       */
/* =============================== */

#treeSourceControls input[type="text"],
#treeSourceControls input[type="password"],
#treeSourceControls select {
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 7px 9px;
    font-size: 13px;
}

#godaddyTreeFields {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: rgba(8, 47, 73, 0.16);
}

#aproGoDaddyAccountSelect {
    min-width: 220px;
    max-width: 320px;
}

/* =============================== */
/*   Responsive/Media Queries      */
/* =============================== */

@media (max-width: 1018px) {
    .apro-discovery-toggle-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1015px) {
    .apro-discovery-toggle-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1014px) {
    .apro-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .apro-discovery-metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(180px, 1fr)); }
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid-primary { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid-secondary { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid.advanced { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .apro-discovery-measure-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .apro-discovery-measure-card.full-width { grid-column: span 2; }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .apro-header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .apro-controls-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .apro-header-right {
        align-items: flex-start;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1009px) {
    .apro-discovery-topbar,
    .apro-discovery-actions-row {
        align-items: stretch;
    }
    .apro-discovery-toolbar {
        width: 100%;
    }
    .apro-discovery-toolbar > * {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
    }
    .apro-discovery-metrics,
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid-primary,
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid-secondary,
    .apro-discovery-filter-grid.advanced,
    .apro-discovery-measure-grid,
    .apro-discovery-measure-inputs,
    .apro-discovery-toggle-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
    .apro-discovery-measure-card.full-width {
        grid-column: auto;
    }
    .apro-main {
        padding: 18px;
    }
    .apro-discovery-provider-toggle-row,
    .apro-discovery-source-toggle-row,
    .apro-discovery-choice-toggle-row,
    .apro-discovery-capability-toggle-row {
        gap: 6px;
    }
    .apro-discovery-provider-toggle,
    .apro-discovery-source-toggle,
    .apro-discovery-choice-toggle,
    .apro-discovery-capability-toggle {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: flex-start;
    }
    .apro-discovery-sort-dir-toggle-row .apro-discovery-choice-toggle {
        min-width: 0;
    }
    #godaddyTreeFields {
        width: 100%;
        align-items: stretch;
    }
    #aproGoDaddyAccountSelect {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: none;
    }
    .apro-godaddy-tree-hint {
        width: auto;
        justify-content: center;
    }
}

/* =============================== */
/*            Modals               */
/* =============================== */

.apro-modal {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0; top: 0;
    width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    z-index: 10000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}
.apro-modal-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0; top: 0;
    width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
    background: rgba(14, 23, 35, 0.85);
    z-index: 10001;
}
.apro-modal-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10002;
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 64px #000b 0.25;
    width: 90vw; max-width: 660px; min-width: 320px;
    padding: 0 0 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    max-height: 92vh;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.apro-modal-header {
    padding: 20px 28px 10px 28px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.apro-modal-body {
    padding: 18px 28px 0 28px;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow-y: auto;
    max-height: calc(92vh - 120px);
    min-height: 80px;
}
.apro-modal-footer {
    padding: 10px 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.apro-modal-textarea {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--text);
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 300px;
    resize: vertical;
}

/* =============================== */
/*      File System Analysis       */
/* =============================== */

#analysisPanel {
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14);
    min-height: 280px;
}

#analysisPanel .analysis-meta { margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
#analysisPanel .analysis-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}
#analysisPanel .apro-mini-button.copy-analysis-btn {
    color: var(--accent-dark);
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent-dark);
    font-weight: bold;
}
#analysisPanel .apro-mini-button.copy-analysis-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

#analysisTiles, #featureTiles, #publishTiles, #filePublishTiles, #fileArchivesTiles {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
}

.analysis-tile, .feature-tile, .publish-tile {
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 2px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    min-width: 280px;
    max-width: 380px;
    flex: 1 0 280px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 7px;
    min-height: 110px;
    position: relative;
    word-break: break-all;
}
.analysis-tile-idle     { border-color: #334155; }
.analysis-tile-running  { border-color: var(--accent); background: #0ea5e940; }
.analysis-tile-done     { border-color: var(--success); background: rgba(40,90,50,0.12); }

.publish-tile-approved { border-color: #facc15; box-shadow: 0 0 3px #facc1550; }
.publish-tile-reviewed { border-color: var(--success); background: #16653422; }
.publish-tile .tile-file-path { font-size: 14px; font-family: monospace; color: #bae6fd; font-weight: bold; }
.publish-tile .tile-file-op { color: #facc15; font-size: 13px; margin-left: 7px; font-weight: bold; }
.publish-tile .tile-filesize { color: #a6adc7; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 3px; }
.publish-tile .tile-status-badge { background: #1c1917; border-radius: 6px; color: #fff2; padding: 3px 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 8px; }
.publish-tile .tile-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; }
.publish-tile .tile-remove-btn { color: var(--danger) !important; background: #fff1; font-size: 15px !important; padding: 3px 8px !important; border: 1px solid var(--danger); }
.publish-tile .approve-btn-pub { background: var(--success); color: var(--success-dark); }
.publish-tile .approve-btn-dis { background: #64748b; color: #eee; opacity: 0.66; cursor: not-allowed; }
.publish-tile .publish-btn-pub { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-dark)!important; font-weight: bold; }
.publish-tile .publish-btn-dis { background: #64748b; color: #eee!important; opacity: 0.67; cursor: not-allowed; }
.publish-tile .reviewed-badge { color: var(--success); margin-left: 7px; font-size: 13px; }
.publish-tile .unchanged-badge { color: #eab308; margin-left: 7px; font-size: 13px; }
.publish-tile .merge-btn { background: var(--muted); color: #182133; border: 1px solid #334155; }

.tile-dest-edit label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}
.tile-dest-edit input[type="text"] {
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.badge-binary {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #332d1a;
    color: #facc15;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.publishModal-diff {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #151b24;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    height: 360px;
}
.publishModal-diff-pane, .publishModal-diff-pane-add {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 0 0 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
}
.publishModal-diff-pane {
    border-right: 1.5px solid #223047;
}
.publishModal-diff-header {
    background: #1a263a;
    padding: 5px 13px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #b7c7e3;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-weight: 400;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #223047;
    white-space: pre;
}
.publishModal-diff-content {
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    background: #151b25;
    color: #f4f7fa;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    white-space: pre;
    overflow: auto;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    border-radius: 0;
    border-bottom-right-radius: 6px;
    border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
    word-break: break-word;
}
.publishModal-diff-content.add {
    color: #10b981;
}
.publishModal-diff-content.del {
    color: #ef4444;
}
.publishModal-diff-content.no-content {
    color: #7a889e;
    opacity: 0.65;
    font-style: italic;
}
.publishModal-bulk-status {
    background: #16263c;
    color: #dbdee7;
    padding: 7px 11px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.publishModal-size-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 3px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #b8c5eb;
}
.publishModal-size-label {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #73f884;
}
.publishModal-size-bytes {
    color: #b8c5eb; margin-left:2px;
}
.publishModal-size-lines { color: #8ae4fa; margin-left:5px; }
.publishModal-warning { color: #fdba74; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.publishModal-success { color: #a7f3d0; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.publishModal-error { color: #fd4444; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

#publishAnalysisActions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#publishTilesEmpty { color: var(--muted); border: 1.5px dashed #334155; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px 30px; font-size: 15px; margin: 18px 0; }

.apro-modal .apro-modal-content.publishModal {
    max-width: 940px;
    min-width: 440px;
}

/* =============================== */
/*      File Types Modal           */
/* =============================== */

.file-type-group {
    margin-bottom: 18px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: #182133;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.file-type-group-label {
    font-size: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    color: var(--muted);
}
.file-type-group-unknown {
    background: #27171a;
    border-color: #ce3c3c80;
}
.file-type-group-unknown .file-type-group-label {
    color: #f87171;
}
.file-type-group-extlist {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
}
.file-type-pill-container {
    position: relative;
}
.file-type-pill {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #223047;
    color: #99dbfe;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: 1.5px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    user-select: none;
}
.file-type-pill-checked {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-dark);
    border-color: #4ee1f8;
    font-weight: bold;
}
.file-type-pill-unknown {
    color: #fa7f58 !important;
    background: #44252a !important;
    border-color: #ce3c3c80 !important;
}
.file-type-pill-unknown.file-type-pill-checked {
    background: #e8b088 !important;
    color: #af2e18 !important;
    border-color: #fa7f58 !important;
}
.file-type-checkbox { display: none; }

/* =============================== */
/*        Multipurpose Analysis    */
/* =============================== */

#analysisPanel .apro-analysis-mode-switch {
    margin-right: 14px;
    min-width: 170px;
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-radius: 7px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.usecase-tile {
    background: var(--panel-2);
    border: 2.5px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 10px;
    min-width: 280px;
    max-width: 380px;
    flex: 1 0 300px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    margin-right: 0;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 7px;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 110px;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.usecase-tile .usecase-title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #facc15;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}
.usecase-tile .usecase-id {
    color: #bae6fd;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: monospace;
}
.usecase-tile .usecase-summary {
    color: #e0e7ef;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.usecase-tile .usecase-description {
    color: #e3f2fd;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.usecase-tile .usecase-steps {
    color: #f1f5f9;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    margin-left: 6px;
}

.usecase-tile .usecase-copy-btn {
    color: var(--accent-dark) !important;
    background: var(--accent);
    font-size: 12px !important;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-left: auto;
    border-radius: 7px;
    padding: 3px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent-dark);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    margin-top: 5px;
}

#analysisPanel .usecase-gen-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}
#analysisPanel .apro-mini-button.copy-usecases-btn {
    color: var(--accent-dark);
    background: var(--accent);
    border-color: var(--accent-dark);
    font-weight: bold;
}
#analysisPanel .apro-mini-button.copy-usecases-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

#useCasesTiles {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
}

/* =============================== */
/* Publishable Files Styles        */
/* =============================== */

.filepublish-tile {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    background: rgba(38,180,255,0.08);
    position: relative;
}

.filepublish-tile .tile-actions .apro-mini-button,
.filepublish-tile .tile-actions .apro-primary-button,
.filepublish-tile .tile-actions .apro-secondary-button {
    min-width: 85px;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-right: 3px;
}

.tile-file-sizes {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #b4ddfc;
    margin-top: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.tile-github-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #cbd5e1;
}

.filepublish-tile .apro-mini-button[disabled],
.filepublish-tile .apro-primary-button[disabled],
.filepublish-tile .apro-secondary-button[disabled] {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

#filePublishReviewModal .apro-modal-content {
    max-width: 980px;
}
#filePublishReviewModal .apro-modal-body {
    padding-top: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    min-height: 340px;
    background: #131a27;
}
#filePublishReviewModal pre {
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    background: #181f29;
    color: #dee6f7;
    padding: 8px;
    min-height: 330px;
    max-height: 475px;
    overflow: auto;
}
#filePublishReviewModal pre + div {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #89a5d2;
    margin-top: 3px;
}

.filepublish-tile .tile-path {
    color: #ffe066;
}

.filepublish-tile .tile-remove-btn {
    color: #ff6b6b !important;
    background: #fff1;
    font-size: 17px !important;
    padding: 3px 10px !important;
    border: 1px solid var(--danger);
}

.apro-publish-destination-panel {
    margin: 12px 0 18px;
    padding: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
}

.apro-publish-destination-toggle {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    color: var(--text);
}

.apro-publish-destination-toggle label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.apro-github-fields.is-hidden {
    display: none;
}

.apro-github-fields-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
}

.apro-github-help {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-top: 4px;
}

/* =============================== */
/* Archived Files                  */
/* =============================== */

.apro-archives-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.apro-archives-current-file {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: var(--text);
}

.apro-archives-current-file code {
    color: #bae6fd;
    word-break: break-all;
}

.apro-archive-tile {
    border-color: #64748b;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
}

.apro-archive-tile .tile-path {
    color: #fde68a;
    font-family: monospace;
}

.apro-archive-meta {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #cbd5e1;
    display: grid;
    gap: 4px;
}

.apro-archive-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.apro-archive-restore-result {
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #a7f3d0;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.apro-archive-empty {
    color: var(--muted);
    border: 1.5px dashed #334155;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 24px 30px;
    font-size: 15px;
    margin: 18px 0;
}

.apro-archive-review-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
    align-items: stretch;
}

.apro-archive-review-pane {
    min-width: 0;
}

.apro-archive-review-pane-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    color: #cbd5e1;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.apro-archive-review-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #89a5d2;
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.apro-archive-review-pre {
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
    background: #181f29;
    color: #dee6f7;
    padding: 10px;
    min-height: 360px;
    max-height: 520px;
    overflow: auto;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
    margin: 0;
}

.apro-archive-review-pre.archive {
    color: #bbe7ff;
}

.apro-archive-modal-warning {
    color: #fdba74;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .apro-archive-review-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

/* =============================== */
/* Header AI Service Select        */
/* =============================== */

.service-select-wrapper { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
.service-select-wrapper label { margin:0; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; }
#serviceId {
  min-width: 220px;
  max-width: 420px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 14px;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .service-select-wrapper { width:100%; }
  #serviceId { width:100%; min-width:0; max-width:none; }
  .apro-github-fields-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .apro-header { position: relative; }
  .service-select-wrapper {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    margin: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .apro-header { position: static; }
  .service-select-wrapper {
    position: static;
    transform: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
}

.apro-nav-links {

.apro-header-redesign .apro-link-button {
    padding: 9px 12px;

    white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 860px) {

        justify-content: flex-start;

        let html = '<option value="">' + escapeHtml(placeholder) + '</option>';
        values.forEach(function (value) {
            const label = formatter ? formatter(value) : value;
            html += '<option value="' + escapeHtml(value) + '"' + (current === value ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + escapeHtml(label) + '</option>';
        });
        el.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function renderToggleButtons(hostId, values, selectedValues, buttonClass, valueFormatter, mode) {
        const host = byId(hostId);
        if (!host) return;
        const selectedSet = {};
        (selectedValues || []).forEach(function (value) {
            selectedSet[String(value).toLowerCase()] = true;
        });
        host.innerHTML = values.map(function (value) {
            const normalized = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const active = !!selectedSet[normalized];
            const label = valueFormatter ? valueFormatter(value) : value;
            return '<button type="button" class="' + buttonClass + (active ? ' is-active' : '') + '" data-value="' + escapeHtml(value) + '" aria-pressed="' + (active ? 'true' : 'false') + '">' + escapeHtml(label) + '</button>';
        }).join('');

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.' + buttonClass + '[data-value]'), function (button) {
            button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (mode === 'single') {
                    Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.' + buttonClass + '[data-value]'), function (peer) {
                        peer.classList.remove('is-active');
                        peer.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                    });
                    button.classList.add('is-active');
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                } else {
                    button.classList.toggle('is-active');
                    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', button.classList.contains('is-active') ? 'true' : 'false');
                }
                applyFilters();
            });
        });
    }

    function renderProviderToggles(values) {
        providerFacetValues = values.slice();
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryProviderToggles', values, parseToggleProviderValues(), 'apro-discovery-provider-toggle', null, 'multi');
    }

    function renderPricingSourceToggles(values) {
        pricingSourceFacetValues = values.slice();
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryPricingSourceToggles', values, parseTogglePricingSourceValues(), 'apro-discovery-source-toggle', function (value) {
            return String(value || '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
        }, 'multi');
    }

    function renderCapabilityToggles(values) {
        capabilityFacetValues = values.slice();
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryCapabilityToggles', values, parseToggleCapabilityValues(), 'apro-discovery-capability-toggle', function (value) {
            return String(value || '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
        }, 'multi');
    }

    function renderNewestWithinToggles() {
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryNewestWithinToggles', Object.keys(AGE_OPTIONS), [filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPublishedAge') || ''], 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', function (value) {
            return AGE_OPTIONS[value] || 'Any age';
        }, 'single');
    }

    function renderSortByToggles() {
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoverySortByToggles', Object.keys(SORT_OPTIONS), [filterValue('aproAiDiscoverySortBy') || 'newest'], 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', function (value) {
            return SORT_OPTIONS[value] || value;
        }, 'single');
    }

    function renderSortDirToggles() {
        renderToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoverySortDirToggles', ['desc', 'asc'], [filterValue('aproAiDiscoverySortDir') || 'desc'], 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', function (value) {
            return value === 'asc' ? 'Ascend' : 'Descend';
        }, 'single');
    }

    function setAllToggleButtons(hostId, buttonClass, isActive) {
        const host = byId(hostId);
        if (!host) return;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('.' + buttonClass + '[data-value]'), function (button) {
            button.classList.toggle('is-active', !!isActive);
            button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    }

    function activateAllProviderToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryProviderToggles', 'apro-discovery-provider-toggle', true);
    }

    function clearAllProviderToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryProviderToggles', 'apro-discovery-provider-toggle', false);
    }

    function activateAllPricingSourceToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryPricingSourceToggles', 'apro-discovery-source-toggle', true);
    }

    function clearAllPricingSourceToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryPricingSourceToggles', 'apro-discovery-source-toggle', false);
    }

    function activateAllCapabilityToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryCapabilityToggles', 'apro-discovery-capability-toggle', true);
    }

    function clearAllCapabilityToggles() {
        setAllToggleButtons('aproAiDiscoveryCapabilityToggles', 'apro-discovery-capability-toggle', false);
    }

    function syncHiddenSelectFromToggle(hostId, buttonClass, targetId, fallbackValue) {
        const target = byId(targetId);
        if (!target) return;
        const host = byId(hostId);
        if (!host) {
            target.value = fallbackValue || '';
            return;
        }
        const active = host.querySelector('.' + buttonClass + '.is-active[data-value]');
        target.value = active ? String(active.getAttribute('data-value') || '') : (fallbackValue || '');
    }

    function applyFilters() {
        syncSelectedFromHeaderIfNeeded();
        syncHiddenSelectFromToggle('aproAiDiscoveryNewestWithinToggles', 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', 'aproAiDiscoveryPublishedAge', '');
        syncHiddenSelectFromToggle('aproAiDiscoverySortByToggles', 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', 'aproAiDiscoverySortBy', 'newest');
        syncHiddenSelectFromToggle('aproAiDiscoverySortDirToggles', 'apro-discovery-choice-toggle', 'aproAiDiscoverySortDir', 'desc');

        const selectedProviders = parseToggleProviderValues();
        const selectedPricingSources = parseTogglePricingSourceValues();
        const selectedCapabilities = parseToggleCapabilityValues();

        const filters = {
            q: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryQ').toLowerCase(),
            providers: selectedProviders,
            pricing_sources: selectedPricingSources,
            capabilities: selectedCapabilities,
            reliability: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryReliability').toLowerCase(),
            newest_within: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPublishedAge'),
            availability: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryAvailability').toLowerCase(),
            capability: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryCapability').toLowerCase(),
            limits: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryLimits').toLowerCase(),
            label_source: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryLabelSource').toLowerCase(),
            limits_source: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryLimitsSource').toLowerCase(),
            capabilities_source: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryCapabilitiesSource').toLowerCase(),
            namespace: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryNamespace').toLowerCase(),
            family: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryFamily'),
            enabled: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryEnabled'),
            input_cutoff_min: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryInputMin'),
            input_cutoff_max: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryInputMax'),
            context_window_min: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryContextMin'),
            context_window_max: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryContextMax'),
            output_cutoff_min: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryOutputMin'),
            output_cutoff_max: intFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryOutputMax'),
            pricing_min: floatFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPricingMin'),
            pricing_max: floatFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPricingMax'),
            max_input_price: floatFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryInputPriceMax'),
            max_output_price: floatFilterValue('aproAiDiscoveryOutputPriceMax'),
            published_date_from: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPublishedFrom'),
            published_date_to: filterValue('aproAiDiscoveryPublishedTo'),
            sort_by: filterValue('aproAiDiscoverySortBy') || 'newest',
            sort_dir: filterValue('aproAiDiscoverySortDir') || 'desc'
        };

        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(AGE_OPTIONS, filters.newest_within)) {
            filters.newest_within = '';
        }

        const effectiveFrom = effectiveDateFrom(filters.published_date_from || null, filters.newest_within);
        const effectiveTo = filters.published_date_to || null;

        filteredCatalog = fullCatalog.filter(function (model) {
            const provider = String(model.provider || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
            const availability = String(model.availability || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
            const reliability = String(((model.reliability || {}).overall) || 'unknown').toLowerCase();
            const enabled = model.enabled ? '1' : '0';
            const ns = namespaceOf(model);
            const families = familyList(model);
            const caps = capabilityGroups(model);
            const pricingSource = sourceType(model, 'pricing');

            if (filters.providers.length && filters.providers.indexOf(provider) === -1) return false;
            if (filters.pricing_sources.length && filters.pricing_sources.indexOf(pricingSource) === -1) return false;
            if (filters.capabilities.length && !filters.capabilities.some(function (cap) { return caps.indexOf(cap) !== -1; })) return false;
            if (filters.availability && availability !== filters.availability) return false;
            if (filters.reliability && reliability !== filters.reliability) return false;
            if (filters.enabled && enabled !== filters.enabled) return false;
            if (filters.capability && caps.indexOf(filters.capability) === -1) return false;
            if (filters.label_source && sourceType(model, 'label') !== filters.label_source) return false;
            if (filters.limits_source && sourceType(model, 'limits') !== filters.limits_source) return false;
            if (filters.capabilities_source && sourceType(model, 'capabilities') !== filters.capabilities_source) return false;
            if (filters.namespace && ns !== filters.namespace) return false;
            if (filters.family && families.indexOf(filters.family) === -1) return false;
            if (filters.limits === 'known' && !hasAnyLimit(model)) return false;
            if (filters.limits === 'missing' && hasAnyLimit(model)) return false;
            if (filters.limits === 'input_known' && limitValue(model, 'max_input_tokens') === null) return false;
            if (filters.limits === 'context_known' && limitValue(model, 'max_context_tokens') === null) return false;
            if (filters.limits === 'output_known' && limitValue(model, 'max_output_tokens') === null) return false;
            if (!measureMatches(model, 'max_input_tokens', filters.input_cutoff_min, filters.input_cutoff_max)) return false;
            if (!measureMatches(model, 'max_context_tokens', filters.context_window_min, filters.context_window_max)) return false;
            if (!measureMatches(model, 'max_output_tokens', filters.output_cutoff_min, filters.output_cutoff_max)) return false;
            if (!pricingMatches(model, filters.pricing_min, filters.pricing_max, filters.max_input_price, filters.max_output_price)) return false;
            if (!dateMatches(model, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo)) return false;

            if (filters.q) {
                const haystack = [
                    model.label || '',
                    model.model_id || '',
                    model.canonical_model_id || '',
                    model.provider || '',
                    families.join(' '),
                    caps.join(' '),
                    ns,
                    pricingDisplay(model),
                    pricingSource,
                    dateOnly(providerCreatedAt(model)) || ''
                ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
                if (haystack.indexOf(filters.q) === -1) return false;
            }
            return true;
        });

        filteredCatalog = sortCatalog(filteredCatalog, filters.sort_by, filters.sort_dir);

        const resultCount = byId('aproAiDiscoveryResultCount');
        if (resultCount) {
            const providerLabel = filters.providers.length ? (' across ' + filters.providers.length + ' selected provider' + (filters.providers.length === 1 ? '' : 's')) : '';
            const pricingSourceLabel = filters.pricing_sources.length ? (' using ' + filters.pricing_sources.length + ' pricing source' + (filters.pricing_sources.length === 1 ? '' : 's')) : '';
            const capabilityLabel = filters.capabilities.length ? (' with ' + filters.capabilities.length + ' capability toggle' + (filters.capabilities.length === 1 ? '' : 's')) : '';
            resultCount.textContent = 'Showing ' + filteredCatalog.length.toLocaleString() + ' of ' + fullCatalog.length.toLocaleString() + ' shared catalog records' + providerLabel + pricingSourceLabel + capabilityLabel + '.';
        }
        renderCatalogTable(filteredCatalog);
        updateSelectedModelBox();
    }

    function renderCatalogTable(catalog) {
        const tbody = byId('aproAiDiscoveryTableBody');
        if (!tbody) return;
        if (!catalog.length) {
            tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="apro-discovery-empty">No catalog records match the current discovery filters.</td></tr>';
            return;
        }
        tbody.innerHTML = catalog.map(function (item) {
            const provider = String(item.provider || 'unknown');
            const label = String(item.label || item.model_id || 'Unknown model');
            const canonical = String(item.canonical_model_id || item.model_id || '');
            const enabled = !!item.enabled;
            const availability = String(item.availability || 'unknown');
            const reliability = String(((item.reliability || {}).overall) || 'unknown');
            const timestamps = item.timestamps && typeof item.timestamps === 'object' ? item.timestamps : {};
            const families = familyList(item);
            const ns = namespaceOf(item);
            const isSelected = selectedCanonicalId && canonical === selectedCanonicalId;
            return '<tr>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-model-picker">' +
                    '<button type="button" class="apro-mini-button apro-discovery-select-button' + (isSelected ? ' is-selected' : '') + '" data-select-model="' + escapeHtml(canonical) + '">' + (isSelected ? 'Selected for APRO' : 'Use in APRO') + '</button>' +
                    '<div class="apro-discovery-select-note">Header controls remain visible during UAT, but this panel now exposes the intended APRO model selection workflow.</div>' +
                '</div></td>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-cell-stack"><div><div class="apro-discovery-model-title">' + escapeHtml(label) + '</div><div class="apro-discovery-code">' + escapeHtml(canonical) + '</div></div>' +
                (families.length ? '<div class="apro-discovery-badges">' + families.map(function (family) { return '<span class="badge">' + escapeHtml(family) + '</span>'; }).join('') + '</div>' : '') +
                (ns ? '<div class="subtle">Namespace: ' + escapeHtml(ns) + '</div>' : '') + '</div></td>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-cell-stack"><div><span class="badge">' + escapeHtml(provider) + '</span></div><div class="subtle">' + (enabled ? 'Enabled' : 'Disabled') + '</div></div></td>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-cell-stack"><div class="apro-discovery-price' + (pricingDisplay(item) === 'Unknown' ? ' is-unknown' : '') + '">' + escapeHtml(pricingDisplay(item)) + '</div><div class="apro-discovery-badges">' + sourceBadge(item, 'pricing', 'Pricing') + '</div></div></td>' +
                '<td><ul class="apro-discovery-kv-list"><li><strong>Input Cutoff:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(limitDisplay(item, 'max_input_tokens')) + '</li><li><strong>Context Window:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(limitDisplay(item, 'max_context_tokens')) + '</li><li><strong>Output Cutoff:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(limitDisplay(item, 'max_output_tokens')) + '</li></ul><div class="apro-discovery-badges">' + sourceBadge(item, 'limits', 'Limits') + '</div></td>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-badges">' + rowCaps(item.capabilities) + '</div></td>' +
                '<td><div class="apro-discovery-cell-stack"><div>' + (providerCreatedAt(item) ? escapeHtml(dateOnly(providerCreatedAt(item)) || providerCreatedAt(item)) : 'Unknown') + '</div><div class="apro-discovery-badges">' + sourceBadge(item, 'provider_created_at', 'Model date') + '</div></div></td>' +
                '<td><span class="badge ' + (availability === 'available' || availability === 'cataloged' ? 'ok' : 'warn') + '">' + escapeHtml(availability) + '</span></td>' +
                '<td><span class="badge ' + (reliability === 'high' ? 'ok' : 'warn') + '">' + escapeHtml(reliability) + '</span>' + reliabilityFieldsHtml(item) + '</td>' +
                '<td><ul class="apro-discovery-kv-list"><li><strong>Collected:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(String(timestamps.collected_at || '—')) + '</li><li><strong>Verified:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(String(timestamps.verified_at || '—')) + '</li><li><strong>Provider Created:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(String(timestamps.provider_created_at || '—')) + '</li></ul></td>' +
                '<td><ul class="apro-discovery-kv-list"><li><strong>Provider:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(String((item.provenance || {}).provider || provider)) + '</li><li><strong>Label source:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(sourceType(item, 'label')) + '</li><li><strong>Limits source:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(sourceType(item, 'limits')) + '</li><li><strong>Capabilities source:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(sourceType(item, 'capabilities')) + '</li><li><strong>Pricing source:</strong> ' + escapeHtml(sourceType(item, 'pricing')) + '</li></ul></td>' +
            '</tr>';
        }).join('');

        Array.prototype.forEach.call(tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-select-model]'), function (button) {
            button.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const canonical = String(button.getAttribute('data-select-model') || '');
                const model = fullCatalog.find(function (item) {
                    return String(item && item.canonical_model_id || '') === canonical;
                });
                if (!model) return;
                setSelectedModel(model);
                if (window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.selectCatalogModelForRuntime === 'function') {
                    try {
                        window.APRO_API.selectCatalogModelForRuntime(model, { source: 'discovery' });
                    } catch (e) {}
                }
                setStatus('Selected APRO model from AI Model Discovery Control: <strong>' + escapeHtml(String(model.label || model.model_id || canonical)) + '</strong>. Header controls remain visible for UAT only.', 'success');
            });
        });
    }

    function renderCatalog(payload) {
        const data = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        fullCatalog = Array.isArray(data.catalog) ? data.catalog : [];
        fullSummary = data.summary && typeof data.summary === 'object' ? data.summary : {};
        metric('aproAiDiscoveryMetricModels', String(fullSummary.model_count != null ? fullSummary.model_count : fullCatalog.length));
        metric('aproAiDiscoveryMetricRun', fullSummary.published_run_id != null ? String(fullSummary.published_run_id) : '—');
        metric('aproAiDiscoveryMetricPublishedAt', fullSummary.published_at ? String(fullSummary.published_at) : 'Not published');
        metric('aproAiDiscoveryMetricStatus', fullSummary.run_status ? String(fullSummary.run_status) : 'unknown');

        const facets = buildFilterFacets(fullCatalog);
        renderProviderToggles(facets.provider);
        renderPricingSourceToggles(facets.pricing_source);
        renderCapabilityToggles(facets.capability);
        renderNewestWithinToggles();
        renderSortByToggles();
        renderSortDirToggles();
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryAvailability', facets.availability, 'All availability');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryReliability', facets.reliability, 'All reliability');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryCapability', facets.capability, 'All capabilities', function (value) { return value.replace(/_/g, ' '); });
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryLabelSource', facets.label_source, 'Any label source');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryLimitsSource', facets.limits_source, 'Any limits source');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryCapabilitiesSource', facets.capabilities_source, 'Any capabilities source');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryNamespace', facets.namespace, 'All namespaces');
        populateSelect('aproAiDiscoveryFamily', facets.family, 'All families');
        syncSelectedFromHeaderIfNeeded();
        
        const pricingEl = byId('aproAiDiscoveryPricingSourceToggles');
        if (pricingEl) {
            const toggles = pricingEl.querySelectorAll('.apro-discovery-source-toggle');
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(toggles, function(t) {
                const val = String(t.getAttribute('data-value') || '').toLowerCase();
                if (val === 'curated_metadata' || val === 'provider_pricing_derived') {
                    t.classList.add('is-active');
                    t.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
                } else {
                    t.classList.remove('is-active');
                    t.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
                }
            });
        }
        const sortEl = byId('aproAiDiscoverySortBy');
        if (sortEl) sortEl.value = 'newest';
        renderSortByToggles();

        applyFilters();
    }

    function renderJob(job) {
        const box = byId('aproAiDiscoveryJobBox');
        if (!box) return;
        if (!job || typeof job !== 'object') {
            box.style.display = 'none';
            box.innerHTML = '';
            return;
        }

        const status = String(job.status || 'unknown');
        box.style.display = '';
        box.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        if (status === 'error') box.classList.add('is-error');
        if (status === 'success' || status === 'partial_success') box.classList.add('is-success');

        box.innerHTML =
            '<strong>Refresh job ' + escapeHtml(String(job.job_id || '')) + '</strong><br>' +
            'Status: ' + escapeHtml(status) +
            (job.started_at ? ' · Started: ' + escapeHtml(String(job.started_at)) : '') +
            (job.completed_at ? ' · Completed: ' + escapeHtml(String(job.completed_at)) : '') +
            (job.error_message ? '<br>Error: ' + escapeHtml(String(job.error_message)) : '');
    }

    async function loadCatalog() {
        if (!panelExists()) return;
        const payload = await apiGet('api/ai_model_discovery.php?action=catalog');
        renderCatalog(payload);
        return payload;
    }

    function stopActivePolling() {
        activePollToken += 1;
        activeJobId = '';
        refreshInFlight = false;
        setRefreshButtonState();
    }

    async function pollJob(jobId) {
        if (!jobId) return;

        stopActivePolling();
        activeJobId = jobId;
        refreshInFlight = true;
        setRefreshButtonState();

        const pollToken = activePollToken;
        let attempts = 0;
        const maxAttempts = 120;
        const intervalMs = 3000;

        async function tick() {
            if (pollToken !== activePollToken) return;
            attempts += 1;

            try {
                const job = await apiGet('api/ai_model_discovery.php?action=job_status&job_id=' + encodeURIComponent(jobId));
                if (pollToken !== activePollToken) return;

                renderJob(job);

                const status = String(job.status || 'unknown');
                if (status === 'queued' || status === 'running') {
                    setStatus('Refresh job is still ' + escapeHtml(status) + '... waiting for completion.', '');

                    if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
                        window.setTimeout(tick, intervalMs);
                    } else {
                        refreshInFlight = false;
                        setRefreshButtonState();
                        setStatus('Refresh job stayed queued/running too long. The backend worker likely failed to complete.', 'error');
                    }
                    return;
                }

                refreshInFlight = false;
                setRefreshButtonState();
                await loadCatalog();

                if (status === 'success' || status === 'partial_success') {
                    setStatus('Refresh completed with status: ' + escapeHtml(status) + '.', 'success');
                } else {
                    setStatus('Refresh finished with status: ' + escapeHtml(status) + '.', 'error');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                if (pollToken !== activePollToken) return;
                refreshInFlight = false;
                setRefreshButtonState();
                setStatus(escapeHtml(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Failed to poll refresh job.'), 'error');
            }
        }

        tick();
    }

    async function refreshCatalog() {
        if (refreshInFlight) {
            setStatus('A shared catalog refresh is already in progress' + (activeJobId ? ' for job ' + escapeHtml(activeJobId) : '') + '.', '');
            return;
        }

        refreshInFlight = true;
        setRefreshButtonState();
        setStatus('Submitting shared AI model discovery refresh request...', '');

        try {
            const result = await apiPost('api/ai_model_discovery.php', {
                action: 'refresh',
                source: 'apro_admin_ui',
                note: 'Manual refresh requested from APRO admin control surface.'
            });

            renderJob(result);
            await loadCatalog();

            const immediateStatus = String((result && result.status) || '');

            if (immediateStatus === 'success' || immediateStatus === 'partial_success') {
                refreshInFlight = false;
                setRefreshButtonState();
                setStatus('Refresh completed immediately with status: ' + escapeHtml(immediateStatus) + '.', 'success');
            } else if (result && result.job_id) {
                setStatus('Refresh job accepted. Polling for completion...', 'success');
                await pollJob(String(result.job_id));
            } else {
                refreshInFlight = false;
                setRefreshButtonState();
                setStatus('Refresh request returned without a job id.', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            refreshInFlight = false;
            setRefreshButtonState();
            setStatus(escapeHtml(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Refresh failed.'), 'error');
        }
    }

    function resetFilters() {
        ['aproAiDiscoveryQ', 'aproAiDiscoveryReliability', 'aproAiDiscoveryPublishedAge', 'aproAiDiscoverySortBy', 'aproAiDiscoverySortDir', 'aproAiDiscoveryInputPriceMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryOutputPriceMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryInputMin', 'aproAiDiscoveryInputMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryContextMin', 'aproAiDiscoveryContextMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryOutputMin', 'aproAiDiscoveryOutputMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryPricingMin', 'aproAiDiscoveryPricingMax', 'aproAiDiscoveryPublishedFrom', 'aproAiDiscoveryPublishedTo', 'aproAiDiscoveryAvailability', 'aproAiDiscoveryCapability', 'aproAiDiscoveryLimits', 'aproAiDiscoveryEnabled', 'aproAiDiscoveryLabelSource', 'aproAiDiscoveryLimitsSource', 'aproAiDiscoveryCapabilitiesSource', 'aproAiDiscoveryNamespace', 'aproAiDiscoveryFamily'].forEach(function (id) {
            const el = byId(id);
            if (!el) return;
            el.value = '';
        });
        activateAllProviderToggles();
        activateAllPricingSourceToggles();
        activateAllCapabilityToggles();
        const sortBy = byId('aproAiDiscoverySortBy');

// analysis.js (Multipurpose Analysis Panel Controller)

window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE || {};

(function () {
    function getPanelsRegistry() { return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS || {}; }

    const MODES = [
        { value: 'fileSystem', label: 'File System Analysis' },
        { value: 'feature', label: 'Feature Analysis' },
        { value: 'implementationPlan', label: 'Implementation Plan' },
        { value: 'filePublishAnalysis', label: 'Publishable Files (AI)' },
        { value: 'archiveManager', label: 'Archived Files (Global)' },
        { value: 'fileArchives', label: 'Archived Files (Selected File)' }
    ];

    let currentMode = 'fileSystem';
    let currentPanel = null;
    let panelContainer = null;
    let dropdown = null;

    function getAvailableModes() {
        return MODES.slice();
    }

    function mountMode(newMode) {
        const registry = getPanelsRegistry();
        currentPanel = registry[newMode] || null;
        if (currentPanel && typeof currentPanel.mount === 'function') {
            currentPanel.mount(panelContainer);
        }
    }

    function switchMode(newMode) {
        if (currentMode === newMode) return;
        if (currentPanel && typeof currentPanel.unmount === 'function') {
            currentPanel.unmount();
        }
        panelContainer.innerHTML = '';
        currentMode = newMode;
        if (dropdown) {
            dropdown.value = newMode;
        }
        mountMode(newMode);
    }

    function init() {
        const analysisPanel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        if (!analysisPanel) {
            return;
        }

        const header = analysisPanel.querySelector('.apro-panel-header');
        const availableModes = getAvailableModes();

        dropdown = document.createElement('select');
        dropdown.className = 'apro-analysis-mode-switch';
        availableModes.forEach(function (mode) {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = mode.value;
            opt.textContent = mode.label;
            dropdown.appendChild(opt);
        });
        dropdown.value = currentMode;
        dropdown.addEventListener('change', function () {
            switchMode(dropdown.value);
        });

        const toolsDiv = header.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) {
            toolsDiv.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', dropdown);
        } else {
            header.appendChild(dropdown);
        }

        panelContainer = document.createElement('div');
        panelContainer.id = 'analysisPanelContainer';

        const children = Array.from(analysisPanel.children);
        children.forEach(function (child) {
            if (!child.classList.contains('apro-panel-header')) {
                analysisPanel.removeChild(child);
            }
        });
        analysisPanel.appendChild(panelContainer);

        if (!availableModes.find(function (mode) { return mode.value === currentMode; })) {
            currentMode = availableModes.length ? availableModes[0].value : 'fileSystem';
        }
        dropdown.value = currentMode;
        mountMode(currentMode);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    function abbreviate(text, maxLength) {
        const value = String(text || '').replaceAll('\r', ' ').replaceAll('\n', ' ').trim();
        return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength) + '...';
    }

    function sleep(ms) {

    }

    function parseBody(text, status, statusText) {

            return text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error('HTTP ' + status + ' ' + statusText + ' - Non-JSON response: ' + (abbreviate(text, 300) || 'Empty response body.'));
        }
    }

    function unwrapApiResponse(data, fallbackMessage) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') { return data; }
        if (data.status === 'success') { return data.data !== undefined ? data.data : data; }
        if (data.status === 'error') { throw new Error(data.message || data.error || fallbackMessage || 'Request failed.'); }
        if (data.success === true || data.ok === true) { return data.data !== undefined ? data.data : data; }
        if (data.success === false || data.ok === false) { throw new Error(data.message || data.error || fallbackMessage || 'Request failed.'); }
        return data;
    }

    function isNetworkError(error) {
        const message = String(error && error.message ? error.message : error).toLowerCase();
        return message.indexOf('failed to fetch') !== -1 || message.indexOf('network') !== -1 || message.indexOf('quic') !== -1 || message.indexOf('load failed') !== -1;
    }

    function jsonHeaders(includeContentType) {
        const headers = {
            Accept: 'application/json',
            'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            'X-APRO-Transport': 'fetch'
        };
        if (includeContentType) { headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; }
        return headers;
    }

    async function fetchJson(url, options) {

        const text = await response.text();
        const data = parseBody(text, response.status, response.statusText);
        if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(data.message || data.error || ('Request failed with HTTP ' + response.status)); }
        return unwrapApiResponse(data, 'Request failed.');
    }

    function xhrPostJson(url, payload) {
        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            try {
                const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.open('POST', url, true);
                xhr.withCredentials = true;
                xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
                xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
                xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', 'XMLHttpRequest');
                xhr.setRequestHeader('X-APRO-Transport', 'xhr-direct');
                xhr.timeout = 0;
                xhr.onload = function () {

            let binary = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) { binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]); }
            return btoa(binary);
        } catch (error) { return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(String(prompt || '')))); }
    }

    function shouldEncodePrompt(url) {
        url = String(url || '');
        return ['submit.php', 'implementation_plan.php', 'feature_analysis.php', 'file_publish_analysis.php', 'publish_analyze.php', 'publish_merge.php'].some(function (name) { return url.indexOf(name) !== -1; });
    }

    function normalizeOutboundPayload(url, payload) {
