            };
            const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyTree(payload);
            return data && data.tree ? data.tree : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    async function collectExtensionDataForFilterModal() {
        const extensionLists = [];

        try {
            const sourceTree = await fetchUnfilteredTreeForCurrentSource();
            const sourceExtensions = collectExtensionsFromTreeRoot(sourceTree);
            if (sourceExtensions.length) extensionLists.push(sourceExtensions);
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
            const activeData = collectExtensionsFromActiveTree();
            if (activeData && Array.isArray(activeData.extensions) && activeData.extensions.length) {
                extensionLists.push(activeData.extensions);
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        const merged = mergeExtensionArrays(extensionLists);
        if (merged.length) {
            return groupExtensionsForModal(merged);
        }

        return null;
    }

    function getDefaultFileTypesFromKnownExtensions(data) {
        if (!data || !data.byGroup || typeof data.byGroup !== 'object') {
            return null;
        }

        const selected = [];
        Object.keys(data.byGroup).forEach(function (group) {
            if (String(group) === 'Unknown') {
                return;
            }
            const values = Array.isArray(data.byGroup[group]) ? data.byGroup[group] : [];
            values.forEach(function (ext) {
                const normalized = normalizeExtensionForFilter(ext);
                if (normalized && selected.indexOf(normalized) === -1) {
                    selected.push(normalized);
                }
            });
        });

        return selected.length ? selected : null;
    }

    function showFileTypeModal(precheckedExts, onApply, onCancel) {
        let modal = document.getElementById('fileTypeModal');
        if (!modal) {
            modal = document.createElement('div');
            modal.id = 'fileTypeModal';
            modal.className = 'apro-modal';
            modal.innerHTML = `
                <div class="apro-modal-backdrop"></div>
                <div class="apro-modal-content" style="max-width:480px">
                    <div class="apro-modal-header">
                        <h3>Filter File Types</h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="apro-modal-body" id="fileTypeModalBody">
                        Loading file types...
                    </div>
                    <div class="apro-modal-footer">
                        <button type="button" id="fileTypeModalApplyButton" class="apro-primary-button">Apply</button>
                        <button type="button" id="fileTypeModalCancelButton" class="apro-secondary-button">Cancel</button>
                        <button type="button" id="fileTypeModalSelectAllButton" class="apro-mini-button">Select All</button>
                        <button type="button" id="fileTypeModalClearButton" class="apro-mini-button">Clear All</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            document.body.appendChild(modal);
        }
        modal.style.display = 'flex';

        function populateModal(extData) {
            const serverGrouping = extData;
            const explicitPrechecked = Array.isArray(precheckedExts);
            const checked = new Set(explicitPrechecked ? precheckedExts : []);
            const body = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalBody');
            body.innerHTML = '';

            const allGroups = Object.keys(serverGrouping.byGroup || {});
            const unknownIdx = allGroups.indexOf('Unknown');
            let orderedGroups = allGroups.slice();
            if (unknownIdx !== -1) {
                orderedGroups.splice(unknownIdx, 1);
                orderedGroups.push('Unknown');
            }

            if (!orderedGroups.length) {
                body.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">No file extensions were found for the current tree source.</div>';
                return;
            }

            for (const group of orderedGroups) {
                const groupBox = document.createElement('div');
                groupBox.className = 'file-type-group';
                if (group === 'Unknown') groupBox.classList.add('file-type-group-unknown');

                const label = document.createElement('div');
                label.textContent = group;
                label.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                label.style.marginBottom = '2px';
                label.className = 'file-type-group-label';
                groupBox.appendChild(label);

                const groupToggleContainer = document.createElement('div');
                groupToggleContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                groupToggleContainer.style.alignItems = 'center';
                groupToggleContainer.style.gap = '8px';
                groupToggleContainer.style.marginBottom = '4px';

                const groupToggle = document.createElement('button');
                groupToggle.type = 'button';
                groupToggle.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                groupToggle.style.fontSize = '12px';
                groupToggle.title = 'Toggle all file types in "' + group + '" on/off';
                groupToggle.style.padding = '4px 8px';
                groupToggle.style.lineHeight = '1.3';

                groupToggleContainer.appendChild(groupToggle);
                groupBox.appendChild(groupToggleContainer);

                const extList = document.createElement('div');
                extList.className = 'file-type-group-extlist';

                let groupCheckboxes = [];
                for (const extRaw of serverGrouping.byGroup[group]) {
                    const isNoExtension = extRaw === '' || extRaw === '(no extension)';
                    const ext = isNoExtension ? '(no extension)' : extRaw;
                    const value = isNoExtension ? '' : normalizeExtensionForFilter(extRaw);
                    const id = 'ftype_' + group + '_' + String(ext).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
                    const chk = document.createElement('input');
                    chk.type = 'checkbox';
                    chk.id = id;
                    chk.value = value;
                    const defaultChecked = group === 'Unknown' ? false : true;
                    chk.checked = explicitPrechecked ? checked.has(value) : defaultChecked;
                    chk.className = 'file-type-checkbox';
                    chk.style.position = 'absolute';
                    chk.style.opacity = 0;
                    chk.style.width = '1px';
                    chk.style.height = '1px';

                    const lab = document.createElement('label');
                    lab.htmlFor = id;
                    lab.className = 'file-type-pill';
                    if (group === 'Unknown') lab.classList.add('file-type-pill-unknown');
                    lab.textContent = ext;

                    chk.addEventListener('change', function () {
                        lab.classList.toggle('file-type-pill-checked', chk.checked);
                        updateGroupToggleText();
                    });

                    if (chk.checked) lab.classList.add('file-type-pill-checked');

                    lab.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                        chk.checked = !chk.checked;
                        lab.classList.toggle('file-type-pill-checked', chk.checked);
                        chk.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                        e.preventDefault();
                    });

                    const containerSpan = document.createElement('span');
                    containerSpan.className = 'file-type-pill-container';
                    containerSpan.appendChild(chk);
                    containerSpan.appendChild(lab);

                    extList.appendChild(containerSpan);
                    groupCheckboxes.push(chk);
                }
                groupBox.appendChild(extList);
                body.appendChild(groupBox);

                function updateGroupToggleText() {
                    const allChecked = groupCheckboxes.length > 0 && groupCheckboxes.every(function (c) { return c.checked; });
                    groupToggle.textContent = allChecked ? 'Clear All in group' : 'Select All in group';
                }

                groupToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    const allChecked = groupCheckboxes.length > 0 && groupCheckboxes.every(function (c) { return c.checked; });
                    groupCheckboxes.forEach(function (c) {
                        c.checked = !allChecked;
                        c.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                    });
                    updateGroupToggleText();
                });

                groupCheckboxes.forEach(function (c) {
                    c.addEventListener('change', updateGroupToggleText);
                });
                updateGroupToggleText();
            }
        }

        async function fetchAndRender() {
            const body = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalBody');
            if (body) {
                body.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Scanning file extensions from the current tree source...</div>';
            }

            try {
                const dynamicData = await collectExtensionDataForFilterModal();
                if (dynamicData) {
                    populateModal(dynamicData);
                    return;
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            if (knownExtensions) {
                populateModal(knownExtensions);
            } else {
                window.APRO_API.getJson('api/file_types.php')
                    .then(function (data) {
                        knownExtensions = data;
                        populateModal(data);
                    })
                    .catch(function (err) {
                        modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalBody').innerHTML = '<div class="apro-status is-error">Failed to load file types.<br>' + (err.message || 'Unknown error') + '</div>';
                    });
            }
        }
        fetchAndRender();

        const applyBtn = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalApplyButton');
        const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalCancelButton');
        const selectAllBtn = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalSelectAllButton');
        const clearBtn = modal.querySelector('#fileTypeModalClearButton');

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            applyBtn.removeEventListener('click', applyHandler);
            cancelBtn.removeEventListener('click', cancelHandler);
            selectAllBtn.removeEventListener('click', selectAllHandler);
            clearBtn.removeEventListener('click', clearAllHandler);
        }

        function getSelectedExtensions() {
            const inputs = modal.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]');
            return Array.from(inputs).filter(function (inp) { return inp.checked; }).map(function (inp) { return inp.value; });
        }

        function applyHandler() {
            const selected = getSelectedExtensions();
            if (selected.length === 0) {
                if (!confirm('No file types selected. Show all files?')) return;
            }
            cleanup();
            onApply(selected.length === 0 ? null : selected);
        }

        function cancelHandler() {
            cleanup();
            if (onCancel) onCancel();
        }

        function selectAllHandler() {
            const inputs = modal.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]');
            inputs.forEach(function (i) {
                i.checked = true;
                i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            });
        }

        function clearAllHandler() {
            const inputs = modal.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]');
            inputs.forEach(function (i) {
                i.checked = false;
                i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            });
        }

        applyBtn.addEventListener('click', applyHandler);
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', cancelHandler);
        selectAllBtn.addEventListener('click', selectAllHandler);
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', clearAllHandler);
    }

    async function loadTree(fileTypes) {
        const argProvided = (arguments.length > 0);
        let ftToUse = argProvided ? fileTypes : currentFileTypes;
        if (typeof ftToUse === 'undefined') {
            if (knownExtensions && knownExtensions.byGroup && knownExtensions.byGroup.Coding) {
                ftToUse = knownExtensions.byGroup.Coding;
            } else {
                ftToUse = null;
            }
        }

        currentFileTypes = Array.isArray(ftToUse) && ftToUse.length ? ftToUse.slice() : null;

        const treeContainer = document.getElementById('treeContainer');
        treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Loading file tree...</div>';
        window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Loading file tree...', '');

        try {
            if (treeSource === 'remote') {
                if (window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE && typeof window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE.load === 'function') {
                    await window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE.load({
                        allowedExtensions: (Array.isArray(ftToUse) && ftToUse.length ? ftToUse.slice() : null)
                    });
                    const metaEl = document.getElementById('treeMeta');
                    if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing Remote server files.';
                    window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
                    window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Remote file tree loaded.', 'success');
                    updateActionButtonsForTreeSource();
                    return;
                }
                throw new Error('Remote server tools are not available.');
            }

            if (treeSource === 'godaddy') {
                if (window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.load === 'function') {
                    await window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.load({
                        allowedExtensions: (Array.isArray(ftToUse) && ftToUse.length ? ftToUse.slice() : null)
                    });
                    const metaEl = document.getElementById('treeMeta');
                    if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing GoDaddy shared hosting files.';
                    window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
                    window.APRO_UI.setStatus('GoDaddy file tree loaded.', 'success');
                    updateActionButtonsForTreeSource();
                    return;
                }
                throw new Error('GoDaddy tree tools are not available.');
            }

            let data;
            if (treeSource === 'server') {
                let method = 'GET';
                let payload = undefined;
                let url = (window.APRO_BOOTSTRAP && window.APRO_BOOTSTRAP.treeEndpoint) || 'api/tree.php';
                if (Array.isArray(ftToUse) && ftToUse.length > 0) {
                    method = 'POST';
                    payload = { file_types: ftToUse };
                }
                data = (method === 'GET')
                    ? await window.APRO_API.getJson(url)
                    : await window.APRO_API.postJson(url, payload);
            } else {
                const url = (window.APRO_BOOTSTRAP && window.APRO_BOOTSTRAP.githubTreeEndpoint) || 'api/github_tree.php';
                const payload = {
                    owner: ghOwner, repo: ghRepo, branch: ghBranch
                };
                if (Array.isArray(ftToUse) && ftToUse.length > 0) {
                    payload.file_types = ftToUse;
                }
                if (!payload.owner || !payload.repo || !payload.branch) {
                    treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Enter GitHub owner/repo/branch, then click Load.</div>';
                    window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Enter GitHub repository details.', 'error');
                    updateActionButtonsForTreeSource();
                    const metaEl = document.getElementById('treeMeta');
                    if (metaEl) {
                        metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing GitHub: enter owner/repo/branch and click "Load Repo".';
                    }
                    return;
                }
                data = await window.APRO_API.postJson(url, payload);
            }

            treeController = window.APRO_TREE.createTreeController(
                treeContainer,
                data.tree,
                selectedPaths,
                expandedPaths,
                function () {
                    window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
                }
            );

            const metaEl = document.getElementById('treeMeta');
            if (metaEl) {
                if (treeSource === 'server') {
                    metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing local server files.';
                } else if (treeSource === 'github') {
                    metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing GitHub: ' + (ghOwner || '[owner]') + '/' + (ghRepo || '[repo]') + ' @ ' + (ghBranch || 'main') + ' — selections will be fetched from GitHub for requests.';
                }
            }

            window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('File tree loaded successfully.', 'success');

            if (treeSource === 'github' && data && data.meta && data.meta.truncated) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Note: GitHub returned a truncated tree due to repo size. Results may be partial.', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Failed to load file tree.</div>';
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(error.message || 'Failed to load file tree.', 'error');
        }

        updateActionButtonsForTreeSource();
    }

    function findNodeByPath(root, path) {
        if (!root || !path) return null;
        if (root.path === path) return root;
        if (!Array.isArray(root.children)) return null;
        for (const c of root.children) {
            const found = findNodeByPath(c, path);
            if (found) return found;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function collectFilesUnderNode(node, out) {
        if (!node) return;
        if (node.type === 'file') {
            out.push(node.path);
            return;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(node.children)) {
            for (const c of node.children) {
                collectFilesUnderNode(c, out);
            }
        }
    }

    function expandSelectionToVisibleFiles(selectedPathsArray) {
        const treeRoot = window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE._getActiveTreeRoot === 'function'
            ? window.APRO_TREE._getActiveTreeRoot()
            : null;

        if (!treeRoot) {
            return (Array.isArray(selectedPathsArray) ? selectedPathsArray.slice() : []).filter(function (p) {
                return typeof p === 'string' && p !== '';
            });
        }

        const resolved = new Set();
        for (const sel of (selectedPathsArray || [])) {
            if (typeof sel !== 'string' || sel === '') continue;
            const node = findNodeByPath(treeRoot, sel);
            if (!node) continue;
            if (node.type === 'file') {
                resolved.add(node.path);
            } else if (node.type === 'directory') {
                const files = [];
                collectFilesUnderNode(node, files);
                for (const f of files) resolved.add(f);
            }
        }

        return Array.from(resolved).sort();
    }

    if (!window.APRO_UI) window.APRO_UI = window.APRO_UI || {};
    window.APRO_UI.expandSelectedToVisibleFiles = expandSelectionToVisibleFiles;

    function showPayloadModal(payloadJson, onSend, onCancel) {
        const modal = document.getElementById('payloadModal');
        const textarea = document.getElementById('payloadEditor');
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        textarea.value = payloadJson;

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            sendBtn.removeEventListener('click', onSendHandler);
            cancelBtn.removeEventListener('click', onCancelHandler);
            exportBtn.removeEventListener('click', onExportHandler);
            exportBtn.disabled = false;
        }

        function onSendHandler() {
            let editedPayload = textarea.value;
            try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(editedPayload);
                cleanup();
                onSend(parsed);
            } catch (e) {
                alert('Invalid JSON: ' + e.message);
            }
        }

        function onCancelHandler() {
            cleanup();
            if (onCancel) onCancel();
        }

        async function onExportHandler() {
            try {
                exportBtn.disabled = true;
                exportBtn.textContent = 'Exporting...';
                const payload = JSON.parse(textarea.value);
                const previewData = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/preview_payload.php', payload);
                const promptText = previewData.user_prompt_text || '';
                if (!promptText) {
                    throw new Error('Failed to assemble prompt.');
                }
                const blob = new Blob([promptText], { type: 'text/plain' });
                const filename = makeExportFilename(payload);
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = url;
                a.download = filename;
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                a.click();
                setTimeout(function () {
                    document.body.removeChild(a);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                }, 200);
                exportBtn.textContent = 'Export as Text';
                exportBtn.disabled = false;
            } catch (err) {
                exportBtn.textContent = 'Export as Text';
                exportBtn.disabled = false;
                alert('Export failed: ' + err.message);
            }
        }

        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('payloadModalSendButton');
        const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('payloadModalCancelButton');
        let exportBtn = document.getElementById('payloadModalExportButton');
        if (!exportBtn) {
            exportBtn = document.createElement('button');
            exportBtn.type = 'button';
            exportBtn.id = 'payloadModalExportButton';
            exportBtn.className = 'apro-secondary-button';
            exportBtn.textContent = 'Export as Text';
            const footer = document.querySelector('.apro-modal-footer');
            footer.insertBefore(exportBtn, footer.firstChild);
        } else {
            exportBtn.style.display = '';
        }

        sendBtn.addEventListener('click', onSendHandler);
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', onCancelHandler);
        exportBtn.addEventListener('click', onExportHandler);
    }

    async function sendAiRequestWithPayload(payload) {
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendRequestButton');
        sendButton.disabled = true;
        window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Sending AI request...', '');
        window.APRO_UI.setResponse('Waiting for AI response...');

        try {
            const data = await window.APRO_API.postJson(bootstrap.submitEndpoint, payload);
            window.APRO_UI.setResponse(data.response_text || '');
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('AI request completed successfully.', 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            window.APRO_UI.setResponse('Request failed.');
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(error.message || 'AI request failed.', 'error');
        } finally {
            sendButton.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    function promptAndSubmitRequest() {
        const payload = window.APRO_UI.getFormPayload(selectedPaths);
        const filesOnly = (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function')
            ? window.APRO_TREE.getCheckedFilePaths()
            : [];
        payload.selected_paths = filesOnly;

        if (treeSource === 'github') {
            const gh = readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage();
            if (gh) {
                payload.github = {
                    owner: gh.owner,
                    repo: gh.repo,
                    branch: gh.branch
                };
            }
        }

        if (treeSource === 'remote') {
            const remote = readRemoteConfig();
            if (!remote) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Remote Server is not configured. Save a valid Server URL and API Key first.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            payload.remote = remote;
        }

        if (treeSource === 'godaddy') {
            const godaddy = readGoDaddyConfig();
            if (!godaddy) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('GoDaddy account is not configured. Select or add an account first.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            payload.godaddy = godaddy;
        }

        const prettyJson = JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
        showPayloadModal(
            prettyJson,
            function (editedPayloadObj) {
                sendAiRequestWithPayload(editedPayloadObj);
            },
            function () {}
        );
    }

    function clearSelection() {
        selectedPaths.clear();
        window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
        if (treeController) treeController.render();
    }

    function copyResponse() {
        const text = document.getElementById('responseOutput').textContent || '';
        if (!navigator.clipboard) {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Clipboard API is not available in this browser.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Response copied to clipboard.', 'success');
        }).catch(function () {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Failed to copy response.', 'error');
        });
    }

    function clearResponse() {
        window.APRO_UI.setResponse('No response yet.');
        window.APRO_UI.setStatus('', '');
    }

    function addFileTypeModalButton() {
        const headerTools = document.querySelector('.apro-panel-tree .apro-panel-tools');
        if (!headerTools || document.getElementById('fileTypeModalButton')) return;
        fileTypeModalButton = document.createElement('button');
        fileTypeModalButton.type = 'button';
        fileTypeModalButton.id = 'fileTypeModalButton';
        fileTypeModalButton.className = 'apro-mini-button';
        fileTypeModalButton.textContent = 'Filter File Types';
        headerTools.appendChild(fileTypeModalButton);

        fileTypeModalButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
            showFileTypeModal(currentFileTypes, function (newTypes) {
                currentFileTypes = newTypes && newTypes.length ? newTypes : null;
                loadTree(currentFileTypes);

        });
    }

        const loadBtn = document.createElement('button');
        loadBtn.type = 'button';
        loadBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
        loadBtn.textContent = 'Load Repo';
        loadBtn.onclick = function () {

            localStorage.setItem('apro_gh_owner', ghOwner);

(() => {
  const ARCHIVE_SUFFIX = /\.\d+\.archive$/i;

  const getApp = () => window.APRO_APP || (window.APRO_APP = {});

  const toast = (message, type = 'info') => {
    const app = getApp();
    if (typeof app.toast === 'function') {
      app.toast(message, type);
    } else if (typeof app.notify === 'function') {
      app.notify(message, type);
    } else {
      console[type === 'error' ? 'error' : 'log'](message);
    }
  };

  const setBusy = (state) => {
    const app = getApp();
    if (typeof app.setBusy === 'function') {
      app.setBusy(state);
    } else if (state) {
      document.body.classList.add('apro-busy');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('apro-busy');
    }
  };

  const reloadTree = () => {
    const app = getApp();
    if (typeof app.reloadTree === 'function') {
      app.reloadTree();
    } else if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof APRO_TREE.reload === 'function') {
      APRO_TREE.reload();
    }
  };

  const archiveFile = async (path) => {
    if (!path) {
      toast('No file path provided.', 'error');
      return;
    }

    if (ARCHIVE_SUFFIX.test(path)) {
      toast('Archiving is not allowed for .archive files.', 'error');
      return;
    }

    if (!window.APRO_API || typeof APRO_API.archiveFile !== 'function') {
      toast('Archive API is unavailable.', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await APRO_API.archiveFile(path);
      toast('File archived successfully.', 'success');
      reloadTree();
    } catch (error) {
      toast(error?.message || 'Failed to archive file.', 'error');
      throw error;
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  window.APRO_ARCHIVE_MANAGER = { archiveFile };
})();

    function escapeHtml(text) {

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.formatBytes === 'function') {

        const value = Number(bytes || 0);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '0 B';
        if (value < 1024) return Math.round(value) + ' B';
        const units = ['KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
        let size = value;
        let unitIndex = -1;
        do { size /= 1024; unitIndex += 1; } while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1);
        const decimals = size >= 100 ? 0 : (size >= 10 ? 1 : 2);

    function getFilteredArchives(state) {

        return (state.archives || []).filter(function (archive) {
            if (!state.filters.includeOrphans && !archive.live_exists) return false;
            if (!query) return true;

        let html = '';

            selectAllEl.addEventListener('change', function () {

    function buildRemoteScanMessage(count, scanMeta) {
        let message = 'Loaded <b>' + escapeHtml(String(count)) + '</b> archive file(s) from Remote.';
        if (!scanMeta || typeof scanMeta !== 'object') return message;
        const metaParts = [];
        if (scanMeta.allowed_root) metaParts.push('Allowed root: <code>' + escapeHtml(scanMeta.allowed_root) + '</code>');
        if (Array.isArray(scanMeta.scan_roots)) {
            metaParts.push('Scanned roots: ' + scanMeta.scan_roots.map(function (p) { return '<code>' + escapeHtml(p) + '</code>'; }).join(', '));
        }
        if (scanMeta.directories_scanned !== undefined) metaParts.push('Directories scanned: <b>' + escapeHtml(String(scanMeta.directories_scanned)) + '</b>');
        if (scanMeta.archives_found !== undefined) metaParts.push('Agent archives found: <b>' + escapeHtml(String(scanMeta.archives_found)) + '</b>');
        if (scanMeta.elapsed_seconds !== undefined) metaParts.push('Elapsed seconds: <b>' + escapeHtml(String(scanMeta.elapsed_seconds)) + '</b>');
        if (scanMeta.truncated) metaParts.push('<span style="color:#fdba74;">Remote archive scan was truncated before all paths were checked.</span>');
        if (Array.isArray(scanMeta.errors) && scanMeta.errors.length) {
            metaParts.push('<span style="color:#fdba74;">Some directories could not be scanned. Error count shown: ' + escapeHtml(String(scanMeta.errors.length)) + '.</span>');
        }
        if (count === 0 && (scanMeta.truncated || (Array.isArray(scanMeta.errors) && scanMeta.errors.length))) {
            metaParts.push('<span style="color:#fdba74;">Remote returned zero archives, but scan metadata indicates the scan may be incomplete.</span>');
        }
        if (metaParts.length) message += '<br>' + metaParts.join('<br>');
        return message;

    async function fetchArchives(container) {

            if (treeSource === 'godaddy') {

                return;

                    setStatus(container, 'Remote Server is not configured. Use Server Connect to save a valid Server URL and API Key.', 'error');
                    return;

                const data = await window.APRO_API.serverArchives({ action: 'list_all', server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: cfg.insecure });
                if (data && data.unsupported) {
                    state.archives = [];
                    state.scanMeta = null;
                    state.loading = false;
                    state.selectedArchivePaths = {};
                    state.selectedDetailArchivePath = '';
                    state.detailArchiveData = null;
                    state.detailCurrentData = null;
                    renderSummary(container);
                    renderTable(container);
                    setStatus(container, 'Remote agent does not support archive listing. Switch Source to Local or update the agent.', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                state.archives = Array.isArray(data.archives) ? data.archives : [];
                state.scanMeta = data && data.scan_meta ? data.scan_meta : null;
                state.loading = false;
                state.selectedArchivePaths = {};
                state.selectedDetailArchivePath = '';
                state.detailArchiveData = null;
                state.detailCurrentData = null;
                renderSummary(container);
                renderTable(container);
                const scanMeta = state.scanMeta;
                const incomplete = !!(scanMeta && (scanMeta.truncated || (Array.isArray(scanMeta.errors) && scanMeta.errors.length)));
                setStatus(container, buildRemoteScanMessage(state.archives.length, scanMeta), (state.archives.length > 0 || !incomplete) ? 'success' : 'error');
                return;
            }

            const endpoint = getEndpoint() + '?action=list_all';
            const data = await window.APRO_API.getJson(endpoint);
            state.archives = Array.isArray(data.archives) ? data.archives : [];
            state.scanMeta = null;
            state.loading = false;
            state.selectedArchivePaths = {};

            state.detailArchiveData = null;

        } catch (error) {

            setStatus(container, escapeHtml(String(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Failed to scan archives.')), 'error');

    function getArchiveByPath(archivePath) {
        const state = getState();
        for (let i = 0; i < state.archives.length; i += 1) {
            if (state.archives[i].archive_path === archivePath) return state.archives[i];
        }
        return null;
    }

    async function openDetailModal(container, archivePath, compareToCurrent) {
        const state = getState();
        const archive = getArchiveByPath(archivePath);
        if (!archive) {
            setStatus(container, 'Archive not found in current result set: ' + escapeHtml(archivePath), 'error');
            return;
        }

        let modal = document.getElementById('archiveManagerReviewModal');
        if (!modal) {
            modal = document.createElement('div');
            modal.id = 'archiveManagerReviewModal';
            modal.className = 'apro-modal';
            modal.innerHTML = [
                '<div class="apro-modal-backdrop"></div>',
                '<div class="apro-modal-content" style="max-width:1180px; width:96vw;">',
                '<div class="apro-modal-header"><h3 id="archiveManagerReviewTitle">Archive Review</h3></div>',
                '<div class="apro-modal-body"><div id="archiveManagerReviewBody"></div></div>',
                '<div class="apro-modal-footer" id="archiveManagerReviewFooter"></div>',
                '</div>'
            ].join('');
            document.body.appendChild(modal);
        }

        const titleEl = modal.querySelector('#archiveManagerReviewTitle');
        const bodyEl = modal.querySelector('#archiveManagerReviewBody');
        const footerEl = modal.querySelector('#archiveManagerReviewFooter');
        titleEl.textContent = compareToCurrent ? 'Compare Archive to Current File' : 'View Archive';
        bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Loading archive detail...</div>';
        footerEl.innerHTML = '';
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        const closeModal = function () { modal.style.display = 'none'; };

        const restoreBtn = document.createElement('button');
        restoreBtn.type = 'button';
        restoreBtn.className = 'apro-primary-button';
        restoreBtn.textContent = 'Restore This Archive';
        restoreBtn.onclick = async function () { await restoreArchive(container, archive.archive_path); closeModal(); };
        footerEl.appendChild(restoreBtn);
        const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
        closeBtn.type = 'button';
        closeBtn.className = 'apro-secondary-button';
        closeBtn.textContent = 'Close';
        closeBtn.onclick = closeModal;
        footerEl.appendChild(closeBtn);

        try {
            state.detailLoading = true;
            const effectiveSource = resolveEffectiveSource(state.sourceMode);
            let archiveData = null;
            let currentData = null;
            if (effectiveSource === 'remote') {
                const cfg = getRemoteConfig();
                if (!cfg) throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured.');
                const result = await window.APRO_API.serverArchives({ action: 'get_archive', server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: cfg.insecure, path: archive.archive_path });
                if (result && result.unsupported) throw new Error('Remote agent does not support archive detail APIs.');
                archiveData = result;
                if (compareToCurrent && archive.live_exists) {
                    currentData = await window.APRO_API.serverFileView({ server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: cfg.insecure, path: archive.live_path, allow_missing: false });
                }
            } else {
                archiveData = await window.APRO_API.getJson(getEndpoint() + '?action=get_archive&path=' + encodeURIComponent(archive.archive_path));
                if (compareToCurrent && archive.live_exists) {
                    currentData = await window.APRO_API.getJson(getEndpoint() + '?action=get_current&path=' + encodeURIComponent(archive.live_path));
                }
            }
            state.detailLoading = false;
            state.selectedDetailArchivePath = archive.archive_path;
            state.detailArchiveData = archiveData;
            state.detailCurrentData = currentData;
            if (compareToCurrent && currentData) {
                bodyEl.innerHTML = [
                    '<div class="apro-archive-modal-warning">Restoring this archive will archive the current live file first, making the restore reversible.</div>',
                    '<div class="apro-archive-review-grid">',
                    '<div class="apro-archive-review-pane"><div class="apro-archive-review-pane-title">Current Live File</div><pre class="apro-archive-review-pre">' + escapeHtml(currentData.content || '') + '</pre><div class="apro-archive-review-meta">Path: <code>' + escapeHtml(currentData.path || archive.live_path) + '</code><br>Size: ' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(currentData.size_bytes)) + ' (' + escapeHtml(String(currentData.size_bytes || 0)) + ' bytes), Lines: ' + escapeHtml(String(currentData.line_count || 0)) + '</div></div>',
                    '<div class="apro-archive-review-pane"><div class="apro-archive-review-pane-title">Archive Version ' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.version || archive.version || '')) + '</div><pre class="apro-archive-review-pre archive">' + escapeHtml(archiveData.content || '') + '</pre><div class="apro-archive-review-meta">Path: <code>' + escapeHtml(archiveData.archive_path || archive.archive_path) + '</code><br>Size: ' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(archiveData.size_bytes)) + ' (' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.size_bytes || 0)) + ' bytes), Lines: ' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.line_count || 0)) + ', Modified: ' + escapeHtml(formatTimestamp(archiveData.modified_time)) + '</div></div>',
                    '</div>'
                ].join('');
            } else {
                const note = archive.live_exists ? '' : '<div class="apro-archive-modal-warning">The current live file is missing. You can still review and restore this archive.</div>';
                bodyEl.innerHTML = [
                    note,
                    '<div class="apro-archive-review-pane-title">Archive Version ' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.version || archive.version || '')) + '</div>',
                    '<pre class="apro-archive-review-pre archive">' + escapeHtml(archiveData.content || '') + '</pre>',
                    '<div class="apro-archive-review-meta">Archive path: <code>' + escapeHtml(archiveData.archive_path || archive.archive_path) + '</code><br>Live path: <code>' + escapeHtml(archiveData.live_path || archive.live_path) + '</code><br>Size: ' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(archiveData.size_bytes)) + ' (' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.size_bytes || 0)) + ' bytes), Lines: ' + escapeHtml(String(archiveData.line_count || 0)) + ', Modified: ' + escapeHtml(formatTimestamp(archiveData.modified_time)) + '</div>'
                ].join('');
            }
        } catch (error) {

            bodyEl.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-status is-error">Failed to load archive detail.<br>' + escapeHtml(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Unknown error') + '</div>';
        }

    async function restoreArchive(container, archivePath) {
        const state = getState();
        const archive = getArchiveByPath(archivePath);
        if (!archive) {
            setStatus(container, 'Archive not found in current result set: ' + escapeHtml(archivePath), 'error');
            return;
        }
        const confirmed = window.confirm('Restore archive version ' + archive.version + ' for ' + archive.live_path + '?\n\nThe current live file will be archived first so the restore is reversible.');
        if (!confirmed) return;
        setStatus(container, 'Restoring archive <code>' + escapeHtml(archive.archive_path) + '</code> ...', '');
        try {
            const effectiveSource = resolveEffectiveSource(state.sourceMode);
            let result = null;
            if (effectiveSource === 'remote') {
                const cfg = getRemoteConfig();
                if (!cfg) throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured.');
                const resp = await window.APRO_API.serverArchives({ action: 'restore', server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: cfg.insecure, archive_path: archive.archive_path });
                if (resp && resp.unsupported) throw new Error('Remote agent does not support archive restore APIs.');
                result = resp;
            } else {
                result = await window.APRO_API.postJson(getEndpoint(), { action: 'restore', archive_path: archive.archive_path });
            }
            if (window.APRO_APP && typeof window.APRO_APP.reloadTree === 'function') await window.APRO_APP.reloadTree();
            await fetchArchives(container);
            const parts = ['Restored <code>' + escapeHtml(result.restored_live_path || archive.live_path) + '</code> from <code>' + escapeHtml(result.source_archive_path || archive.archive_path) + '</code>.'];
            if (result.backup_archive_path) parts.push('Previous live file archived as <code>' + escapeHtml(result.backup_archive_path) + '</code>.');
            if (result.restored_permissions) parts.push('Permissions restored to <code>' + escapeHtml(result.restored_permissions) + '</code>.');
            setStatus(container, parts.join('<br>'), 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            setStatus(container, escapeHtml(String(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Restore failed.')), 'error');
        }
    }

    async function rehomeSelected(container) {
        const state = getState();
        const selected = getSelectedArchivePaths(state);
        if (!selected.length) { setStatus(container, 'Select at least one archive row first.', 'error'); return; }
        if (resolveEffectiveSource(state.sourceMode) === 'remote') { setStatus(container, 'Rehome is not available for Remote archives in this version.', 'error'); return; }
        if (getTreeSource() === 'godaddy') { setStatus(container, 'Rehome is not available for GoDaddy archives in this iteration.', 'error'); return; }
        const targetDir = window.prompt('Enter the destination directory for the selected archives.\n\nUse a full scan-root-relative path such as /public_html/admin/apro/_archive_rehome');
        if (targetDir === null) return;
        if (!String(targetDir).trim()) { setStatus(container, 'Destination directory is required for rehome.', 'error'); return; }
        setStatus(container, 'Rehoming ' + escapeHtml(String(selected.length)) + ' archive(s)...', '');
        try {
            const result = await window.APRO_API.postJson(getEndpoint(), { action: 'rehome', archive_paths: selected, target_dir: String(targetDir).trim() });
            await fetchArchives(container);
            const moved = Array.isArray(result.moved) ? result.moved : [];
            const skipped = Array.isArray(result.skipped) ? result.skipped : [];
            const errors = Array.isArray(result.errors) ? result.errors : [];
            const lines = [];
            if (moved.length) lines.push('Moved ' + escapeHtml(String(moved.length)) + ' archive(s) to <code>' + escapeHtml(result.target_dir || String(targetDir).trim()) + '</code>.');
            if (skipped.length) lines.push('Skipped: ' + skipped.map(function (item) { return '<code>' + escapeHtml(item.archive_path || '') + '</code> (' + escapeHtml(item.reason || 'skipped') + ')'; }).join(', '));
            if (errors.length) lines.push('Errors: ' + errors.map(function (item) { return '<code>' + escapeHtml(item.archive_path || '') + '</code> (' + escapeHtml(item.message || 'error') + ')'; }).join(', '));
            setStatus(container, lines.join('<br>') || 'Rehome completed.', 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            setStatus(container, escapeHtml(String(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Rehome failed.')), 'error');
        }
    }

    async function zipSelected(container) {
        const state = getState();
        const selected = getSelectedArchivePaths(state);
        if (!selected.length) { setStatus(container, 'Select at least one archive row first.', 'error'); return; }
        if (resolveEffectiveSource(state.sourceMode) === 'remote') { setStatus(container, 'ZIP is not available for Remote archives in this version.', 'error'); return; }
        if (getTreeSource() === 'godaddy') { setStatus(container, 'ZIP export is not available for GoDaddy archives in this iteration.', 'error'); return; }
        const defaultName = 'archive_bundle_' + Date.now() + '.zip';

        if (zipPath === null) return;
        if (!String(zipPath).trim()) { setStatus(container, 'ZIP output path is required.', 'error'); return; }
        setStatus(container, 'Creating archive for ' + escapeHtml(String(selected.length)) + ' selected archive(s)...', '');
        try {
            const result = await window.APRO_API.postJson(getEndpoint(), { action: 'zip_selected', archive_paths: selected, zip_path: String(zipPath).trim() });

            if (result.size_bytes !== undefined) lines.push('Archive size: <b>' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(result.size_bytes)) + '</b>.');
            setStatus(container, lines.join('<br>'), 'success');

        }
    }

    async function rehomeAndZipSelected(container) {

            const note = /\.tar\.gz$/i.test(pathStr) ? ' (tar.gz fallback used)' : '';

            if (Array.isArray(result.moved)) lines.push('Moved ' + escapeHtml(String(result.moved.length)) + ' archive(s).');

            if (typeof result.size_bytes !== 'undefined') lines.push('Archive size: <b>' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(result.size_bytes)) + '</b>.');
            if (result.deleted_dir) lines.push('Temporary folder removed after successful archive.');
            setStatus(container, lines.join('<br>'), 'success');
        } catch (error) {
            setStatus(container, escapeHtml(String(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Rehome + archive failed.')), 'error');
        }

// featureAnalysis.js

(function () {
    const STATE_KEY = 'feature';

    function getState() {
        if (!window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY]) {
            window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY] = {
                features: [],
                lastAiRaw: '',
                running: false,
                lastMode: 'prompt',
                lastPrompt: '',
                lastPaths: [],
                aiError: '',
            };
        }
        return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
    }

    function mount(container) {
        const state = getState();
        // Panel header tools: copy, re-analyze
        const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) {
            toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
            const copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
            copyBtn.type = 'button';
            copyBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            copyBtn.textContent = 'Copy Feature List';
            copyBtn.disabled = !state.features.length;
            copyBtn.onclick = () => copyFeaturesToClipboard();
            toolsDiv.appendChild(copyBtn);
        }
        // Main controls
        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="analysis-meta">
                Extracts and lists features of your software project via prompt, code, or both. 
                Choose analysis method and run feature extraction as needed. Click "Revise" on any feature to edit.
            </div>
            <div class="analysis-actions" id="featureAnalysisActions"></div>
            <div id="featureTiles"></div>
            ${state.aiError ? '<div class="apro-status is-error">' + state.aiError + '</div>' : ''}
        `;

        renderActions();
        renderTiles();

        function renderActions() {
            const actionsDiv = container.querySelector('#featureAnalysisActions');
            actionsDiv.innerHTML = '';
            const runPrompt = document.createElement('button');
            runPrompt.type = 'button';
            runPrompt.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runPrompt.textContent = 'Analyze via Prompt';
            runPrompt.onclick = () => startFeatureAnalysis('prompt');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runPrompt);

            const runFiles = document.createElement('button');
            runFiles.type = 'button';
            runFiles.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runFiles.textContent = 'Analyze Selected Files';
            runFiles.onclick = () => startFeatureAnalysis('files');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runFiles);

            const runBoth = document.createElement('button');
            runBoth.type = 'button';
            runBoth.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runBoth.textContent = 'Analyze Both';
            runBoth.onclick = () => startFeatureAnalysis('both');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runBoth);

            const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
            clearBtn.type = 'button';
            clearBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear All';
            clearBtn.onclick = () => { state.features = []; state.lastAiRaw = ''; state.aiError = ''; renderTiles(); };
            actionsDiv.appendChild(clearBtn);
        }

        function renderTiles() {
            const tilesDiv = container.querySelector('#featureTiles');
            if (!state.features || !state.features.length) {
                tilesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">No features extracted yet. Run analysis above.</div>';
                if (toolsDiv) toolsDiv.querySelector('button').disabled = true;
                return;
            }
            if (toolsDiv) toolsDiv.querySelector('button').disabled = false;
            tilesDiv.innerHTML = '';
            state.features.forEach((feature, i) => {
                const tile = document.createElement('div');
                tile.className = 'analysis-tile analysis-tile-done';

                const head = document.createElement('div');
                head.className = 'tile-head';
                head.innerHTML = `<span class="tile-path"><b>${escapeHtml(feature.name || 'Unnamed Feature')}</b></span>`;
                tile.appendChild(head);

                // Summary/mini details
                const summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
                summaryDiv.className = 'tile-result-purpose';
                summaryDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Summary:</b> ' + escapeHtml(feature.summary || '');
                tile.appendChild(summaryDiv);

                if (feature.referenced_files && feature.referenced_files.length) {
                    const refsDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    refsDiv.className = 'tile-result-files';
                    refsDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Files:</b> ' +
                        feature.referenced_files.map(escapeHtml).join(', ');
                    tile.appendChild(refsDiv);
                }
                if (feature.origin) {
                    const originDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    originDiv.style.fontSize = '12px';
                    originDiv.style.color = '#a5b3e4';
                    originDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Source:</b> ' + escapeHtml(feature.origin);
                    tile.appendChild(originDiv);
                }
                // Actions
                const actionsDiv = document.createElement('div');
                actionsDiv.className = 'tile-actions';
                const reviseBtn = document.createElement('button');
                reviseBtn.type = 'button';
                reviseBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                reviseBtn.textContent = 'Revise';
                reviseBtn.onclick = () => showReviseModal(i, feature);
                actionsDiv.appendChild(reviseBtn);
                tile.appendChild(actionsDiv);

                // Expandable: details
                const det = document.createElement('details');
                det.style.marginTop = '6px';
                const sum = document.createElement('summary');
                sum.textContent = 'Show Details';
                det.appendChild(sum);
                const detPre = document.createElement('pre');
                detPre.style.whiteSpace = 'pre-wrap';
                detPre.textContent = feature.details || '';
                det.appendChild(detPre);
                tile.appendChild(det);

                tilesDiv.appendChild(tile);
            });
        }

        function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (!text) return '';
            return text.replace(/[<>&"']/g, function(c) {
                return {'<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','&':'&amp;','"':'&quot;','\'':'&#39;'}[c];
            });
        }

        function showReviseModal(idx, feature) {
            // Create modal dom
            let modal = document.getElementById('featureReviseModal');
            if (!modal) {
                modal = document.createElement('div');
                modal.id = 'featureReviseModal';
                modal.className = 'apro-modal';
                modal.innerHTML = `
                  <div class="apro-modal-backdrop"></div>
                  <div class="apro-modal-content">
                    <div class="apro-modal-header">
                        <h3>Edit Feature</h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="apro-modal-body">
                        <div class="apro-field"><label>Name
                            <input id="featureNameInput" type="text" style="width:100%"
                                   value="">
                        </label></div>
                        <div class="apro-field"><label>Summary
                            <textarea id="featureSummaryInput" style="width:100%"></textarea>
                        </label></div>
                        <div class="apro-field"><label>Details
                            <textarea id="featureDetailsInput" style="width:100%;min-height:120px"></textarea>
                        </label></div>
                        <div class="apro-field"><label>Referenced Files
                            <input id="featureRefsInput" type="text" style="width:100%"
                             placeholder="Comma separated" value="">
                        </label></div>
                        <div class="apro-field"><span style="color:#999;font-size:13px;">
                            Source: <span id="featureOriginLabel"></span>
                        </span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="apro-modal-footer">
                        <button type="button" id="featureSaveButton" class="apro-primary-button">Save</button>
                        <button type="button" id="featureCancelButton" class="apro-secondary-button">Cancel</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(modal);
            }
            // Set initial values
            modal.querySelector('#featureNameInput').value = feature.name || '';
            modal.querySelector('#featureSummaryInput').value = feature.summary || '';
            modal.querySelector('#featureDetailsInput').value = feature.details || '';
            modal.querySelector('#featureRefsInput').value = (feature.referenced_files || []).join(', ');
            modal.querySelector('#featureOriginLabel').textContent = feature.origin || '';

            modal.style.display = 'flex';

            function closeModal() { modal.style.display = 'none'; }
            modal.querySelector('#featureCancelButton').onclick = closeModal;
            modal.querySelector('#featureSaveButton').onclick = function () {
                // Save edits
                state.features[idx] = {
                    ...feature,
                    name: modal.querySelector('#featureNameInput').value,
                    summary: modal.querySelector('#featureSummaryInput').value,
                    details: modal.querySelector('#featureDetailsInput').value,
                    referenced_files: modal.querySelector('#featureRefsInput').value
                        .split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
                    origin: feature.origin || '',
                };
                closeModal();
                renderTiles();
            };
        }

        async function startFeatureAnalysis(mode) {
            if (state.running) return;
            // Gather required data
            state.running = true;
            state.aiError = '';
            const prompt = document.getElementById('userPrompt').value || '';
            const serviceId = document.getElementById('serviceId').value || '';
            // Files-only: read explicitly checked file nodes
            const selectedPaths = (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function')
                ? window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths()
                : [];

            // Defensive: do not allow both fields empty
            if ((mode === 'prompt' && !prompt) ||
                (mode === 'files' && (!selectedPaths || !selectedPaths.length)) ||
                (mode === 'both' && !prompt && (!selectedPaths || !selectedPaths.length))) {
                alert("You must provide a prompt and/or select files according to the chosen analysis mode.");
                state.running = false;
                return;
            }

            container.querySelector('#featureTiles').innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Extracting features... Please wait.</div>';

            try {
                const res = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/feature_analysis.php', {
                    prompt: prompt,
                    selected_paths: selectedPaths,
                    service_id: serviceId,
                    analysis_mode: mode
                });

                // Merge features, avoiding duplicates by name/summary/origin
                if (Array.isArray(res.features) && res.features.length) {
                    const existing = state.features || [];
                    const newOnes = res.features.filter(
                        nf => !existing.some(ef =>
                            ef.name === nf.name &&
                            ef.summary === nf.summary &&
                            ef.origin === nf.origin)
                    );
                    state.features = existing.concat(newOnes);
                }
                // Do not clear state.features if there are no new features.

                state.lastAiRaw = res.ai_response_text || '';
                state.lastMode = mode;
                state.lastPrompt = prompt;
                state.lastPaths = selectedPaths;
                state.aiError = '';
            } catch (e) {
                // Do not clear the feature set on error
                state.lastAiRaw = '';
                state.aiError = String(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to extract features.');
            }
            state.running = false;
            renderTiles();
        }

        function copyFeaturesToClipboard() {
            const text = buildFeatureListText();
            if (!navigator.clipboard) {
                alert('Clipboard API is not available in this browser.');
                return;
            }
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
            .then(() => window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Feature list copied to clipboard.', 'success'))
            .catch(() => window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Could not copy feature list.', 'error'));
        }

        function buildFeatureListText() {
            const out = [];
            out.push('Feature Analysis Results (APRO):');
            out.push('');
            out.push('Extracted Feature Count: ' + getState().features.length);
            out.push('');
            getState().features.forEach((f, idx) => {
                out.push('------------------------------------------------');
                out.push('Feature #' + (idx + 1));
                out.push('Name: ' + (f.name || ''));
                out.push('Summary: ' + (f.summary || ''));
                out.push('Details:');
                out.push((f.details || ''));
                if (Array.isArray(f.referenced_files) && f.referenced_files.length) {
                    out.push('Referenced files:');
                    f.referenced_files.forEach(rf => out.push('  - ' + rf));
                }
                out.push('Origin: ' + (f.origin || ''));
                out.push('');
            });
            out.push('------------------------------------------------');
            return out.join('\n');
        }
    }

    function unmount() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = panel && panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
        // Do not erase or reset state (by design)
    }

    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS || {};
    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS['feature'] = { mount, unmount };
})();

(function () {
    const STATE_KEY = 'fileArchives';
    const LS_SOURCE_KEY = 'apro_archives_source_mode_file';

    function getTreeSource() {
        try { return localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server'; } catch (e) { return 'server'; }
    }

    function getPersistedSourceMode() {
        try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_SOURCE_KEY) || 'follow'; } catch (e) { return 'follow'; }
    }

    function setPersistedSourceMode(mode) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(LS_SOURCE_KEY, mode); } catch (e) {}
    }

    function resolveEffectiveSource(mode) {
        const m = (mode || 'follow');
        if (m === 'follow') {
            const ts = getTreeSource();
            if (ts === 'remote') return 'remote';
            if (ts === 'godaddy') return 'godaddy';
            return 'local';
        }
        return m;
    }

    function canListRemoteArchives() {
        return false;
    }

    function getGoDaddyConfig() {
        try {
            if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
                const cfg = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
                if (cfg && cfg.base_url && cfg.username && cfg.api_token) {
                    return {
                        base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),
                        username: String(cfg.username || '').trim(),
                        api_token: String(cfg.api_token || '').trim(),
                        insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                        root_path: String(cfg.root_path || '/public_html').trim() || '/public_html',
                        label: String(cfg.label || '').trim(),
                        id: String(cfg.id || '').trim()
                    };
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function getState() {
        if (!window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY]) {
            window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY] = {
                selectedFile: '',
                archives: [],
                loading: false,
                error: '',
                lastRestoreMessage: '',
                sourceMode: getPersistedSourceMode()
            };
        }
        return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
            return ({
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                '"': '&quot;',
                "'": '&#39;'
            })[char];
        });
    }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.formatBytes === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_TREE.formatBytes(bytes);
        }
        const value = Number(bytes || 0);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
            return '0 B';
        }
        if (value < 1024) {
            return Math.round(value) + ' B';
        }
        const units = ['KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
        let size = value;
        let unitIndex = -1;
        do {
            size /= 1024;
            unitIndex += 1;
        } while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1);
        const decimals = size >= 100 ? 0 : (size >= 10 ? 1 : 2);
        return size.toFixed(decimals) + ' ' + units[unitIndex];
    }

    function formatTimestamp(timestamp) {
        const numeric = Number(timestamp || 0);
        if (!Number.isFinite(numeric) || numeric <= 0) {
            return 'Unknown';
        }
        const dt = new Date(numeric * 1000);
        return dt.toLocaleString();
    }

    function getSelectedFilesOnly() {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths();

        statusEl.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        statusEl.textContent = message || '';
        if (type === 'error') {
            statusEl.classList.add('is-error');
        } else if (type === 'success') {
            statusEl.classList.add('is-success');
        }
    }

    function setStatusHtml(statusEl, html, type) {
        statusEl.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        statusEl.innerHTML = html || '';
        if (type === 'error') {
            statusEl.classList.add('is-error');

            statusEl.classList.add('is-success');
        }
    }

            });
            sourceWrap.appendChild(sourceLbl);

            const loadSelectedBtn = document.createElement('button');
            loadSelectedBtn.type = 'button';

            loadSelectedBtn.textContent = 'Load Archives for Selected File';

            if (type === 'success') {

                setStatusHtml(statusEl, state.lastRestoreMessage, 'success');

                    const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyArchives({

                        username: cfg.username,
                        api_token: cfg.api_token,

                        path: livePath
                    });
                    state.archives = Array.isArray(data.archives) ? data.archives : [];
                    state.loading = false;
                    renderTiles();
                    if (state.archives.length) {
                        setStatus('Loaded ' + state.archives.length + ' GoDaddy archive(s) for <code>' + escapeHtml(livePath) + '</code>.', 'success');

                if (effectiveSource === 'remote' && !canListRemoteArchives()) {

                    renderCurrentFile();
                    renderTiles();
                    setStatus('Remote archive listing is not available from the configured HTTPS Agent. Select "Local" or "GoDaddy" to view archives stored on those targets.', 'error');
                    return;

                const data = await window.APRO_API.getJson('api/file_archives.php?action=list&path=' + encodeURIComponent(livePath));
                state.archives = Array.isArray(data.archives) ? data.archives : [];
                state.loading = false;
                renderTiles();

                    });
                    if (compareToCurrent && archive.live_exists) {

        async function restoreArchive(archive) {
            const confirmed = window.confirm('Restore archive version ' + archive.version + ' for ' + archive.live_path + '?\n\nThe current live file will be archived first so the restore can be reversed.');

                    result = await window.APRO_API.godaddyArchives({
                        action: 'restore',
                        base_url: cfg.base_url,
                        username: cfg.username,
                        api_token: cfg.api_token,
                        insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                        archive_path: archive.archive_path
                    });
                } else {
                    result = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/file_archives.php', {
                        action: 'restore',
                        archive_path: archive.archive_path
                    });
                }

                const parts = [
                    'Restored <code>' + escapeHtml(result.restored_live_path || archive.live_path) + '</code> from <code>' + escapeHtml(result.source_archive_path || archive.archive_path) + '</code>.'
                ];
                if (result.backup_archive_path) {
                    parts.push('Previous live file archived as <code>' + escapeHtml(result.backup_archive_path) + '</code>.');
                }
                if (result.restored_permissions) {
                    parts.push('Restored file permissions: <code>' + escapeHtml(result.restored_permissions) + '</code>.');
                }
                state.lastRestoreMessage = parts.join('<br>');
                state.error = '';

                if (window.APRO_APP && typeof window.APRO_APP.reloadTree === 'function') {
                    await window.APRO_APP.reloadTree();
                }

                await Promise.resolve();
                await fetchArchives(state.selectedFile || archive.live_path);
                setStatus(state.lastRestoreMessage, 'success');
            } catch (error) {
                const message = String(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Restore failed.');
                state.error = message;
                setStatus(message, 'error');
            }
        }
    }

    function unmount() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = panel && panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) {
            toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
        }
    }

    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS || {};
    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS[STATE_KEY] = { mount: mount, unmount: unmount };
})();

        };
    }

    function renderActions(actionsDiv, handlers, opts) {
        actionsDiv.innerHTML = '';

        const runPrompt = makeButton('Analyze via Prompt', 'apro-mini-button');

        aiRespBtn.id = 'fpCreateFromAiResponseBtn';

            clearBtn: clearBtn,
            approveAllBtn: approveAllBtn,
            unapproveAllBtn: unapproveAllBtn,
            publishBtn: publishBtn
        };
    }

    function mount(container, handlers, options) {
        const actionsDiv = ensureContainer(container);
        const h = normalizeHandlers(handlers);
        const btns = renderActions(actionsDiv, h, options || {});

        function setBusy(isBusy) {
            const disable = !!isBusy;
            btns.runPrompt.disabled = disable;
            btns.runFiles.disabled = disable;
            btns.runBoth.disabled = disable;
            btns.generateFilesBtn.disabled = disable;
            btns.genTiles.disabled = disable;
            if (btns.aiRespBtn && btns.aiRespBtn.style.display !== 'none') {
                btns.aiRespBtn.disabled = disable;
            }
            btns.publishBtn.disabled = disable;
        }

        function setTilesCount(n) {
            const count = Number(n || 0);
            btns.publishBtn.disabled = (count <= 0);
        }

        function destroy() {
            if (actionsDiv && actionsDiv.parentNode) {
                actionsDiv.innerHTML = '';
            }
        }

        return { setBusy: setBusy, setTilesCount: setTilesCount, destroy: destroy, container: actionsDiv };
    }

    NS.actions = {
        mount: mount
    };
})();

(function () {
    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }

    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function') ? FP.getState() : {
            githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' }
        };
    }

    function getPromptFromUI() {
        const el = document.getElementById('userPrompt');
        return el ? String(el.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function getSelectedFilePaths() {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths();
        }
        return [];
    }

    function getTreeSource() {
