            return (localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server');
        } catch (e) {
            return 'server';
        }
    }

    function isGithubTreeSource() {
        return getTreeSource() === 'github';
    }

    function isRemoteTreeSource() {
        return getTreeSource() === 'remote';
    }

    function isGoDaddyTreeSource() {
        return getTreeSource() === 'godaddy';
    }

    function readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage() {
        try {
            const owner = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '';
            const repo = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '';
            const branch = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main';
            if (owner && repo && branch) {
                return { owner, repo, branch };
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function readRemoteConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function') {
            const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig() || {};
            const server_url = String(cfg.server_url || '').trim();
            const api_key = String(cfg.api_key || '').trim();
            if (server_url && api_key) {
                return {
                    server_url: server_url,
                    api_key: api_key,
                    insecure: !!cfg.insecure
                };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function readGoDaddyConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
            const cfg = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
            if (cfg && cfg.base_url && cfg.username && cfg.api_token) {
                return {
                    base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),
                    username: String(cfg.username || '').trim(),
                    api_token: String(cfg.api_token || '').trim(),
                    root_path: String(cfg.root_path || '/public_html').trim() || '/public_html',
                    insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                    label: String(cfg.label || '').trim(),
                    id: String(cfg.id || '').trim()
                };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text) {
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.stripMarkdownCodeBlock === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text);
        }
        text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
        if (!text) return '';
        text = text.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '');
        text = text.replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '');
        return text.trim();
    }

    function getSelectedModelPayload() {
        const runtimeModelId = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelRuntimeId === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelRuntimeId() || '').trim()
            : '';
        const provider = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproProvider === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproProvider() || '').trim().toLowerCase()
            : '';
        const canonicalId = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelCatalogId === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelCatalogId() || '').trim()
            : '';

        let label = '';
        try {
            const serviceEl = document.getElementById('serviceId');
            if (serviceEl && serviceEl.selectedIndex >= 0 && serviceEl.options[serviceEl.selectedIndex]) {
                label = String(serviceEl.options[serviceEl.selectedIndex].textContent || '').trim();
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        if (!runtimeModelId) {
            throw new Error('An AI model must be selected before using Analyze Both.');
        }

        const inferredProvider = provider || (canonicalId && canonicalId.indexOf(':') !== -1
            ? String(canonicalId.split(':')[0] || '').trim().toLowerCase()
            : (/^gemini/i.test(runtimeModelId) ? 'gemini' : 'openai'));
        const inferredCanonical = canonicalId || (inferredProvider ? (inferredProvider + ':' + runtimeModelId) : runtimeModelId);

        return {
            provider: inferredProvider,
            model_id: runtimeModelId,
            catalog_canonical_id: inferredCanonical,
            label: label || runtimeModelId
        };
    }

    function normalizeTile(serverTile, githubDefaults) {
        const enc = String(serverTile.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text';
        const content = enc === 'base64' ? (serverTile.content || '') : stripMarkdownCodeBlock(serverTile.content || '');
        const path = String(serverTile.path || '');
        const op = String(serverTile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase() === 'ADD' ? 'ADD' : 'REPLACE';

        return {
            path: path,
            target_path: path,
            operation: op,
            content: content,
            encoding: enc,
            approved: false,
            reviewed: false,
            _identical: false,
            _replace_size: typeof content === 'string' ? content.length : 0,
            _replace_lines: (enc === 'base64') ? null : ((String(content).match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1),
            github: {
                owner: (githubDefaults.owner || ''),
                repo: (githubDefaults.repo || ''),
                branch: (githubDefaults.branch || 'main'),
                path: path || (githubDefaults.path || ''),
                commit_message: githubDefaults.commit_message || ('APRO publish: ' + (path || 'update file'))
            }
        };
    }

    function normalizeTiles(serverTiles, githubDefaults) {
        const list = Array.isArray(serverTiles) ? serverTiles : [];
        const gd = githubDefaults || getState().githubDefaults || { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' };
        return list.map(function (t) { return normalizeTile(t, gd); });
    }

    function buildAnalyzePayload(mode, options) {
        const opt = options || {};
        const prompt = (typeof opt.prompt === 'string') ? String(opt.prompt).trim() : getPromptFromUI();
        const selected_paths = Array.isArray(opt.selected_paths) ? opt.selected_paths.slice() : getSelectedFilePaths();
        const model = opt.model && typeof opt.model === 'object' ? Object.assign({}, opt.model) : getSelectedModelPayload();
        const service_id = (typeof opt.service_id === 'string' && String(opt.service_id).trim())
            ? String(opt.service_id).trim()
            : String(model.model_id || '').trim();

        if (mode === 'prompt' && !prompt) {
            throw new Error('You must provide a prompt for "Analyze via Prompt".');
        }
        if (mode === 'files' && (!selected_paths || selected_paths.length === 0)) {
            throw new Error('You must select at least one file for "Analyze Selected Files".');
        }
        if (mode === 'both' && !prompt && (!selected_paths || selected_paths.length === 0)) {
            throw new Error('You must provide a prompt or select files for "Analyze Both".');
        }
        if (!service_id) {
            throw new Error('An AI model must be selected before running publish analysis.');
        }

        const payload = {
            prompt: prompt,
            selected_paths: selected_paths,
            service_id: service_id,
            model: model,
            analysis_mode: mode
        };

        if (isGithubTreeSource()) {
            const gh = readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage();
            if (gh) {
                payload.github = gh;
            }
        } else if (isRemoteTreeSource()) {
            const remote = readRemoteConfig();
            if (!remote) {
                throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured. Save a valid Server URL and API Key first.');
            }
            payload.remote = remote;
        } else if (isGoDaddyTreeSource()) {
            const godaddy = readGoDaddyConfig();
            if (!godaddy) {
                throw new Error('GoDaddy account is not configured. Select or add an account first.');
            }
            payload.godaddy = godaddy;
        }

        return payload;
    }

    async function startPublishAnalysis(mode, options) {
        if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API || typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.analyze !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.analyze is not available.');
        }

        const payload = buildAnalyzePayload(mode, options);
        const response = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.analyze(payload);

        return {
            tiles: normalizeTiles(response.publish_files, getState().githubDefaults),
            ai_response_text: response.ai_response_text || '',
            fallback_used: !!response.fallback_used,
            mode: mode,
            prompt: payload.prompt || '',
            selected_paths: Array.isArray(payload.selected_paths) ? payload.selected_paths.slice() : []
        };
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.analyze = {
        start: startPublishAnalysis,
        buildPayload: buildAnalyzePayload,
        normalizeTiles: normalizeTiles
    };
})();

(function () {
    // /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/approval.js
    // Approve/unapprove helpers for the Publishable Files panel.
    //
    // Export:
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approval.approveAll(container)   -> { approved: number, skipped: string[] }
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approval.unapproveAll(container) -> { unapproved: number }
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approval.approveTile(tile, container) -> boolean
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approval.markReviewed(tile, container) -> boolean

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH || {};
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function') ? FP.getState() : { tiles: [] };
    }

    function setPanelStatus(container, message, type) {
        try {
            const el = container && container.querySelector ? container.querySelector('#filePublishPanelStatus') : document.getElementById('filePublishPanelStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.innerHTML = message ? String(message) : '';
                el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
                if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
                if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message || '', type || '');
        }
    }

    function renderIfPossible(container) {
        if (FP.renderTiles && typeof FP.renderTiles.render === 'function') {
            try { FP.renderTiles.render(container || document); } catch (e) {}
        }
    }

    function approveAll(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const tiles = Array.isArray(s.tiles) ? s.tiles : [];
        if (!tiles.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No tiles available to approve.', 'error');
            return { approved: 0, skipped: [] };
        }

        let approvedCount = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 1) {
            const t = tiles[i] || {};
            if (!t.approved) {
                t.approved = true;
                approvedCount += 1;
            }
        }

        renderIfPossible(container);
        setPanelStatus(container, 'All files approved. Identical files are allowed and may still be published.', 'success');
        return { approved: approvedCount, skipped: [] };
    }

    function unapproveAll(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const tiles = Array.isArray(s.tiles) ? s.tiles : [];
        if (!tiles.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No tiles available to unapprove.', 'error');
            return { unapproved: 0 };
        }

        let count = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 1) {
            const t = tiles[i] || {};
            if (t.approved) {
                t.approved = false;
                count += 1;
            }
        }

        renderIfPossible(container);
        setPanelStatus(container, 'All files unapproved.', 'success');
        return { unapproved: count };
    }

    function approveTile(tile, container) {
        if (!tile || typeof tile !== 'object') {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'approveTile: invalid tile.', 'error');
            return false;
        }
        tile.approved = true;
        renderIfPossible(container);
        return true;
    }

    function markReviewed(tile, container) {
        if (!tile || typeof tile !== 'object') {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'markReviewed: invalid tile.', 'error');
            return false;
        }
        tile.reviewed = true;
        renderIfPossible(container);
        return true;
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approval = {
        approveAll: approveAll,
        unapproveAll: unapproveAll,
        approveTile: approveTile,
        markReviewed: markReviewed
    };
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/clipboard.js
(function () {
    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function')
            ? FP.getState()
            : { tiles: [], generateRaw: '' };
    }

    function setPanelStatus(container, message, type) {
        try {
            const el = container && container.querySelector ? container.querySelector('#filePublishPanelStatus') : document.getElementById('filePublishPanelStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.innerHTML = message ? String(message) : '';
                el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
                if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
                if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message || '', type || '');
        }
    }

    function buildText(tiles) {
        const list = Array.isArray(tiles) ? tiles : [];
        const out = [];
        out.push('Publishable Files Export (APRO)');
        out.push('');
        out.push('File count: ' + list.length);
        out.push('');

        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i += 1) {
            const f = list[i] || {};
            out.push('------------------------------------------------');
            out.push('File #' + (i + 1));
            out.push('Path: ' + (f.path || ''));
            out.push('Target Path: ' + (f.target_path || f.path || ''));
            out.push('Operation: ' + (String(f.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase()));
            out.push('Encoding: ' + (String(f.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text'));
            if (typeof f._replace_size === 'number' || typeof f._replace_lines === 'number') {
                const parts = [];
                if (typeof f._replace_size === 'number') parts.push('bytes=' + f._replace_size);
                if (typeof f._replace_lines === 'number') parts.push('lines=' + f._replace_lines);
                if (parts.length) out.push('Proposed size: ' + parts.join(', '));
            }
            if (typeof f.revision_summary === 'string' && f.revision_summary.trim() !== '') {
                out.push('Revision Summary: ' + f.revision_summary.trim());
            }
            out.push('CONTENT:');
            out.push(String(f.content || ''));
            out.push('');
        }
        out.push('------------------------------------------------');
        return out.join('\n');
    }

    async function writeClipboardText(text) {
        if (navigator.clipboard && typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText === 'function') {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            return;
        }

        const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = text;
        ta.style.position = 'fixed';
        ta.style.top = '-9999px';
        ta.style.left = '-9999px';
        ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        if (!ok) {
            throw new Error('Copy command failed.');
        }
    }

    async function copyTilesToClipboard(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const tiles = Array.isArray(s.tiles) ? s.tiles : [];
        if (!tiles.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No publishable files to copy.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const text = buildText(tiles);
        try {
            await writeClipboardText(text);
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Publishable file list/code copied to clipboard.', 'success');
        } catch (e) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Could not copy publishable file output.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function copyRawResponseToClipboard(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const raw = String(s.generateRaw || s.aiRaw || '');
        if (!raw.trim()) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No raw AI response is available to copy.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        try {
            await writeClipboardText(raw);
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Raw AI response copied to clipboard.', 'success');
        } catch (e) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Could not copy raw AI response.', 'error');
        }
    }

    function installHeaderButton(container) {
        try {
            const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
            const toolsDiv = (panel && panel.querySelector) ? panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools') : null;
            if (!toolsDiv) return;

            if (!toolsDiv.querySelector('#fpCopyTilesButton')) {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.type = 'button';
                btn.id = 'fpCopyTilesButton';
                btn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                btn.textContent = 'Copy File Output';
                btn.disabled = !(Array.isArray(getState().tiles) && getState().tiles.length > 0);
                btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    copyTilesToClipboard(container || document);
                });
                toolsDiv.appendChild(btn);
            }

            if (!toolsDiv.querySelector('#fpCopyRawResponseButton')) {
                const rawBtn = document.createElement('button');
                rawBtn.type = 'button';
                rawBtn.id = 'fpCopyRawResponseButton';
                rawBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                rawBtn.textContent = 'Copy Raw AI Response';
                rawBtn.disabled = !String(getState().generateRaw || getState().aiRaw || '').trim();
                rawBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    copyRawResponseToClipboard(container || document);
                });
                toolsDiv.appendChild(rawBtn);
            }

            FP.clipboard = FP.clipboard || {};
            FP.clipboard._refreshHeaderButton = function () {
                try {
                    const b = document.getElementById('fpCopyTilesButton');
                    if (b) {
                        const hasTiles = Array.isArray(getState().tiles) && getState().tiles.length > 0;
                        b.disabled = !hasTiles;
                    }
                    const rawBtn = document.getElementById('fpCopyRawResponseButton');
                    if (rawBtn) {
                        const hasRaw = !!String(getState().generateRaw || getState().aiRaw || '').trim();
                        rawBtn.disabled = !hasRaw;
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            };
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.clipboard = {
        buildText: buildText,
        copyTilesToClipboard: copyTilesToClipboard,
        copyRawResponseToClipboard: copyRawResponseToClipboard,
        installHeaderButton: installHeaderButton
    };
})();

(function () {
    // filePublish/createFromAiResponse.js
    // Transforms the current AI Response panel text into publish tiles via /api/publish_tiles.php
    //
    // Export:
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.createFromAiResponse.generate(options?) -> Promise<{ tiles, ai_response_text, fallback_used, selected_paths }>

    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        if (typeof FP.getState === 'function') return FP.getState();
        // Minimal fallback shape if state.js isn't loaded (keeps behavior predictable)
        return {
            githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' }
        };
    }

    function getSelectedFilePaths() {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths();
        }
        return [];
    }

    function getAiResponseTextFromUI() {
        const el = document.getElementById('responseOutput');
        if (!el) return '';
        // responseOutput is a <pre> where textContent carries the raw AI response
        return String(el.textContent || '').trim();
    }

    function stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text) {
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.stripMarkdownCodeBlock === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text);
        }
        text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
        if (!text) return '';
        text = text.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '');
        text = text.replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '');
        return text.trim();
    }

    // Fallback normalizer if APRO_FILEPUBLISH.analyze.normalizeTiles isn't available
    function fallbackNormalizeTile(serverTile, githubDefaults) {
        const enc = String(serverTile.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text';
        const contentRaw = String(serverTile.content || '');
        const content = (enc === 'base64') ? contentRaw : stripMarkdownCodeBlock(contentRaw);
        const path = String(serverTile.path || '');
        const op = String(serverTile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase() === 'ADD' ? 'ADD' : 'REPLACE';
        const gd = githubDefaults || {};

        return {
            path: path,
            target_path: path,
            operation: op,
            content: content,
            encoding: enc,
            approved: false,
            reviewed: false,
            _identical: false,
            _replace_size: content.length,
            _replace_lines: (enc === 'base64') ? null : ((content.match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1),
            github: {
                owner: gd.owner || '',
                repo: gd.repo || '',
                branch: gd.branch || 'main',
                path: path || (gd.path || ''),
                commit_message: gd.commit_message || ('APRO publish: ' + (path || 'update file'))
            }
        };
    }

    function normalizeTiles(serverTiles, githubDefaults) {
        // Prefer the analyzer's normalizer if present
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.analyze && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.analyze.normalizeTiles === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.analyze.normalizeTiles(serverTiles, githubDefaults);
        }
        const list = Array.isArray(serverTiles) ? serverTiles : [];
        const gd = githubDefaults || (getState().githubDefaults || { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' });
        return list.map(function (t) { return fallbackNormalizeTile(t, gd); });
    }

    async function generate(options) {
        if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API || typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.tilesFromAiResponse !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.tilesFromAiResponse is not available.');
        }

        const opts = options || {};
        let aiText = typeof opts.ai_response_text === 'string' ? String(opts.ai_response_text).trim() : getAiResponseTextFromUI();

        if (!aiText || aiText === 'No response yet.') {
            throw new Error('AI Response panel is empty. Run an AI request or provide ai_response_text.');
        }

        const selectedPaths = Array.isArray(opts.selected_paths) ? opts.selected_paths.slice() : getSelectedFilePaths();

        const payload = {
            ai_response_text: aiText
        };
        // Provide optional context to help server disambiguate path-only entries, if available
        if (selectedPaths && selectedPaths.length) {
            payload.selected_paths = selectedPaths;
        }

        const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.tilesFromAiResponse(payload);
        const normalized = normalizeTiles(res.publish_files, getState().githubDefaults);

        return {
            tiles: normalized,
            ai_response_text: res.ai_response_text || aiText,
            fallback_used: !!res.fallback_used,
            selected_paths: selectedPaths
        };
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.createFromAiResponse = {
        generate: generate
    };
})();

(function () {
    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        if (typeof FP.getState === 'function') return FP.getState();
        return {
            githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' }
        };
    }

    function getCheckedFilePaths() {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths();
        }
        return [];
    }

    function getTreeSource() {
        try {
            return localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server';
        } catch (e) {
            return 'server';
        }
    }

    function getPublishDestination() {
        try {
            if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getPublishDestination === 'function') {
                const dest = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getPublishDestination();
                if (dest === 'github' || dest === 'remote' || dest === 'server' || dest === 'godaddy') {
                    return dest;
                }
            }

            const stored = localStorage.getItem('apro_publish_destination') || 'server';
            if (stored === 'github' || stored === 'remote' || stored === 'server' || stored === 'godaddy') {
                return stored;
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        return 'server';
    }

    function readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage() {
        try {
            const owner = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '';
            const repo = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '';
            const branch = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main';
            if (owner && repo && branch) {
                return { owner, repo, branch };
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function readGithubPublishTargetDefaults() {
        const s = getState();
        const gd = s.githubDefaults || {};

        const owner = String(
            (document.getElementById('githubPublishOwner') && document.getElementById('githubPublishOwner').value) ||
            gd.owner ||
            localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') ||
            ''
        ).trim();

        const repo = String(
            (document.getElementById('githubPublishRepo') && document.getElementById('githubPublishRepo').value) ||
            gd.repo ||
            localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') ||
            ''
        ).trim();

        const branch = String(
            (document.getElementById('githubPublishBranch') && document.getElementById('githubPublishBranch').value) ||
            gd.branch ||
            localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') ||
            'main'
        ).trim() || 'main';

        return { owner, repo, branch };
    }

    function getRemoteConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig() || {};
        }
        return {};
    }

    function getGoDaddyConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
        }
        return null;
    }

    async function fetchLocalFile(path) {
        return window.APRO_API.viewFile(path);
    }

    async function fetchRemoteFile(path) {
        if (!window.APRO_API || typeof window.APRO_API.serverFileView !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('Remote file view API is not available.');
        }

        const cfg = getRemoteConfig();
        const serverUrl = String(cfg.server_url || '').trim();
        const apiKey = String(cfg.api_key || '').trim();
        const insecure = !!cfg.insecure;

        if (!serverUrl || !apiKey) {
            throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured. Save a valid Server URL and API Key first.');
        }

        const data = await window.APRO_API.serverFileView({
            server_url: serverUrl,
            api_key: apiKey,
            insecure: insecure,
            path: path,
            allow_missing: true
        });

        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
            throw new Error('Invalid remote file response.');
        }

        return {
            path: String(data.path || path || ''),
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text',
            exists: data.exists !== false,
            size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
            truncated: !!data.truncated,
            line_count: (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null
        };

        if (!cfg || !cfg.base_url || !cfg.username || !cfg.api_token) {
            throw new Error('GoDaddy account is not configured. Select or add an account first.');

        });

        return {

            exists: data.exists !== false,

        }

        if (dest === 'godaddy') {

            if (!cfg || !cfg.base_url || !cfg.username || !cfg.api_token) {
                throw new Error('GoDaddy publish destination is selected, but no account is configured.');
            }

            const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyFile({
                base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),

            github: {
                owner: gd.owner || '',

                branch: gd.branch || 'main',
                path: normalizedPath || (gd.path || ''),

        const ghDefaults = getState().githubDefaults || { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' };

                if (!p) continue;

                    const op = await inferOperationForPublishDestination(p);
                    tiles.push(normalizeTileFromPayload(p, data, op, ghDefaults, false, false, false));
                } catch (e) {
                    errors.push(p + ': ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'error'));
                }
            }
        } else if (sourceRemote) {
            for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i += 1) {
                const p = String(selected[i] || '').trim();
                if (!p) continue;
                try {
                    const data = await fetchRemoteFile(p);
                    const op = await inferOperationForPublishDestination(p);
                    tiles.push(normalizeTileFromPayload(p, data, op, ghDefaults, false, true, false));
                } catch (e) {
                    errors.push(p + ': ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'error'));
                }
            }
        } else if (sourceGoDaddy) {
            for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i += 1) {
                const p = String(selected[i] || '').trim();
                if (!p) continue;
                try {
                    const data = await fetchGoDaddyFile(p);
                    const op = await inferOperationForPublishDestination(p);
                    tiles.push(normalizeTileFromPayload(p, data, op, ghDefaults, false, false, true));
                } catch (e) {
                    errors.push(p + ': ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'error'));
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i += 1) {
                const p = String(selected[i] || '').trim();
                if (!p) continue;
                try {
                    const data = await fetchLocalFile(p);
                    const op = await inferOperationForPublishDestination(p);
                    tiles.push(normalizeTileFromPayload(p, data, op, ghDefaults, true, false, false));
                } catch (e) {
                    errors.push(p + ': ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'error'));
                }
            }
        }

        return {
            tiles: tiles,
            errors: errors,
            source: sourceGithub ? 'github' : (sourceRemote ? 'remote' : (sourceGoDaddy ? 'godaddy' : 'server')),
            selected_paths: selected.slice()
        };
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.createFromCurrent = {
        generate: generate
    };
})();

(function () {
    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }

    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function') ? FP.getState() : {
            githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' }
        };
    }

    function getPromptFromUI() {
        const el = document.getElementById('userPrompt');
        return el ? String(el.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function getSelectedFilePaths() {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths();
        }
        return [];
    }

    function getTreeSource() {
        try {
            return (localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server');
        } catch (e) {
            return 'server';
        }
    }

    function readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage() {
        try {
            const owner = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '';
            const repo = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '';
            const branch = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main';
            if (owner && repo && branch) {
                return { owner: owner, repo: repo, branch: branch };
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function readRemoteConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function') {
            const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig() || {};
            const server_url = String(cfg.server_url || '').trim();
            const api_key = String(cfg.api_key || '').trim();
            if (server_url && api_key) {
                return {
                    server_url: server_url,
                    api_key: api_key,
                    insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                    browse_root: String(cfg.browse_root || cfg.dest_path || '/').trim() || '/',
                    dest_path: String(cfg.dest_path || '/').trim() || '/'
                };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function readGoDaddyConfig() {
        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
            const cfg = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
            if (cfg && cfg.base_url && cfg.username && cfg.api_token) {
                return {
                    base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),
                    username: String(cfg.username || '').trim(),
                    api_token: String(cfg.api_token || '').trim(),
                    root_path: String(cfg.root_path || '/public_html').trim() || '/public_html',
                    insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                    label: String(cfg.label || '').trim(),
                    id: String(cfg.id || '').trim()
                };
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function getSelectedModelPayload() {
        const runtimeModelId = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelRuntimeId === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelRuntimeId() || '').trim()
            : '';
        const provider = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproProvider === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproProvider() || '').trim().toLowerCase()
            : '';
        const canonicalId = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelCatalogId === 'function'
            ? String(window.APRO_API.getSelectedAproModelCatalogId() || '').trim()
            : '';

        let label = '';
        try {
            const serviceEl = document.getElementById('serviceId');
            if (serviceEl && serviceEl.selectedIndex >= 0 && serviceEl.options[serviceEl.selectedIndex]) {
                label = String(serviceEl.options[serviceEl.selectedIndex].textContent || '').trim();
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        if (!runtimeModelId) {
            throw new Error('An AI model must be selected before using Generate Files.');
        }

        const inferredProvider = provider || (canonicalId && canonicalId.indexOf(':') !== -1 ? String(canonicalId.split(':')[0] || '').trim().toLowerCase() : (/^gemini/i.test(runtimeModelId) ? 'gemini' : 'openai'));
        const inferredCanonical = canonicalId || (inferredProvider ? (inferredProvider + ':' + runtimeModelId) : runtimeModelId);

        return {
            provider: inferredProvider,
            model_id: runtimeModelId,
            catalog_canonical_id: inferredCanonical,
            label: label || runtimeModelId
        };
    }

    function normalizeGeneratedFileRow(file, githubDefaults) {
        const row = file && typeof file === 'object' ? file : {};
        const path = String(row.file_path || row.path || row.target_path || '').trim();
        const content = String(row.file_content != null ? row.file_content : (row.content || ''));
        const operation = String(row.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase() === 'ADD' ? 'ADD' : 'REPLACE';
        const summary = String(row.file_revision_summary || row.revision_summary || row.summary || '').trim();
        const gd = githubDefaults || {};

        if (!path) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            path: path,
            target_path: path,
            operation: operation,
            content: content,
            encoding: 'text',
            approved: false,
            reviewed: false,
            revision_summary: summary,
            _identical: false,
            _replace_size: typeof content === 'string' ? content.length : 0,
            _replace_lines: content === '' ? 0 : ((String(content).match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1),
            github: {
                owner: gd.owner || '',
                repo: gd.repo || '',
                branch: gd.branch || 'main',
                path: path || (gd.path || ''),
                commit_message: gd.commit_message || ('APRO publish: ' + (path || 'update file'))
            }
        };
    }

    function normalizeGeneratedFiles(apiFiles) {
        const gd = getState().githubDefaults || { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main', path: '', commit_message: '' };
        const list = Array.isArray(apiFiles) ? apiFiles : [];
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i += 1) {
            const normalized = normalizeGeneratedFileRow(list[i], gd);
            if (normalized) {
                out.push(normalized);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    function buildPayload(options) {
        const opts = options || {};
        const prompt = typeof opts.prompt === 'string' ? String(opts.prompt).trim() : getPromptFromUI();
        const selected_paths = Array.isArray(opts.selected_paths) ? opts.selected_paths.slice() : getSelectedFilePaths();
        const model = opts.model && typeof opts.model === 'object' ? Object.assign({}, opts.model) : getSelectedModelPayload();

        if (!prompt) {
            throw new Error('Prompt is required for Generate Files.');
        }
        if (!selected_paths || selected_paths.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('Select at least one file for Generate Files.');
        }

        const payload = {
            prompt: prompt,
            selected_paths: selected_paths,
            model: model,
            service_id: model.model_id || ''
        };

        const source = getTreeSource();
        if (source === 'github') {
            const gh = readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage();
            if (!gh) {
                throw new Error('GitHub mode is active but owner/repo/branch are missing. Enter details and click "Load Repo" first.');
            }
            payload.github = gh;
        } else if (source === 'remote') {
            const remote = readRemoteConfig();
            if (!remote) {
                throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured. Save a valid Server URL and API Key first.');
            }
            payload.remote = remote;
        } else if (source === 'godaddy') {
            const godaddy = readGoDaddyConfig();
            if (!godaddy) {
                throw new Error('GoDaddy account is not configured. Select or add an account first.');
            }
            payload.godaddy = godaddy;
        }

        return payload;
    }

    async function start(options) {
        if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API || typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.generateFiles !== 'function') {
            throw new Error('APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.generateFiles is not available.');
        }

        const payload = buildPayload(options);
        const response = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.generateFiles(payload);
        const generatedFiles = Array.isArray(response.generated_files) ? response.generated_files : [];
        const tiles = normalizeGeneratedFiles(generatedFiles);

        return {
            tiles: tiles,
            generated_files: generatedFiles,
            raw_ai_response: String(response.raw_ai_response || ''),
            parse_status: String(response.parse_status || (tiles.length ? 'success' : 'failed')),
            warnings: Array.isArray(response.warnings) ? response.warnings : [],
            provider: String(response.provider || payload.model.provider || ''),
            model_id: String(response.model_id || payload.model.model_id || ''),
            generation_id: String(response.generation_id || ''),
            usage: response.usage && typeof response.usage === 'object' ? response.usage : null,
            prompt: payload.prompt,
            selected_paths: Array.isArray(payload.selected_paths) ? payload.selected_paths.slice() : []
        };
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.generate = {
        buildPayload: buildPayload,
        start: start,
        normalizeGeneratedFiles: normalizeGeneratedFiles
    };
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/githubForm.js
(function () {
    // githubForm.js
    // Utilities for reading/writing the GitHub publish form in the Publishable Files panel.
    // Exposes:
    //   - getFields(container)
    //   - syncDefaultsFromForm(container)
    //   - applyTileDefaults(container, tile)
    //   - collectPublishPayload(container, tile)
    //   - attachAutoSync(container)

    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }

    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function safeContainer(container) {
        return (container instanceof HTMLElement) ? container : document;
    }

    function getFields(container) {
        const root = safeContainer(container);
        return {
            owner: root.querySelector('#githubPublishOwner') || null,
            repo: root.querySelector('#githubPublishRepo') || null,
            branch: root.querySelector('#githubPublishBranch') || null,
            path: root.querySelector('#githubPublishPath') || null,
            commitMessage: root.querySelector('#githubPublishCommitMessage') || null
        };
    }

    function readForm(container) {
        const f = getFields(container);
        return {
            owner: (f.owner && f.owner.value || '').trim(),
            repo: (f.repo && f.repo.value || '').trim(),
            branch: (f.branch && f.branch.value || '').trim() || 'main',
            path: (f.path && f.path.value || '').trim(),
            commit_message: (f.commitMessage && f.commitMessage.value || '').trim()
        };
    }

    function syncDefaultsFromForm(container) {
        if (!FP.updateGithubDefaults || !FP.getGithubDefaults) {
            return null;
        }
        const vals = readForm(container);
        // Update defaults (persists owner/repo/branch; path/commit_message stay in-memory)
        FP.updateGithubDefaults({
            owner: vals.owner,
            repo: vals.repo,
            branch: vals.branch,
            path: vals.path,
            commit_message: vals.commit_message
        });
        return FP.getGithubDefaults();
    }

    function applyTileDefaults(container, tile) {
        const f = getFields(container);
        if (!f.owner || !tile) {
            return;
        }
        const gh = tile.github || {};
        const owner = gh.owner || '';
        const repo = gh.repo || '';
        const branch = gh.branch || 'main';
        const path = gh.path || tile.path || '';
        const commitMsg = gh.commit_message || '';

        f.owner.value = owner;
        f.repo.value = repo;
        f.branch.value = branch;
        f.path.value = path;
        f.commitMessage.value = commitMsg;
    }

    function collectPublishPayload(container, tile) {
        const vals = readForm(container);

        if (!vals.owner || !vals.repo || !vals.branch || !vals.path || !vals.commit_message) {
            throw new Error('GitHub owner, repo, branch, target path, and commit message are all required.');
        }

        // Attach normalized github data back to the tile
        tile.github = {
            owner: vals.owner,
            repo: vals.repo,
            branch: vals.branch,
            path: vals.path,
            commit_message: vals.commit_message
        };

        // Sync defaults for subsequent tiles
        if (FP.setGithubDefaults) {
            FP.setGithubDefaults({
                owner: vals.owner,
                repo: vals.repo,
                branch: vals.branch,
                path: vals.path,
                commit_message: vals.commit_message
            });
        }

        return {
            owner: vals.owner,
            repo: vals.repo,
            branch: vals.branch,
            path: vals.path,
            content: String(tile.content || ''),
            encoding: (String(tile.encoding || 'text') === 'base64') ? 'base64' : 'text',
            commit_message: vals.commit_message
        };
    }

    function attachAutoSync(container) {
        const f = getFields(container);
        [f.owner, f.repo, f.branch, f.path, f.commitMessage].forEach(function (el) {
            if (!el) return;
            el.addEventListener('input', function () {
                try { syncDefaultsFromForm(container); } catch (e) { /* noop */ }
            });
        });
    }

    // Export namespace
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.githubForm = {
        getFields: getFields,
        syncDefaultsFromForm: syncDefaultsFromForm,
        applyTileDefaults: applyTileDefaults,
        collectPublishPayload: collectPublishPayload,
        attachAutoSync: attachAutoSync
    };
})();

(function () {
    // filePublish/merge.js
    // Provides a reusable "merge with AI" helper for publish tiles.
    //
    // Export:
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.merge.mergeWithAI(tile, options?) -> Promise<{ merged_content, tile, ai_response_text }>
    //
    // options:
    //   - container?: HTMLElement (to write panel status to #filePublishPanelStatus if present)
    //   - promptOverride?: string (optional override/inject at top of merge prompt)
    //   - reopenModal?: boolean (if true and reviewModal.show is available, reopen diff modal with updated content)
    //   - service_id?: string (override; otherwise read from #serviceId)

    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function')
            ? FP.getState()
            : { publishDestination: 'server', githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main' } };
    }

    function getServiceIdFromUI() {
        const el = document.getElementById('serviceId');
        return el ? String(el.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function setPanelStatus(container, message, type) {
        try {
            const el = container && container.querySelector ? container.querySelector('#filePublishPanelStatus') : document.getElementById('filePublishPanelStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.innerHTML = message ? String(message) : '';
                el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
                if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
                if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message || '', type || '');
        }
    }

    function stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text) {
        if (FP && typeof FP.stripMarkdownCodeBlock === 'function') {
            return FP.stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text);
        }
        text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
        if (!text) return '';
        text = text.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '');
        text = text.replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '');
        return text.trim();
    }

    function encIsBase64(enc) {
        return String(enc || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64';
    }

    async function loadOriginalFromGithub(tile) {
        const s = getState();
        const gh = Object.assign({
            owner: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.owner) || '',
            repo: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.repo) || '',
            branch: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.branch) || 'main',
            path: tile.path || ''
        }, (tile.github || {}));

        if (!gh.owner || !gh.repo || !gh.branch || !gh.path) {
            throw new Error('GitHub target not set for merge.');
        }

        const fetchGh = (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile === 'function')
            ? window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile
            : function (owner, repo, branch, path) { return window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(owner, repo, branch, path); };

        const data = await fetchGh(gh.owner, gh.repo, gh.branch, gh.path);
        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text')
        };
    }

    async function loadOriginalFromLocal(tile) {
        const data = await window.APRO_API.viewFile(tile.path);
        if (data.exists === false) {
            throw new Error('Current local file is missing; cannot merge.');
        }
        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text')
        };
    }

    async function ensureOriginal(tile) {
        // Use hydrated metadata if already present
        if (tile && tile._original && typeof tile._original.content === 'string') {
            return {
                content: String(tile._original.content || ''),
                encoding: String(tile._original.encoding || 'text')
            };
        }
        // Try metadata-only hydration (no DOM writes)
        if (FP.tileHydration && typeof FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata === 'function') {
            try {
                await FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile);
                if (tile && tile._original && typeof tile._original.content === 'string') {
                    return {
                        content: String(tile._original.content || ''),
                        encoding: String(tile._original.encoding || 'text')
                    };
                }
            } catch (e) {
                // continue to explicit fetch
            }
        }
        // Explicit fetch based on publish destination
        const toGithub = (getState().publishDestination === 'github');
        return toGithub ? loadOriginalFromGithub(tile) : loadOriginalFromLocal(tile);
    }

    async function mergeWithAI(tile, options) {
        const opts = options || {};
        const container = opts.container || null;

        if (!tile || typeof tile !== 'object') {
            throw new Error('mergeWithAI requires a tile object.');
        }
        const op = String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase();
        if (op !== 'REPLACE') {
            throw new Error('Merge is only available for REPLACE operations.');
        }

        // Load original content
        let originalPayload;
        try {
            originalPayload = await ensureOriginal(tile);
        } catch (e) {
            setPanelStatus(container, e && e.message ? e.message : 'Could not load current file for merge.', 'error');
            throw e;
        }

        // Guard: text-only merge (skip binary/base64 on either side)
        if (encIsBase64(originalPayload.encoding)) {
            const err = new Error('Cannot perform AI merge on binary/base64 original content.');
            setPanelStatus(container, err.message, 'error');
            throw err;
        }
        if (encIsBase64(tile.encoding)) {
            const err = new Error('Cannot perform AI merge on binary/base64 proposed content.');
            setPanelStatus(container, err.message, 'error');
            throw err;
        }

        const serviceId = typeof opts.service_id === 'string' && opts.service_id
            ? String(opts.service_id).trim()
            : getServiceIdFromUI();

        if (!serviceId) {
            const err = new Error('AI Service ID is required for merge.');
            setPanelStatus(container, err.message, 'error');
            throw err;
        }

        const payload = {
            path: String(tile.path || ''),
            service_id: serviceId,
            original_content: String(originalPayload.content || ''),
            partial_content: String(tile.content || '')
        };

        if (typeof opts.promptOverride === 'string' && opts.promptOverride.trim() !== '') {
            payload.prompt = String(opts.promptOverride);
        }

        if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API || typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.merge !== 'function') {
            const err = new Error('APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.merge is not available.');
            setPanelStatus(container, err.message, 'error');
            throw err;
        }

        try {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Requesting AI merge for ' + (tile.path || '(unknown)') + ' ...', '');
            const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.merge(payload);

            const merged = stripMarkdownCodeBlock(res.merged_content || '');
            if (!merged) {
                const err = new Error('Merge returned empty content; no changes applied.');
                setPanelStatus(container, err.message, 'error');
                throw err;
            }

            // Update tile proposal
            tile.content = merged;
            tile.encoding = 'text';

            // Rehydrate metadata for identical/size flags
            if (FP.tileHydration && typeof FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata === 'function') {
                try { await FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile); } catch (e) {}
            }

            setPanelStatus(container, 'AI merge produced a new proposal for ' + (tile.path || '(unknown)'), 'success');

            // Optionally reopen/update the review modal with the merged content
            if (opts.reopenModal && FP.reviewModal && typeof FP.reviewModal.show === 'function') {
                try {
                    FP.reviewModal.show(tile, -1, container);
                } catch (e) {
                    // best-effort only
                }
            }

            return {
                merged_content: merged,
                tile: tile,
                ai_response_text: res.ai_response_text || ''
            };
        } catch (e) {
            const msg = e && e.message ? e.message : 'Merge failed.';
            setPanelStatus(container, msg, 'error');
            throw e;
        }
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.merge = {
        mergeWithAI: mergeWithAI
    };
})();

    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }

    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        if (typeof FP.getState === 'function') {
            return FP.getState();

        return {
            tiles: [],
            aiRaw: '',
            running: false,
            mode: 'prompt',
            prompt: '',

    function wireDestinationControls(container) {
        const radios = container.querySelectorAll('input[name="aproPublishDestination"]');
        const ghFields = container.querySelector('#githubPublishFields');
        const remoteFields = container.querySelector('#remotePublishFields');
        const godaddyFields = container.querySelector('#godaddyPublishFields');
        const s = getState();

        function apply(val) {
            if (typeof FP.setPublishDestination === 'function') {
                FP.setPublishDestination(val);
            } else {
                if (val === 'github') s.publishDestination = 'github';
                else if (val === 'remote') s.publishDestination = 'remote';
                else if (val === 'godaddy') s.publishDestination = 'godaddy';
                else s.publishDestination = 'remote';
            }
            if (ghFields) ghFields.classList.toggle('is-hidden', s.publishDestination !== 'github');
            if (remoteFields) remoteFields.classList.toggle('is-hidden', s.publishDestination !== 'remote');
            if (godaddyFields) godaddyFields.classList.toggle('is-hidden', s.publishDestination !== 'godaddy');

            if (s.publishDestination === 'github' && Array.isArray(s.tiles) && s.tiles.length === 1) {
                if (FP.githubForm && typeof FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults === 'function') {
                    FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults(container, s.tiles[0]);
                }
            }
            if (FP.renderTiles && typeof FP.renderTiles.render === 'function') {
                try { FP.renderTiles.render(container); } catch (e) {}
            }
        }

        const remoteCfgBtn = container.querySelector('#remoteOpenConfigBtn');
        if (remoteCfgBtn) {
            remoteCfgBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal === 'function') {
                    window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal();
                }
            });
        }

        const godaddyRefreshBtn = container.querySelector('#godaddyRefreshAccountBtn');
        if (godaddyRefreshBtn) {
            godaddyRefreshBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const summary = container.querySelector('#godaddyPublishAccountSummary');
                const account = getSelectedGoDaddyAccount();
                if (!summary) return;
                if (!account) {
                    summary.innerHTML = 'No GoDaddy account selected.';
                } else {
                    summary.innerHTML = 'Selected account: <b>' + escapeHtml(account.label || account.username || 'GoDaddy Account') + '</b><br><span class="apro-github-help">Root: ' + escapeHtml(account.root_path || '/public_html') + '</span>';
                }
            });
        }

        radios.forEach(function (r) {
            r.addEventListener('change', function () {
                let v = 'remote';
                if (r.value === 'github') v = 'github';
                else if (r.value === 'remote') v = 'remote';
                else if (r.value === 'godaddy') v = 'godaddy';
                apply(v);
            });
        });
    }

    function refreshHeaderCopyButton() {
        if (FP.clipboard && typeof FP.clipboard._refreshHeaderButton === 'function') {
            try { FP.clipboard._refreshHeaderButton(); } catch (e) {}
        }
    }

    async function setTilesAndRender(container, tiles, actionsCtl, statusMessage, statusType) {
        const s = getState();
        s.tiles = Array.isArray(tiles) ? tiles.slice() : [];

        if (FP.tileHydration && typeof FP.tileHydration.hydrateTilesComparisonMetadata === 'function') {
            try { await FP.tileHydration.hydrateTilesComparisonMetadata(s.tiles); } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (FP.renderTiles && typeof FP.renderTiles.render === 'function') {
            FP.renderTiles.render(container);
        }

        if (s.publishDestination === 'github' && s.tiles.length === 1) {
            if (FP.githubForm && typeof FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults === 'function') {
                FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults(container, s.tiles[0]);
            }
        }

        if (actionsCtl && typeof actionsCtl.setTilesCount === 'function') {
            actionsCtl.setTilesCount(s.tiles.length);
        }

        refreshHeaderCopyButton();

        if (statusMessage) {
            setPanelStatus(container, statusMessage, statusType || '');
        } else {
            setPanelStatus(container, '', '');
        }
    }

            try { FP.githubForm.attachAutoSync(container); } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (FP.renderTiles && typeof FP.renderTiles.render === 'function') {
            try { FP.renderTiles.render(container); } catch (e) {}
        }

        let actionsCtl = null;

            const handlers = {
                onAnalyzePrompt: async function () {

                            ? 'AI analysis complete (fallback parser applied). Review proposed changes below.'
                            : 'AI analysis complete. Review proposed changes below.',

                    } catch (e) {

                    }

                    if (!FP.analyze || typeof FP.analyze.start !== 'function') {

                        return;
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {

                        await setTilesAndRender(container, res.tiles, actionsCtl, res.fallback_used
                            ? 'AI analysis complete (fallback parser applied). Review proposed changes below.'
                            : 'AI analysis complete. Review proposed changes below.',
                            'success');
                    } catch (e) {
                        setPanelStatus(container, String(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to analyze selected files.'), 'error');
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                },
                onAnalyzeBoth: async function () {
                    if (!FP.analyze || typeof FP.analyze.start !== 'function') {
                        setPanelStatus(container, 'Analyze module is not available.', 'error');
                        return;
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {
                        const res = await FP.analyze.start('both');
                        await setTilesAndRender(container, res.tiles, actionsCtl, res.fallback_used
                            ? 'AI analysis complete (fallback parser applied). Review proposed changes below.'
                            : 'AI analysis complete. Review proposed changes below.',
                            'success');
                    } catch (e) {
                        setPanelStatus(container, String(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to analyze via prompt + files.'), 'error');
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                },
                onGenerateFiles: async function () {
                    if (!FP.generate || typeof FP.generate.start !== 'function') {

                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {
                        const out = await FP.generate.start();
                        s.generateRaw = String(out.raw_ai_response || '');

                        s.generateWarnings = Array.isArray(out.warnings) ? out.warnings.slice() : [];
                        s.lastGenerationMeta = {
                            generation_id: String(out.generation_id || ''),
                            provider: String(out.provider || ''),

                        };

                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);

                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {
                        const out = await FP.createFromCurrent.generate();
                        const lines = [];

                            lines.push('<span style="color:#faa;">Errors: ' + out.errors.map(escapeHtml).join('; ') + '</span>');
                        }
                        await setTilesAndRender(container, out.tiles || [], actionsCtl, lines.join('<br>'), 'success');
                    } catch (e) {
                        setPanelStatus(container, String(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to create tiles from current files.'), 'error');
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);

                onCreateFromAiResponse: async function () {
                    if (!FP.createFromAiResponse || typeof FP.createFromAiResponse.generate !== 'function') {
                        setPanelStatus(container, 'Create-from-AI-response module is not available.', 'error');

                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {
                        const out = await FP.createFromAiResponse.generate();
                        await setTilesAndRender(container, out.tiles || [], actionsCtl, out.fallback_used
                            ? 'Tiles created from AI Response (fallback parser applied). Review below.'

                    } catch (e) {

                onClearAll: function () {
                    s.tiles = [];
                    s.generateRaw = '';
                    s.generateParseStatus = '';
                    s.generateWarnings = [];

                    refreshHeaderCopyButton();

                    if (!FP.approval || typeof FP.approval.unapproveAll !== 'function') {
                        setPanelStatus(container, 'Approval module is not available.', 'error');
                        return;
                    }
                    const res = FP.approval.unapproveAll(container);
                    refreshHeaderCopyButton();
                    return res;
                },
                onPublishApproved: async function () {
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(true);
                    try {
                        const dest = (typeof FP.getPublishDestination === 'function') ? FP.getPublishDestination() : (getState().publishDestination || 'remote');
                        if (dest === 'github') {
                            if (!FP.publishGithub || typeof FP.publishGithub.publishApproved !== 'function') {
                                setPanelStatus(container, 'GitHub publish module is not available.', 'error');
                                actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                                return;
                            }
                            await FP.publishGithub.publishApproved(container);
                        } else if (dest === 'remote') {
                            if (!window.APRO_PUBLISH_SERVER || typeof window.APRO_PUBLISH_SERVER.publish !== 'function') {
                                setPanelStatus(container, 'Remote publish module is not available.', 'error');
                                actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                                return;

                            setPanelStatus(container, 'Packaging and deploying approved tiles to Remote Server...', '');

                            if (!FP.publishGoDaddy || typeof FP.publishGoDaddy.publishApproved !== 'function') {
                                setPanelStatus(container, 'GoDaddy publish module is not available.', 'error');
                                actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                                return;
                            }
                            await FP.publishGoDaddy.publishApproved(container);
                        } else {
                            throw new Error('Unsupported destination: ' + dest);
                        }
                        refreshHeaderCopyButton();

                        setPanelStatus(container, String(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Publish failed.'), 'error');
                    }
                    actionsCtl && actionsCtl.setBusy(false);
                }
            };

            actionsCtl = FP.actions.mount(container, handlers, { enableAiResponseButton: true });
            if (actionsCtl && typeof actionsCtl.setTilesCount === 'function') {
                actionsCtl.setTilesCount(Array.isArray(s.tiles) ? s.tiles.length : 0);

        } else {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Action bar module is not available.', 'error');
        }

        setPanelStatus(container, '', '');
        refreshHeaderCopyButton();

    // GitHub publish helpers for the Publishable Files panel.
    //
    // Export:
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.publishGithub.publishFilesToGithub(tile, container) -> Promise<result>
    //   window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.publishGithub.publishApproved(container) -> Promise<result[]|{published,skipped,errors}>
    //
    // Notes:
    //   - Uses APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubPublish and githubPublishBulk under the hood
    //   - Batches bulk payloads and retries on HTTP 413 by splitting or falling back to single-file publish

            ? FP.getState()
            : { tiles: [], githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main' } };
    }

    function setPanelStatus(container, message, type) {
        try {
            const el = container && container.querySelector ? container.querySelector('#filePublishPanelStatus') : document.getElementById('filePublishPanelStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.innerHTML = message ? String(message) : '';
                el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
                if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
                if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message || '', type || '');
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(new RegExp('[&<>' + String.fromCharCode(34) + String.fromCharCode(39) + ']', 'g'), function (char) {
            if (char === '&') return '&amp;';
            if (char === '<') return '&lt;';
            if (char === '>') return '&gt;';
            if (char === String.fromCharCode(34)) return '&quot;';
            if (char === String.fromCharCode(39)) return '&#39;';
            return char;
        });
    }

    function getUtils() {
        const U = FP.utils || {};
        const chunker = (typeof U.chunkFilesBySize === 'function')
            ? U.chunkFilesBySize
            : function (files, maxBytes) {
                const arr = Array.isArray(files) ? files.slice() : [];
                const limit = Number(maxBytes);
                if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) return arr.length ? [arr] : [];
                const chunks = [];
                let cur = [];
                let curBytes = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
                    const f = arr[i] || {};
                    const fBytes = (typeof f.content === 'string' ? f.content.length : 0) + 256;
                    if (cur.length > 0 && (curBytes + fBytes) > limit) {
                        chunks.push(cur);
                        cur = [];
                        curBytes = 0;
                    }
                    cur.push(f);
                    curBytes += fBytes;
                }

        }

            const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubPublish(

                payload.repo,
                payload.branch,
                payload.path,
                payload.content,
                payload.encoding,
                payload.commit_message

            const msg = [
                'GitHub publish succeeded:',
                '<br><code>' + escapeHtml(res.owner + '/' + res.repo) + '</code> @ <code>' + escapeHtml(res.branch) + '</code>',

('<br><a href=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + escapeHtml(res.commit_url) + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' target=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '_blank' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' rel=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'noopener noreferrer' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '>View Commit</a>') : '')
            ].join('');

            vals.owner,
            vals.repo,
            vals.branch,

        );

'<br><a href=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + escapeHtml(res.commit_url) + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' target=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '_blank' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' rel=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'noopener noreferrer' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '>View Commit</a>' : ''), 'success');

        const s = getState();
        const approved = Array.isArray(s.tiles)
            ? s.tiles.filter(function (t) { return !!t.approved; })
            : [];

        if (!approved.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No approved files to publish.', 'error');
            return { published: [], skipped: [], errors: [] };
        }

        const vals = readGithubForm(container);
        ensureGithubCoordinates(vals);
        if (!vals.commit_message) {
            vals.commit_message = 'APRO bulk publish (' + approved.length + ' file' + (approved.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ')';
        }

        const files = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < approved.length; i += 1) {
            const entry = normalizeTileToBulkEntry(approved[i]);
            if (entry) files.push(entry);

        if (!files.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No files could be prepared for GitHub publish.', 'error');

        const chunkFilesBySize = getUtils().chunkFilesBySize;
        const MAX_BATCH_BYTES = 900000;
        let batches = chunkFilesBySize(files, MAX_BATCH_BYTES);

            let committed = false;

            while (!committed) {
                try {
                    const suffix = batches.length > 1 ? (' [batch ' + (i + 1) + '/' + batches.length + ']') : '';
                    setPanelStatus(container, 'Publishing batch ' + (i + 1) + '/' + batches.length + ' (' + batch.length + ' files)...', '');

                        vals.owner,
                        vals.repo,
                        vals.branch,

                        const singleRes = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubPublish(
                            vals.owner,

                            vals.branch,
                            single.path,

                            normalizeEncoding(single.encoding),

                        results.push(singleRes);
                        if (singleRes && singleRes.commit_url) commitLinks.push(singleRes.commit_url);
                        committed = true;
                    } else {
                        const mid = Math.max(1, Math.floor(batch.length / 2));
                        const left = batch.slice(0, mid);
                        const right = batch.slice(mid);
                        batches.splice(i, 1, left);
                        batches.splice(i + 1, 0, right);
                        batch = left;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        approved.forEach(function (tile) {
            tile.reviewed = true;
        });

        if (FP.renderTiles && typeof FP.renderTiles.render === 'function') {
            try { FP.renderTiles.render(container || document); } catch (e) {}
        }

        let message = 'GitHub publish completed in ' + results.length + ' commit' + (results.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + '.';
        if (commitLinks.length) {
            message += '<br>' + commitLinks.map(function (url) {
                return '<a href=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + escapeHtml(url) + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' target=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '_blank' + String.fromCharCode(34) + ' rel=' + String.fromCharCode(34) + 'noopener noreferrer' + String.fromCharCode(34) + '>View commit</a>';
            }).join('<br>');
        }
        setPanelStatus(container, message, 'success');

        return results;
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.publishGithub = {
        publishFilesToGithub: publishFilesToGithub,
        publishApproved: publishApproved
    };
})();

    }

    function normalizeEncoding(value) {
        return String(value || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text';
    }
