        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
        }
        return null;
    }

    function normalizeToFileSpec(item) {
        if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
            return null;
        }

        const path = String(item.path || item.target_path || '').trim();
        const target = String(item.target_path || path || '').trim();

        if (!path || !target) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            path: path,
            target_path: target,
            operation: normalizeOperation(item.operation),
            content: String(item.content || ''),
            encoding: normalizeEncoding(item.encoding)
        };
    }

    function normalizeToFiles(tilesOrFiles) {
        const arr = Array.isArray(tilesOrFiles) ? tilesOrFiles : (tilesOrFiles ? [tilesOrFiles] : []);
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
            const f = normalizeToFileSpec(arr[i]);
            if (f) out.push(f);
        }
        return out;
    }

    function markPublishedTilesReviewed(files, container) {
        try {
            const s = getState();
            if (!Array.isArray(s.tiles)) return;

            const byTarget = Object.create(null);
            files.forEach(function (f) {
                byTarget[String(f.target_path || f.path || '')] = true;
            });

            s.tiles.forEach(function (t) {
                const tgt = String((t.target_path && String(t.target_path).trim()) ? t.target_path : t.path || '');

        const lines = [];

        if (published.length) {
            lines.push('Published:<br>' + published.map(function (p) {
                const parts = [];
                parts.push('<code>' + escapeHtml(String(p.path || '')) + '</code>');
                parts.push('(' + escapeHtml(String(p.operation || '')) + ')');
                if (p.created) parts.push('created');
                if (p.overwrote_existing) parts.push('overwrote existing');

        }

        }

        const files = normalizeToFiles(tilesOrFiles);
        if (!files.length) {
            throw new Error('No files to publish.');
        }

        setPanelStatus(container, 'Publishing file(s) to GoDaddy shared hosting...', '');

        try {
            const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.godaddyPublish({
                action: files.length > 1 ? 'publish_bulk' : 'publish',
                base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),
                username: String(cfg.username || '').trim(),
                api_token: String(cfg.api_token || '').trim(),
                insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                files: files
            });
            markPublishedTilesReviewed(files, container);
            setPanelStatus(container, summarizeResult(res), (Array.isArray(res.errors) && res.errors.length) ? 'error' : 'success');
            return res;
        } catch (e) {
            const msg = e && e.message ? e.message : 'GoDaddy publish failed.';
            setPanelStatus(container, msg, 'error');
            throw e;
        }
    }

    async function publishApproved(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const approved = Array.isArray(s.tiles)
            ? s.tiles.filter(function (t) { return !!t.approved; })
            : [];

        if (!approved.length) {
            setPanelStatus(container, 'No approved files to publish.', 'error');
            return { published: [], skipped: [], errors: [] };
        }

        return publishFiles(approved, container);
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.publishGoDaddy = {
        publishFiles: publishFiles,
        publishApproved: publishApproved
    };
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/renderTiles.js
(function () {
    // filePublish/renderTiles.js
    // Renders the Publishable Files tiles list and per-tile controls.
    // Dependencies:
    //   - window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getState() from state.js
    //   - window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.utils.{escapeHtml, formatFileStats}
    //   - window.APRO_API.viewFile (local current-file fetch)
    //   - window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile (GitHub current-file fetch)
    //
    // Optional (if present, preferred):
    //   - window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.reviewModal.show(tile, idx, container)
    //   - window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.tileHydration.fetchFileSizes(tile, sizeDiv) for DOM hydration
    //
    // Notes:
    //   - This module includes a minimal fallback hydration path. If tileHydration.js is present,
    //     it will handle Local/GitHub/Remote comparisons and DOM updates (including "Current (Remote)").

    if (!window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH) {
        window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = {};
    }

    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;
    const U = (FP.utils || {});
    const escapeHtml = typeof U.escapeHtml === 'function'
        ? U.escapeHtml
        : function (text) {
            return String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
                return ({
                    '&': '&amp;',
                    '<': '&lt;',
                    '>': '&gt;',
                    '"': '&quot;',
                    "'": '&#39;'
                })[char];
            });
        };
    const formatFileStats = typeof U.formatFileStats === 'function'
        ? U.formatFileStats
        : function (bytes, lines) {
            const n = Number(bytes || 0);
            const kb = (n / 1024);
            const kbText = kb.toFixed(2);
            const parts = [];
            parts.push(String(n) + ' bytes (' + kbText + ' KB)');
            if (typeof lines === 'number' && isFinite(lines)) {
                parts.push(String(lines) + ' lines');
            }
            return parts.join(', ');
        };

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function') ? FP.getState() : {
            tiles: [],
            publishDestination: 'server',
            githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main' }
        };
    }

    function isPublishToGithub() {
        const s = getState();
        return (s.publishDestination === 'github');
    }

    function isPublishToRemote() {
        const s = getState();
        return (s.publishDestination === 'remote');
    }

    function applyGithubDefaultsIfSingle(container) {
        try {
            if (!FP.githubForm || typeof FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults !== 'function') return;
            const s = getState();
            if (s.publishDestination === 'github' && s.tiles.length === 1) {
                FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults(container, s.tiles[0]);
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function renderTiles(container) {
        const s = getState();
        const tilesDiv = container.querySelector('#filePublishTiles');
        if (!tilesDiv) {
            return;
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(s.tiles) || s.tiles.length === 0) {
            tilesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">No publishable files. Run analysis or create tiles from current files.</div>';
            return;
        }

        tilesDiv.innerHTML = '';
        s.tiles.forEach(function (tile, idx) {
            const el = renderTile(tile, idx, container);
            tilesDiv.appendChild(el);

            // Post-render warning: replacement far smaller than original (only when we have both sizes)
            setTimeout(function () {
                try {
                    if (tile.operation === 'REPLACE' && tile._original && typeof tile._replace_size === 'number') {
                        const origSize = Number(tile._original.size_bytes || 0);
                        const replSize = Number(tile._replace_size || 0);
                        if (origSize > 0 && replSize < 0.8 * origSize) {
                            if (!el.querySelector('.tile-short-warning')) {
                                const badge = document.createElement('div');
                                badge.className = 'tile-short-warning';
                                badge.style.color = '#c83';
                                badge.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                                badge.style.marginTop = '4px';
                                badge.style.fontSize = '13px';
                                badge.textContent = 'Warning: Replacement file is much smaller than the original!';
                                el.appendChild(badge);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }, 100);
        });

        applyGithubDefaultsIfSingle(container);
    }

    function renderTile(tile, idx, container) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'analysis-tile analysis-tile-done filepublish-tile';

        // Header with path and remove
        const head = document.createElement('div');
        head.className = 'tile-head';
        head.innerHTML = '<span class="tile-path">' + escapeHtml(tile.path || '') + '</span>';
        const removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
        removeBtn.type = 'button';
        removeBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button tile-remove-btn';
        removeBtn.textContent = '×';
        removeBtn.title = 'Remove from view';
        removeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            const s = getState();
            s.tiles = s.tiles.filter(function (_t, j) { return j !== idx; });
            renderTiles(container);
        });
        head.appendChild(removeBtn);
        div.appendChild(head);

        // Editable operation selector (+ binary tag)
        const opDiv = document.createElement('div');
        const isBinary = (String(tile.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64');

        const opLabel = document.createElement('label');
        opLabel.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        opLabel.style.alignItems = 'center';
        opLabel.style.gap = '8px';
        opLabel.style.fontWeight = '700';
        opLabel.innerHTML = '<span>Operation:</span>';

        const opSelect = document.createElement('select');
        opSelect.style.borderRadius = '7px';
        opSelect.style.padding = '4px 8px';
        opSelect.style.background = 'var(--panel-2)';
        opSelect.style.color = 'var(--text)';
        opSelect.style.border = '1px solid var(--border)';

        ['ADD', 'REPLACE'].forEach(function (op) {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = op;
            opt.textContent = op;
            if (String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase() === op) {
                opt.selected = true;
            }
            opSelect.appendChild(opt);
        });

        opSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
            tile.operation = opSelect.value;

            if (FP.tileHydration && typeof FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata === 'function') {
                FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile)
                    .then(function () {
                        renderTiles(container);
                    })
                    .catch(function () {
                        renderTiles(container);
                    });
            } else {
                renderTiles(container);
            }
        });

        opLabel.appendChild(opSelect);
        opDiv.appendChild(opLabel);

        if (isBinary) {
            const binaryBadge = document.createElement('span');
            binaryBadge.style.marginLeft = '8px';
            binaryBadge.style.padding = '2px 6px';
            binaryBadge.style.borderRadius = '6px';
            binaryBadge.style.background = '#332d1a';
            binaryBadge.style.color = '#facc15';
            binaryBadge.style.fontSize = '12px';
            binaryBadge.textContent = 'binary';
            opDiv.appendChild(binaryBadge);
        }

        div.appendChild(opDiv);

        // Target path editor
        const pathEdit = document.createElement('div');
        pathEdit.className = 'tile-dest-edit';
        pathEdit.style.margin = '6px 0 2px';
        const initialTarget = (tile.target_path && String(tile.target_path).trim()) ? tile.target_path : (tile.path || '');
        pathEdit.innerHTML = '<label style="font-size:12px;color:#cbd5e1;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">Local dest path <input type="text" style="min-width:280px;" value="' + escapeHtml(initialTarget) + '"></label>';
        const input = pathEdit.querySelector('input');
        input.addEventListener('input', function () {
            tile.target_path = String(input.value || '').trim();
        });
        div.appendChild(pathEdit);

        // Size stats/hydration
        const sizeDiv = document.createElement('div');
        sizeDiv.className = 'tile-file-sizes';
        sizeDiv.textContent = 'Loading file sizes...';
        div.appendChild(sizeDiv);

        // Prefer external hydrator if available (supports Local/GitHub/Remote)
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.tileHydration && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.tileHydration.fetchFileSizes === 'function') {
            try {
                window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.tileHydration.fetchFileSizes(tile, sizeDiv);
            } catch (e) {
                // Fallback below
                minimalHydration(tile, sizeDiv);
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback if tileHydration not loaded
            minimalHydration(tile, sizeDiv);
        }

        // GitHub current target (if present)
        if (tile.github && (tile.github.owner || tile.github.repo || tile.github.path)) {
            const ghDiv = document.createElement('div');
            ghDiv.className = 'tile-github-meta';
            ghDiv.innerHTML = '<b>GitHub target:</b> ' + escapeHtml((tile.github.owner || '') + '/' + (tile.github.repo || '') + ' @ ' + (tile.github.branch || 'main') + ' → ' + (tile.github.path || ''));
            div.appendChild(ghDiv);
        }

        // Actions: Review, Approve, Mark Reviewed
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'tile-actions';

        const reviewBtn = document.createElement('button');
        reviewBtn.type = 'button';
        reviewBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button tile-analyze-btn';
        reviewBtn.textContent = 'View & Review';
        reviewBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            openReview(tile, idx, container);
        });
        actions.appendChild(reviewBtn);

        const approveBtn = document.createElement('button');
        approveBtn.type = 'button';
        approveBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
        approveBtn.textContent = tile.approved ? 'Approved' : 'Approve';
        approveBtn.disabled = !!tile.approved;
        approveBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            tile.approved = true;
            renderTiles(container);
        });
        actions.appendChild(approveBtn);

        const markReviewedBtn = document.createElement('button');
        markReviewedBtn.type = 'button';
        markReviewedBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
        markReviewedBtn.textContent = tile.reviewed ? 'Reviewed' : 'Mark as Reviewed';
        markReviewedBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            tile.reviewed = true;
            renderTiles(container);
        });
        actions.appendChild(markReviewedBtn);

        div.appendChild(actions);

        // Identical note + truncated note
        if (tile._identical) {
            const warn = document.createElement('div');
            warn.style.color = '#daa';
            const destLabel = isPublishToGithub() ? 'GitHub target' : (isPublishToRemote() ? 'Remote target' : 'local file');
            warn.textContent = 'No changes detected against ' + destLabel + '; you may still approve/publish if you want.';
            div.appendChild(warn);
        }
        if (tile._original && tile._original.truncated) {
            const tr = document.createElement('div');
            tr.style.color = '#faa';
            tr.textContent = '(Current file content truncated in size stats)';
            div.appendChild(tr);
        }

        return div;
    }

    // Minimal hydration (current vs replacement) if tileHydration is not available.
    function minimalHydration(tile, sizeDiv) {

            tile._replace_size = c.length;

            sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<strong>Replacement:</strong> ' + formatFileStats(tile._replace_size, tile._replace_lines);
            tile._identical = false;
        }

        const op = String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase();
        if (op !== 'REPLACE') {

            return;
        }

        const toGithub = isPublishToGithub();
        const toRemote = isPublishToRemote();
        const enc = String(tile.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase();
        const replContent = String(tile.content || '');

        function finalizeWithOriginal(orig) {
            tile._original = orig;
            tile._replace_size = replContent.length;
            tile._replace_lines = (enc === 'base64') ? null : ((replContent.match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1);

            if ((enc === 'base64') && (orig.encoding === 'base64')) {
                tile._identical = (String(orig.content || '') === String(replContent || ''));
            } else if ((enc !== 'base64') && (orig.encoding !== 'base64')) {
                tile._identical = (String(orig.content || '') === String(replContent || ''));
            } else {
                tile._identical = false;
            }

            const label = toGithub ? 'Current (GitHub): ' : (toRemote ? 'Current (Remote): ' : 'Current (Local): ');
            const curStats = formatFileStats(orig.size_bytes, orig.line_count);
            const repStats = formatFileStats(tile._replace_size, tile._replace_lines);
            sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong>' + curStats + '<br><strong>Replacement:</strong> ' + repStats;
        }

        if (toGithub) {
            const s = getState();
            const gh = Object.assign({
                owner: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.owner) || '',
                repo: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.repo) || '',
                branch: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.branch) || 'main',
                path: tile.path || ''
            }, (tile.github || {}));

            if (!gh.owner || !gh.repo || !gh.branch || !gh.path) {
                setReplaceOnly();
                sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#faa;">(GitHub target not set; skipping current-file comparison)</span><br>' + sizeDiv.innerHTML;
                return;
            }

            const fetchGh = (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile === 'function')
                ? window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile
                : function (owner, repo, branch, path) { return window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(owner, repo, branch, path); };

            fetchGh(gh.owner, gh.repo, gh.branch, gh.path)
                .then(function (data) {
                    const orig = {
                        content: String(data.content || ''),
                        size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
                        line_count: (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null,
                        truncated: !!data.truncated,
                        encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
                        source: 'github'
                    };
                    finalizeWithOriginal(orig);
                })
                .catch(function () {
                    setReplaceOnly();
                    sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#faa;">(GitHub current file not found or could not be loaded)</span><br>' + sizeDiv.innerHTML;
                });
            return;
        }

        // Remote and Local fallbacks: For Remote we cannot fetch content here; tileHydration (if present) does it.
        // Without tileHydration, fall back to Local file stats only.
        window.APRO_API.viewFile(tile.path)
            .then(function (data) {
                if (data.exists === false) {
                    setReplaceOnly();
                    const note = toRemote ? '(Remote comparison unavailable; local file missing)' : '(Current local file is missing)';
                    sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#faa;">' + note + '</span><br>' + sizeDiv.innerHTML;
                    tile._identical = false;
                    return;
                }
                const orig = {
                    content: String(data.content || ''),
                    size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
                    line_count: (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null,
                    truncated: !!data.truncated,
                    encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
                    source: 'local'
                };
                finalizeWithOriginal(orig);
            })
            .catch(function () {
                setReplaceOnly();
                const note = toRemote ? '(Remote comparison unavailable)' : '(Failed to load current local file or stats)';
                sizeDiv.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#faa;">' + note + '</span><br>' + sizeDiv.innerHTML;
                tile._identical = false;
            });
    }

    function openReview(tile, idx, container) {
        // If a dedicated review modal module is present, use it
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.reviewModal && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.reviewModal.show === 'function') {
            try {
                window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.reviewModal.show(tile, idx, container);
                return;
            } catch (e) {
                // fall through to fallback
            }
        }

        // Fallback: show the proposed content using File Viewer (no diff)
        try {
            if (window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                const payload = {
                    path: tile.target_path || tile.path || '(proposed)',
                    size_bytes: String(tile.content || '').length,
                    content: String(tile.content || ''),
                    encoding: String(tile.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'text',
                    truncated: false,
                    line_count: (String(tile.encoding || 'text') === 'base64') ? null : ((String(tile.content || '').match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1),
                    exists: false
                };
                window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(payload);
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        // Last-resort extremely minimal review
        alert('Proposed content for ' + (tile.path || '(unknown)') + ':\n\n' +
            (String(tile.encoding || 'text') === 'base64'
                ? '[binary/base64 content omitted from inline preview]'
                : String(tile.content || '').slice(0, 2000)));
    }

    // Export namespace
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.renderTiles = {
        render: renderTiles,
        renderTile: renderTile
    };

(function () {
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH || {};
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;

    function getState() {
        return (typeof FP.getState === 'function')
            ? FP.getState()
            : { publishDestination: 'server', githubDefaults: {} };
    }

    function getServiceIdFromUI() {
        const el = document.getElementById('serviceId');
        return el ? String(el.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[&<>']/g, function (char) {
            return ({
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                "'": '&#39;'
            })[char];
        }).replace(new RegExp(String.fromCharCode(34), 'g'), '&quot;');
    }

    function formatFileStats(bytes, lines) {
        if (FP.utils && typeof FP.utils.formatFileStats === 'function') {
            return FP.utils.formatFileStats(bytes, lines);
        }
        const n = Number(bytes || 0);
        const kb = (n / 1024).toFixed(2);
        const parts = [];
        parts.push(String(n) + ' bytes (' + kb + ' KB)');
        if (typeof lines === 'number' && isFinite(lines)) {
            parts.push(String(lines) + ' lines');
        }
        return parts.join(', ');
    }

    function stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text) {
        if (FP && typeof FP.stripMarkdownCodeBlock === 'function') {
            return FP.stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text);
        }
        text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
        if (!text) return '';
        text = text.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '');
        text = text.replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '');
        return text.trim();
    }

    function setPanelStatus(container, message, type) {
        try {
            const el = (container && container.querySelector)
                ? container.querySelector('#filePublishPanelStatus')
                : document.getElementById('filePublishPanelStatus');
            if (el) {
                el.innerHTML = message ? String(message) : '';
                el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
                if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
                if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
                return;
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message || '', type || '');
        }
    }

    function ensureModal() {
        let modal = document.getElementById('filePublishReviewModal');
        if (modal) return modal;

        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'filePublishReviewModal';

        const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
        backdrop.className = 'apro-modal-backdrop';
        modal.appendChild(backdrop);

        const content = document.createElement('div');
        content.className = 'apro-modal-content';
        content.style.maxWidth = '980px';
        modal.appendChild(content);

        header.className = 'apro-modal-header';

        const title = document.createElement('h3');
        title.textContent = 'Review & Diff File';
        header.appendChild(title);

        const body = document.createElement('div');
        body.className = 'apro-modal-body';

        const bodyContent = document.createElement('div');
        bodyContent.id = 'filePublishModalContent';

        footer.className = 'apro-modal-footer';
        footer.id = 'filePublishModalFooter';

    function getGithubFetcher() {
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile;
        }
        return function (owner, repo, branch, path) {
            return window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(owner, repo, branch, path);

    }

    function getRemoteTarget(tile) {
        const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function'
            ? window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig()
            : null;
        const raw = String((tile && tile.target_path) ? tile.target_path : ((tile && tile.path) || '')).trim();

        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath === 'function') {
            try {
                return window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath(raw, cfg);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

    }

        }
        return null;
    }

    function originalMetaFromTile(tile) {
        if (!tile || !tile._original) return '';
        const source = tile._original.source ? ' (' + tile._original.source + ')' : '';
        return formatFileStats(tile._original.size_bytes, tile._original.line_count) + source;
    }

    async function loadCurrentForTile(tile) {
        const dest = (getState().publishDestination || 'server');
        const publishToGithub = (dest === 'github');
        const publishToRemote = (dest === 'remote');
        const publishToGoDaddy = (dest === 'godaddy');
        const op = String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase();

        if (op !== 'REPLACE') {
            return {
                leftContent: '',
                leftMeta: publishToGithub
                    ? '(No current file on GitHub; new ADD)'
                    : (publishToRemote
                        ? '(No current file on Remote; new ADD)'
                        : (publishToGoDaddy ? '(No current file on GoDaddy; new ADD)' : '(No current file; new ADD)')),
                encoding: 'text'
            };
        }

        try {
            if (FP.tileHydration && typeof FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata === 'function') {
                await FP.tileHydration.hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile);
            }
            if (tile._original) {
                return {
                    leftContent: String(tile._original.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? '[Binary content preview unavailable]' : String(tile._original.content || ''),
                    leftMeta: originalMetaFromTile(tile),
                    encoding: tile._original.encoding || 'text'
                };
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
            if (publishToGithub) {
                const s = getState();
                const gh = Object.assign({
                    owner: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.owner) || '',

                    branch: (s.githubDefaults && s.githubDefaults.branch) || 'main',
                    path: tile.path || ''
                }, (tile.github || {}));

                if (!gh.owner || !gh.repo || !gh.branch || !gh.path) {
                    return { leftContent: '(GitHub target not set; cannot show current)', leftMeta: '', encoding: 'text' };
                }

                const data = await getGithubFetcher()(gh.owner, gh.repo, gh.branch, gh.path);
                return {
                    leftContent: String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? '[Binary content preview unavailable]' : String(data.content || ''),
                    leftMeta: 'Size: ' + formatFileStats(Number(data.size_bytes || 0), (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null) + ' (GitHub' + (String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? ', binary' : '') + ')',
                    encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text')
                };
            }

            if (publishToRemote) {
                const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig();
                if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key) {

                });

                if (data && data.exists === false) {

                }

                return {
                    leftContent: String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? '[Binary content preview unavailable]' : String(data.content || ''),
                    leftMeta: 'Size: ' + formatFileStats(Number(data.size_bytes || 0), (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null) + ' (Remote' + (String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? ', binary' : '') + ')',
                    encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text')
                };
            }

            if (publishToGoDaddy) {
                const cfg = getGoDaddyConfig();
                if (!cfg || !cfg.base_url || !cfg.username || !cfg.api_token) {
                    return { leftContent: '(GoDaddy account not configured; cannot show current)', leftMeta: '', encoding: 'text' };
                }

                const target = String(tile.target_path || tile.path || '').trim();
                const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyFile({
                    base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),

                if (data && data.exists === false) {

                }

                return {
                    leftContent: String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? '[Binary content preview unavailable]' : String(data.content || ''),
                    leftMeta: 'Size: ' + formatFileStats(Number(data.size_bytes || 0), (typeof data.line_count === 'number') ? data.line_count : null) + ' (GoDaddy' + (String(data.encoding || 'text') === 'base64' ? ', binary' : '') + ')',
                    encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text')

    async function publishTile(tile, container, publishToGitHub, publishToRemote, publishToGoDaddy) {
        if (publishToRemote) {
            if (!window.APRO_PUBLISH_SERVER || typeof window.APRO_PUBLISH_SERVER.publish !== 'function') {
                throw new Error('Remote publish module is not available.');
            }
            tile.approved = true;
            setPanelStatus(container, 'Packaging and deploying approved tiles to Remote Server...', '');
            await window.APRO_PUBLISH_SERVER.publish();

        }

        if (publishToGoDaddy) {
            if (FP.publishGoDaddy && typeof FP.publishGoDaddy.publishFiles === 'function') {

                tile.reviewed = true;
                return;
            }

            if (!FP.githubForm || typeof FP.githubForm.collectPublishPayload !== 'function') {
                throw new Error('GitHub publish module is not available.');
            }

            if (typeof FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults === 'function') {
                FP.githubForm.applyTileDefaults(container, tile);
            }

            const ghPayload = FP.githubForm.collectPublishPayload(container, tile);
            const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubPublish(

                ghPayload.content,

            );

            tile.reviewed = true;

                '<code>' + escapeHtml(res.owner + '/' + res.repo) + '</code> @ <code>' + escapeHtml(res.branch) + '</code><br>' +
                'Target: <code>' + escapeHtml(res.path) + '</code><br>' +
                (res.commit_url ? ('<a href="' + escapeHtml(res.commit_url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View Commit</a>') : ''),
                'success'
            );
            return;
        }

        if (FP.publishLocal && typeof FP.publishLocal.publishFiles === 'function') {
            await FP.publishLocal.publishFiles([tile], container);
            tile.reviewed = true;
            return;
        }

        const filesOut = [{
            path: tile.path,
            target_path: (tile.target_path && String(tile.target_path).trim()) ? String(tile.target_path).trim() : tile.path,
            operation: String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase() === 'ADD' ? 'ADD' : 'REPLACE',
            content: String(tile.content || ''),
            encoding: (String(tile.encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64') ? 'base64' : 'text'
        }];

        const res = await window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.commit(filesOut);
        tile.reviewed = true;

        const lines = [];
        if (Array.isArray(res.published) && res.published.length) {
            lines.push('Published:<br>' + res.published.map(function (f) {
                return '<code>' + escapeHtml(f.path) + '</code> (' + escapeHtml(f.operation) + ')';
            }).join(', '));
        }
        if (Array.isArray(res.skipped) && res.skipped.length) {
            lines.push('Skipped:<br>' + res.skipped.map(function (f) {
                return '<code>' + escapeHtml(f.path) + '</code> (' + escapeHtml(f.reason) + ')';
            }).join(', '));
        }
        if (Array.isArray(res.errors) && res.errors.length) {
            lines.push('<span style="color:#faa;">Errors:<br>' +
                res.errors.map(function (e) {
                    return '<code>' + escapeHtml(e.path) + '</code>: ' + escapeHtml(e.message);
                }).join('<br>') + '</span>');
        }

        setPanelStatus(
            container,
            lines.join('<br>') || 'Publish complete.',
            (Array.isArray(res.errors) && res.errors.length) ? 'error' : 'success'
        );
    }

        show: show

(function () {
    const DEFAULT_DEST = '/';
    const DEFAULT_BROWSE = '/';
    const LS_KEYS = {url:'apro_remote_server_url',key:'apro_remote_server_api_key',insecure:'apro_remote_server_insecure',dest:'apro_remote_dest_path',browse:'apro_remote_browse_root'};

    function slash(value) {
        let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');
        while (s.indexOf('//') !== -1) s = s.split('//').join('/');
        return s;
    }

    function hasTraversal(path) {
        return slash(path).split('/').some(function (part) { return part === '..'; });
    }

    function cleanAbsolute(path, fallback) {
        let p = slash(path);
        const fb = fallback == null ? '/' : fallback;
        if (!p) p = fb;
        if (!p) p = '/';
        if (p.charAt(0) !== '/') p = '/' + p.replace(/^\/+/, '');
        while (p.indexOf('//') !== -1) p = p.split('//').join('/');
        if (hasTraversal(p)) p = fb || '/';
        if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) p = p.slice(0, -1);
        return p || fb || '/';
    }

    function getStored(key, fallback) {
        try {
            const v = localStorage.getItem(key);
            return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' ? fallback : v;
        } catch (e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    function getConfig() {
        return {
            server_url: String(getStored(LS_KEYS.url, '') || '').trim(),
            api_key: String(getStored(LS_KEYS.key, '') || '').trim(),
            insecure: getStored(LS_KEYS.insecure, '0') === '1',
            dest_path: cleanAbsolute(getStored(LS_KEYS.dest, DEFAULT_DEST), DEFAULT_DEST),
            browse_root: cleanAbsolute(getStored(LS_KEYS.browse, DEFAULT_BROWSE), DEFAULT_BROWSE)
        };
    }

    function setConfig(cfg) {
        cfg = cfg || {};
        try {
            if (cfg.server_url !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.url, String(cfg.server_url || '').trim());
            if (cfg.api_key !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.key, String(cfg.api_key || '').trim());
            if (cfg.insecure !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.insecure, cfg.insecure ? '1' : '0');
            if (cfg.dest_path !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.dest, cleanAbsolute(cfg.dest_path, DEFAULT_DEST));
            if (cfg.browse_root !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.browse, cleanAbsolute(cfg.browse_root, DEFAULT_BROWSE));
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function joinUnder(base, rel) {
        const b = cleanAbsolute(base, DEFAULT_DEST);
        const r = slash(rel).replace(/^\/+/, '');
        if (!r) return b;
        return b === '/' ? '/' + r : b + '/' + r;
    }

    function resolveRemoteTargetPath(path, cfg) {
        cfg = cfg || getConfig();
        const dest = cleanAbsolute(cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_DEST, DEFAULT_DEST);
        const raw = slash(path);
        if (raw === '') return dest;
        if (raw.charAt(0) === '/') return cleanAbsolute(raw, '/');
        return cleanAbsolute(joinUnder(dest, raw), dest);
    }

    function pathRelativeToDest(path, cfg) {
        cfg = cfg || getConfig();
        const dest = cleanAbsolute(cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_DEST, DEFAULT_DEST);
        const full = resolveRemoteTargetPath(path, cfg);
        if (full === dest) return '';
        if (dest !== '/' && full.indexOf(dest + '/') === 0) return full.slice(dest.length + 1);
        return full.replace(/^\/+/, '');
    }

    function ensureModal() {
        let modal = document.getElementById('aproServerConfigModal');
        if (modal) return modal;
        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'aproServerConfigModal';
        modal.className = 'apro-modal';
        modal.innerHTML = `<div class='apro-modal-backdrop'></div><div class='apro-modal-content' style='max-width:560px'><div class='apro-modal-header'><h3>Remote Server Connection</h3></div><div class='apro-modal-body' style='display:grid;gap:10px;'><div class='apro-field'><label>Server URL</label><input type='text' id='aproServerUrl' placeholder='https://example.com'></div><div class='apro-field'><label>API Key (X-System-Api-Key)</label><input type='password' id='aproServerApiKey' autocomplete='new-password'></div><div class='apro-field'><label>Destination Root for relative publish paths</label><input type='text' id='aproServerDest' placeholder='/'></div><div class='apro-field'><label>Browse Root</label><input type='text' id='aproServerBrowseRoot' placeholder='/'></div><label style='display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;opacity:.9;'><input type='checkbox' id='aproServerInsecure'> Allow self-signed TLS</label><div id='aproServerCfgStatus' class='apro-status' style='min-height:28px'></div></div><div class='apro-modal-footer'><button type='button' id='aproServerTestBtn' class='apro-mini-button'>Test & Save</button><button type='button' id='aproServerCloseBtn' class='apro-primary-button'>Close</button></div></div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        modal.querySelector('.apro-modal-backdrop').addEventListener('click', function () { modal.style.display = 'none'; });
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', function () { modal.style.display = 'none'; });
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerTestBtn').addEventListener('click', onTestAndSave);
        return modal;
    }

    function writeStatus(text, type) {
        const el = document.getElementById('aproServerCfgStatus');
        if (!el) return;
        el.innerHTML = text ? String(text) : '';
        el.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        if (type === 'error') el.classList.add('is-error');
        if (type === 'success') el.classList.add('is-success');
    }

    async function onTestAndSave() {
        const url = document.getElementById('aproServerUrl').value.trim();
        const key = document.getElementById('aproServerApiKey').value.trim();
        const insecure = !!document.getElementById('aproServerInsecure').checked;
        const dest = cleanAbsolute(document.getElementById('aproServerDest').value, DEFAULT_DEST);
        const browse = cleanAbsolute(document.getElementById('aproServerBrowseRoot').value, DEFAULT_BROWSE);
        if (!url || !key) { writeStatus('Server URL and API Key are required.', 'error'); return; }
        writeStatus('Testing connectivity...', '');
        try {
            const res = await window.APRO_API.serverTest({method:'https_agent', server_url:url, api_key:key, insecure:insecure});
            if (res && res.ok) {
                setConfig({server_url:url, api_key:key, insecure:insecure, dest_path:dest, browse_root:browse});
                writeStatus('Connection OK (HTTP ' + (res.status_code || '200') + '). Saved. Browse root: ' + browse + '. Publish root: ' + dest + '.', 'success');
            } else {
                writeStatus('Test failed (HTTP ' + (res && res.status_code ? res.status_code : 'n/a') + ').', 'error');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            writeStatus(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Test failed.', 'error');
        }
    }

    function populateModalFields(modal) {
        const cfg = getConfig();
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerUrl').value = cfg.server_url || '';
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerApiKey').value = cfg.api_key || '';
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerInsecure').checked = !!cfg.insecure;
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerDest').value = cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_DEST;
        modal.querySelector('#aproServerBrowseRoot').value = cfg.browse_root || DEFAULT_BROWSE;
        writeStatus('', '');
    }

    function showConfigModal() {
        const modal = ensureModal();
        populateModalFields(modal);
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function installTreeToolsShortcut() {
        const tools = document.querySelector('.apro-panel-tree .apro-panel-tools');
        if (!tools || document.getElementById('aproServerCfgBtn')) return;
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.id = 'aproServerCfgBtn';
        btn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
        btn.textContent = 'Server Connect';
        btn.title = 'Configure Remote Server connection';
        btn.addEventListener('click', showConfigModal);
        tools.appendChild(btn);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { try { installTreeToolsShortcut(); } catch (e) {} });
    window.APRO_SERVER = {getConfig:getConfig,setConfig:setConfig,showConfigModal:showConfigModal,resolveRemoteTargetPath:resolveRemoteTargetPath,pathRelativeToDest:pathRelativeToDest,defaults:{dest_path:DEFAULT_DEST,browse_root:DEFAULT_BROWSE},_cleanAbsolute:cleanAbsolute};
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/state.js
(function () {
    const STATE_KEY = 'filePublishAnalysis';

    function loadPersisted(key, fallback) {
        try {
            const v = localStorage.getItem(key);
            if (v === null || v === undefined) return fallback;
            return v;
        } catch (e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    function savePersisted(key, value) {
        try {
            if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
                localStorage.removeItem(key);
            } else {
                localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function normalizePublishDestination(dest) {
        const value = String(dest || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (value === 'github') return 'github';
        if (value === 'remote') return 'remote';
        if (value === 'godaddy') return 'godaddy';
        return 'remote'; // Default to remote if not recognized
    }

    function initStateShape() {
        const persistedDest = normalizePublishDestination(loadPersisted('apro_publish_destination', 'remote'));
        const ghOwner = loadPersisted('apro_gh_owner', '');
        const ghRepo = loadPersisted('apro_gh_repo', '');
        const ghBranch = loadPersisted('apro_gh_branch', 'main');

        return {
            tiles: [],
            aiRaw: '',
            running: false,
            mode: 'prompt',
            prompt: '',
            paths: [],
            aiError: '',
            skipped: [],
            bulkStatus: '',
            publishedFiles: [],
            publishDestination: persistedDest,
            githubDefaults: {
                owner: ghOwner || '',
                repo: ghRepo || '',
                branch: ghBranch || 'main',
                path: '',
                commit_message: ''
            },
            generateRaw: '',
            generateParseStatus: '',
            generateWarnings: [],
            lastGenerationMeta: null
        };
    }

    function ensureState() {
        window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE || {};
        if (!window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY]) {
            window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY] = initStateShape();
        } else {
            const base = initStateShape();
            const cur = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
            Object.keys(base).forEach(function (k) {
                if (!(k in cur)) cur[k] = base[k];
            });
            if (typeof cur.githubDefaults !== 'object' || cur.githubDefaults === null) {
                cur.githubDefaults = base.githubDefaults;
            } else {
                const gbase = base.githubDefaults;
                const gcur = cur.githubDefaults;
                Object.keys(gbase).forEach(function (k) {
                    if (!(k in gcur)) gcur[k] = gbase[k];
                });
            }
            cur.publishDestination = normalizePublishDestination(cur.publishDestination || base.publishDestination);
        }
        return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
    }

    function getState() {
        return ensureState();
    }

    function resetStatePreserveDestination() {
        const s = getState();
        const dest = s.publishDestination;
        const gh = Object.assign({}, s.githubDefaults);

        const fresh = initStateShape();
        Object.keys(fresh).forEach(function (k) {
            s[k] = fresh[k];
        });

        s.publishDestination = normalizePublishDestination(dest);
        s.githubDefaults = gh;
    }

    function resetPublishSessionState() {
        const s = getState();
        s.running = false;
        s.aiError = '';
        s.skipped = [];
        s.bulkStatus = '';
        s.publishedFiles = [];
        s.generateWarnings = [];
        s.generateParseStatus = '';
        s.lastGenerationMeta = null;
    }

    function setPublishDestination(dest) {
        const value = normalizePublishDestination(dest);
        const s = getState();
        s.publishDestination = value;
        savePersisted('apro_publish_destination', value);
        return value;
    }

    function getPublishDestination() {
        return normalizePublishDestination(getState().publishDestination);
    }

    function updateGithubDefaults(partial) {
        const s = getState();
        const next = Object.assign({}, s.githubDefaults, partial || {});
        s.githubDefaults = next;

        if (typeof next.owner === 'string') savePersisted('apro_gh_owner', next.owner.trim());
        if (typeof next.repo === 'string') savePersisted('apro_gh_repo', next.repo.trim());
        if (typeof next.branch === 'string') savePersisted('apro_gh_branch', next.branch.trim() || 'main');

        return s.githubDefaults;
    }

    function setGithubDefaults(all) {
        const clean = Object.assign({
            owner: '',
            repo: '',
            branch: 'main',
            path: '',
            commit_message: ''
        }, all || {});
        return updateGithubDefaults(clean);
    }

    function getGithubDefaults() {
        return Object.assign({}, getState().githubDefaults);
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH || {};
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.STATE_KEY = STATE_KEY;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getState = getState;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.resetStatePreserveDestination = resetStatePreserveDestination;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.resetPublishSessionState = resetPublishSessionState;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.setPublishDestination = setPublishDestination;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getPublishDestination = getPublishDestination;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.updateGithubDefaults = updateGithubDefaults;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.setGithubDefaults = setGithubDefaults;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getGithubDefaults = getGithubDefaults;
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/tileHydration.js
(function () {
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH || {};
    const FP = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH;
    const U = FP.utils || {};

    const formatFileStats = (U && typeof U.formatFileStats === 'function')
        ? U.formatFileStats
        : function (bytes, lines) {
            const n = Number(bytes || 0);
            const kb = (n / 1024);
            const kbText = kb.toFixed(2);
            const parts = [];
            parts.push(String(n) + ' bytes (' + kbText + ' KB)');
            if (typeof lines === 'number' && isFinite(lines)) {
                parts.push(String(lines) + ' lines');
            }
            return parts.join(', ');
        };

    function getState() {
        const s = (typeof FP.getState === 'function')
            ? FP.getState()
            : { publishDestination: 'server', githubDefaults: { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main' } };
        if (!s.githubDefaults) {
            s.githubDefaults = { owner: '', repo: '', branch: 'main' };
        }
        return s;
    }

    function computeLines(content, encoding) {
        if (String(encoding || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64') {
            return null;
        }
        const text = String(content == null ? '' : content);
        return text === '' ? 0 : (text.match(/\n/g) || []).length + 1;
    }

    function isBase64(enc) {
        return String(enc || 'text').toLowerCase() === 'base64';
    }

    function setReplaceOnly(tile) {
        const content = String(tile.content || '');
        tile._original = null;
        tile._replace_size = content.length;
        tile._replace_lines = computeLines(content, tile.encoding);
        tile._identical = false;
    }

    function finalize(tile, original) {
        const content = String(tile.content || '');
        tile._original = {
            content: String(original.content || ''),
            size_bytes: Number(original.size_bytes || 0),
            line_count: typeof original.line_count === 'number' ? original.line_count : null,
            truncated: !!original.truncated,
            encoding: String(original.encoding || 'text'),
            source: String(original.source || '')
        };
        tile._replace_size = content.length;
        tile._replace_lines = computeLines(content, tile.encoding);
        tile._identical = (isBase64(tile._original.encoding) === isBase64(tile.encoding)) && String(tile._original.content || '') === content;
    }

    function remoteTarget(tile) {
        const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function'
            ? window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig()
            : null;
        const rawTarget = tile && tile.target_path != null ? String(tile.target_path).trim() : '';
        const path = rawTarget ? rawTarget : String((tile && tile.path) || '');

        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath(path, cfg);
        }
        return path;
    }

    function getGithubFetcher() {
        if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH_API.githubFetchFile;
        }
        return function (owner, repo, branch, path) {
            return window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(owner, repo, branch, path);
        };
    }

    async function loadRemote(tile) {
        const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function'
            ? window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig()
            : null;

        if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key || !window.APRO_API || typeof window.APRO_API.serverFileView !== 'function') {
            return null;
        }

        const data = await window.APRO_API.serverFileView({
            server_url: cfg.server_url,
            api_key: cfg.api_key,
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            path: remoteTarget(tile),
            allow_missing: true
        });

        if (!data || data.exists === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
            line_count: typeof data.line_count === 'number' ? data.line_count : null,
            truncated: !!data.truncated,
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
            source: 'remote'
        };
    }

    async function loadGithub(tile) {
        const s = getState();
        const defaults = s.githubDefaults || {};
        const gh = Object.assign({
            owner: defaults.owner || '',
            repo: defaults.repo || '',
            branch: defaults.branch || 'main',
            path: tile.path || ''
        }, tile.github || {});

        if (!gh.owner || !gh.repo || !gh.branch || !gh.path) {
            return null;
        }

        const fetcher = getGithubFetcher();
        const data = await fetcher(gh.owner, gh.repo, gh.branch, gh.path);

        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
            line_count: typeof data.line_count === 'number' ? data.line_count : null,
            truncated: !!data.truncated,
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
            source: 'github'
        };
    }

    async function loadLocal(tile) {
        if (!window.APRO_API || typeof window.APRO_API.viewFile !== 'function') {
            return null;
        }

        const data = await window.APRO_API.viewFile(tile.path);

        if (!data || data.exists === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
            line_count: typeof data.line_count === 'number' ? data.line_count : null,
            truncated: !!data.truncated,
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
            source: 'local'
        };
    }

    async function loadGoDaddy(tile) {
        const cfg = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function' ? window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() : null;
        if (!cfg || !cfg.base_url || !window.APRO_API || typeof window.APRO_API.godaddyFile !== 'function') {
            return null;
        }

        const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyFile({
            base_url: cfg.base_url,
            username: cfg.username,
            api_token: cfg.api_token,
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            path: tile.target_path || tile.path
        });

        if (!data || data.exists === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            content: String(data.content || ''),
            size_bytes: Number(data.size_bytes || 0),
            line_count: typeof data.line_count === 'number' ? data.line_count : null,
            truncated: !!data.truncated,
            encoding: String(data.encoding || 'text'),
            source: 'godaddy'
        };
    }

    function makeNote(text) {
        return '<span style="color:#faa;">(' + String(text || '') + ')</span>';
    }

    function getCurrentLabel(source) {
        if (source === 'remote') {
            return 'Current (Remote):';
        }
        if (source === 'github') {
            return 'Current (GitHub):';
        }
        if (source === 'godaddy') {
            return 'Current (GoDaddy):';
        }
        return 'Current (Local):';
    }

    async function hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile) {
        const op = String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase();

        if (op !== 'REPLACE') {
            setReplaceOnly(tile);
            return tile;
        }

        try {
            const dest = getState().publishDestination || 'server';
            let original = null;

            if (dest === 'remote') {
                original = await loadRemote(tile);
            } else if (dest === 'github') {
                original = await loadGithub(tile);
            } else if (dest === 'godaddy') {
                original = await loadGoDaddy(tile);
            } else {
                original = await loadLocal(tile);
            }

            if (original) {
                finalize(tile, original);
            } else {
                setReplaceOnly(tile);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('[APRO] Hydration failed for', tile.path, e);
            setReplaceOnly(tile);
        }

        return tile;
    }

    async function hydrateTilesComparisonMetadata(tiles) {
        const arr = Array.isArray(tiles) ? tiles : [];

        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
            try {
                await hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(arr[i]);
            } catch (e) {
                // continue next tile
            }
        }

        return arr;
    }

    async function fetchFileSizes(tile, sizeDiv) {
        await hydrateTileComparisonMetadata(tile);

        const replStats = formatFileStats(tile._replace_size || 0, tile._replace_lines);

        if (!tile._original) {
            const op = String(tile.operation || 'REPLACE').toUpperCase();
            const parts = [];

            if (op === 'REPLACE') {
                parts.push(makeNote('Current file not found or comparison unavailable'));
            }

            parts.push('<strong>Replacement:</strong> ' + replStats);
            sizeDiv.innerHTML = parts.join('<br>');
            return;
        }

        const sourceLabel = getCurrentLabel(tile._original.source);
        sizeDiv.innerHTML = 
            '<strong>' + sourceLabel + '</strong> ' + formatFileStats(tile._original.size_bytes, tile._original.line_count) +
            '<br><strong>Replacement:</strong> ' + replStats;
    }

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.tileHydration = {
        fetchFileSizes: fetchFileSizes,
        hydrateTileComparisonMetadata: hydrateTileComparisonMetadata,
        hydrateTilesComparisonMetadata: hydrateTilesComparisonMetadata,
        _remoteTarget: remoteTarget
    };
})();

// /public_html/admin/apro/assets/js/filePublish/utils.js
(function () {
    // Safely attach to namespace
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH || {};

    // Strip a single leading and trailing Markdown code fence from a string
    function stripMarkdownCodeBlock(text) {
        text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
        if (!text) return '';
        // Remove opening ``` (optionally with lang), and closing ```
        text = text.replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '');
        text = text.replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '');
        return text.trim();
    }

    // Basic HTML escape
    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
            return ({
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                '"': '&quot;',
                "'": '&#39;'
            })[char];
        });
    }

    // Format bytes using APRO_TREE.formatBytes if available; otherwise fallback
    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        const n = Number(bytes || 0);
        if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.formatBytes === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_TREE.formatBytes(n);
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return '0 B';
        const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB'];
        let size = n;
        let idx = 0;
        while (size >= 1024 && idx < units.length - 1) {
            size /= 1024;
            idx += 1;
        }
        const decimals = size >= 100 ? 0 : (size >= 10 ? 1 : 2);
        return size.toFixed(decimals) + ' ' + units[idx];
    }

    // Return a concise stats string "X bytes (Y KB), Z lines" (omit lines if not provided)
    function formatFileStats(bytes, lines) {
        const n = Number(bytes || 0);
        const kb = (n / 1024);
        const kbText = kb.toFixed(2);
        const parts = [];
        parts.push(String(n) + ' bytes (' + kbText + ' KB)');
        if (typeof lines === 'number' && isFinite(lines)) {
            parts.push(String(lines) + ' lines');
        }
        return parts.join(', ');
    }

    // Approximate combined payload bytes for an array of {content:string}
    // Adds a small fixed overhead per file to account for JSON wrapping/keys
    function approxBytesForFiles(files) {
        const arr = Array.isArray(files) ? files : [];
        let total = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
            const f = arr[i] || {};
            const c = (typeof f.content === 'string') ? f.content.length : 0;
            total += (c + 256); // crude JSON overhead
        }
        return total;
    }

    // Split an array of files into chunks, each not exceeding maxBytes (approx.)
    // Preserves order. If a single file exceeds maxBytes, it will be in its own chunk.
    function chunkFilesBySize(files, maxBytes) {
        const arr = Array.isArray(files) ? files.slice() : [];
        const limit = Number(maxBytes);
        if (!Number.isFinite(limit) || limit <= 0) {
            return arr.length ? [arr] : [];
        }

        const chunks = [];
        let cur = [];
        let curBytes = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
            const f = arr[i] || {};
            const fBytes = (typeof f.content === 'string' ? f.content.length : 0) + 256;

            // If adding this file would exceed the limit, flush current chunk first
            if (cur.length > 0 && (curBytes + fBytes) > limit) {
                chunks.push(cur);
                cur = [];
                curBytes = 0;
            }
            cur.push(f);
            curBytes += fBytes;
        }
        if (cur.length) {
            chunks.push(cur);
        }
        return chunks;
    }

    // Export on a utils bag and convenience aliases on the namespace root
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.utils = {
        stripMarkdownCodeBlock: stripMarkdownCodeBlock,
        escapeHtml: escapeHtml,
        formatBytes: formatBytes,
        formatFileStats: formatFileStats,
        approxBytesForFiles: approxBytesForFiles,
        chunkFilesBySize: chunkFilesBySize
    };

    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.stripMarkdownCodeBlock = stripMarkdownCodeBlock;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.escapeHtml = escapeHtml;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.formatBytes = formatBytes;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.formatFileStats = formatFileStats;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.approxBytesForFiles = approxBytesForFiles;
    window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.chunkFilesBySize = chunkFilesBySize;
})();

// filePublishAnalysis.js (compatibility shim)
// This monolithic controller has been decomposed into modular files under assets/js/filePublish/*.
// Index now includes those modules directly. This shim remains for backward compatibility.
// If included by mistake, it will warn and attempt to no-op safely.

(function () {
    try {
        console.warn('[APRO] assets/js/filePublishAnalysis.js is deprecated. The Publishable Files panel has been split into modular files under assets/js/filePublish/. Please remove this script include and ensure the modular scripts are loaded (state.js, utils.js, api.js, githubForm.js, actions.js, analyze.js, createFromCurrent.js, createFromAiResponse.js, tileHydration.js, renderTiles.js, reviewModal.js, merge.js, publishLocal.js, publishGithub.js, approval.js, clipboard.js, panel.js).');

        // Best-effort: if the modular panel already registered, nothing to do.
        if (window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS && window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS['filePublishAnalysis']) {
            return;
        }

        // If not registered, register a minimal placeholder panel so the app remains stable.
        window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS || {};
        window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS['filePublishAnalysis'] = {
            mount: function (container) {
                if (!container) return;
                container.innerHTML = '' +
                    '<div class="analysis-meta">' +
                    '<b>Publishable Files (AI) module has moved.</b><br>' +
                    'This panel has been refactored into modular scripts under <code>assets/js/filePublish/</code>.' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="apro-status is-error">Legacy filePublishAnalysis.js was loaded. Please update your page to include the modular scripts and remove this file.</div>';
            },
            unmount: function () { /* no-op */ }
        };
    } catch (e) {
        // Silent fallback
    }
})();
