(function () {
    const STATE_KEY = 'fileSystem';

    function getState() {
        if (!window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY]) {
            // Everything that was previously `let`-scoped state goes here
            window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY] = {
                analysisFiles: [], // { path, status, referenced_files, purpose, ai_response_text, service_id }
                runningAnalysis: false,
            };
        }
        return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
    }

    let _panelActionsWired = false; // Ensures one-time wiring if needed

    function mount(container) {
        const state = getState();

        // ==== Render tools in panel header (Copy Complete System Analysis button) ====
        const analysisPanel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = analysisPanel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) {
            toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
            const copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
            copyBtn.type = 'button';
            copyBtn.id = 'copyAllAnalysisButton';
            copyBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button copy-analysis-btn';
            copyBtn.textContent = 'Copy Complete System Analysis';
            copyBtn.disabled = true; // will enable as appropriate
            copyBtn.onclick = function () { copyAllAnalysisToClipboard(); };
            toolsDiv.appendChild(copyBtn);
        }

        // ---- HTML structure for panel body ----
        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="analysis-meta">
                Add files to analyze their references and system purpose. AI will analyze only one file at a time, automatically for all.
            </div>
            <div class="analysis-actions">
                <button type="button" id="addFileAnalysisButton" class="apro-mini-button">Add to Analysis</button>
                <button type="button" id="analyzeAllButton" class="apro-mini-button">Analyze All</button>
                <button type="button" id="analysisClearAllButton" class="apro-mini-button">Clear All</button>
            </div>
            <div id="analysisTiles"></div>
        `;

        // PATH TYPE MAP support remains unchanged
        function getPathTypeMap() {
            return window.APRO_TREE && window.APRO_TREE._PATH_TYPE_MAP || {};
        }

        function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (!text) return '';
            return (text + '').replace(/[<>&"']/g, function (c) {
                return { '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '&': '&amp;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
            });
        }

        // --- Fallback: Try to extract a purpose string from AI response block ---
        function fallbackExtractPurpose(text) {
            // Remove code block if present
            text = (text || '').replace(/^\s*```[a-zA-Z0-9]*\s*\r?\n?/i, '').replace(/\r?\n?```\s*$/i, '').trim();
            // Look for "purpose": in JSON or in an obvious assignment
            let m = text.match(/"purpose"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/);
            if (m && m[1]) return m[1];
            // Try single quotes
            m = text.match(/'purpose'\s*:\s*'([^']+)'/);
            if (m && m[1]) return m[1];
            // Try purpose: line prefix (not in JSON)
            m = text.match(/^purpose\s*:\s*(.+)$/im);
            if (m && m[1]) return m[1].trim();
            // Look for possible freeform answer at end
            if (/purpose/i.test(text)) {
                let idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf('purpose');
                return text.slice(idx).replace(/^[^:]*[:\-]\s*/, '').split('\n')[0].trim();
            }
            return '';
        }

        function updateAnalysisPanel() {
            const tilesDiv = container.querySelector('#analysisTiles');
            const analysisFiles = getState().analysisFiles;
            if (!tilesDiv) return;

            tilesDiv.innerHTML = '';

            if (analysisFiles.length === 0) {
                tilesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">No files are in Analysis. Select files and use "Add to Analysis" to begin.</div>';
                container.querySelector('#analysisClearAllButton').disabled = true;
                container.querySelector('#analyzeAllButton').disabled = true;
                setCopyAllDisabled(true);
                return;
            }

            container.querySelector('#analysisClearAllButton').disabled = false;
            container.querySelector('#analyzeAllButton').disabled = analysisFiles.every(f => f.status === 'done');
            setCopyAllDisabled(!analysisFiles.some(f => f.status === 'done'));

            analysisFiles.forEach((file, idx) => {
                const tile = document.createElement('div');
                tile.className = 'analysis-tile' + (file.status === 'running' ? ' analysis-tile-running' : (file.status === 'done' ? ' analysis-tile-done' : ' analysis-tile-idle'));
                tile.dataset.idx = idx;
                tile.tabIndex = 0;

                const head = document.createElement('div');
                head.className = 'tile-head';
                const pathSpan = document.createElement('span');
                pathSpan.className = 'tile-path';
                pathSpan.textContent = file.path;
                head.appendChild(pathSpan);

                if (file.status !== 'running') {
                    const removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
                    removeBtn.type = 'button';
                    removeBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button tile-remove-btn';
                    removeBtn.textContent = '×';
                    removeBtn.title = 'Remove from Analysis';
                    removeBtn.onclick = function () {
                        getState().analysisFiles = getState().analysisFiles.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
                        updateAnalysisPanel();
                    };
                    head.appendChild(removeBtn);
                }
                tile.appendChild(head);

                // Status line and actions
                const actionsDiv = document.createElement('div');
                actionsDiv.className = 'tile-actions';
                if (file.status === 'idle') {
                    const analyzeBtn = document.createElement('button');
                    analyzeBtn.type = 'button';
                    analyzeBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button tile-analyze-btn';
                    analyzeBtn.textContent = 'Analyze';
                    analyzeBtn.onclick = function () {
                        startAnalysisForIdx(idx);
                    };
                    actionsDiv.appendChild(analyzeBtn);
                } else if (file.status === 'running') {
                    actionsDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="tile-running-text">Analyzing...</span>';
                } else if (file.status === 'done') {
                    actionsDiv.innerHTML = '<span class="tile-done-text">Analyzed</span>';
                }
                tile.appendChild(actionsDiv);

                // Results (if available)
                if (file.status === 'done') {
                    const refsDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    refsDiv.className = 'tile-result-files';
                    refsDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Referenced files:</b> ' + (Array.isArray(file.referenced_files) && file.referenced_files.length ? escapeHtml(file.referenced_files.join(', ')) : 'none');
                    tile.appendChild(refsDiv);

                    const purDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    purDiv.className = 'tile-result-purpose';
                    // Show purpose if nonempty after trim
                    let hasPurpose = typeof file.purpose === 'string' && file.purpose.trim() !== '';
                    let fallbackPurpose = '';
                    if (!hasPurpose && typeof file.ai_response_text === 'string' && file.ai_response_text.trim() !== '') {
                        fallbackPurpose = fallbackExtractPurpose(file.ai_response_text);
                        hasPurpose = fallbackPurpose !== '';
                    }
                    if (hasPurpose) {
                        purDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Purpose:</b> ' + escapeHtml(file.purpose.trim() || fallbackPurpose);
                        if (file.purpose.trim() === '' && fallbackPurpose !== '') {
                            purDiv.innerHTML += ' <span style="color:#fbc02d; font-size:12px;">(fallback extracted)</span>';
                        }
                    } else {
                        purDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Purpose:</b> (not defined)';
                    }
                    tile.appendChild(purDiv);
                }
                // Raw AI response (show as expandable) -- always display on "done"
                if (file.status === 'done') {
                    const details = document.createElement('details');
                    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
                    summary.textContent = 'Show raw AI response';
                    details.appendChild(summary);

                    const pre = document.createElement('pre');
                    pre.className = 'tile-raw-ai';
                    if ('ai_response_text' in file && typeof file.ai_response_text === 'string' && file.ai_response_text.trim() !== '') {
                        pre.textContent = file.ai_response_text;
                    } else {
                        pre.textContent = '(empty AI response)';
                    }
                    details.appendChild(pre);

                    tile.appendChild(details);
                }
                tilesDiv.appendChild(tile);
            });
        }

        function setCopyAllDisabled(disabled) {
            const parentPanel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
            if (!parentPanel) return;
            const copyBtn = parentPanel.querySelector('.copy-analysis-btn');
            if (copyBtn) copyBtn.disabled = !!disabled;
        }

        function addSelectedFiles(selectedPaths, serviceId) {
            if (!selectedPaths || !selectedPaths.length) {
                alert('No files selected.');
                return;
            }
            const pathTypeMap = getPathTypeMap();
            // Only allow adding files (no directories)
            const filePaths = selectedPaths.filter((path) =>
                path && pathTypeMap[path] === 'file'
            );
            const excludedCount = selectedPaths.length - filePaths.length;

            let added = 0;
            let state = getState();
            for (const path of filePaths) {
                if (state.analysisFiles.some(f => f.path === path)) continue;
                state.analysisFiles.push({
                    path,
                    status: 'idle',
                    referenced_files: [],
                    purpose: '',
                    ai_response_text: '',
                    service_id: serviceId
                });
                added++;
            }
            if (added)
                updateAnalysisPanel();

            if (excludedCount > 0) {
                alert('Only regular files can be added to File System Analysis. ' + excludedCount + ' folder(s) were ignored.');
            }
            if (added === 0 && filePaths.length > 0) {
                alert('All selected files are already present in analysis.');
            }
        }

        function clearAll() {
            getState().analysisFiles = [];
            updateAnalysisPanel();
        }

        /**
         * Check that a list of server-relative paths exist on the server scan root.
         * Returns { ok: true } or { ok: false, missing: '/path' or message }.
         * Uses APRO_API.viewFile for lightweight existence check.
         */
        async function checkPathsExistOnServer(paths) {
            if (!Array.isArray(paths) || paths.length === 0) {
                return { ok: true };
            }
            if (!window.APRO_API || typeof window.APRO_API.viewFile !== 'function') {
                return { ok: false, missing: 'Server-side viewFile API unavailable' };
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
                const p = String(paths[i] || '').trim();
                if (p === '' || p === '/') continue;
                try {
                    const res = await window.APRO_API.viewFile(p);
                    // APRO_API.viewFile returns an object with exists boolean for allow_missing call,
                    // but in normal call it returns file metadata or throws. Normalize:
                    if (res && typeof res.exists !== 'undefined') {
                        if (res.exists === false) {
                            return { ok: false, missing: p };
                        }
                    } else if (res && res.path) {
                        // exists
                    } else {
                        // Unexpected shape — treat as missing
                        return { ok: false, missing: p };
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    // viewFile threw — treat as missing
                    return { ok: false, missing: p };
                }
            }
            return { ok: true };
        }

        // === GitHub helpers ===
        function isGithubTreeSource() {
            try {
                return (localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server') === 'github';
            } catch (e) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        function readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage() {
            try {
                const owner = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '';
                const repo = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '';
                const branch = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main';
                if (owner && repo && branch) {
                    return { owner, repo, branch };
                }
            } catch (e) {}
            return null;
        }

        async function startAnalysisForIdx(idx) {
            const state = getState();
            if (state.runningAnalysis) return;
            if (!state.analysisFiles[idx] || state.analysisFiles[idx].status !== 'idle') return;
            state.runningAnalysis = true;
            state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'running';
            updateAnalysisPanel();

            try {
                const file = state.analysisFiles[idx];
                const serviceId = file.service_id && file.service_id.trim() ? file.service_id.trim() : (document.getElementById('serviceId') ? document.getElementById('serviceId').value : '');
                const subjectPath = String(file.path || '');
                const analysisPaths = state.analysisFiles.map(f => String(f.path || ''));

                const usingGithub = isGithubTreeSource();
                if (usingGithub) {
                    const gh = readGithubMetaFromLocalStorage();
                    if (!gh) {
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'idle';
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = 'GitHub mode: owner/repo/branch are not configured. Enter details and click "Load Repo" first.';
                        updateAnalysisPanel();
                        state.runningAnalysis = false;
                        if (window._analyzeAllMode) runNextPendingAnalysis();
                        return;
                    }

                    try {
                        const res = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/file_analysis.php', {
                            subject_path: subjectPath,
                            analysis_paths: analysisPaths,
                            service_id: serviceId,
                            github: gh
                        });
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].referenced_files = res.referenced_files || [];
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].purpose = res.purpose || '';
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = res.ai_response_text || '';
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'done';
                    } catch (e) {
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'idle';
                        state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = 'AI request failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'Unknown error.');
                    } finally {
                        state.runningAnalysis = false;
                        updateAnalysisPanel();
                        if (window._analyzeAllMode) runNextPendingAnalysis();
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // Local/server filesystem mode — validate existence defensively before calling API
                const existence = await checkPathsExistOnServer([subjectPath, ...analysisPaths]);
                if (!existence.ok) {
                    // Mark this tile as idle/error and provide clear message
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'idle';
                    const msg = (existence.missing && typeof existence.missing === 'string')
                        ? 'Selected path does not exist on the server scan root: ' + existence.missing + '. If these files are from GitHub, switch the file tree to GitHub mode or fetch contents first.'
                        : 'One or more selected files are not available on the server.';
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = msg;
                    updateAnalysisPanel();
                    state.runningAnalysis = false;
                    // If running an Analyze All batch, continue to next pending but don't call server for this one.
                    if (window._analyzeAllMode) {
                        runNextPendingAnalysis();
                    }
                    return;
                }

                // All paths resolvable on local scan root — safe to call server API
                try {
                    const res = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/file_analysis.php', {
                        subject_path: subjectPath,
                        analysis_paths: analysisPaths,
                        service_id: serviceId
                    });
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].referenced_files = res.referenced_files || [];
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].purpose = res.purpose || '';
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = res.ai_response_text || '';
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'done';
                } catch (e) {
                    // API call failed — capture message but avoid exposing raw stack
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'idle';
                    state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = 'AI request failed: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'Unknown error.');
                }
            } catch (outerErr) {
                // Unexpected error path
                state.analysisFiles[idx].status = 'idle';
                state.analysisFiles[idx].ai_response_text = 'Analysis failed: ' + (outerErr && outerErr.message ? outerErr.message : 'Unknown error');
            } finally {
                state.runningAnalysis = false;
                updateAnalysisPanel();
                if (window._analyzeAllMode) {
                    runNextPendingAnalysis();
                }
            }
        }
        function runNextPendingAnalysis() {
            const analysisFiles = getState().analysisFiles;
            const idx = analysisFiles.findIndex(f => f.status === 'idle');
            const state = getState();
            if (idx !== -1 && !state.runningAnalysis) {
                startAnalysisForIdx(idx);
            } else {
                window._analyzeAllMode = false;
            }
        }

        function analyzeAll() {
            const state = getState();
            if (state.runningAnalysis) return;
            window._analyzeAllMode = true;
            runNextPendingAnalysis();
        }

        function buildFullSystemAnalysisText() {
            const analysisFiles = getState().analysisFiles;
            let out = [];
            out.push("File System Analysis (APRO):");
            out.push("");
            let doneFiles = analysisFiles.filter(f => f.status === 'done');
            out.push("Analyzed file count: " + doneFiles.length + " / " + analysisFiles.length);
            out.push("");
            doneFiles.forEach((file, idx) => {
                out.push("-------------------------------------------------");
                out.push("File #" + (idx + 1));
                out.push("Path: " + file.path);
                out.push("");
                out.push("Referenced files:");
                if (Array.isArray(file.referenced_files) && file.referenced_files.length) {
                    file.referenced_files.forEach(rf => out.push("  - " + rf));
                } else {
                    out.push("  (none)");
                }
                out.push("");
                out.push("Purpose:");
                out.push(file.purpose ? file.purpose : "(not defined)");
                out.push("");
                out.push("Raw AI response:");
                out.push(file.ai_response_text ? file.ai_response_text : "(empty)");
                out.push("");
            });
            out.push("-------------------------------------------------");
            return out.join('\n');
        }

        function copyAllAnalysisToClipboard() {
            const text = buildFullSystemAnalysisText();
            if (!navigator.clipboard) {
                alert('Clipboard API is not available in this browser.');
                return;
            }
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
            .then(function () {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('File System Analysis copied to clipboard.', 'success');
            })
            .catch(function () {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Could not copy system analysis to clipboard.', 'error');
            });
        }

        function setupAnalysisActions() {
            if (_panelActionsWired) return;
            _panelActionsWired = true;
            container.querySelector('#addFileAnalysisButton').addEventListener('click', function () {
                const serviceId = document.getElementById('serviceId').value;
                const selectedPaths = window.APRO_UI.getSelectedPaths ? window.APRO_UI.getSelectedPaths() : [];
                if (!selectedPaths || selectedPaths.length === 0) {
                    alert('No files selected.');
                    return;
                }
                addSelectedFiles(selectedPaths, serviceId);
            });

            container.querySelector('#analysisClearAllButton').addEventListener('click', function () {
                clearAll();
            });

            container.querySelector('#analyzeAllButton').addEventListener('click', function () {
                analyzeAll();
            });
        }

        // -- INIT --
        // Patch createTreeController to save root for later mapping
        if (!window.APRO_TREE) window.APRO_TREE = {};

        Document: ['.csv', '.doc', '.docx', '.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.rtf', '.xls', '.xlsx'],
        Archive: ['.7z', '.gz', '.rar', '.tar', '.tgz', '.zip'],
        Audio: ['.aac', '.flac', '.m4a', '.mp3', '.ogg', '.wav'],
        Video: ['.avi', '.m4v', '.mov', '.mp4', '.mpeg', '.webm']

    const DEFAULT_BINARY_EXTENSIONS = ['.7z', '.avif', '.gif', '.gz', '.ico', '.jpeg', '.jpg', '.mov', '.mp3', '.mp4', '.pdf', '.png', '.rar', '.tar', '.tgz', '.webp', '.zip'];

        const base = String(name || '').split('/').pop().split('\\').pop();

(function () {
    const VIEWER_ID = 'aproFileViewerModal';
    const TITLE_ID = 'aproFileViewerTitle';
    const META_ID = 'aproFileViewerMeta';
    const CONTENT_ID = 'aproFileViewerContent';
    const NOTICE_ID = 'aproFileViewerNotice';
    const COPY_ID = 'aproFileViewerCopyBtn';
    const DOWNLOAD_ID = 'aproFileViewerDownloadBtn';
    const REFRESH_ID = 'aproFileViewerRefreshBtn';
    const CLOSE_ID = 'aproFileViewerCloseBtn';

    let modal = null;
    let elements = null;
    const viewerState = {
        path: '',
        encoding: 'text',
        content: '',
        sizeBytes: 0,
        truncated: false,
        lineCount: null,
        exists: true
    };

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
            return ({
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                '"': '&quot;',
                "'": '&#39;'
            })[char];
        });
    }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        const value = Number(bytes || 0);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return '0 B';
        if (value < 1024) return Math.round(value) + ' B';
        const units = ['KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
        let size = value;
        let index = -1;
        do {
            size /= 1024;
            index += 1;
        } while (size >= 1024 && index < units.length - 1);
        const decimals = size >= 100 ? 0 : (size >= 10 ? 1 : 2);
        return size.toFixed(decimals) + ' ' + units[index];
    }

    function decodeBase64ToBytes(base64Text) {
        const sanitized = String(base64Text || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
        try {
            const binary = atob(sanitized);
            const len = binary.length;
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
            for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
                bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
            }
            return bytes;
        } catch (error) {
            throw new Error('Failed to decode base64 content.');
        }
    }

    function ensureModal() {
        if (modal) {
            return modal;
        }

        modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = VIEWER_ID;
        modal.className = 'apro-modal apro-fileviewer-modal';
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="apro-modal-backdrop"></div>',
            '<div class="apro-modal-content apro-fileviewer">',
            '  <div class="apro-modal-header">',
            '    <div class="apro-fileviewer-header">',
            '      <h3 id="' + TITLE_ID + '">File Viewer</h3>',
            '      <div class="apro-fileviewer-toolbar">',
            '        <button type="button" id="' + COPY_ID + '" class="apro-mini-button">Copy</button>',
            '        <button type="button" id="' + DOWNLOAD_ID + '" class="apro-mini-button">Download</button>',
            '        <button type="button" id="' + REFRESH_ID + '" class="apro-mini-button">Refresh</button>',
            '        <button type="button" id="' + CLOSE_ID + '" class="apro-primary-button">Close</button>',
            '      </div>',
            '    </div>',
            '  </div>',
            '  <div class="apro-modal-body">',
            '    <div id="' + META_ID + '" class="apro-fileviewer-meta"></div>',
            '    <div id="' + NOTICE_ID + '" class="apro-status" style="display:none;"></div>',
            '    <pre id="' + CONTENT_ID + '" class="apro-fileviewer-content"></pre>',
            '  </div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');

        document.body.appendChild(modal);

        const closeModal = () => {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        };

        elements = {
            title: modal.querySelector('#' + TITLE_ID),
            meta: modal.querySelector('#' + META_ID),
            notice: modal.querySelector('#' + NOTICE_ID),
            content: modal.querySelector('#' + CONTENT_ID),
            copyBtn: modal.querySelector('#' + COPY_ID),
            downloadBtn: modal.querySelector('#' + DOWNLOAD_ID),
            refreshBtn: modal.querySelector('#' + REFRESH_ID),
            closeBtn: modal.querySelector('#' + CLOSE_ID)
        };

        modal.querySelector('.apro-modal-backdrop').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        elements.closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (modal.style.display === 'flex' && event.key === 'Escape') {
                closeModal();
            }
        });

        elements.copyBtn.addEventListener('click', handleCopy);
        elements.downloadBtn.addEventListener('click', handleDownload);
        elements.refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', handleRefresh);

        return modal;
    }

    function showStatus(message, type) {
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus(message, type || '');
        }
    }

    function showNotice(message, type) {
        const notice = elements.notice;
        if (!notice) {
            return;
        }
        if (!message) {
            notice.style.display = 'none';
            notice.textContent = '';
            notice.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
            return;
        }
        notice.style.display = '';
        notice.textContent = message;
        notice.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        if (type === 'error') {
            notice.classList.add('is-error');
        } else if (type === 'success') {
            notice.classList.add('is-success');
        }
    }

    function updateTitle(path) {
        if (!elements.title) {
            return;
        }
        const label = path ? 'File Viewer: ' + path : 'File Viewer';
        elements.title.textContent = label;
    }

    function setLoadingState(path) {
        updateTitle(path);
        if (elements.meta) {
            elements.meta.innerHTML = '';
        }
        if (elements.content) {
            elements.content.textContent = 'Loading…';
            elements.content.classList.add('is-loading');
        }
        showNotice('', '');
    }

    function buildMetaHtml(data) {
        const parts = [];
        const path = data.path || viewerState.path || '';
        parts.push('<div class="publishModal-size-bar">');
        parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-label">Path:</span> <span class="publishModal-size-bytes"><code>' + escapeHtml(path) + '</code></span>');
        parts.push('</div>');

        parts.push('<div class="publishModal-size-bar">');
        parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-label">Size:</span> <span class="publishModal-size-bytes">' + escapeHtml(formatBytes(data.size_bytes)) + ' (' + escapeHtml(String(data.size_bytes || 0)) + ' bytes)</span>');
        if (typeof data.line_count === 'number') {
            parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-lines">Lines: ' + escapeHtml(String(data.line_count)) + '</span>');
        }
        parts.push('</div>');

        parts.push('<div class="publishModal-size-bar">');
        parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-label">Encoding:</span> <span class="publishModal-size-bytes">' + escapeHtml(String(data.encoding || 'text')) + '</span>');
        parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-lines">Truncated: ' + (data.truncated ? 'yes' : 'no') + '</span>');
        if (data.exists === false) {
            parts.push('  <span class="publishModal-size-lines" style="color:#fca5a5;">File Missing</span>');
        }
        parts.push('</div>');

        return parts.join('');
    }

    function renderContent(data, options) {
        const metaHtml = buildMetaHtml(data);
        elements.meta.innerHTML = metaHtml;

        let displayContent = '';
        let copyDisabled = false;
        let noticeMessage = '';
        let noticeType = '';

        if (data.exists === false) {
            displayContent = '[File not found on disk]';
            copyDisabled = true;
            noticeMessage = 'The requested file does not exist on disk.';
            noticeType = 'error';
        } else if (data.encoding === 'base64') {
            const chunked = String(data.content || '').replace(/(.{76})/g, '$1\n');
            displayContent = chunked;
            copyDisabled = true;
            noticeMessage = 'Binary file detected. Download the file for accurate content.';
            noticeType = '';
        } else {
            displayContent = String(data.content || '');
            copyDisabled = false;
            if (data.truncated) {
                noticeMessage = 'Content truncated due to size limits.';
                noticeType = 'error';
            }
        }

        elements.content.classList.remove('is-loading');
        elements.content.innerHTML = escapeHtml(displayContent);
        if (!options || !options.preserveScroll) {
            elements.content.scrollTop = 0;
        }

        setCopyButtonState(!copyDisabled);
        showNotice(noticeMessage, noticeType);
    }

    function setCopyButtonState(enabled) {
        if (!elements.copyBtn) {
            return;
        }
        if (enabled) {
            elements.copyBtn.disabled = false;
            elements.copyBtn.title = 'Copy file contents to clipboard';
        } else {
            elements.copyBtn.disabled = true;
            elements.copyBtn.title = 'Copy is unavailable for this file';
        }
    }

    function updateViewerState(path, data) {
        viewerState.path = path || data.path || '';
        viewerState.encoding = data.encoding || 'text';
        viewerState.content = String(data.content || '');
        viewerState.sizeBytes = Number(data.size_bytes || 0);
        viewerState.truncated = !!data.truncated;

            updateTitle(path);
        } catch (error) {

        }
    }

    function isVisible() {
        return modal && modal.style.display === 'flex';
    }

    window.APRO_FILEVIEWER = {
        open: open,
        openWithPayload: openWithPayload,
        close: close,
        isVisible: isVisible,
        get state() {
            return Object.assign({}, viewerState);
        }
    };
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const STORAGE_KEY = 'apro_godaddy_accounts';
    const SELECTED_KEY = 'apro_godaddy_selected_account_id';

    function readAccounts() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
            return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter(function (row) { return row && typeof row === 'object'; }) : [];
        } catch (error) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    function writeAccounts(accounts) {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(accounts) ? accounts : []));
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    function normalizeAccount(input) {
        const row = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {};
        const id = String(row.id || ('gd_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8))).trim();
        const label = String(row.label || '').trim() || 'GoDaddy Account';
        let baseUrl = String(row.base_url || row.host || '').trim();
        if (baseUrl && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(baseUrl)) {
            baseUrl = 'https://' + baseUrl.replace(/^\/+/, '');
        }
        return {
            id: id,
            label: label,
            base_url: baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, ''),
            username: String(row.username || '').trim(),
            api_token: String(row.api_token || '').trim(),
            root_path: String(row.root_path || '/public_html').trim() || '/public_html',
            insecure: !!row.insecure
        };
    }

    function getSelectedAccountId() {
        try {
            return String(localStorage.getItem(SELECTED_KEY) || '').trim();
        } catch (error) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    function setSelectedAccountId(id) {
        try {
            if (id) localStorage.setItem(SELECTED_KEY, String(id));
            else localStorage.removeItem(SELECTED_KEY);
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    function getSelectedAccount() {
        const id = getSelectedAccountId();
        const accounts = readAccounts();
        for (let i = 0; i < accounts.length; i += 1) {
            if (String(accounts[i].id || '') === id) {
                return normalizeAccount(accounts[i]);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function upsertAccount(account) {
        const normalized = normalizeAccount(account);
        const accounts = readAccounts();
        const next = [];
        let replaced = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < accounts.length; i += 1) {
            const current = normalizeAccount(accounts[i]);
            if (current.id === normalized.id) {
                next.push(normalized);
                replaced = true;
            } else {
                next.push(current);
            }
        }
        if (!replaced) next.push(normalized);
        writeAccounts(next);
        setSelectedAccountId(normalized.id);
        return normalized;
    }

    function removeAccount(id) {
        const cleanId = String(id || '').trim();
        if (!cleanId) return;
        const accounts = readAccounts().filter(function (row) {
            return String(row.id || '') !== cleanId;
        });
        writeAccounts(accounts);
        if (getSelectedAccountId() === cleanId) {
            setSelectedAccountId(accounts.length ? String(accounts[0].id || '') : '');
        }
    }

    function promptForAccount(existing) {
        const current = existing ? normalizeAccount(existing) : normalizeAccount({});
        const label = window.prompt('GoDaddy account label:', current.label || 'GoDaddy Account');
        if (label === null) return null;
        const baseUrl = window.prompt('cPanel base URL (example: https://host.example.com:2083):', current.base_url || '');
        if (baseUrl === null) return null;
        const username = window.prompt('cPanel username:', current.username || '');
        if (username === null) return null;
        const apiToken = window.prompt('cPanel API token:', current.api_token || '');
        if (apiToken === null) return null;
        const rootPath = window.prompt('Default root path:', current.root_path || '/public_html');
        if (rootPath === null) return null;
        const insecure = window.confirm('Allow insecure/self-signed TLS for this GoDaddy/cPanel endpoint? Click OK for yes, Cancel for no.');

        return normalizeAccount({
            id: current.id,
            label: label,
            base_url: baseUrl,
            username: username,
            api_token: apiToken,
            root_path: rootPath,
            insecure: insecure
        });
    }

    function ensureSelector() {
        return document.getElementById('aproGoDaddyAccountSelect');
    }

    function renderSelector() {
        const select = ensureSelector();
        if (!select) return;
        const accounts = readAccounts().map(normalizeAccount);
        const selectedId = getSelectedAccountId();
        let html = '<option value="">Select GoDaddy account...</option>';
        accounts.forEach(function (account) {
            html += '<option value="' + String(account.id).replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '"' + (account.id === selectedId ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + account.label + '</option>';
        });
        select.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function installInlineControls() {
        const host = document.getElementById('godaddyTreeFields');
        if (!host || host.dataset.bound === '1') return;
        host.dataset.bound = '1';

        if (!host.querySelector('#aproGoDaddyAccountSelect')) {
            const select = document.createElement('select');
            select.id = 'aproGoDaddyAccountSelect';
            select.style.minWidth = '220px';
            select.addEventListener('change', function () {
                setSelectedAccountId(String(select.value || '').trim());
            });
            host.appendChild(select);
        }

        if (!host.querySelector('#aproGoDaddyAccountAddBtn')) {
            const addBtn = document.createElement('button');
            addBtn.type = 'button';
            addBtn.id = 'aproGoDaddyAccountAddBtn';
            addBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            addBtn.textContent = 'Add Account';
            addBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const account = promptForAccount(null);
                if (!account) return;
                upsertAccount(account);
                renderSelector();
            });
            host.appendChild(addBtn);
        }

        if (!host.querySelector('#aproGoDaddyAccountEditBtn')) {
            const editBtn = document.createElement('button');
            editBtn.type = 'button';
            editBtn.id = 'aproGoDaddyAccountEditBtn';
            editBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            editBtn.textContent = 'Edit';
            editBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const current = getSelectedAccount();
                if (!current) {
                    window.alert('Select a GoDaddy account first.');
                    return;
                }
                const updated = promptForAccount(current);
                if (!updated) return;
                upsertAccount(updated);
                renderSelector();
            });
            host.appendChild(editBtn);
        }

        if (!host.querySelector('#aproGoDaddyAccountDeleteBtn')) {
            const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
            delBtn.type = 'button';
            delBtn.id = 'aproGoDaddyAccountDeleteBtn';
            delBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            delBtn.textContent = 'Delete';
            delBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const current = getSelectedAccount();
                if (!current) {
                    window.alert('Select a GoDaddy account first.');
                    return;
                }
                if (!window.confirm('Delete GoDaddy account "' + current.label + '"?')) return;
                removeAccount(current.id);
                renderSelector();
            });
            host.appendChild(delBtn);
        }

        if (!host.querySelector('#aproGoDaddyTestBtn')) {
            const testBtn = document.createElement('button');
            testBtn.type = 'button';
            testBtn.id = 'aproGoDaddyTestBtn';
            testBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            testBtn.textContent = 'Test';
            testBtn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
                const account = getSelectedAccount();
                if (!account) {
                    window.alert('Select a GoDaddy account first.');
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    testBtn.disabled = true;
                    const result = await window.APRO_API.godaddyTest(account);
                    if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
                        const browse = result && result.browse_check && result.browse_check.ok === false
                            ? (' Connection OK, but root browse failed: ' + String(result.browse_check.message || 'unknown error') + '.')
                            : ' GoDaddy connection OK.';
                        window.APRO_UI.setStatus('GoDaddy account "' + account.label + '" tested successfully.' + browse, 'success');
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
                        window.APRO_UI.setStatus(error && error.message ? error.message : 'GoDaddy test failed.', 'error');
                    }
                } finally {
                    testBtn.disabled = false;
                }
            });
            host.appendChild(testBtn);
        }

        renderSelector();
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', installInlineControls);

    window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS = {
        getAccounts: function () { return readAccounts().map(normalizeAccount); },
        getSelectedId: getSelectedAccountId,
        setSelectedId: setSelectedAccountId,
        getSelected: getSelectedAccount,
        save: upsertAccount,
        remove: removeAccount,
        renderSelector: renderSelector,
        installInlineControls: installInlineControls
    };
})();

// implementationPlanAnalysis.js

(function () {
    const STATE_KEY = 'implementationPlan';

    function getState() {
        if (!window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY]) {
            window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY] = {
                implementationPlan: [],
                lastAiRaw: '',
                running: false,
                lastMode: 'prompt',
                lastPrompt: '',
                lastPaths: [],
                aiError: '',
                statusMessage: '',
                statusType: '',
                fallbackUsed: false,
            };
        }
        return window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANEL_STATE[STATE_KEY];
    }

    function mount(container) {
        const state = getState();

        const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) {
            toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
            const copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
            copyBtn.type = 'button';
            copyBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button copy-analysis-btn';
            copyBtn.textContent = 'Copy Implementation Plan';
            copyBtn.disabled = !state.implementationPlan.length;
            copyBtn.onclick = () => copyPlanToClipboard();
            toolsDiv.appendChild(copyBtn);
        }

        container.innerHTML = `
            <div class="analysis-meta">
                <b>Implementation Plan Analysis:</b><br>
                Generates a deduplicated list of files to <b>ADD</b> or <b>REPLACE</b>, to achieve a user-stated system change, based on a prompt and/or file selection.
            </div>
            <div class="analysis-actions" id="planAnalysisActions"></div>
            <div id="planTiles"></div>
            <div id="planStatus" class="apro-status" style="margin-top:12px; min-height:45px; display:none;"></div>
        `;

        renderActions();
        renderTiles();
        renderStatus();

        function renderActions() {
            const actionsDiv = container.querySelector('#planAnalysisActions');
            actionsDiv.innerHTML = '';

            const runPrompt = document.createElement('button');
            runPrompt.type = 'button';
            runPrompt.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runPrompt.textContent = 'Analyze via Prompt';
            runPrompt.onclick = () => startPlanAnalysis('prompt');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runPrompt);

            const runFiles = document.createElement('button');
            runFiles.type = 'button';
            runFiles.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runFiles.textContent = 'Analyze Selected Files';
            runFiles.onclick = () => startPlanAnalysis('files');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runFiles);

            const runBoth = document.createElement('button');
            runBoth.type = 'button';
            runBoth.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            runBoth.textContent = 'Analyze Both';
            runBoth.onclick = () => startPlanAnalysis('both');
            actionsDiv.appendChild(runBoth);

            const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
            clearBtn.type = 'button';
            clearBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear All';
            clearBtn.onclick = () => { resetPanelState(); renderTiles(); renderStatus(); };
            actionsDiv.appendChild(clearBtn);
        }

        function renderTiles() {
            const state = getState();
            const tilesDiv = container.querySelector('#planTiles');
            const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
            const toolsDiv = panel ? panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools') : null;

            if (!state.implementationPlan || !state.implementationPlan.length) {
                tilesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">No implementation plan items. Run analysis above.</div>';
                if (toolsDiv) {
                    const btn = toolsDiv.querySelector('button');
                    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
                }
                return;
            }

            if (toolsDiv) {
                const btn = toolsDiv.querySelector('button');
                if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            }

            const deduped = dedupeByPath(state.implementationPlan);
            tilesDiv.innerHTML = '';
            deduped.forEach(function (item, idx) {
                const tile = document.createElement('div');
                tile.className = 'analysis-tile analysis-tile-done plan-tile';

                const head = document.createElement('div');
                head.className = 'tile-head';

                const pathSpan = document.createElement('span');
                pathSpan.className = 'tile-path';
                pathSpan.textContent = item.path || '(no path)';
                head.appendChild(pathSpan);

                const removeBtn = document.createElement('button');
                removeBtn.type = 'button';
                removeBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button tile-remove-btn';
                removeBtn.textContent = '×';
                removeBtn.title = 'Remove from view';
                removeBtn.onclick = function () {
                    const state = getState();
                    state.implementationPlan = deduped.filter((_, i) => i !== idx);
                    if (state.implementationPlan.length === 0) {
                        state.statusMessage = '';
                        state.statusType = '';
                    }
                    renderTiles();
                    renderStatus();
                };
                head.appendChild(removeBtn);
                tile.appendChild(head);

                const opColor = (item.operation === 'ADD')
                    ? 'background:rgba(34,197,94,0.11);color:#25a244;'
                    : 'background:rgba(56,189,248,0.13);color:#0ea5e9;';
                const opDiv = document.createElement('div');
                opDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Operation:</b> <span style="' + opColor + 'padding:2px 8px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:bold">' + escapeHtml(item.operation || '-') + '</span>';
                tile.appendChild(opDiv);

                const summaryDiv = document.createElement('div');
                summaryDiv.className = 'tile-result-purpose';
                summaryDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Summary:</b> ' + escapeHtml(item.summary || '');
                tile.appendChild(summaryDiv);

                const rationaleDiv = document.createElement('div');
                rationaleDiv.className = 'tile-result-files';
                rationaleDiv.innerHTML = '<b>Rationale:</b> ' + escapeHtml(item.rationale || '');
                tile.appendChild(rationaleDiv);

                const details = document.createElement('details');
                details.style.marginTop = '4px';
                const summary = document.createElement('summary');
                summary.textContent = 'Show raw AI for this tile';
                details.appendChild(summary);
                const pre = document.createElement('pre');
                pre.className = 'tile-raw-ai';
                pre.textContent = JSON.stringify(item, null, 2);
                details.appendChild(pre);
                tile.appendChild(details);

                tilesDiv.appendChild(tile);
            });
        }

        function renderStatus() {
            const state = getState();
            const statusEl = container.querySelector('#planStatus');
            if (!statusEl) {
                return;
            }

            let message = '';
            let type = '';

            if (state.aiError) {
                message = escapeHtml(state.aiError);
                type = 'error';
            } else if (state.statusMessage) {
                message = state.statusMessage;
                type = state.statusType;
            }

            statusEl.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');

            if (!message) {
                statusEl.style.display = 'none';
                statusEl.textContent = '';
                return;
            }

            statusEl.style.display = '';
            statusEl.innerHTML = message;

            if (type === 'error') {
                statusEl.classList.add('is-error');
            } else if (type === 'success') {
                statusEl.classList.add('is-success');
            }
        }

        function resetPanelState() {
            const s = getState();
            s.implementationPlan = [];
            s.lastAiRaw = '';
            s.lastMode = 'prompt';
            s.lastPrompt = '';
            s.lastPaths = [];
            s.aiError = '';
            s.statusMessage = '';
            s.statusType = '';
            s.fallbackUsed = false;
        }

        function escapeHtml(text) {
            if (!text) return '';
            return text.replace(/[<>&"]/g, function (c) {
                return { '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '&': '&amp;', '"': '&quot;' }[c];
            });
        }

        function dedupeByPath(planArr) {
            const seen = {};
            const deduped = [];
            for (const item of planArr) {
                if (!item.path || seen[item.path]) continue;
                seen[item.path] = true;
                deduped.push(item);
            }
            return deduped;
        }

        async function startPlanAnalysis(mode) {
            const state = getState();
            if (state.running) return;
            state.running = true;
            state.aiError = '';
            state.statusMessage = 'Generating implementation plan…';
            state.statusType = '';
            renderStatus();

            const prompt = document.getElementById('userPrompt').value || '';
            const serviceId = document.getElementById('serviceId').value || '';
            // Files-only: read explicitly checked file nodes
            const selectedPaths = (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function')
                ? window.APRO_UI.getCheckedFilePaths()
                : [];

            if ((mode === 'prompt' && !prompt) ||
                (mode === 'files' && (!selectedPaths || !selectedPaths.length)) ||
                (mode === 'both' && !prompt && (!selectedPaths || !selectedPaths.length))) {
                alert('You must provide a prompt and/or select files according to the chosen analysis mode.');
                state.running = false;
                state.statusMessage = '';
                renderStatus();
                return;
            }

            const planTiles = container.querySelector('#planTiles');
            planTiles.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Generating implementation plan... Please wait.</div>';

            try {
                const res = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/implementation_plan.php', {
                    prompt: prompt,
                    selected_paths: selectedPaths,
                    service_id: serviceId,
                    analysis_mode: mode
                });

                const planItems = Array.isArray(res.implementation_plan) ? dedupeByPath(res.implementation_plan) : [];
                state.implementationPlan = planItems;
                state.lastAiRaw = res.ai_response_text || '';
                state.lastMode = mode;
                state.lastPrompt = prompt;
                state.lastPaths = selectedPaths;
                state.fallbackUsed = !!res.fallback_used;
                state.aiError = '';

                if (planItems.length === 0) {
                    state.statusMessage = state.fallbackUsed
                        ? 'Implementation plan fallback applied but no actionable items were produced. Review inputs and try again.'
                        : 'Implementation plan returned no actionable items.';
                } else if (state.fallbackUsed) {
                    state.statusMessage = 'Implementation plan generated (fallback parser applied). Review proposed changes below.';
                } else {
                    state.statusMessage = 'Implementation plan generated. Review proposed changes below.';
                }
                state.statusType = planItems.length === 0 ? 'error' : 'success';
            } catch (e) {
                state.lastAiRaw = '';
                state.aiError = 'Error: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to get implementation plan.');
                state.statusMessage = '';
                state.statusType = 'error';
                state.fallbackUsed = false;
                state.implementationPlan = [];
            }

            state.running = false;
            renderTiles();
            renderStatus();
        }

        function copyPlanToClipboard() {
            const plan = dedupeByPath(getState().implementationPlan);
            if (!plan.length) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('No implementation plan to copy.', 'error');
                return;
            }
            const out = [
                'Implementation Plan Results (APRO):',
                '',
                'Plan Item Count: ' + plan.length,
                ''
            ];
            plan.forEach((item, idx) => {
                out.push('------------------------------------------------');
                out.push('Path: ' + (item.path || ''));
                out.push('Operation: ' + (item.operation || ''));
                out.push('Summary: ' + (item.summary || ''));
                out.push('Rationale: ' + (item.rationale || ''));
                out.push('');
            });
            out.push('------------------------------------------------');
            const text = out.join('\n');
            if (!navigator.clipboard) {
                alert('Clipboard API is not available in this browser.');
                return;
            }
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
                .then(() => window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Implementation plan copied to clipboard.', 'success'))
                .catch(() => window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Could not copy implementation plan.', 'error'));
        }
    }

    function unmount() {
        const panel = document.getElementById('analysisPanel');
        const toolsDiv = panel && panel.querySelector('.apro-panel-tools');
        if (toolsDiv) toolsDiv.innerHTML = '';
    }

    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS = window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS || {};
    window.APRO_ANALYSIS_PANELS['implementationPlan'] = { mount, unmount };
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const state = {
        modal: null,
        elements: null,
        isBusy: false,
        pendingReplace: null
    };

    const DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT = '/';

    function escapeHtml(text) {
        return String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (char) {
            return {
                '&': '&amp;',
                '<': '&lt;',
                '>': '&gt;',
                '"': '&quot;',
                "'": '&#39;'
            }[char] || char;
        });
    }

    function slash(value) {
        let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/');
        while (s.indexOf('//') !== -1) {
            s = s.split('//').join('/');
        }
        return s;
    }

    function hasTraversal(path) {
        return slash(path).split('/').some(function (part) {
            return part === '..';
        });
    }

    function cleanAbs(path, fallback) {
        const fb = fallback == null || fallback === '' ? DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT : String(fallback);
        let p = slash(path);

        if (!p) {
            p = fb;
        }
        if (!p) {
            p = DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
        }
        if (p.charAt(0) !== '/') {
            p = '/' + p.replace(/^\/+/, '');
        }
        while (p.indexOf('//') !== -1) {
            p = p.split('//').join('/');
        }
        if (hasTraversal(p)) {
            throw new Error('Path may not contain path traversal (..).');
        }
        if (p.length > 1 && p.endsWith('/')) {
            p = p.slice(0, -1);
        }
        return p || fb || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
    }

    function bytesToBase64(bytes) {
        let binary = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
            binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
        }
        return btoa(binary);
    }

    function textToBytes(text) {
        return new TextEncoder().encode(String(text == null ? '' : text));
    }

    function getTreeSource() {
        try {
            return localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server';
        } catch (error) {
            return 'server';
        }
    }

    function getPublishDestination() {
        try {
            if (window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH && typeof window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getPublishDestination === 'function') {
                const dest = window.APRO_FILEPUBLISH.getPublishDestination();
                if (dest === 'github' || dest === 'remote' || dest === 'server' || dest === 'godaddy') {
                    return dest;
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        try {
            const stored = localStorage.getItem('apro_publish_destination') || '';
            if (stored === 'github' || stored === 'remote' || stored === 'server' || stored === 'godaddy') {
                return stored;
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        const source = getTreeSource();
        if (source === 'github') {
            return 'github';
        }
        if (source === 'remote') {
            return 'remote';
        }
        if (source === 'godaddy') {
            return 'godaddy';
        }
        return 'server';
    }

    function isGitHubMode() {
        return getPublishDestination() === 'github' || getTreeSource() === 'github';
    }

    function isRemoteMode() {
        return !isGitHubMode() && (getPublishDestination() === 'remote' || getTreeSource() === 'remote');
    }

    function isGoDaddyMode() {
        return !isGitHubMode() && !isRemoteMode() && (getPublishDestination() === 'godaddy' || getTreeSource() === 'godaddy');
    }

    function getModeLabel() {
        if (isGitHubMode()) {
            return 'GitHub';
        }
        if (isRemoteMode()) {
            return 'Remote Server';
        }
        if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
            return 'GoDaddy';
        }
        return 'Local';
    }

    function dirname(path) {
        const clean = cleanAbs(path, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        if (clean === '/') {
            return '/';
        }
        const idx = clean.lastIndexOf('/');
        return idx <= 0 ? '/' : clean.slice(0, idx);
    }

    function basename(path) {
        const clean = cleanAbs(path, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        if (clean === '/') {
            return '';
        }
        return clean.slice(clean.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    }

    function normalizeDir(input) {
        return cleanAbs(input || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
    }

    function normalizeFilename(input) {
        let name = slash(input || '');
        name = name.replace(/^\/+/, '');
        if (hasTraversal(name)) {
            throw new Error('Path may not contain path traversal (..).');
        }
        return name;
    }

    function joinPath(dir, name) {
        const cleanDir = normalizeDir(dir);
        const cleanName = normalizeFilename(name) || 'untitled.txt';
        return cleanAbs(cleanDir === '/' ? '/' + cleanName : cleanDir + '/' + cleanName, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
    }

    function getRemoteConfig(throwIfMissing) {
        const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig === 'function'
            ? (window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig() || {})
            : {};

        const out = {
            server_url: String(cfg.server_url || '').trim(),
            api_key: String(cfg.api_key || '').trim(),
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            dest_path: cleanAbs(cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT),
            browse_root: cleanAbs(cfg.browse_root || cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT)
        };

        if (throwIfMissing && (!out.server_url || !out.api_key)) {
            if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal === 'function') {
                window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal();
            }
            throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured. Save a valid Server URL and API Key first.');
        }

        return out;
    }

    function getGoDaddyConfig(throwIfMissing) {
        let cfg = null;
        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
            cfg = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected() || null;
        }
        const out = cfg ? {
            base_url: String(cfg.base_url || '').trim(),
            username: String(cfg.username || '').trim(),
            api_token: String(cfg.api_token || '').trim(),
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            root_path: cleanAbs(cfg.root_path || '/public_html', '/public_html'),
            label: String(cfg.label || '').trim()
        } : null;

        if (throwIfMissing && (!out || !out.base_url || !out.username || !out.api_token)) {
            throw new Error('GoDaddy account is not configured. Select or add a GoDaddy account first.');
        }

        return out;
    }

    function remoteTarget(path, cfg) {
        cfg = cfg || getRemoteConfig(false);

        if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath === 'function') {
            return cleanAbs(window.APRO_SERVER.resolveRemoteTargetPath(path, cfg), cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        }

        const raw = slash(path);
        if (!raw) {
            return cleanAbs(cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        }
        if (raw.charAt(0) === '/') {
            return cleanAbs(raw, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        }

        const base = cleanAbs(cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        return cleanAbs(base === '/' ? '/' + raw : base + '/' + raw, base);
    }

    function findSelectedBaseDir() {
        try {
            const selected = window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.getSelectedPaths === 'function'
                ? window.APRO_UI.getSelectedPaths()
                : [];

            if (!Array.isArray(selected) || selected.length === 0) {
                if (isRemoteMode()) {
                    return getRemoteConfig(false).dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
                }
                if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
                    const gd = getGoDaddyConfig(false);
                    return gd && gd.root_path ? gd.root_path : '/public_html';
                }
                return DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
            }

            const selectedPath = String(selected[0] || '').trim();
            if (!selectedPath) {
                if (isRemoteMode()) {
                    return getRemoteConfig(false).dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
                }
                if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
                    const gd = getGoDaddyConfig(false);
                    return gd && gd.root_path ? gd.root_path : '/public_html';
                }
                return DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
            }

            let type = '';
            if (window.CSS && typeof window.CSS.escape === 'function') {
                const item = document.querySelector('li.apro-tree-item[data-path="' + CSS.escape(selectedPath) + '"]');
                if (item) {
                    type = item.getAttribute('data-type') || '';
                }
            }

            if (!type) {
                const items = document.querySelectorAll('li.apro-tree-item');
                for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
                    if ((items[i].getAttribute('data-path') || '') === selectedPath) {
                        type = items[i].getAttribute('data-type') || '';
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (type === 'directory') {
                return cleanAbs(selectedPath, DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
            }

            return cleanAbs(dirname(selectedPath), DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT);
        } catch (error) {
            if (isRemoteMode()) {
                try {
                    return getRemoteConfig(false).dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
                } catch (ignored) {}
            }
            if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
                try {
                    const gd = getGoDaddyConfig(false);
                    return gd && gd.root_path ? gd.root_path : '/public_html';
                } catch (ignored) {}
            }
            return DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT;
        }
    }

    function getPromptText() {
        const promptEl = document.getElementById('userPrompt');
        return promptEl ? String(promptEl.value || '') : '';
    }

    function getTargetPath() {
        return joinPath(state.elements.dirInput.value, state.elements.nameInput.value);
    }

    function ensureModal() {
        if (state.modal) {
            return state.modal;
        }

        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'newFileFromPromptModal';
        modal.className = 'apro-modal';
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.innerHTML = [
            '<div class="apro-modal-backdrop"></div>',
            '<div class="apro-modal-content" style="max-width:880px; width:96vw;">',

            '        <button type="button" id="nffpUseSelected" class="apro-mini-button" title="Use directory from current File Tree selection">Use Selected</button>',
            '      </div>',

            '          <div class="apro-field"><label>GitHub Owner<input type="text" id="nffpGhOwner"></label></div>',
            '          <div class="apro-field"><label>Repository<input type="text" id="nffpGhRepo"></label></div>',
            '          <div class="apro-field"><label>Branch<input type="text" id="nffpGhBranch" placeholder="main"></label></div>',
            '          <div class="apro-field"><label>Commit Message<input type="text" id="nffpGhCommit" placeholder="APRO: add or replace file"></label></div>',
            '        </div>',

            '    </div>',
            '    <div id="nffpExistNotice" class="apro-status" style="display:none;"></div>',
            '    <div id="nffpDiffWrap" style="display:none; margin-top:10px;">',
            '      <div class="publishModal-diff">',
            '        <div class="publishModal-diff-pane">',
            '          <div id="nffpCurrentHeader" class="publishModal-diff-header">Current file</div>',
            '          <pre id="nffpCurrentContent" class="publishModal-diff-content"></pre>',
            '        </div>',
            '        <div class="publishModal-diff-pane-add">',
            '          <div id="nffpProposedHeader" class="publishModal-diff-header">Proposed from Prompt</div>',
            '          <pre id="nffpProposedContent" class="publishModal-diff-content"></pre>',
            '        </div>',
            '      </div>',
            '      <div id="nffpDiffMeta" style="font-size:12px;color:#9fb4d1;margin-top:6px;"></div>',
            '    </div>',
            '  </div>',
            '  <div class="apro-modal-footer">',
            '    <button type="button" id="nffpCommitButton" class="apro-primary-button">Create File</button>',
            '    <button type="button" id="nffpReplaceButton" class="apro-primary-button" style="display:none;">Replace and archive current</button>',
            '    <button type="button" id="nffpCancelButton" class="apro-secondary-button">Cancel</button>',
            '  </div>',
            '</div>'
        ].join('');

        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        modal.querySelector('.apro-modal-backdrop').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (modal.style.display === 'flex' && event.key === 'Escape') {
                closeModal();
            }
        });

        state.modal = modal;
        state.elements = {
            modeNotice: modal.querySelector('#nffpModeNotice'),
            dirInput: modal.querySelector('#nffpDirInput'),
            nameInput: modal.querySelector('#nffpNameInput'),
            useSelectedBtn: modal.querySelector('#nffpUseSelected'),
            pathPreview: modal.querySelector('#nffpPathPreview'),
            existNotice: modal.querySelector('#nffpExistNotice'),
            diffWrap: modal.querySelector('#nffpDiffWrap'),
            currentPre: modal.querySelector('#nffpCurrentContent'),
            proposedPre: modal.querySelector('#nffpProposedContent'),
            diffMeta: modal.querySelector('#nffpDiffMeta'),
            commitBtn: modal.querySelector('#nffpCommitButton'),
            replaceBtn: modal.querySelector('#nffpReplaceButton'),
