            ghOwner: modal.querySelector('#nffpGhOwner'),
            ghRepo: modal.querySelector('#nffpGhRepo'),
            ghBranch: modal.querySelector('#nffpGhBranch'),
            ghCommit: modal.querySelector('#nffpGhCommit'),
            currentHeader: modal.querySelector('#nffpCurrentHeader'),
            proposedHeader: modal.querySelector('#nffpProposedHeader')
        };

        attachHandlers();
        return modal;
    }

    function closeModal() {
        if (state.modal) {
            state.modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function setNotice(message, type) {
        const notice = state.elements.existNotice;
        if (!notice) {
            return;
        }
        notice.style.display = message ? '' : 'none';
        notice.classList.remove('is-error', 'is-success');
        notice.textContent = message || '';
        if (type === 'error') {
            notice.classList.add('is-error');
        }
        if (type === 'success') {
            notice.classList.add('is-success');
        }
    }

    function setBusy(isBusy) {
        state.isBusy = !!isBusy;
        const e = state.elements;
        [e.commitBtn, e.replaceBtn, e.dirInput, e.nameInput, e.useSelectedBtn, e.ghOwner, e.ghRepo, e.ghBranch, e.ghCommit].forEach(function (el) {
            if (el) {
                el.disabled = !!isBusy;
            }
        });
        if (e.cancelBtn) {
            e.cancelBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    function currentCreateText() {
        if (isGitHubMode()) {
            return 'Commit New File';
        }
        if (isRemoteMode()) {
            return 'Create on Remote Server';
        }
        if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
            return 'Create on GoDaddy';
        }
        return 'Create File';
    }

    function currentReplaceText() {
        if (isGitHubMode()) {
            return 'Commit Replacement';
        }
        if (isRemoteMode()) {
            return 'Replace on Remote Server and archive current';
        }
        if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
            return 'Replace on GoDaddy and archive current';
        }
        return 'Replace and archive current';
    }

    function resetReplaceUI() {
        const e = state.elements;
        state.pendingReplace = null;
        if (e.diffWrap) {
            e.diffWrap.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (e.currentPre) {
            e.currentPre.textContent = '';
        }
        if (e.proposedPre) {
            e.proposedPre.textContent = '';
        }
        if (e.diffMeta) {
            e.diffMeta.textContent = '';
        }
        if (e.commitBtn) {
            e.commitBtn.disabled = false;
            e.commitBtn.style.display = '';
            e.commitBtn.textContent = currentCreateText();
        }
        if (e.replaceBtn) {
            e.replaceBtn.disabled = false;
            e.replaceBtn.style.display = 'none';
            e.replaceBtn.textContent = currentReplaceText();
        }
        if (e.currentHeader) {
            e.currentHeader.textContent = isGitHubMode() ? 'Current GitHub file' : (isRemoteMode() ? 'Current Remote Server file' : (isGoDaddyMode() ? 'Current GoDaddy file' : 'Current file'));
        }
        if (e.proposedHeader) {
            e.proposedHeader.textContent = 'Proposed from Prompt';
        }
    }

    async function checkExistenceLocal(path) {
        let payload;
        if (window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.getJson === 'function') {
            payload = await window.APRO_API.getJson('api/file_view.php?allow_missing=1&path=' + encodeURIComponent(path));
            if (payload && payload.status === 'success' && payload.data) {
                payload = payload.data;
            }
        } else {
            const response = await fetch('api/file_view.php?allow_missing=1&path=' + encodeURIComponent(path), {
                method: 'GET',
                credentials: 'same-origin',
                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
            });
            const text = await response.text();
            try {
                payload = JSON.parse(text);
            } catch (error) {
                throw new Error('Unable to parse file existence response.');
            }
            if (payload.status !== 'success' && payload.success !== true && payload.ok !== true) {
                throw new Error(payload.message || payload.error || 'File existence check failed.');
            }
            payload = payload.data || payload;
        }

        const data = payload || {};
        return {
            exists: data.exists !== false,
            data: data.exists !== false ? data : null
        };
    }

    async function checkExistenceRemote(path) {
        const cfg = getRemoteConfig(true);
        const target = remoteTarget(path, cfg);
        const request = {
            server_url: cfg.server_url,
            api_key: cfg.api_key,
            insecure: cfg.insecure,
            path: target,
            allow_missing: true
        };
        const data = window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.serverFileView === 'function'
            ? await window.APRO_API.serverFileView(request)
            : await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/server/file.php', request);

        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
            throw new Error('Invalid Remote Server file response.');
        }

        return {
            exists: data.exists !== false,
            data: data.exists !== false ? data : null,
            target: target
        };
    }

    async function checkExistenceGitHub(path) {
        const owner = (state.elements.ghOwner.value || '').trim();
        const repo = (state.elements.ghRepo.value || '').trim();
        const branch = (state.elements.ghBranch.value || '').trim() || 'main';

        if (!owner || !repo || !branch) {
            throw new Error('GitHub owner, repo, and branch are required.');
        }

        try {
            const data = await window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(owner, repo, branch, path);
            return { exists: true, data: data };
        } catch (error) {
            const message = String(error && error.message ? error.message : '');
            if (/404|not\s+found/i.test(message)) {
                return { exists: false, data: null };
            }
            throw error;
        }
    }

    async function checkExistenceGoDaddy(path) {
        const cfg = getGoDaddyConfig(true);
        const data = await window.APRO_API.godaddyFile({
            base_url: cfg.base_url,
            username: cfg.username,
            api_token: cfg.api_token,
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            path: path,
            allow_missing: true
        });
        return {
            exists: !!(data && data.exists !== false),
            data: data && data.exists !== false ? data : null,
            target: path
        };
    }

    async function publishLocal(path, operation, content) {
        const file = {
            path: path,
            target_path: path,
            operation: operation,
            content: content,
            encoding: 'text'
        };

        if (window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.publishLocal === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_API.publishLocal([file], false);
        }

        return window.APRO_API.postJson('api/publish_commit.php', {
            action: 'publish',
            files: [file]
        });
    }

    async function publishToGitHub(path, operation, content, owner, repo, branch, commitMessage) {
        return window.APRO_API.githubPublish(owner, repo, branch, path, content, 'text', commitMessage);
    }

    function tarWriteString(buf, offset, value) {
        const text = String(value || '');
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length && offset + i < buf.length; i += 1) {
            buf[offset + i] = text.charCodeAt(i) & 255;
        }
    }

    function tarWriteOctal(buf, offset, length, value) {
        const text = Math.max(0, Number(value || 0)).toString(8);
        const pad = Math.max(0, length - 1 - text.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < pad; i += 1) {
            buf[offset + i] = 48;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < text.length && pad + i < length - 1; i += 1) {
            buf[offset + pad + i] = text.charCodeAt(i) & 255;
        }
        buf[offset + length - 1] = 0;
    }

    function tarHeader(path, size) {
        const buf = new Uint8Array(512);
        let name = String(path || '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
        let prefix = '';

        if (name.length > 100) {
            const lastSlash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
            if (lastSlash > 0) {
                prefix = name.substring(0, Math.min(lastSlash, 155));
                name = name.substring(prefix.length + 1);
            }
        }

        tarWriteString(buf, 0, name.substring(0, 100));
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 100, 8, 420);
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 108, 8, 0);
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 116, 8, 0);
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 124, 12, size);
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 136, 12, Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
        for (let i = 148; i < 156; i += 1) {
            buf[i] = 32;
        }
        buf[156] = 48;
        tarWriteString(buf, 257, 'ustar');
        tarWriteString(buf, 263, '00');
        tarWriteString(buf, 345, prefix.substring(0, 155));

        let sum = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 512; i += 1) {
            sum += buf[i];
        }
        tarWriteOctal(buf, 148, 8, sum);
        return buf;
    }

    function pad512(bytes) {
        const remainder = bytes.length % 512;
        if (remainder === 0) {
            return bytes;
        }
        const out = new Uint8Array(bytes.length + 512 - remainder);
        out.set(bytes, 0);
        return out;
    }

    function buildTar(files) {
        const blocks = [];
        files.forEach(function (file) {
            blocks.push(tarHeader(file.path, file.bytes.length));
            blocks.push(pad512(file.bytes));
        });
        blocks.push(new Uint8Array(512));
        blocks.push(new Uint8Array(512));

        let total = 0;
        blocks.forEach(function (block) {
            total += block.length;
        });

        const out = new Uint8Array(total);
        let offset = 0;
        blocks.forEach(function (block) {
            out.set(block, offset);
            offset += block.length;
        });
        return out;
    }

    async function gzipBytes(bytes) {
        if (typeof CompressionStream === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('This browser does not support in-browser gzip packaging. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox version.');
        }
        const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('gzip'));
        return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
    }

    async function archiveRemote(path) {
        const cfg = getRemoteConfig(true);
        const target = remoteTarget(path, cfg);
        return window.APRO_API.serverArchive({
            method: 'https_agent',
            server_url: cfg.server_url,
            api_key: cfg.api_key,
            insecure: cfg.insecure,
            path: target
        });
    }

    async function publishRemote(path, operation, content) {
        const cfg = getRemoteConfig(true);
        const target = remoteTarget(path, cfg);

        if (operation === 'REPLACE') {
            await archiveRemote(target);
        }

        const root = dirname(target);
        const entry = basename(target) || 'untitled.txt';
        const tar = buildTar([{ path: entry, bytes: textToBytes(content) }]);
        const gz = await gzipBytes(tar);

        return window.APRO_API.serverPublish({
            method: 'https_agent',
            server_url: cfg.server_url,
            api_key: cfg.api_key,
            insecure: cfg.insecure,
            dest_path: root,
            post_hook: '',
            package_b64: bytesToBase64(gz)
        });
    }

    async function publishGoDaddy(path, operation, content) {
        const cfg = getGoDaddyConfig(true);
        const result = await window.APRO_API.godaddyPublish({
            action: 'publish',
            base_url: cfg.base_url,
            username: cfg.username,
            api_token: cfg.api_token,
            insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
            files: [{
                path: path,
                target_path: path,
                operation: operation,
                content: content,
                encoding: 'text'
            }]
        });
        return result;
    }

    function summarizePublishResult(result) {
        const published = Array.isArray(result && result.published) ? result.published : [];
        const skipped = Array.isArray(result && result.skipped) ? result.skipped : [];
        const errors = Array.isArray(result && result.errors) ? result.errors : [];
        const parts = [];

        if (published.length) {
            parts.push('Published: ' + published.map(function (row) {
                return row.path + ' (' + row.operation + ')';
            }).join(', '));
        }
        if (skipped.length) {
            parts.push('Skipped: ' + skipped.map(function (row) {
                return row.path + ' (' + row.reason + ')';
            }).join(', '));
        }
        if (errors.length) {
            parts.push('Errors: ' + errors.map(function (row) {
                return row.path + ' (' + row.message + ')';
            }).join(', '));
        }

        return parts.join('\n');
    }

    async function reloadTreeQuietly() {
        try {
            if (window.APRO_APP && typeof window.APRO_APP.reloadTree === 'function') {
                await window.APRO_APP.reloadTree();
            }
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    async function afterPublishSuccessLocal(fullPath, result) {
        setNotice(summarizePublishResult(result) || ('Publish completed. Path: ' + fullPath), 'success');
        resetReplaceUI();
        await reloadTreeQuietly();

        try {
            if (window.confirm('Open the file in the viewer now?') && window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.open === 'function') {
                window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.open(fullPath);
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        addPathToSelectionWithPrompt(fullPath);
    }

    async function afterPublishSuccessRemote(fullPath, result) {
        const code = result && result.status_code ? result.status_code : 200;
        setNotice('Remote Server publish completed (HTTP ' + code + ').\nPath: ' + fullPath, 'success');
        resetReplaceUI();
        await reloadTreeQuietly();

        try {
            if (window.confirm('Open the remote file in the viewer now?') && window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                const probe = await checkExistenceRemote(fullPath);
                if (probe && probe.data) {
                    window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(probe.data);

    async function afterPublishSuccessGitHub(fullPath, result) {
        const lines = [
            'GitHub publish succeeded: ' + (result && result.created ? 'created' : 'updated'),
            'Repo: ' + ((result && result.owner) || '') + '/' + ((result && result.repo) || '') + ' @ ' + ((result && result.branch) || ''),
            'Path: ' + ((result && result.path) || fullPath)

        if (result && result.commit_url) {
            lines.push('Commit: ' + result.commit_url);
        }

        setNotice(lines.join('\n'), 'success');
        resetReplaceUI();
        await reloadTreeQuietly();

        try {
            if (window.confirm('Open the committed file from GitHub now?') && window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                const owner = state.elements.ghOwner.value.trim();
                const repo = state.elements.ghRepo.value.trim();
                const branch = state.elements.ghBranch.value.trim() || 'main';

                window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(file);
            }
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    async function afterPublishSuccessGoDaddy(fullPath, result) {

        setNotice(summary, 'success');
        resetReplaceUI();
        await reloadTreeQuietly();

        try {
            if (window.confirm('Open the GoDaddy file in the viewer now?') && window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                const probe = await checkExistenceGoDaddy(fullPath);
                if (probe && probe.data) {
                    window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(probe.data);
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {}

        addPathToSelectionWithPrompt(fullPath);
    }

    function addPathToSelectionWithPrompt(fullPath) {
        try {
            if (!window.confirm('Add this file to the current selection set?')) {
                return;
            }
            if (window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS && typeof window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS.add === 'function') {
                window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS.add(fullPath);
            }
            if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary === 'function') {
                window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS || new Set());
            }
        } catch (error) {}
    }

    async function handleCreateOrReplace(operation, path, content) {
        setBusy(true);
        const e = state.elements;
        const busyText = isGitHubMode() ? 'Committing...' : (isRemoteMode() ? 'Publishing to Remote...' : (isGoDaddyMode() ? 'Publishing to GoDaddy...' : (operation === 'ADD' ? 'Creating...' : 'Replacing...')));

        if (operation === 'ADD' && e.commitBtn) {
            e.commitBtn.textContent = busyText;
        }
        if (operation === 'REPLACE' && e.replaceBtn) {
            e.replaceBtn.textContent = busyText;
        }

        try {
            if (isGitHubMode()) {
                const owner = e.ghOwner.value.trim();
                const repo = e.ghRepo.value.trim();
                const branch = e.ghBranch.value.trim() || 'main';
                let commitMessage = e.ghCommit.value.trim();

                if (!commitMessage) {
                    commitMessage = 'APRO: ' + (operation === 'ADD' ? 'add ' : 'replace ') + path;
                }
                if (!owner || !repo || !branch) {
                    throw new Error('GitHub owner, repo, and branch are required.');
                }

                const result = await publishToGitHub(path, operation, content, owner, repo, branch, commitMessage);
                await afterPublishSuccessGitHub(path, result);
            } else if (isRemoteMode()) {
                const target = remoteTarget(path, getRemoteConfig(true));
                const result = await publishRemote(target, operation, content);
                await afterPublishSuccessRemote(target, result);
            } else if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
                const result = await publishGoDaddy(path, operation, content);
                await afterPublishSuccessGoDaddy(path, result);
            } else {
                const result = await publishLocal(path, operation, content);
                await afterPublishSuccessLocal(path, result);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            setNotice(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Publish failed.', 'error');
        } finally {
            if (e.commitBtn) {
                e.commitBtn.textContent = currentCreateText();
            }
            if (e.replaceBtn) {
                e.replaceBtn.textContent = currentReplaceText();
            }
            setBusy(false);
        }
    }

    async function prepareReplaceViewCommon(fullPath, currentData, proposedContent) {
        const e = state.elements;

        if (e.commitBtn) {
            e.commitBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (e.replaceBtn) {
            e.replaceBtn.disabled = false;
            e.replaceBtn.style.display = '';
            e.replaceBtn.textContent = currentReplaceText();
        }
        if (!e.diffWrap) {
            return;
        }

        let currentDisplay = '';
        if (!currentData || currentData.encoding === 'base64') {
            currentDisplay = currentData ? '[Binary or non-text file content. Replacement will overwrite the entire file.]' : '[Current file not available]';
        } else {
            currentDisplay = String(currentData.content || '');
        }

        e.currentPre.textContent = currentDisplay;
        e.proposedPre.textContent = proposedContent;

        const currentLines = currentData && typeof currentData.line_count === 'number'
            ? currentData.line_count
            : (currentDisplay === '' ? 0 : currentDisplay.split('\n').length);
        const proposedLines = proposedContent === '' ? 0 : proposedContent.split('\n').length;
        const currentSize = currentData && typeof currentData.size_bytes === 'number' ? currentData.size_bytes : currentDisplay.length;

        e.diffMeta.textContent = [

            setNotice('A file already exists at this path on the Remote Server. Review the comparison and click Replace on Remote Server to continue.', '');
        } else if (isGoDaddyMode()) {
            setNotice('A file already exists at this path on GoDaddy. Review the comparison and click Replace on GoDaddy to continue. The existing file will be archived first.', '');
        } else {

        }

    async function doCommitFlow() {
        if (state.isBusy) {
            return;
        }

        resetReplaceUI();
        const promptText = getPromptText();
        if (!promptText.trim()) {
            setNotice('The Prompt field is empty. Enter the desired file contents before creating the file.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        let fullPath;
        try {
            fullPath = getTargetPath();
        } catch (error) {
            setNotice(error && error.message ? error.message : 'A valid absolute target path is required.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        if (!fullPath || !fullPath.startsWith('/')) {
            setNotice('A valid absolute target path is required.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        try {
            setBusy(true);
            setNotice('Checking if the target file exists in ' + getModeLabel() + ' mode...', '');

            const probe = isGitHubMode()
                ? await checkExistenceGitHub(fullPath)
                : (isRemoteMode() ? await checkExistenceRemote(fullPath) : (isGoDaddyMode() ? await checkExistenceGoDaddy(fullPath) : await checkExistenceLocal(fullPath)));

            if (!probe.exists) {
                setNotice('', '');
                await handleCreateOrReplace('ADD', publishPath, promptText);

            await prepareReplaceViewCommon(publishPath, probe.data || null, promptText);
        } catch (error) {
            setBusy(false);
            resetReplaceUI();
            setNotice(error && error.message ? error.message : 'File existence check failed.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function doReplaceFlow() {
        if (state.isBusy) {
            return;
        }
        if (!state.pendingReplace) {
            setNotice('No replacement is pending. Re-run the check before replacing.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        await handleCreateOrReplace('REPLACE', state.pendingReplace.path, state.pendingReplace.content);
    }

    function handleInputChange() {
        const e = state.elements;
        try {
            const full = joinPath(e.dirInput.value, e.nameInput.value);
            if (e.pathPreview) {
                e.pathPreview.textContent = full;
            }
            resetReplaceUI();
            setNotice('', '');
        } catch (error) {
            if (e.pathPreview) {
                e.pathPreview.textContent = 'Invalid path';
            }
            resetReplaceUI();
            setNotice(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Invalid path.', 'error');
        }
    }

    function attachHandlers() {
        const e = state.elements;
        e.dirInput.addEventListener('input', handleInputChange);
        e.nameInput.addEventListener('input', handleInputChange);
        e.useSelectedBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            e.dirInput.value = findSelectedBaseDir();
            if (!e.nameInput.value.trim()) {
                e.nameInput.value = 'new_file.txt';
            }
            handleInputChange();
        });
        e.commitBtn.addEventListener('click', doCommitFlow);
        e.replaceBtn.addEventListener('click', doReplaceFlow);
        e.cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    }

    function resetModalState() {
        const baseDir = findSelectedBaseDir();
        const e = state.elements;
        e.dirInput.value = baseDir;
        e.nameInput.value = '';

        try {
            e.pathPreview.textContent = joinPath(baseDir, '');
        } catch (error) {
            e.pathPreview.textContent = '/untitled.txt';
        }

        setNotice('', '');
        resetReplaceUI();
        state.isBusy = false;

        const ghMode = isGitHubMode();
        const remoteMode = isRemoteMode() && !ghMode;
        const godaddyMode = isGoDaddyMode() && !ghMode && !remoteMode;

        if (e.ghWrap) {
            e.ghWrap.style.display = ghMode ? '' : 'none';
        }
        if (ghMode) {
            if (e.ghOwner) {
                e.ghOwner.value = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '';
            }
            if (e.ghRepo) {
                e.ghRepo.value = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '';
            }
            if (e.ghBranch) {
                e.ghBranch.value = localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main';
            }
            if (e.ghCommit) {
                e.ghCommit.value = '';
            }
        }

        if (e.modeNotice) {
            if (ghMode) {
                e.modeNotice.textContent = 'Publish destination: GitHub Repository. This flow will commit to the configured GitHub repo.';
            } else if (remoteMode) {
                const cfg = getRemoteConfig(false);
                e.modeNotice.textContent = 'Publish destination: Remote Server. Absolute target paths are published literally; relative paths use the configured destination root ' + (cfg.dest_path || DEFAULT_REMOTE_ROOT) + '.';
            } else if (godaddyMode) {
                const gd = getGoDaddyConfig(false);
                e.modeNotice.textContent = 'Publish destination: GoDaddy. This flow writes directly to ' + ((gd && gd.label) ? gd.label : 'the selected GoDaddy account') + ' and archives the current file first when replacing.';
            } else {
                e.modeNotice.textContent = 'Publish destination: Local Server Filesystem.';
            }
        }

        if (e.commitBtn) {
            e.commitBtn.textContent = currentCreateText();
        }
        if (e.replaceBtn) {
            e.replaceBtn.textContent = currentReplaceText();
        }
        if (e.currentHeader) {
            e.currentHeader.textContent = ghMode ? 'Current GitHub file' : (remoteMode ? 'Current Remote Server file' : (godaddyMode ? 'Current GoDaddy file' : 'Current file'));
        }
    }

    function openModal() {
        ensureModal();
        resetModalState();
        state.modal.style.display = 'flex';
        setTimeout(function () {
            if (state.elements.nameInput) {
                state.elements.nameInput.focus();
            }
        }, 0);
    }

    function wireOpenButton() {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const button = document.getElementById('newFileFromPromptButton');
            if (button) {
                button.addEventListener('click', openModal);
            }
        });
    }

    wireOpenButton();
    window.APRO_NewFileFromPrompt = { open: openModal };
})();

    function getGithubMeta() {
        try {
            const owner = String(localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_owner') || '').trim();
            const repo = String(localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_repo') || '').trim();
            const branch = String(localStorage.getItem('apro_gh_branch') || 'main').trim() || 'main';
            if (owner && repo && branch) {
                return { owner, repo, branch };
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function getGoDaddyMeta() {
        try {
            if (window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
                const account = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected();
                if (account && account.base_url && account.username && account.api_token) {
                    return account;
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
    }

    function normalizePath(path) {
        if (typeof path !== 'string') {
            return '';
        }
        let normalized = path.trim();
        if (normalized === '') {
            return '';
        }
        normalized = normalized.replace(/\\/g, '/');
        normalized = normalized.replace(/\/+?/g, '/');
        if (normalized !== '/' && !normalized.startsWith('/')) {
            normalized = '/' + normalized;
        }
        if (normalized.length > 1 && normalized.endsWith('/')) {
            normalized = normalized.slice(0, -1);
        }
        return normalized || '/';
    }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
        const value = Number(bytes);
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
            return '0 B';
        }
        const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB'];
        let size = value;
        let index = 0;
        while (size >= 1024 && index < units.length - 1) {
            size /= 1024;
            index += 1;
        }
        const decimals = size >= 100 ? 0 : (size >= 10 ? 1 : 2);
        return size.toFixed(decimals) + ' ' + units[index];
    }

    function ensureGoDaddyNodeMenu() {
        if (godaddyNodeMenuEl) {
            return godaddyNodeMenuEl;
        }
        const menu = document.createElement('div');
        menu.id = 'aproGoDaddyTreeNodeMenu';
        menu.style.position = 'fixed';
        menu.style.zIndex = '30000';
        menu.style.minWidth = '200px';
        menu.style.padding = '6px';
        menu.style.borderRadius = '10px';
        menu.style.border = '1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28)';
        menu.style.background = '#0f172a';
        menu.style.boxShadow = '0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,0.38)';
        menu.style.display = 'none';
        menu.innerHTML = '' +
            '<button type="button" data-action="expand-recursive" class="apro-mini-button" style="display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 6px 0;text-align:left;">Expand recursively</button>' +
            '<button type="button" data-action="collapse-subtree" class="apro-mini-button" style="display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;">Collapse subtree</button>';
        document.body.appendChild(menu);
        godaddyNodeMenuEl = menu;
        return godaddyNodeMenuEl;
    }

    function hideGoDaddyNodeMenu() {
        const menu = ensureGoDaddyNodeMenu();
        menu.style.display = 'none';
        menu.removeAttribute('data-path');
    }

    function showGoDaddyNodeMenu(path, x, y) {
        const menu = ensureGoDaddyNodeMenu();
        menu.setAttribute('data-path', String(path || ''));
        menu.style.left = Math.max(8, Number(x || 0)) + 'px';
        menu.style.top = Math.max(8, Number(y || 0)) + 'px';
        menu.style.display = 'block';
    }

    function bindGoDaddyNodeMenuEvents() {
        if (godaddyNodeMenuBound) {
            return;
        }
        godaddyNodeMenuBound = true;
        const menu = ensureGoDaddyNodeMenu();

        document.addEventListener('click', function () {
            hideGoDaddyNodeMenu();
        });
        document.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
            hideGoDaddyNodeMenu();
        }, true);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                hideGoDaddyNodeMenu();
            }
        });

        menu.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            const button = event.target && typeof event.target.closest === 'function'
                ? event.target.closest('button[data-action]')
                : null;
            if (!button) {
                return;
            }
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            const action = String(button.getAttribute('data-action') || '');
            const path = String(menu.getAttribute('data-path') || '').trim();
            hideGoDaddyNodeMenu();
            if (!path || !window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE) {
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'expand-recursive' && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive === 'function') {
                window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive(path);
                return;
            }
            if (action === 'collapse-subtree' && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.collapseSubtree === 'function') {
                window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.collapseSubtree(path);
            }
        });
    }

    function createTreeController(container, treeData, selectedPaths, expandedPaths, onSelectionChanged) {
        if (!(container instanceof HTMLElement)) {
            throw new Error('APRO_TREE.createTreeController requires a container element.');
        }

        const selectedSet = (selectedPaths && typeof selectedPaths.has === 'function') ? selectedPaths : new Set();
        const expandedSet = (expandedPaths && typeof expandedPaths.has === 'function') ? expandedPaths : new Set();
        const callback = (typeof onSelectionChanged === 'function') ? onSelectionChanged : function () {};
        const checkboxByPath = new Map();

        const rootPath = normalizePath(treeData && typeof treeData.path === 'string' ? treeData.path : '/');
        if (rootPath && !expandedSet.has(rootPath)) {
            expandedSet.add(rootPath);
        }

        function resolveNodePath(node, parentPath) {
            if (node && typeof node.path === 'string' && node.path.trim() !== '') {
                return normalizePath(node.path);
            }
            const name = (node && typeof node.name === 'string') ? node.name.trim() : '';
            if (!name) {
                return parentPath || '/';
            }
            let base = parentPath || '/';
            if (base !== '/') {
                base += '/' + name;
            } else {
                base += name;
            }
            return normalizePath(base);
        }

        function getChildren(node) {
            if (!node) {
                return [];
            }
            if (Array.isArray(node.children)) {
                return node.children;
            }
            if (Array.isArray(node.nodes)) {
                return node.nodes;
            }
            return [];
        }

        function setSelection(path, shouldSelect) {
            if (!path) {
                return;
            }
            if (shouldSelect) {
                selectedSet.add(path);
            } else {
                selectedSet.delete(path);
            }
        }

        function getCheckboxFromLi(li) {
            if (!li) {
                return null;
            }
            return li.querySelector(':scope > .apro-tree-row > .apro-tree-checkbox');
        }

        function applyCheckboxState(li, isChecked, isDir, syncDescendants) {
            const checkbox = getCheckboxFromLi(li);
            if (!checkbox) {
                return;
            }

            checkbox.checked = isChecked;
            checkbox.indeterminate = false;

            const path = li.dataset.path || '';
            if (path) {
                setSelection(path, isChecked);
            }

            if (isDir && syncDescendants) {
                const childList = li.querySelector(':scope > ul.apro-tree-children');
                if (childList) {
                    Array.from(childList.children)
                        .filter(child => child.classList && child.classList.contains('apro-tree-item'))
                        .forEach(childLi => {
                            const childIsDir = childLi.dataset.type === 'directory';
                            applyCheckboxState(childLi, isChecked, childIsDir, true);
                        });
                }
            }
        }

        function initializeSelectionStates() {
            checkboxByPath.forEach(checkbox => {
                checkbox.checked = false;
                checkbox.indeterminate = false;
            });

            const sortedPaths = Array.from(selectedSet.values()).sort((a, b) => {
                return b.split('/').length - a.split('/').length;
            });

            sortedPaths.forEach(path => {
                const checkbox = checkboxByPath.get(path);
                if (!checkbox) {
                    return;
                }
                const li = checkbox.closest('li.apro-tree-item');
                if (!li) {
                    return;
                }
                const isDir = li.dataset.type === 'directory';
                applyCheckboxState(li, true, isDir, false);
            });
        }

        async function fetchRemoteChildren(targetPath) {
            try {
                if (!window.APRO_SERVER || typeof window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig !== 'function') {
                    throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured.');
                }
                const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig();
                if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key) {
                    throw new Error('Remote Server is not configured.');
                }
                const res = await window.APRO_API.serverTree({ method: 'https_agent', server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: !!cfg.insecure, path: targetPath });
                const t = res && res.tree ? res.tree : null;
                let children = Array.isArray(t && t.children) ? t.children : [];
                try {
                    const allowed = (window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE && typeof window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE._getAllowedExtensionsSet === 'function')
                        ? window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE._getAllowedExtensionsSet()
                        : null;
                    if (allowed && allowed.size) {
                        const getExt = (window.APRO_FILETYPES && typeof window.APRO_FILETYPES.getFileExtension === 'function')
                            ? window.APRO_FILETYPES.getFileExtension
                            : function (name) {
                                const m = String(name || '').match(/(\.[^./\\]+)$/);
                                return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : '';
                            };
                        children = children.filter(function (child) {
                            if ((child && child.type) === 'file') {
                                const base = String(child.name || child.path || '');
                                const ext = getExt(base);
                                return allowed.has(ext);
                            }
                            return true;
                        });
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
                return children;
            } catch (e) {
                const msg = (e && e.message) ? e.message : 'Failed to load directory from server.';
                window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus && window.APRO_UI.setStatus(msg, 'error');
                return [];
            }
        }

        async function fetchGoDaddyChildren(targetPath) {
            try {
                const account = getGoDaddyMeta();
                if (!account) {
                    throw new Error('GoDaddy account is not configured.');
                }
                const res = await window.APRO_API.godaddyTree({
                    base_url: account.base_url,
                    username: account.username,
                    api_token: account.api_token,
                    insecure: !!account.insecure,
                    root_path: account.root_path || '/public_html',
                    path: targetPath,
                    expand_mode: 'single'
                });
                const t = res && res.tree ? res.tree : null;
                return Array.isArray(t && t.children) ? t.children : [];
            } catch (e) {
                const msg = (e && e.message) ? e.message : 'Failed to load directory from GoDaddy.';
                window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus && window.APRO_UI.setStatus(msg, 'error');
                return [];
            }
        }

        function findNodeByPathInData(node, targetPath, parentPath) {
            if (!node) return null;
            const p = resolveNodePath(node, parentPath);
            if (p === targetPath) return node;
            const kids = getChildren(node) || [];
            for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
                const found = findNodeByPathInData(kids[i], targetPath, p);
                if (found) return found;
            }
            return null;
        }

        function setNodeChildrenInData(targetPath, newChildren) {
            const n = findNodeByPathInData(treeData, targetPath, null);
            if (n) {
                n.children = Array.isArray(newChildren) ? newChildren : [];
                if (!n.children.length) {
                    n._remote_empty = true;
                } else {
                    n._remote_empty = false;
                }
            }
        }

        function buildFileActions(nodePath) {
            const actionsWrap = document.createElement('div');
            actionsWrap.className = 'apro-tree-actions';

            let hasAction = false;

            if (window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.open === 'function') {
                const viewBtn = document.createElement('button');
                viewBtn.type = 'button';
                viewBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                viewBtn.textContent = 'View';

                if (isGithubTreeSource()) {
                    const meta = getGithubMeta();
                    if (!meta) {
                        viewBtn.disabled = true;
                        viewBtn.title = 'Enter GitHub owner/repo/branch and Load Repo.';
                    } else {
                        viewBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            event.stopPropagation();
                            const btn = viewBtn; btn.disabled = true;
                            window.APRO_API.githubFetchFile(meta.owner, meta.repo, meta.branch, nodePath)
                                .then(function (data) {
                                    if (window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                                        window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(data);
                                    }
                                })
                                .catch(function (err) {
                                    if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
                                        window.APRO_UI.setStatus(err && err.message ? err.message : 'Failed to load file from GitHub.', 'error');
                                    }
                                })
                                .finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
                        });
                    }
                } else if (isRemoteTreeSource()) {
                    const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig();
                    if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key) {
                        viewBtn.disabled = true;
                        viewBtn.title = 'Configure Remote Server first.';
                    } else {
                        viewBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
                            const btn = viewBtn; btn.disabled = true;
                            window.APRO_API.serverFileView({
                                server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                                path: nodePath, allow_missing: false
                            }).then(function (payload) {
                                if (window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                                    window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(payload);
                                }
                            }).catch(function (err) {
                                window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus && window.APRO_UI.setStatus(err.message || 'Failed to load remote file.', 'error');
                            }).finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
                        });
                    }
                } else if (isGoDaddyTreeSource()) {
                    const gd = getGoDaddyMeta();
                    if (!gd) {
                        viewBtn.disabled = true;
                        viewBtn.title = 'Select a GoDaddy account first.';
                    } else {
                        viewBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            event.stopPropagation();
                            const btn = viewBtn; btn.disabled = true;
                            window.APRO_API.godaddyFile({
                                base_url: gd.base_url,
                                username: gd.username,
                                api_token: gd.api_token,
                                insecure: !!gd.insecure,
                                path: nodePath
                            }).then(function (data) {
                                if (window.APRO_FILEVIEWER && typeof window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload === 'function') {
                                    window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.openWithPayload(data);
                                }
                            }).catch(function (err) {
                                if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
                                    window.APRO_UI.setStatus(err && err.message ? err.message : 'Failed to load file from GoDaddy.', 'error');
                                }
                            }).finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
                        });
                    }
                } else {
                    viewBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        event.stopPropagation();
                        try {
                            window.APRO_FILEVIEWER.open(nodePath);
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.error(error);
                        }
                    });
                }

                actionsWrap.appendChild(viewBtn);
                hasAction = true;
            }

            if (isGithubTreeSource() || isGoDaddyTreeSource()) {
            } else if (isRemoteTreeSource()) {
                const archiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
                archiveBtn.type = 'button';
                archiveBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                archiveBtn.textContent = 'Archive';

                if (ARCHIVE_SUFFIX_PATTERN.test(nodePath) || /\.n\.archive$/i.test(nodePath)) {
                    archiveBtn.disabled = true;
                    archiveBtn.title = 'Archive files cannot be archived again.';
                } else {
                    const cfg = window.APRO_SERVER && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig && window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig();
                    if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key) {
                        archiveBtn.disabled = true;
                        archiveBtn.title = 'Configure Remote Server first.';
                    } else {
                        archiveBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
                            if (!confirm('Archive this file on the Remote Server?')) return;
                            const btn = archiveBtn; btn.disabled = true;
                            window.APRO_API.serverArchive({ server_url: cfg.server_url, api_key: cfg.api_key, insecure: !!cfg.insecure, path: nodePath })
                                .then(function () {
                                    window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE && typeof window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE.load === 'function' && window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE.load();
                                })
                                .catch(function (err) {
                                    window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus && window.APRO_UI.setStatus(err.message || 'Remote archive failed.', 'error');
                                })
                                .finally(function () { btn.disabled = false; });
                        });
                    }
                }
                actionsWrap.appendChild(archiveBtn);
                hasAction = true;
            } else if (isLocalTreeSource() && window.APRO_ARCHIVE_MANAGER && typeof window.APRO_ARCHIVE_MANAGER.archiveFile === 'function') {
                const archiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
                archiveBtn.type = 'button';
                archiveBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
                archiveBtn.textContent = 'Archive';

                if (ARCHIVE_SUFFIX_PATTERN.test(nodePath) || /\.n\.archive$/i.test(nodePath)) {
                    archiveBtn.disabled = true;
                    archiveBtn.title = 'Archive files cannot be archived again.';
                } else {
                    archiveBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        event.stopPropagation();

                        const confirmArchive = window.confirm('Archive this file? The current version will be moved into the .archive rotation.');
                        if (!confirmArchive) {
                            return;
                        }

                        archiveBtn.disabled = true;
                        Promise.resolve()
                            .then(() => window.APRO_ARCHIVE_MANAGER.archiveFile(nodePath))
                            .catch((error) => {
                                archiveBtn.disabled = false;
                                if (error && error.message) {
                                    console.error(error);
                                }
                            });
                    });
                }

                actionsWrap.appendChild(archiveBtn);
                hasAction = true;
            }

            return hasAction ? actionsWrap : null;
        }

        function buildNodeList(nodes, depth, parentPath) {
            const ul = document.createElement('ul');
            ul.className = 'apro-tree-list';
            if (depth === 0) {
                ul.classList.add('apro-tree-root');
            }
            nodes.forEach(node => {
                const li = buildNode(node, depth, parentPath);
                if (li) {
                    ul.appendChild(li);
                }
            });
            return ul;
        }

        function buildNode(node, depth, parentPath) {
            if (!node) {
                return null;
            }

            const nodePath = resolveNodePath(node, parentPath);
            const isDirectory = (node.type === 'directory' || node.type === 'dir' || Array.isArray(node.children));
            const children = getChildren(node);
            const isExpanded = isDirectory && expandedSet.has(nodePath);
            const sizeValue = typeof node.size === 'number'
                ? node.size
                : (typeof node.size_bytes === 'number' ? node.size_bytes : null);

            const li = document.createElement('li');
            li.className = 'apro-tree-item';
            if (nodePath) {
                li.dataset.path = nodePath;
            }
            li.dataset.type = isDirectory ? 'directory' : 'file';
            li.classList.toggle('is-selected', selectedSet.has(nodePath));

            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.className = 'apro-tree-row';
            li.appendChild(row);

            if (isDirectory) {
                const toggle = document.createElement('button');
                toggle.type = 'button';
                toggle.className = 'apro-tree-toggle';

                const hideToggle = (!children.length && !isRemoteTreeSource() && !isGoDaddyTreeSource());
                if (hideToggle || node._remote_empty === true) {
                    toggle.classList.add('is-hidden');
                }

                toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', isExpanded ? 'Collapse directory' : 'Expand directory');
                toggle.textContent = isExpanded ? '▾' : '▸';
                toggle.addEventListener('click', async function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();

                    const recursiveRequest = isGoDaddyTreeSource() && event.shiftKey;
                    const wasExpanded = expandedSet.has(nodePath);
                    if (wasExpanded && !recursiveRequest) {
                        expandedSet.delete(nodePath);
                        render();
                        return;
                    }

                    if (recursiveRequest && window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive === 'function') {
                        toggle.disabled = true;
                        const prev = toggle.textContent;
                        toggle.textContent = '…';
                        try {
                            await window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive(nodePath);
                            return;
                        } finally {
                            toggle.textContent = prev;
                            toggle.disabled = false;
                        }
                    }

                    expandedSet.add(nodePath);

                    if ((isRemoteTreeSource() || isGoDaddyTreeSource()) && (!children || children.length === 0) && !node._remote_empty) {
                        try {
                            toggle.disabled = true;
                            const prev = toggle.textContent;
                            toggle.textContent = '…';
                            const fetched = isGoDaddyTreeSource()
                                ? await fetchGoDaddyChildren(nodePath)
                                : await fetchRemoteChildren(nodePath);
                            setNodeChildrenInData(nodePath, fetched);
                            render();
                            toggle.textContent = prev;
                            toggle.disabled = false;
                            return;
                        } catch (e) {
                            toggle.disabled = false;
                        }
                    }

                    render();
                });
                row.appendChild(toggle);
            } else {
                const placeholder = document.createElement('span');
                placeholder.className = 'apro-tree-toggle is-hidden';
                row.appendChild(placeholder);
            }

            const checkboxId = 'apro-tree-checkbox-' + (++checkboxUidCounter);
            const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
            checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
            checkbox.id = checkboxId;
            checkbox.className = 'apro-tree-checkbox';
            row.appendChild(checkbox);

            if (nodePath) {
                checkboxByPath.set(nodePath, checkbox);
            }

            const label = document.createElement('label');
            label.className = 'apro-tree-label ' + (isDirectory ? 'apro-tree-directory' : 'apro-tree-file');
            label.setAttribute('for', checkboxId);

            const nameSpan = document.createElement('span');
            nameSpan.className = 'apro-tree-name';
            nameSpan.textContent = node.name || node.label || (nodePath === '/' ? '/' : nodePath.split('/').pop() || '(unnamed)');
            label.appendChild(nameSpan);

            if (sizeValue !== null && !Number.isNaN(sizeValue)) {
                const sizeSpan = document.createElement('span');
                sizeSpan.className = 'apro-tree-size';
                sizeSpan.textContent = formatBytes(sizeValue);
                label.appendChild(sizeSpan);
            }

            if (isGoDaddyTreeSource() && isDirectory) {
                const recursiveBtn = document.createElement('button');
                recursiveBtn.type = 'button';
                recursiveBtn.className = 'apro-godaddy-tree-hint';
                recursiveBtn.textContent = '↘ recursive';
                recursiveBtn.setAttribute('title', 'Expand this folder recursively');
                recursiveBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    if (window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive === 'function') {
                        window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive(nodePath);
                    }
                });
                label.appendChild(recursiveBtn);
            }

            row.appendChild(label);

            if (isDirectory) {
                if (isGoDaddyTreeSource()) {
                    row.classList.add('apro-godaddy-directory-row');
                    row.setAttribute('title', 'Click to expand one level. Shift+click or use ↘ recursive to expand this folder recursively. Right-click also opens recursive actions.');
                    bindGoDaddyNodeMenuEvents();
                    row.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (event) {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        event.stopPropagation();
                        showGoDaddyNodeMenu(nodePath, event.clientX, event.clientY);
                    });
                    row.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                        if (!event.shiftKey) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (event.target && typeof event.target.closest === 'function' && event.target.closest('.apro-tree-checkbox')) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (event.target && typeof event.target.closest === 'function' && event.target.closest('.apro-tree-toggle')) {
                            return;
                        }
                        event.preventDefault();
                        event.stopPropagation();
                        if (window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive === 'function') {
                            window.APRO_GODADDY_TREE.expandNodeRecursive(nodePath);
                        }
                    }, true);
                }

                label.addEventListener('dblclick', function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();

(function () {
    // treeServer.js
    // Adds simple Remote Server browsing utilities for the File Tree using APRO server endpoints.

    if (!window.APRO_SERVER) {
        console.warn('[APRO] serverForm.js not loaded; remote server tools unavailable.');
        return;
    }

    function getCfg() {
        return window.APRO_SERVER.getConfig();
    }

    // Maintain an in-memory set of allowed extensions for client-side filtering of Remote trees
    let allowedExtensionsSet = null;

    function setAllowedExtensions(exts) {
        if (Array.isArray(exts) && exts.length) {
            const set = new Set();
            exts.forEach(function (ext) {
                const value = String(ext || '').trim();
                if (value !== '') set.add(value);
            });
            allowedExtensionsSet = set.size ? set : null;
        } else {
            allowedExtensionsSet = null;
        }
    }

    function getAllowedExtensionsSet() {
        return allowedExtensionsSet;
    }

    function getExt(name) {
        if (window.APRO_FILETYPES && typeof window.APRO_FILETYPES.getFileExtension === 'function') {
            return window.APRO_FILETYPES.getFileExtension(name);
        }
        const match = String(name || '').match(/(\.[^./\\]+)$/);
        return match ? match[1].toLowerCase() : '';
    }

    function filterChildrenInPlace(node) {
        if (!node || !allowedExtensionsSet || !allowedExtensionsSet.size) return;

        const kids = Array.isArray(node.children) ? node.children : [];
        node.children = kids.filter(function (child) {
            if (!child || typeof child !== 'object') return false;
            if ((child.type || '') === 'file') {
                return allowedExtensionsSet.has(getExt(child.name || child.path || ''));
            }
            // Always keep directories (do not recurse; remote children are lazy-loaded)
            return true;
        });
    }

    async function loadRemoteTree(pathOrOptions, maybeOptions) {
        const cfg = getCfg();
        if (!cfg || !cfg.server_url || !cfg.api_key) {
            if (window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus) window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Configure a Remote Server first.', 'error');
            if (window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal) window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal();
            return;
        }

        // Support flexible args: load(path), load(options), or load(path, options)
        let reqPath = '';
        let options = null;
        if (typeof pathOrOptions === 'string') {
            reqPath = pathOrOptions;
            options = maybeOptions && typeof maybeOptions === 'object' ? maybeOptions : null;
        } else if (pathOrOptions && typeof pathOrOptions === 'object') {
            options = pathOrOptions;
        }

        // Apply filter selection (null => show all)
        if (options && Array.isArray(options.allowedExtensions)) {
            setAllowedExtensions(options.allowedExtensions);
        } else {
            setAllowedExtensions(null);
        }

        const treeContainer = document.getElementById('treeContainer');
        const selectedPaths = window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS || new Set();
        const expandedPaths = new Set();
        const configuredBrowseRoot = cfg.browse_root || localStorage.getItem('apro_remote_browse_root') || cfg.dest_path || '/var/www/html';
        const browseRoot = (reqPath && String(reqPath).trim()) ? String(reqPath).trim() : configuredBrowseRoot;
        expandedPaths.add(browseRoot);
        const metaEl = document.getElementById('treeMeta');

        if (treeContainer) {
            treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-loading">Loading remote file tree...</div>';
        }
        if (window.APRO_UI && typeof window.APRO_UI.setStatus === 'function') {
            window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Loading remote file tree...', '');
        }

        try {
            const payload = {
                method: 'https_agent',
                server_url: cfg.server_url,
                api_key: cfg.api_key,
                insecure: !!cfg.insecure,
                path: browseRoot
            };

            let res;
            if (window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.serverTree === 'function') {
                res = await window.APRO_API.serverTree(payload);
            } else if (window.APRO_API && typeof window.APRO_API.postJson === 'function') {
                res = await window.APRO_API.postJson('api/server/tree.php', payload);
            } else {
                throw new Error('APRO_API is not available.');
            }

            const data = res && res.tree ? res : { tree: { name: '/', path: browseRoot, type: 'directory', children: [] } };

            // Apply client-side file-type filtering (files only) on initial load
            try { filterChildrenInPlace(data.tree); } catch (e) {}

            // Render into existing tree with APRO_TREE controller
            if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.createTreeController === 'function') {
                window.APRO_TREE.createTreeController(
                    treeContainer,
                    data.tree,
                    selectedPaths,
                    expandedPaths,
                    function () {
                        if (window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary) {
                            window.APRO_UI.updateSelectionSummary(selectedPaths);
                        }
                    }
                );
            } else if (treeContainer) {
                treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-status is-error">APRO_TREE is not available.</div>';
            }

            if (metaEl) {
                metaEl.textContent = 'Browsing Remote: ' + (cfg.server_url || '(unset)') + ' — root: ' + browseRoot + ' — publish root: ' + (cfg.dest_path || '/var/www/html');
            }

            if (window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus('Remote file tree loaded.', 'success');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (treeContainer) treeContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="apro-status is-error">Failed to load remote tree.</div>';
            if (window.APRO_UI && window.APRO_UI.setStatus) {
                window.APRO_UI.setStatus(e && e.message ? e.message : 'Failed to load remote tree.', 'error');
            }
        }
    }

    function installButtons() {
        const tools = document.querySelector('.apro-panel-tree .apro-panel-tools');
        if (!tools) return;

        if (!document.getElementById('aproRemoteCfgBtn')) {
            const connectBtn = document.createElement('button');
            connectBtn.type = 'button';
            connectBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            connectBtn.id = 'aproRemoteCfgBtn';
            connectBtn.textContent = 'Server Connect';
            connectBtn.title = 'Configure Remote Server connection (HTTPS Agent)';
            connectBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (window.APRO_SERVER && typeof window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal === 'function') {
                    window.APRO_SERVER.showConfigModal();
                }
            });
            tools.appendChild(connectBtn);
        }

        if (!document.getElementById('aproRemoteTreeBtn')) {
            const remoteBtn = document.createElement('button');
            remoteBtn.type = 'button';
            remoteBtn.className = 'apro-mini-button';
            remoteBtn.id = 'aproRemoteTreeBtn';
            remoteBtn.textContent = 'Load Remote Tree';
            remoteBtn.title = 'Browse the Remote Server file tree (HTTPS Agent)';
            remoteBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                loadRemoteTree();
            });
            tools.appendChild(remoteBtn);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        try { installButtons(); } catch (e) {}
    });

    // Export utility for other modules
    window.APRO_REMOTE_TREE = {
        load: loadRemoteTree,
        _getAllowedExtensionsSet: getAllowedExtensionsSet
    };
})();

(function () {
    function byId(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }

    };

    const PUBLISH_TARGET_LABELS = {

        if (type === 'error') element.classList.add('is-error');
        if (type === 'success') element.classList.add('is-success');
    }

        const output = byId('responseOutput');
        if (!output) return;

    }

        else if (Array.isArray(selectedPaths)) count = selectedPaths.length;
        else if (selectedPaths && typeof selectedPaths.length === 'number') count = selectedPaths.length;

    }

        const source = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (source === 'github') return 'github';
        if (source === 'remote') return 'remote';

        return 'server';
    }

        const target = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (target === 'github') return 'github';

    function installSelectionBridge() {
        const serviceEl = byId('serviceId');
        if (serviceEl && !serviceEl.dataset.aproSelectionBridgeBound) {
            serviceEl.dataset.aproSelectionBridgeBound = '1';
            serviceEl.addEventListener('change', selectHeaderModelAsActive);
        }
        if (!document.documentElement.dataset.aproDiscoverySelectionBridgeBound) {
            document.documentElement.dataset.aproDiscoverySelectionBridgeBound = '1';
            document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                const target = event.target;
                const button = target && typeof target.closest === 'function' ? target.closest('[data-select-model]') : null;
                if (!button) return;
                const selected = selectDiscoveryModelAsActive(button);
                if (selected) setStatus(providerDisplayLabel(selected.provider || 'openai') + ' model selected for APRO runtime requests.', 'success');
            }, true);
        }
        if (!window.__aproHeaderModelEventBound) {
            window.__aproHeaderModelEventBound = true;
            window.addEventListener('apro:selected-model-changed', function (event) { hydrateHeaderModelDisplay(event.detail || {}); });
        }
        hydrateFromStorageOrBootstrap();
    }

    function installHeaderSourceTargetBridge() {
        hydrateHeaderSourceAndTargetDisplays();
        if (!document.documentElement.dataset.aproHeaderSourceTargetBridgeBound) {
            document.documentElement.dataset.aproHeaderSourceTargetBridgeBound = '1';
            document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
                const target = event.target;
                if (!target) return;
                if (target.name === 'aproTreeSource') {
                    updateHeaderTreeSourceDisplay(target.value || 'server');
                    return;
                }
                if (target.name === 'aproPublishDestination') {
                    updateHeaderPublishTargetDisplay(target.value || 'remote');
                }
            }, true);
        }
    }

    function getFormPayload(selectedPaths) {
        let pathsArray = [];
        if (Array.isArray(selectedPaths)) pathsArray = selectedPaths.slice();
        else if (selectedPaths instanceof Set) pathsArray = Array.from(selectedPaths.values());
        else if (selectedPaths && typeof selectedPaths === 'object' && typeof selectedPaths.length === 'number') pathsArray = Array.from(selectedPaths);
        const activeRuntimeModelId = getSharedRuntimeModelId();
        const headerServiceId = getHeaderServiceId();
        const payload = {
            prompt: byId('userPrompt') ? byId('userPrompt').value : '',
            include_mode: byId('includeMode') ? byId('includeMode').value : 'both',
            service_id: activeRuntimeModelId || headerServiceId,
            selected_paths: pathsArray.sort()
        };
        try {
            const treeSource = localStorage.getItem('apro_tree_source') || 'server';
            if (treeSource === 'godaddy' && window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS && typeof window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected === 'function') {
                const account = window.APRO_GODADDY_ACCOUNTS.getSelected();
                if (account && account.base_url && account.username && account.api_token) {
                    payload.godaddy = {
                        base_url: String(account.base_url || '').trim(),
                        username: String(account.username || '').trim(),
                        api_token: String(account.api_token || '').trim(),
                        root_path: String(account.root_path || '/public_html').trim() || '/public_html',
                        insecure: !!account.insecure,
                        label: String(account.label || '').trim(),
                        id: String(account.id || '').trim()
                    };
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {}
        return payload;
    }

    function getSelectedPaths() {
        if (window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS && window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS instanceof Set) return Array.from(window._APRO_SELECTED_PATHS.values());
        return [];
    }

    function getCheckedFilePaths() {
        if (window.APRO_TREE && typeof window.APRO_TREE.getCheckedFilePaths === 'function') return window.APRO_TREE.getCheckedFilePaths();
        return [];
    }

    window.APRO_UI = {
        setStatus: setStatus,
        setResponse: setResponse,
        updateSelectionSummary: updateSelectionSummary,
        getFormPayload: getFormPayload,
        getSelectedPaths: getSelectedPaths,
        getCheckedFilePaths: getCheckedFilePaths,
        syncHeaderServiceSelect: syncHeaderServiceSelect,
        hydrateHeaderModelDisplay: hydrateHeaderModelDisplay,
        selectHeaderModelAsActive: selectHeaderModelAsActive,
        selectDiscoveryModelAsActive: selectDiscoveryModelAsActive,
        normalizeTreeSource: normalizeTreeSource,
        normalizePublishTarget: normalizePublishTarget,
        treeSourceLabel: treeSourceLabel,
        publishTargetLabel: publishTargetLabel,
        updateHeaderTreeSourceDisplay: updateHeaderTreeSourceDisplay,
        updateHeaderPublishTargetDisplay: updateHeaderPublishTargetDisplay,
        syncHeaderTreeSource: updateHeaderTreeSourceDisplay,
        syncHeaderPublishTarget: updateHeaderPublishTargetDisplay,
        hydrateHeaderSourceAndTargetDisplays: hydrateHeaderSourceAndTargetDisplays
    };

    function init() {
        installHeaderSourceTargetBridge();
        installSelectionBridge();
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    else init();
})();

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

final class AproGeminiProvider implements AproAiProviderInterface
{
    public function sendRequest(array $service, string $userPrompt, array $selectedItems, array $options = []): array
    {
        @set_time_limit(0);
        @ini_set('max_execution_time', '0');
        @ini_set('max_input_time', '0');
        ignore_user_abort(true);

        $apiKey = trim((string)apro_env_value('GEMINI_API_KEY', ''));
        if ($apiKey === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.');
        }

        $model = trim((string)($service['model'] ?? ''));

                'Authorization: Bearer ' . $apiKey,
            ],
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $jsonBody,
            CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 1800,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 1800,
            CURLOPT_NOSIGNAL => true,
        ]);

        $rawResponse = curl_exec($curl);
        $curlError = curl_error($curl);
        $curlErrno = curl_errno($curl);

    {
        $lines = [];

        $lines[] = '- Resolved file count: ' . (string)($options['resolved_file_count'] ?? count($selectedItems));
        $lines[] = '- Include paths: ' . (!empty($options['include_paths']) ? 'yes' : 'no');
        $lines[] = '- Include contents: ' . (!empty($options['include_contents']) ? 'yes' : 'no');
        $lines[] = '';

            if (isset($item['encoding'])) { $lines[] = 'Encoding: ' . (string)$item['encoding']; }

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function apro_ai_provider_from_service(array $service): AproAiProviderInterface
{
    $provider = strtolower(trim((string)($service['provider'] ?? '')));

    if ($provider === 'openai') {
        return new AproOpenAiProvider();
    }

    if ($provider === 'gemini' || $provider === 'google') {
        return new AproGeminiProvider();
    }

    throw new RuntimeException('Unsupported AI provider: ' . $provider);
}

        if (array_key_exists($key, $_GET)) {

if (!function_exists('apro_parse_env_line')) {
    function apro_parse_env_line(string $line): ?array
    {
        $line = trim($line);

        if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
            return null;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($line, 'export ')) {
            $line = trim(substr($line, 7));
        }

        $position = strpos($line, '=');
        if ($position === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $position));
        $value = trim(substr($line, $position + 1));

        if ($key === '' || !preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/', $key)) {
            return null;
        }

        if ($value !== '') {
            $first = $value[0];
            $last = substr($value, -1);

            if (($first === '"' && $last === '"') || ($first === "'" && $last === "'")) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
                if ($first === '"') {
                    $value = stripcslashes($value);
                }
            } else {
                $hashPosition = strpos($value, ' #');
                if ($hashPosition !== false) {
                    $value = rtrim(substr($value, 0, $hashPosition));
                }
            }
        }

        return [$key, $value];
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_load_env')) {
    function apro_load_env(bool $forceReload = false): array
    {
        static $loaded = false;
        static $values = [];

        if ($loaded && !$forceReload) {
            return $values;
        }

        $values = [];
        $file = apro_env_file_path();

        if (is_file($file) && is_readable($file)) {
            $lines = file($file, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES);
            if (is_array($lines)) {
                foreach ($lines as $line) {
                    $parsed = apro_parse_env_line((string)$line);
                    if ($parsed === null) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    [$key, $value] = $parsed;
                    $values[$key] = $value;

                    if (!array_key_exists($key, $_ENV)) {
                        $_ENV[$key] = $value;
                    }

                    if (!array_key_exists($key, $_SERVER)) {
                        $_SERVER[$key] = $value;
                    }

                    if (getenv($key) === false) {
                        putenv($key . '=' . $value);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $loaded = true;
        return $values;
    }
}

        if (in_array($normalized, ['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on'], true)) {
