<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function apro_fs_get_file_extension(string $filename): string
{
    $basename = basename($filename);
    if ($basename === '' || $basename === '.' || $basename === '..') {
        return '';
    }

    if ($basename[0] === '.' && substr_count($basename, '.') === 1) {
        return strtolower($basename);
    }

    $ext = pathinfo($basename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
    if ($ext === '' || $ext === null) {
        return '';
    }

    return '.' . strtolower($ext);
}

function apro_fs_normalize_slashes(string $path): string
{
    $path = str_replace('\\', '/', trim($path));
    $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;
    if ($path === '') {
        return '';
    }
    if ($path !== '/' && strlen($path) > 1) {
        $path = rtrim($path, '/');
    }
    return $path;
}

function apro_fs_path_is_within_root(string $absolutePath, string $root): bool
{
    $absolutePath = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($absolutePath);
    $root = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($root);
    if ($root === '/') {
        return $absolutePath !== '' && str_starts_with($absolutePath, '/');
    }
    return $absolutePath === $root || str_starts_with($absolutePath . '/', $root . '/');
}

function apro_fs_clean_input_path(string $inputPath): string
{
    $inputPath = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($inputPath);
    if ($inputPath === '') {
        return '';
    }

    $isAbsolute = $inputPath[0] === '/';
    $parts = [];
    foreach (explode('/', $inputPath) as $part) {
        if ($part === '' || $part === '.') {
            continue;
        }
        if ($part === '..') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Path traversal is not allowed: ' . $inputPath);
        }
        $parts[] = $part;
    }

    if (empty($parts)) {
        return $isAbsolute ? '/' : '';
    }

    return ($isAbsolute ? '/' : '') . implode('/', $parts);
}

function apro_fs_sort_nodes(array &$directories, array &$files): void
{
    usort($directories, static fn(array $a, array $b): int => strnatcasecmp((string)$a['name'], (string)$b['name']));
    usort($files, static fn(array $a, array $b): int => strnatcasecmp((string)$a['name'], (string)$b['name']));
}

function apro_fs_scan_directory_filtered(string $absoluteDirectory, ?array $allowedExtensions = null, array &$visited = []): array
{
    $absoluteDirectory = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($absoluteDirectory);
    if ($absoluteDirectory === '' || !is_dir($absoluteDirectory) || !is_readable($absoluteDirectory)) {
        return [];
    }

    $realDirectory = realpath($absoluteDirectory);
    if ($realDirectory === false) {
        $realDirectory = $absoluteDirectory;
    }
    $realDirectory = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($realDirectory);

    if (isset($visited[$realDirectory])) {
        return [];
    }
    $visited[$realDirectory] = true;

    $entries = scandir($realDirectory);
    if (!is_array($entries)) {
        return [];
    }

    $directories = [];
    $files = [];

    foreach ($entries as $entry) {
        if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
            continue;
        }

        $absolutePath = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($realDirectory . '/' . $entry);
        if (!file_exists($absolutePath) || is_link($absolutePath)) {
            continue;
        }

        try {
            $relativePath = apro_fs_to_relative_path($absolutePath);
        } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
            $relativePath = $absolutePath;
        }

        if (is_dir($absolutePath)) {
            $children = apro_fs_scan_directory_filtered($absolutePath, $allowedExtensions, $visited);
            $directoryNode = [
                'name' => $entry,
                'path' => $relativePath,
                'type' => 'directory',
                'expanded' => false,
                'size' => 0,
                'children' => $children,
            ];

            $dirSize = 0;
            foreach ($children as $child) {
                $dirSize += (int)($child['size'] ?? 0);
            }
            $directoryNode['size'] = $dirSize;
            $directories[] = $directoryNode;

        if (is_file($absolutePath)) {
            $ext = apro_fs_get_file_extension($entry);
            if ($allowedExtensions === null || isset($allowedExtensions[$ext])) {

                    'name' => $entry,
                    'path' => $relativePath,
                    'type' => 'file',
                    'size' => (int)(@filesize($absolutePath) ?: 0),

            }
        }

    apro_fs_sort_nodes($directories, $files);
    return array_merge($directories, $files);

function apro_fs_build_full_tree(?array $allowedExtensions = null): array
{
    $root = apro_fs_normalize_slashes(apro_real_scan_root());
    if ($root === '') {

    }

    $visited = [];

            foreach (apro_fs_collect_files_from_directory($absolutePath, $allowedExtensions, $visited) as $childFile) {
                $files[] = $childFile;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (is_file($absolutePath)) {
            if ($allowedExtensions !== null) {
                $ext = apro_fs_get_file_extension(basename($absolutePath));
                if (!isset($allowedExtensions[$ext])) {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            $files[] = $absolutePath;
        }
    }

    return $files;
}

function apro_fs_read_file_for_ai(string $absoluteFile): array
{
    $contents = file_get_contents($absoluteFile);
    if ($contents === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to read selected file: ' . $absoluteFile);
    }

    $truncated = false;
    if (strlen($contents) > APRO_MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
        $contents = substr($contents, 0, APRO_MAX_FILE_BYTES);
        $truncated = true;
    }

    if (strpos($contents, "\0") !== false) {
        return [
            'content' => base64_encode($contents),
            'encoding' => 'base64',
            'truncated' => $truncated,
        ];
    }

    return [
        'content' => $contents,
        'encoding' => 'text',
        'truncated' => $truncated,
    ];
}

function apro_fs_collect_selected_items(array $selectedPaths, bool $includePaths, bool $includeContents, ?array $allowedExtensions = null): array
{
    $selectedPaths = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_map(static fn($value): string => trim((string)$value), $selectedPaths), static fn(string $value): bool => $value !== '')));

    $selectedCount = count($selectedPaths);
    if ($selectedCount === 0) {
        return [
            'selected_count' => 0,
            'resolved_file_count' => 0,
            'total_content_bytes' => 0,
            'items' => [],
        ];
    }

    $resolvedFiles = [];

    foreach ($selectedPaths as $selectedPath) {
        $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($selectedPath);

        if (is_dir($absolutePath)) {
            $visited = [];
            foreach (apro_fs_collect_files_from_directory($absolutePath, $allowedExtensions, $visited) as $filePath) {
                $resolvedFiles[$filePath] = true;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (is_file($absolutePath)) {
            if ($allowedExtensions !== null) {
                $ext = apro_fs_get_file_extension(basename($absolutePath));
                if (!isset($allowedExtensions[$ext])) {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            $resolvedFiles[$absolutePath] = true;
        }
    }

    $absoluteFiles = array_keys($resolvedFiles);
    sort($absoluteFiles, SORT_NATURAL | SORT_FLAG_CASE);

    if (count($absoluteFiles) > APRO_MAX_FILES_PER_REQUEST) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Too many files were resolved from the selection.');
    }

    $items = [];
    $totalContentBytes = 0;

    foreach ($absoluteFiles as $absoluteFile) {
        $item = [
            'path' => $includePaths ? $absoluteFile : '',
            'size_bytes' => (int)(@filesize($absoluteFile) ?: 0),
        ];

        if ($includeContents) {
            $fileData = apro_fs_read_file_for_ai($absoluteFile);
            $contentLength = strlen((string)$fileData['content']);
            $totalContentBytes += $contentLength;
            if ($totalContentBytes > APRO_MAX_TOTAL_CONTENT_BYTES) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Selected file contents exceed the configured total request limit.');
            }
            $item['content'] = $fileData['content'];
            $item['encoding'] = $fileData['encoding'];
            $item['truncated'] = $fileData['truncated'];
            if (($fileData['encoding'] ?? '') === 'text') {
                $contentStr = (string)$fileData['content'];
                $item['line_count'] = ($contentStr === '') ? 0 : (substr_count($contentStr, "\n") + 1);
            }
        }

        if (!$includePaths) {
            unset($item['path']);
        }

        $items[] = $item;
    }

    return [
        'selected_count' => $selectedCount,
        'resolved_file_count' => count($absoluteFiles),
        'total_content_bytes' => $totalContentBytes,
        'items' => $items,
    ];
}

function apro_fs_is_archive_path(string $relativePath): bool
{
    $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', trim($relativePath));
    return (bool)preg_match('/\.\d+\.archive$/', $normalized);
}

function apro_fs_next_archive_absolute_path(string $absolutePath): string
{
    $archiveIndex = 1;
    do {
        $candidate = $absolutePath . '.' . $archiveIndex . '.archive';
        $archiveIndex++;
    } while (file_exists($candidate));

    return $candidate;
}

function apro_fs_archive_file(string $relativePath): array
{
    $normalized = apro_fs_normalize_slashes($relativePath);
    if ($normalized === '' || $normalized === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A valid file path is required.');
    }
    if (apro_fs_is_archive_path($normalized)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive files cannot be archived again.');
    }

    $absolutePath = apro_fs_to_absolute_path($normalized);
    if (!is_file($absolutePath) || is_link($absolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Selected path is not a regular file: ' . $normalized);
    }

    $sizeBytes = (int)(@filesize($absolutePath) ?: 0);
    $modifiedTime = @filemtime($absolutePath) ?: null;
    $archiveAbsolutePath = apro_fs_next_archive_absolute_path($absolutePath);
    $archiveDirectory = dirname($archiveAbsolutePath);

    if (!is_dir($archiveDirectory)) {
        if (!@mkdir($archiveDirectory, 0775, true) && !is_dir($archiveDirectory)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to prepare archive directory.');
        }
    }

    if (!@rename($absolutePath, $archiveAbsolutePath)) {
        $error = error_get_last();
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to archive file: ' . ($error['message'] ?? 'rename failed.'));
    }

    clearstatcache(true, $absolutePath);
    clearstatcache(true, $archiveAbsolutePath);

    $version = null;
    if (preg_match('/\.(\d+)\.archive$/', $archiveAbsolutePath, $matches)) {
        $version = (int)$matches[1];
    }

    return [
        'original_path' => $normalized,
        'archived_path' => $archiveAbsolutePath,
        'archive_version' => $version,
        'size_bytes' => $sizeBytes,
        'modified_time' => $modifiedTime,
    ];
}

class AproGithubApiClient {
    private string $token;
    private string $owner;
    private string $repo;
    private string $branch;
    private string $apiBase;

    public function __construct(?string $token = null, ?string $owner = null, ?string $repo = null, ?string $branch = null) {
        $this->token = (string)($token ?? apro_github_env('GITHUB_TOKEN', apro_github_env('GITHUB_PAT', apro_github_env('APRO_GITHUB_TOKEN', ''))));
        $this->owner = (string)($owner ?? apro_github_env('GITHUB_OWNER', apro_github_env('GITHUB_REPO_OWNER', apro_github_env('APRO_GITHUB_OWNER', ''))));
        $this->repo = (string)($repo ?? apro_github_env('GITHUB_REPO', apro_github_env('GITHUB_REPOSITORY_NAME', apro_github_env('APRO_GITHUB_REPO', ''))));
        $this->branch = (string)($branch ?? apro_github_env('GITHUB_BRANCH', apro_github_env('APRO_GITHUB_BRANCH', 'main')));
        $this->apiBase = rtrim((string)apro_github_env('GITHUB_API_BASE', 'https://api.github.com'), '/');
        if ($this->owner === '' || $this->repo === '') {
            $repository = (string)apro_github_env('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', '');
            if ($repository !== '' && strpos($repository, '/') !== false) {
                [$this->owner, $this->repo] = explode('/', $repository, 2);
            }
        }
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool {
        return $this->token !== '' && $this->owner !== '' && $this->repo !== '';
    }

    public function request(string $method, string $path, array $payload = null): array {
        if (!$this->isConfigured()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('GitHub API is not configured.');
        }
        $method = strtoupper($method);
        $url = $this->apiBase . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        $headers = [
            'Accept: application/vnd.github+json',
            'Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->token,
            'User-Agent: AXIAMAX-ADMIN-APRO',
            'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28',
        ];
        $body = null;
        if ($payload !== null) {
            $body = json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            if ($body === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode GitHub API request payload.');
            }
            $headers[] = 'Content-Type: application/json';
        }
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to initialize GitHub request.');
        }
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => $method,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HEADER => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 90,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
        ]);
        if ($body !== null) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $body);
        }
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        if ($response === false) {
            $error = curl_error($ch);
            curl_close($ch);
            throw new RuntimeException('GitHub request failed: ' . $error);
        }
        $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        $headerSize = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HEADER_SIZE);
        curl_close($ch);
        $responseBody = substr($response, $headerSize);
        $decoded = json_decode($responseBody, true);
        $data = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : ['raw' => $responseBody];
        if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) {
            $message = $data['message'] ?? ('GitHub API returned HTTP ' . $status);
            throw new RuntimeException((string)$message);
        }
        return $data;
    }

    public function repoPath(string $path): string {
        return 'repos/' . rawurlencode($this->owner) . '/' . rawurlencode($this->repo) . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }

    public function getContents(string $path, ?string $ref = null): array {
        $query = ['ref' => $ref ?: $this->branch];
        return $this->request('GET', $this->repoPath('contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode(ltrim($path, '/')))) . '?' . http_build_query($query));
    }

    public function getFile(string $path, ?string $ref = null): array {
        $data = $this->getContents($path, $ref);
        $content = isset($data['content']) ? base64_decode(str_replace("\n", '', (string)$data['content']), true) : false;
        return [
            'path' => $data['path'] ?? $path,
            'sha' => $data['sha'] ?? null,
            'content' => $content === false ? '' : $content,
            'encoding' => $data['encoding'] ?? null,
            'download_url' => $data['download_url'] ?? null,
        ];
    }

    public function putFile(string $path, string $content, string $message = 'Update file from APRO', ?string $sha = null, ?string $branch = null): array {
        $payload = [
            'message' => $message,
            'content' => base64_encode($content),
            'branch' => $branch ?: $this->branch,
        ];
        if ($sha !== null && $sha !== '') {
            $payload['sha'] = $sha;
        } else {
            try {
                $existing = $this->getContents($path, $branch ?: $this->branch);
                if (isset($existing['sha'])) {
                    $payload['sha'] = $existing['sha'];
                }
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
            }
        }
        return $this->request('PUT', $this->repoPath('contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode(ltrim($path, '/')))), $payload);
    }

    public function deleteFile(string $path, string $message = 'Delete file from APRO', ?string $sha = null, ?string $branch = null): array {
        if ($sha === null || $sha === '') {
            $existing = $this->getContents($path, $branch ?: $this->branch);
            $sha = (string)($existing['sha'] ?? '');
        }
        if ($sha === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('GitHub file SHA is required for delete.');
        }
        return $this->request('DELETE', $this->repoPath('contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode(ltrim($path, '/')))), [
            'message' => $message,
            'sha' => $sha,
            'branch' => $branch ?: $this->branch,
        ]);
    }

    public function tree(?string $ref = null, bool $recursive = true): array {
        $branch = $ref ?: $this->branch;
        $branchData = $this->request('GET', $this->repoPath('branches/' . rawurlencode($branch)));
        $sha = $branchData['commit']['commit']['tree']['sha'] ?? $branchData['commit']['sha'] ?? $branch;
        return $this->request('GET', $this->repoPath('git/trees/' . rawurlencode((string)$sha)) . ($recursive ? '?recursive=1' : ''));
    }
}

function apro_github_get_pat(): string
{
    $token = (string)apro_github_env('GITHUB_PAT', '');
    if ($token === '') {
        $token = (string)apro_github_env('GITHUB_TOKEN', apro_github_env('APRO_GITHUB_TOKEN', ''));
    }
    if ($token === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GITHUB_PAT is not configured.');
    }

    return $token;
}

function apro_github_normalize_repo_path(string $path): string
{
    $path = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path));
    $path = ltrim($path, '/');

    if ($path === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub target path is required.');
    }

    if (strpos($path, '..') !== false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub target path may not contain path traversal segments.');
    }

    return $path;
}

function apro_github_build_api_base(): string
{
    return rtrim((string)apro_github_env('GITHUB_API_BASE', 'https://api.github.com'), '/');
}

function apro_github_request(string $method, string $url, ?array $body = null): array
{
    $token = apro_github_get_pat();
    $curl = curl_init($url);
    if ($curl === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to initialize GitHub API request.');
    }

    $headers = [
        'Authorization: Bearer ' . $token,
        'User-Agent: APRO-GitHub-Publisher',
        'Accept: application/vnd.github+json',
        'Content-Type: application/json',
        'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28',
    ];

    $payload = null;
    if ($body !== null) {
        $payload = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        if ($payload === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to encode GitHub API request payload.');
        }
    }

    curl_setopt_array($curl, [
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => strtoupper($method),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 60,
        CURLOPT_HEADER => true,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
        CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => 2,
    ]);

    if ($payload !== null) {
        curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $payload);
    }

    $rawResponse = curl_exec($curl);
    $curlError = curl_error($curl);
    $httpCode = (int)curl_getinfo($curl, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
    $headerSize = (int)curl_getinfo($curl, CURLINFO_HEADER_SIZE);
    curl_close($curl);

    if ($rawResponse === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub API request failed: ' . $curlError);
    }

    $rawHeaders = substr($rawResponse, 0, $headerSize);
    $rawBody = substr($rawResponse, $headerSize);
    $decoded = null;

    if (trim($rawBody) !== '') {
        $decoded = json_decode($rawBody, true);
    }

    return [
        'ok' => $httpCode >= 200 && $httpCode < 300,
        'status_code' => $httpCode,
        'headers_raw' => $rawHeaders,
        'body_raw' => $rawBody,
        'body' => is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : null,
    ];
}

function apro_github_extract_error_message(array $response, string $fallback): string
{
    $body = $response['body'] ?? null;
    if (is_array($body)) {
        $message = trim((string)($body['message'] ?? ''));
        if ($message !== '') {
            if (isset($body['errors']) && is_array($body['errors']) && count($body['errors']) > 0) {
                $parts = [];
                foreach ($body['errors'] as $error) {
                    if (is_array($error)) {
                        $errMsg = trim((string)($error['message'] ?? $error['code'] ?? ''));
                        if ($errMsg !== '') {
                            $parts[] = $errMsg;
                        }
                    } elseif (is_string($error) && trim($error) !== '') {
                        $parts[] = trim($error);
                    }
                }
                if (!empty($parts)) {
                    $message .= ' (' . implode('; ', $parts) . ')';
                }
            }
            return $message;
        }
    }

    return $fallback . ' (HTTP ' . (int)($response['status_code'] ?? 0) . ')';
}

function apro_github_get_file_metadata(string $owner, string $repo, string $branch, string $path): array
{
    $owner = trim($owner);
    $repo = trim($repo);
    $branch = trim($branch);
    $path = apro_github_normalize_repo_path($path);

    if ($owner === '' || $repo === '' || $branch === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub owner, repo, and branch are required.');
    }

    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode($path))
        . '?ref=' . rawurlencode($branch);

    $response = apro_github_request('GET', $url, null);

    if ((int)$response['status_code'] === 404) {
        return [
            'success' => true,
            'exists' => false,
            'sha' => null,
            'path' => $path,
            'response' => $response,
        ];
    }

    if (!$response['ok']) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'exists' => false,
            'sha' => null,
            'path' => $path,
            'error' => apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to fetch GitHub file metadata.'),
            'response' => $response,
        ];
    }

    $body = $response['body'] ?? [];
    $sha = is_array($body) ? (string)($body['sha'] ?? '') : '';

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'exists' => true,
        'sha' => $sha !== '' ? $sha : null,
        'path' => $path,
        'response' => $response,
    ];
}

function apro_github_put_file(
    string $owner,
    string $repo,
    string $branch,
    string $path,
    string $content,
    string $commitMessage,
    ?string $sha = null
): array {
    $owner = trim($owner);
    $repo = trim($repo);
    $branch = trim($branch);
    $path = apro_github_normalize_repo_path($path);
    $commitMessage = trim($commitMessage);

    if ($owner === '' || $repo === '' || $branch === '' || $commitMessage === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub owner, repo, branch, path, and commit message are required.');
    }

    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode($path));

    $body = [
        'message' => $commitMessage,
        'content' => base64_encode($content),
        'branch' => $branch,
    ];

    if ($sha !== null && trim($sha) !== '') {
        $body['sha'] = trim($sha);
    }

    $response = apro_github_request('PUT', $url, $body);

    if (!$response['ok']) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'path' => $path,
            'status_code' => (int)$response['status_code'],
            'error' => apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to publish file to GitHub.'),
            'response' => $response,
        ];
    }

    $bodyOut = $response['body'] ?? [];
    $contentNode = is_array($bodyOut) && isset($bodyOut['content']) && is_array($bodyOut['content']) ? $bodyOut['content'] : [];
    $commitNode = is_array($bodyOut) && isset($bodyOut['commit']) && is_array($bodyOut['commit']) ? $bodyOut['commit'] : [];

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'path' => $path,
        'status_code' => (int)$response['status_code'],
        'content_sha' => (string)($contentNode['sha'] ?? ''),
        'commit_sha' => (string)($commitNode['sha'] ?? ''),
        'commit_url' => (string)($commitNode['html_url'] ?? $commitNode['url'] ?? ''),
        'response' => $response,
    ];
}

function apro_github_publish_file(
    string $owner,
    string $repo,
    string $branch,
    string $path,
    string $content,
    string $commitMessage
): array {
    $metadata = apro_github_get_file_metadata($owner, $repo, $branch, $path);
    if (empty($metadata['success'])) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'error' => (string)($metadata['error'] ?? 'Failed to inspect GitHub file state.'),
            'step' => 'lookup',
            'metadata' => $metadata,
        ];
    }

    $publish = apro_github_put_file(
        $owner,
        $repo,
        $branch,
        $path,
        $content,
        $commitMessage,
        !empty($metadata['exists']) ? (string)($metadata['sha'] ?? '') : null
    );

    if (empty($publish['success'])) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'error' => (string)($publish['error'] ?? 'Failed to publish file to GitHub.'),
            'step' => 'publish',
            'metadata' => $metadata,
            'publish' => $publish,
        ];
    }

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'created' => empty($metadata['exists']),
        'updated' => !empty($metadata['exists']),
        'owner' => trim($owner),
        'repo' => trim($repo),
        'branch' => trim($branch),
        'path' => apro_github_normalize_repo_path($path),
        'previous_sha' => $metadata['sha'] ?? null,
        'content_sha' => $publish['content_sha'] ?? '',
        'commit_sha' => $publish['commit_sha'] ?? '',
        'commit_url' => $publish['commit_url'] ?? '',
        'lookup' => $metadata,
        'publish' => $publish,
    ];
}

function apro_github_get_repo_tree(string $owner, string $repo, string $ref, bool $recursive = true): array
{
    $owner = trim($owner);
    $repo = trim($repo);
    $ref = trim($ref);

    if ($owner === '' || $repo === '' || $ref === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub owner, repo, and branch/ref are required.');
    }

    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/trees/' . rawurlencode($ref);

    if ($recursive) {
        $url .= '?recursive=1';
    }

    $response = apro_github_request('GET', $url, null);

    if (!$response['ok']) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'status_code' => (int)$response['status_code'],
            'error' => apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to load GitHub repository tree.'),
            'response' => $response,
        ];
    }

    $body = $response['body'] ?? [];
    $tree = is_array($body) && isset($body['tree']) && is_array($body['tree']) ? $body['tree'] : [];

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'sha' => (string)($body['sha'] ?? ''),
        'truncated' => (bool)($body['truncated'] ?? false),
        'tree' => $tree,
        'response' => $response,
    ];
}

// ----- New helper: fetch a file's normalized content/encoding from GitHub -----
function apro_github_fetch_file_content(string $owner, string $repo, string $branch, string $path): array
{
    $normPath = apro_github_normalize_repo_path($path);
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/contents/' . str_replace('%2F', '/', rawurlencode($normPath))
        . '?ref=' . rawurlencode($branch);

    $response = apro_github_request('GET', $url, null);

    if ((int)($response['status_code'] ?? 0) === 404) {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub file not found for path: ' . $path);
    }

    if (empty($response['ok'])) {
        $msg = apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to fetch GitHub file content.');
        throw new RuntimeException($msg);
    }

    $body = $response['body'] ?? [];
    if (!is_array($body)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unexpected GitHub API response format.');
    }

    $apiSize = (int)($body['size'] ?? 0);
    $apiEncoding = (string)($body['encoding'] ?? '');
    $apiContent = (string)($body['content'] ?? '');

    $apiContent = str_replace(["\r", "\n"], '', $apiContent);

    if ($apiEncoding !== 'base64') {
        throw new RuntimeException('GitHub returned an unsupported content encoding: ' . $apiEncoding);
    }

    if ($apiContent === '') {
        if ($apiSize === 0) {
            $decoded = '';
        } else {
            throw new RuntimeException('GitHub returned empty content for non-empty file.');
        }
    } else {
        $decoded = base64_decode($apiContent, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to decode GitHub file content.');
        }
    }

    $bytes = $decoded;
    $truncated = false;

    if (strlen($bytes) > APRO_MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
        $bytes = substr($bytes, 0, APRO_MAX_FILE_BYTES);
        $truncated = true;
    }

    $isBinary = strpos($bytes, "\0") !== false;

    $encoding = 'text';
    $contentOut = '';
    $lineCount = null;

    if ($isBinary) {
        $encoding = 'base64';
        $contentOut = base64_encode($bytes);
    } else {
        $contentOut = $bytes;
        $lineCount = ($contentOut === '') ? 0 : (substr_count($contentOut, "\n") + 1);
    }

    $result = [
        'path' => '/' . $normPath,
        'size_bytes' => $apiSize,
        'encoding' => $encoding,
        'truncated' => $truncated,
        'content' => $contentOut,
    ];
    if ($lineCount !== null) {
        $result['line_count'] = $lineCount;
    }
    return $result;
}

// ----- New helpers for bulk publish (single commit via Git Trees API) -----
function apro_github_get_ref_sha(string $owner, string $repo, string $branch): string
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/refs/heads/' . rawurlencode($branch);

    $response = apro_github_request('GET', $url, null);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to get git ref.'));
    }
    $body = $response['body'] ?? [];
    $sha = is_array($body) ? (string)($body['object']['sha'] ?? '') : '';
    if ($sha === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Could not determine branch ref sha.');
    }
    return $sha;
}

function apro_github_get_commit_tree_sha(string $owner, string $repo, string $commitSha): string
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/commits/' . rawurlencode($commitSha);

    $response = apro_github_request('GET', $url, null);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to load commit for tree.'));
    }
    $body = $response['body'] ?? [];
    $treeSha = is_array($body) ? (string)($body['tree']['sha'] ?? '') : '';
    if ($treeSha === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Tree sha missing on base commit.');
    }
    return $treeSha;
}

function apro_github_create_blob(string $owner, string $repo, string $content, string $encoding = 'utf-8'): array
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/blobs';

    $body = [
        'content' => $content,
        'encoding' => ($encoding === 'base64') ? 'base64' : 'utf-8'
    ];

    $response = apro_github_request('POST', $url, $body);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to create blob.'));
    }
    return $response['body'] ?? [];
}

function apro_github_create_tree(string $owner, string $repo, string $baseTreeSha, array $items): array
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/trees';

    $tree = [];
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $tree[] = [
            'path' => apro_github_normalize_repo_path((string)$it['path']),
            'mode' => '100644',
            'type' => 'blob',
            'sha' => (string)$it['sha']
        ];
    }

    $body = [
        'base_tree' => $baseTreeSha,
        'tree' => $tree
    ];

    $response = apro_github_request('POST', $url, $body);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to create tree.'));
    }
    return $response['body'] ?? [];
}

function apro_github_create_commit(string $owner, string $repo, string $message, string $treeSha, array $parents): array
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/commits';

    $body = [
        'message' => $message,
        'tree' => $treeSha,
        'parents' => $parents
    ];

    $response = apro_github_request('POST', $url, $body);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to create commit.'));
    }
    return $response['body'] ?? [];
}

function apro_github_update_ref(string $owner, string $repo, string $branch, string $commitSha, bool $force = false): array
{
    $url = apro_github_build_api_base()
        . '/repos/' . rawurlencode($owner)
        . '/' . rawurlencode($repo)
        . '/git/refs/heads/' . rawurlencode($branch);

    $body = [
        'sha' => $commitSha,
        'force' => $force
    ];

    $response = apro_github_request('PATCH', $url, $body);
    if (!$response['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_github_extract_error_message($response, 'Failed to update ref.'));
    }
    return $response['body'] ?? [];
}

function apro_github_publish_files_bulk(string $owner, string $repo, string $branch, array $files, string $commitMessage): array
{
    if (empty($files)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('No files provided for bulk publish.');
    }

    $baseCommitSha = apro_github_get_ref_sha($owner, $repo, $branch);
    $baseTreeSha = apro_github_get_commit_tree_sha($owner, $repo, $baseCommitSha);

    $blobItems = [];
    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $path = (string)($file['path'] ?? '');
        if ($path === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Each file must include a non-empty path.');
        }
        $encoding = strtolower((string)($file['encoding'] ?? 'text'));
        $content = (string)($file['content'] ?? '');

        // For blobs, pass content as-is with declared encoding (base64 or utf-8)
        $blobRes = apro_github_create_blob($owner, $repo, $encoding === 'base64' ? $content : $content, $encoding === 'base64' ? 'base64' : 'utf-8');
        $blobSha = (string)($blobRes['sha'] ?? '');
        if ($blobSha === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create blob for ' . $path);
        }
        $blobItems[] = [ 'path' => $path, 'sha' => $blobSha ];
    }

    $treeRes = apro_github_create_tree($owner, $repo, $baseTreeSha, $blobItems);
    $newTreeSha = (string)($treeRes['sha'] ?? '');
    if ($newTreeSha === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create tree for bulk publish.');
    }

    $commitRes = apro_github_create_commit($owner, $repo, $commitMessage, $newTreeSha, [$baseCommitSha]);
    $commitSha = (string)($commitRes['sha'] ?? '');
    if ($commitSha === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Failed to create commit for bulk publish.');
    }

    apro_github_update_ref($owner, $repo, $branch, $commitSha, false);

    return [
        'success' => true,
        'commit_sha' => $commitSha,
        'tree_sha' => $newTreeSha,
        'files_count' => count($files),
        'commit_url' => (string)($commitRes['html_url'] ?? $commitRes['url'] ?? '')
    ];
}

if (!function_exists('apro_godaddy_sanitize_base_url')) {
    function apro_godaddy_sanitize_base_url(string $url): string
    {

            return '';
        }
        if (preg_match('#^https?://[^/@:]+:[^/@:]+@#i', $url)) {

if (!function_exists('apro_godaddy_normalize_path')) {
    function apro_godaddy_normalize_path(string $path, string $fallback = '/'): string
    {
        $path = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path));
        $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;
        if ($path === '') {
            $path = $fallback;
        }
        if ($path === '') {
            $path = '/';
        }
        if ($path[0] !== '/') {
            $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');

    }

        if ($this->username === '') {

        }
        if ($this->apiToken === '') {

    public function getFileContent(string $file): array
    {
        $file = trim($file);

        }

        $normalized = str_replace('\\', '/', $file);
        $normalized = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $normalized) ?: $normalized;

        }

        $directory = dirname($normalized);
        $basename = basename($normalized);

        if ($basename === '' || $basename === '.' || $basename === '..') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('file path must include a filename.');
        }

        if ($directory === '' || $directory === '.') {
            $directory = '/';
        }
        $directory = str_replace('\\', '/', $directory);
        $directory = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $directory) ?: $directory;
        if ($directory === '') {
            $directory = '/';
        }

        $attempts = [
            [
                'label' => 'dir+file',
                'query' => [
                    'dir' => $directory,
                    'file' => $basename,
                ],
            ],
            [
                'label' => 'dirfile',
                'query' => [
                    'dirfile' => $normalized,
                ],
            ],
            [
                'label' => 'file',
                'query' => [
                    'file' => $normalized,
                ],

        $errors = [];

            try {
                return $this->requestJson('GET', '/execute/Fileman/get_file_content', $attempt['query']);

    public function createDirectory(string $dir): array
    {

        if ($dir === '' || $dir === '/') {
            return ['status' => 1, 'data' => ['path' => '/']];
        }

        $normalized = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $dir) ?: $dir;
        if ($normalized[0] !== '/') {
            $normalized = '/' . ltrim($normalized, '/');
        }

        $parts = array_values(array_filter(explode('/', trim($normalized, '/')), static function (string $part): bool {
            return $part !== '' && $part !== '.';
        }));

        if ($parts === []) {
            return ['status' => 1, 'data' => ['path' => '/']];

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!defined('APRO_LOCAL_INSTALL_HELPER')) {
    define('APRO_LOCAL_INSTALL_HELPER', '/usr/local/sbin/flex-apro-install-file');
}
if (!defined('APRO_LOCAL_ARCHIVE_HELPER')) {
    define('APRO_LOCAL_ARCHIVE_HELPER', '/usr/local/sbin/flex-apro-archive-file');
}

function apro_priv_pub_normalize_path(string $path): string
{
    $path = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path));
    $path = preg_replace('#/+#', '/', $path) ?: $path;
    if ($path === '') {
        return '';
    }
    if ($path[0] !== '/') {
        $path = '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
    }
    return strlen($path) > 1 ? rtrim($path, '/') : $path;
}

function apro_priv_pub_root(): string
{
    $root = function_exists('apro_real_scan_root') ? apro_real_scan_root() : '/';
    $root = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path((string)$root);
    return $root !== '' ? $root : '/';
}

function apro_priv_pub_within_root(string $absolutePath): bool
{
    $root = apro_priv_pub_root();
    $absolutePath = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($absolutePath);
    if ($absolutePath === '') {
        return false;
    }
    if ($root === '/') {
        return $absolutePath[0] === '/';
    }
    return $absolutePath === $root || str_starts_with($absolutePath . '/', $root . '/');
}

function apro_priv_pub_absolute_path(string $targetPath): string
{
    $targetPath = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($targetPath);
    if ($targetPath === '' || $targetPath === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('A valid target path is required.');
    }

    if (function_exists('apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create')) {
        try {
            $candidate = apro_fs_to_absolute_path_create($targetPath, false);
            $candidate = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($candidate);
            if ($candidate !== '' && apro_priv_pub_within_root($candidate)) {
                return $candidate;
            }
        } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
        }
    }

    $root = apro_priv_pub_root();
    $candidate = $targetPath;
    if ($root !== '/' && !str_starts_with($candidate . '/', $root . '/')) {
        $candidate = $root . '/' . ltrim($targetPath, '/');
    }
    $candidate = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($candidate);
    if (!apro_priv_pub_within_root($candidate)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Target path is outside the allowed scan root: ' . $targetPath);
    }
    return $candidate;
}

function apro_priv_pub_relative_path(string $absolutePath): string
{
    if (function_exists('apro_fs_to_relative_path')) {
        try {
            return apro_fs_to_relative_path($absolutePath);
        } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
        }
    }

    $root = apro_priv_pub_root();
    $absolutePath = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($absolutePath);
    if ($root === '/') {
        return $absolutePath;
    }
    if ($absolutePath === $root) {
        return '/';
    }
    return '/' . ltrim(substr($absolutePath, strlen($root)), '/');
}

function apro_priv_pub_command_message(array $result, string $fallback): string
{
    $output = trim((string)($result['output'] ?? ''));
    if ($output !== '') {
        return $output;
    }
    return $fallback;
}

function apro_priv_pub_run_helper(string $helper, array $args): array
{
    $cmd = 'sudo -n ' . escapeshellarg($helper);
    foreach ($args as $arg) {
        $cmd .= ' ' . escapeshellarg((string)$arg);
    }
    $cmd .= ' 2>&1';

    $output = [];
    $code = 0;
    exec($cmd, $output, $code);

    return [
        'ok' => $code === 0,
        'code' => $code,
        'output' => implode("\n", $output),
        'command' => $cmd,
    ];
}

function apro_priv_pub_prepare_parent_direct(string $destination): bool
{
    $parent = dirname($destination);
    if (is_dir($parent)) {
        return true;
    }
    return @mkdir($parent, 0775, true) || is_dir($parent);
}

function apro_priv_pub_is_helper_available(string $helper): bool
{
    return is_file($helper) && is_executable($helper);
}

function apro_priv_pub_make_stage_dir(): string
{
    $base = rtrim(sys_get_temp_dir(), '/\\');
    if ($base === '') {
        $base = '/tmp';
    }

    $dir = $base . '/apro_stage_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8));
    if (!@mkdir($dir, 0700, true) && !is_dir($dir)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create APRO stage directory.');
    }
    @chmod($dir, 0700);
    return $dir;
}

function apro_priv_pub_stage_file(string $content, string $destination): array
{
    $stageDir = apro_priv_pub_make_stage_dir();
    $safeName = basename($destination);
    if ($safeName === '' || $safeName === '.' || $safeName === '..') {
        $safeName = 'payload.bin';
    }
    $stageFile = $stageDir . '/' . $safeName;

    if (@file_put_contents($stageFile, $content, LOCK_EX) === false) {
        @unlink($stageFile);
        @rmdir($stageDir);
        throw new RuntimeException('Unable to write APRO stage file.');
    }
    @chmod($stageFile, 0644);

    return [
        'dir' => $stageDir,
        'file' => $stageFile,
    ];
}

function apro_priv_pub_cleanup_stage(?array $stage): void
{
    if (!is_array($stage)) {
        return;
    }
    if (!empty($stage['file']) && is_string($stage['file'])) {
        @unlink($stage['file']);
    }
    if (!empty($stage['dir']) && is_string($stage['dir'])) {
        @rmdir($stage['dir']);
    }
}

function apro_priv_pub_install_file_direct(string $source, string $destination): bool
{
    if (!is_file($source) || !is_readable($source)) {
        return false;
    }
    if (is_link($destination)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to publish over symlink target: ' . $destination);
    }
    if (!apro_priv_pub_prepare_parent_direct($destination)) {
        return false;
    }

    $parent = dirname($destination);
    if (!is_dir($parent) || !is_writable($parent)) {
        return false;
    }

    $tmp = @tempnam($parent, '.apro-publish-');
    if ($tmp === false) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!@copy($source, $tmp)) {
        @unlink($tmp);
        return false;
    }

    @chmod($tmp, 0644);

    if (!@rename($tmp, $destination)) {
        @unlink($tmp);
        return false;
    }

    @chmod($destination, 0644);
    return true;
}

function apro_priv_pub_install_file(string $source, string $destination): string
{
    $destination = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($destination);
    if ($destination === '' || $destination === '/') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Bad destination path.');
    }
    if (!apro_priv_pub_within_root($destination)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Destination is outside the allowed scan root: ' . $destination);
    }
    if (is_link($destination)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to publish over symlink target: ' . $destination);
    }

    if (apro_priv_pub_install_file_direct($source, $destination)) {
        clearstatcache(true, $destination);
        return 'direct';
    }

    if (!apro_priv_pub_is_helper_available(APRO_LOCAL_INSTALL_HELPER)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Privileged install helper is not available.');
    }

    $result = apro_priv_pub_run_helper(APRO_LOCAL_INSTALL_HELPER, [$source, $destination]);
    if (!$result['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_priv_pub_command_message($result, 'Privileged install helper failed.'));
    }

    clearstatcache(true, $destination);
    return 'privileged_helper';
}

function apro_priv_pub_install_content(string $content, string $destination): string
{
    $destination = apro_priv_pub_absolute_path($destination);

    $stage = null;
    try {
        $stage = apro_priv_pub_stage_file($content, $destination);
        return apro_priv_pub_install_file((string)$stage['file'], $destination);
    } finally {
        apro_priv_pub_cleanup_stage($stage);
    }
}

function apro_priv_pub_next_archive_path(string $absolutePath): string
{
    $i = 1;
    do {
        $candidate = $absolutePath . '.' . $i . '.archive';
        $i++;
    } while (file_exists($candidate));
    return $candidate;
}

function apro_priv_pub_move_file(string $source, string $destination): string
{
    $source = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($source);
    $destination = apro_priv_pub_normalize_path($destination);

    if ($source === '' || $destination === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Source and destination are required.');
    }
    if (is_link($source) || is_link($destination)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to move symlink source or target.');
    }

    if (@rename($source, $destination)) {
        clearstatcache(true, $source);
        clearstatcache(true, $destination);
        return 'direct_rename';
    }

    if (!apro_priv_pub_is_helper_available(APRO_LOCAL_ARCHIVE_HELPER)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Privileged archive helper is not available.');
    }

    $result = apro_priv_pub_run_helper(APRO_LOCAL_ARCHIVE_HELPER, [$source, $destination]);
    if (!$result['ok']) {
        throw new RuntimeException(apro_priv_pub_command_message($result, 'Privileged archive helper failed.'));
    }

    clearstatcache(true, $source);
    clearstatcache(true, $destination);
    return 'privileged_helper';
}

function apro_priv_pub_archive_existing_file(string $absolutePath): array
{
    $absolutePath = apro_priv_pub_absolute_path($absolutePath);
    if (!is_file($absolutePath) || is_link($absolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive target is not a regular file: ' . $absolutePath);
    }
    if (!apro_priv_pub_within_root($absolutePath)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Archive target is outside the allowed scan root: ' . $absolutePath);
    }

    $archivePath = apro_priv_pub_next_archive_path($absolutePath);
    $method = apro_priv_pub_move_file($absolutePath, $archivePath);

    $version = null;
    if (preg_match('/[.]([0-9]+)[.]archive$/', $archivePath, $matches)) {
        $version = (int)$matches[1];
    }

    return [
        'archive_absolute_path' => $archivePath,
        'archive_relative_path' => apro_priv_pub_relative_path($archivePath),
        'archive_version' => $version,
        'archive_method' => $method,
    ];
}

function apro_priv_pub_restore_archived_file(string $archivePath, string $livePath): bool
{
    try {
        apro_priv_pub_move_file($archivePath, $livePath);
        return true;
    } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
    }

    try {
        $content = @file_get_contents($archivePath);
        if ($content === false) {
            return false;
        }
        apro_priv_pub_install_content($content, $livePath);
        @unlink($archivePath);
        return true;
    } catch (Throwable $ignored) {
        return false;
    }
}

            if (preg_match('/Target\s*Path\s*:\s*(.+)/i', $body, $targetMatch)) {

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/common.php';

class AproAwsConnector {
    private string $region;
    private string $instanceId;
    private string $profile;

    public function __construct(?string $region = null, ?string $instanceId = null, ?string $profile = null) {
        $this->region = (string)($region ?? apro_env_value('AWS_REGION', apro_env_value('AWS_DEFAULT_REGION', 'us-east-1')));
        $this->instanceId = (string)($instanceId ?? apro_env_value('APRO_AWS_INSTANCE_ID', apro_env_value('AWS_INSTANCE_ID', '')));
        $this->profile = (string)($profile ?? apro_env_value('AWS_PROFILE', ''));
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool {
        return $this->region !== '';
    }

    public function config(): array {
        return [
            'region' => $this->region,
            'instanceId' => $this->instanceId,
            'profile' => $this->profile,
            'hasAccessKey' => apro_env_value('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', '') !== '',
            'hasSecretKey' => apro_env_value('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY', '') !== '',
        ];
    }

    public function instanceMetadata(string $path = 'instance-id'): ?string {
        $token = $this->metadataToken();
        $headers = $token ? ['X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: ' . $token] : [];
        $url = 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch === false) {
            return null;
        }
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 2,
            CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 1,
        ]);
        $body = curl_exec($ch);
        $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        return ($status >= 200 && $status < 300 && is_string($body)) ? $body : null;
    }

    private function metadataToken(): ?string {
        $ch = curl_init('http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token');
        if ($ch === false) {
            return null;
        }
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'PUT',
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600'],
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 2,
            CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 1,
        ]);
        $body = curl_exec($ch);
        $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);
        return ($status >= 200 && $status < 300 && is_string($body) && $body !== '') ? $body : null;
    }

    public function describe(): array {
        return array_merge($this->config(), [
            'metadataInstanceId' => $this->instanceMetadata('instance-id'),
            'availabilityZone' => $this->instanceMetadata('placement/availability-zone'),
        ]);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_aws_connector')) {
    function apro_aws_connector(): AproAwsConnector {
        return new AproAwsConnector();
    }
}

                if ($real !== false) {
                    $out[] = rtrim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $real), '/');
                }
            }
        }
        if (!$out && is_dir('/var/www')) {
            $out[] = '/var/www';
        }
        return array_values(array_unique($out));
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_default_root')) {
    function apro_server_default_root(): string {
        $configured = apro_server_normalize_path((string)apro_env_value('APRO_SERVER_DEFAULT_ROOT', apro_env_value('SERVER_DEFAULT_ROOT', '/var/www')));
        $real = is_dir($configured) ? realpath($configured) : false;
        if ($real !== false) {
            return rtrim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $real), '/');
        }
        $roots = apro_server_allowed_roots();
        return $roots[0] ?? '/var/www';
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_resolve_path')) {
    function apro_server_resolve_path(string $path, bool $mustExist = false): string {
        $path = apro_server_normalize_path($path);
        if ($path === '') {
            $path = apro_server_default_root();
        } elseif ($path[0] !== '/') {
            $path = apro_server_default_root() . '/' . $path;
        }
        $existing = file_exists($path) ? realpath($path) : false;
        if ($existing !== false) {
            $resolved = $existing;
        } else {
            if ($mustExist) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Path does not exist: ' . $path);
            }
            $parent = dirname($path);
            $parentReal = is_dir($parent) ? realpath($parent) : false;
            if ($parentReal === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Parent path does not exist: ' . $parent);
            }
            $resolved = rtrim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $parentReal), '/') . '/' . basename($path);
        }
        $resolved = rtrim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $resolved), '/');
        foreach (apro_server_allowed_roots() as $root) {
            $root = rtrim(str_replace(chr(92), '/', $root), '/');
            if ($resolved === $root || strpos($resolved . '/', $root . '/') === 0) {
                return $resolved;
            }
        }
        throw new RuntimeException('Path is outside the allowed server roots.');
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_read_text_file')) {
    function apro_server_read_text_file(string $path): string {
        $resolved = apro_server_resolve_path($path, true);
        if (!is_file($resolved) || !is_readable($resolved)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('File is not readable.');
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($resolved);
        if ($content === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to read file.');
        }
        return $content;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_write_text_file')) {
    function apro_server_write_text_file(string $path, string $content): string {
        $resolved = apro_server_resolve_path($path, false);
        $dir = dirname($resolved);
        if (!is_dir($dir) && !mkdir($dir, 0775, true) && !is_dir($dir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create directory.');
        }
        if (!is_writable($dir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Directory is not writable.');
        }
        $tmp = tempnam($dir, '.apro-write-');
        if ($tmp === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to create temporary file.');
        }
        if (file_put_contents($tmp, $content, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            @unlink($tmp);
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to write temporary file.');
        }
        @chmod($tmp, 0664);
        if (!rename($tmp, $resolved)) {
            @unlink($tmp);
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to replace destination file.');
        }
        return $resolved;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_tree')) {
    function apro_server_tree(string $path = '', int $maxDepth = 3): array {
        $root = apro_server_resolve_path($path ?: apro_server_default_root(), true);
        $maxDepth = max(0, min($maxDepth, 20));
        $walk = function (string $dir, int $depth) use (&$walk, $maxDepth): array {
            $items = [];
            $entries = scandir($dir) ?: [];
            foreach ($entries as $entry) {
                if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                    continue;
                }
                $full = $dir . '/' . $entry;
                $isDir = is_dir($full);
                $item = ['name' => $entry, 'path' => $full, 'type' => $isDir ? 'directory' : 'file'];
                if (!$isDir) {
                    $item['size'] = @filesize($full) ?: 0;
                    $item['modified'] = @filemtime($full) ?: null;
                } elseif ($depth < $maxDepth) {
                    $item['children'] = $walk($full, $depth + 1);
                }
                $items[] = $item;
            }
            usort($items, static function ($a, $b) {
                if ($a['type'] !== $b['type']) {
                    return $a['type'] === 'directory' ? -1 : 1;
                }
                return strcasecmp($a['name'], $b['name']);
            });
            return $items;
        };
        return ['root' => $root, 'children' => is_dir($root) ? $walk($root, 0) : []];
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_server_base_url')) {
    function apro_server_base_url(): string {
        $configured = (string)apro_env_value('APRO_BASE_URL', '');
        if ($configured !== '') {
            return rtrim($configured, '/');
        }
        $https = (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') || (($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO'] ?? '') === 'https');
        $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? 'apro.maxflex.ai';
        return ($https ? 'https' : 'http') . '://' . $host . '/admin/apro';
    }
}

/**
 * HTTPS Agent connector for APRO.
 *
 * This client targets the hardened admin-api on the Admin EC2 server:
 *   - GET  /admin-api/ping           (auth: X-System-Api-Key)
 *   - GET  /admin-api/tree?path=...  (auth: X-System-Api-Key)
 *   - POST /admin-api/publish        (multipart: package, dest_path, post_hook)
 *   - POST /admin-api/upload-env     (JSON: {env_text, mode})
 *
 * It also supports generic JSON agent endpoints used by newer APRO HTTPS agent flows:
 *   - GET  /test
 *   - GET  /tree
 *   - GET  /file
 *   - POST /publish
 *   - GET  /archives
 */
class AproHttpsAgentConnector
{
    private string $baseUrl;
    private string $apiKey;
    private string $token;
    private bool $insecure;
    private int $timeout;

    /**
     * @param string|null    $baseUrl e.g., https://admin.example.com
     * @param string|null    $apiKey  SYSTEM_API_KEY / agent token value
     * @param array|int|null $options { insecure?: bool, timeout?: int } or timeout seconds
     */
    public function __construct(?string $baseUrl = null, ?string $apiKey = null, $options = [])
    {
        if (is_int($options)) {
            $options = ['timeout' => $options];
        } elseif ($options === null) {
            $options = [];
        } elseif (!is_array($options)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Connector options must be an array, integer timeout, or null.');
        }

        $rawBaseUrl = trim((string)($baseUrl ?? apro_env_value('APRO_HTTPS_AGENT_URL', apro_env_value('HTTPS_AGENT_URL', ''))));
        if ($rawBaseUrl !== '') {
            $sanitized = function_exists('apro_server_sanitize_base_url')
                ? apro_server_sanitize_base_url($rawBaseUrl)
                : rtrim($rawBaseUrl, '/');

            if ($sanitized === '') {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid server_url. Provide a host or full https:// URL without credentials.');
            }

            $this->baseUrl = rtrim($sanitized, '/');
        } else {
            $this->baseUrl = '';
        }

        $resolvedToken = (string)($apiKey ?? apro_env_value(
            'APRO_HTTPS_AGENT_TOKEN',
            apro_env_value('HTTPS_AGENT_TOKEN', apro_env_value('SYSTEM_API_KEY', ''))
        ));

        $this->apiKey = trim($resolvedToken);
        $this->token = $this->apiKey;
        $this->insecure = (bool)($options['insecure'] ?? false);
        $this->timeout = (int)($options['timeout'] ?? apro_env_value('APRO_HTTPS_AGENT_TIMEOUT', 60));

        if ($this->timeout <= 0) {
            $this->timeout = 60;
        }
    }

    public function isConfigured(): bool
    {
        return $this->baseUrl !== '';
    }

    private function assertConfigured(): void
    {
        if (!$this->isConfigured()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('HTTPS agent URL is not configured.');
        }
    }

    private function headers(array $extra = []): array
    {
        $headers = [
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ];

        if ($this->apiKey !== '') {
            $headers['X-System-Api-Key'] = $this->apiKey;
            $headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' . $this->apiKey;
            $headers['X-APRO-Agent-Token'] = $this->apiKey;
        }

        return array_merge($headers, $extra);
    }

    private function normalizeCurlHeaders(array $headers): array
    {
        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($headers as $key => $value) {
            if (is_int($key)) {
                $normalized[] = (string)$value;
            } else {
                $normalized[] = (string)$key . ': ' . (string)$value;
            }
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Generic JSON request helper for APRO HTTPS agent endpoints.
     */
    public function request(string $method, string $path, array $payload = [], array $headers = []): array
    {
        $this->assertConfigured();

        $method = strtoupper($method);
        $url = $this->baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($path, '/');
        $body = null;

        if ($method === 'GET' && $payload) {
            $url .= (strpos($url, '?') === false ? '?' : '&') . http_build_query($payload);
        } elseif ($payload || in_array($method, ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'], true)) {
            $body = json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            if ($body === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Unable to encode HTTPS agent request body as JSON.');
            }
        }

        $requestHeaders = $this->headers($headers);
        if ($body !== null) {
            $requestHeaders['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
        }

        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to initialize HTTPS request.');
        }

        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => $method,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HEADER => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $this->normalizeCurlHeaders($requestHeaders),
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => $this->timeout,
            CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => false,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => !$this->insecure,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST => $this->insecure ? 0 : 2,
        ]);

        if ($body !== null) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $body);
        }

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        if ($response === false) {
            $error = curl_error($ch);
            curl_close($ch);
            throw new RuntimeException('HTTPS agent request failed: ' . $error);
        }

        $status = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        $headerSize = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HEADER_SIZE);
        curl_close($ch);

        $responseBody = substr($response, $headerSize);
        $decoded = json_decode($responseBody, true);
        $data = is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : ['raw' => $responseBody];

        if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) {
            $message = $data['error'] ?? $data['message'] ?? ('HTTPS agent returned HTTP ' . $status);
            throw new RuntimeException((string)$message);
        }

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * Generic connectivity/auth check against /test.
     */
    public function test(): array
    {
        return $this->request('GET', '/test');
    }

    /**
     * Simple connectivity/auth check against /admin-api/ping.
     * @return array { status_code:int, json?:array|null, snippet?:string|null }
     */
    public function ping(): array
    {
        $this->assertConfigured();

        $url = $this->baseUrl . '/admin-api/ping';
        $resp = apro_server_http_get($url, $this->headers(), max(15, (int)($this->timeout / 3)), $this->insecure);
        $json = json_decode($resp['body'], true);

        return [
            'status_code' => $resp['status'],
            'json' => is_array($json) ? $json : null,
            'snippet' => is_array($json) ? null : substr($resp['body'], 0, 1000),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve a directory tree from the agent.
     *
     * When called with a string, targets the hardened admin-api endpoint:
     *   GET /admin-api/tree?path=...
     *
     * When called with an array, targets the generic agent endpoint:
     *   GET /tree?...params...
     *
     * @param string|array $path
     */
    public function tree($path = '/'): array
    {
        $this->assertConfigured();

        if (is_array($path)) {
            return $this->request('GET', '/tree', $path);
        }

        $cleanPath = trim((string)$path) === '' ? '/' : (string)$path;
        $url = $this->baseUrl . '/admin-api/tree?path=' . rawurlencode($cleanPath);
        $resp = apro_server_http_get($url, $this->headers(), max(20, $this->timeout), $this->insecure);
        $json = json_decode($resp['body'], true);

        if (!is_array($json)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Agent returned non-JSON response (HTTP ' . $resp['status'] . ').');
        }

        return $json;
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve a file from the generic HTTPS agent endpoint.
     */
    public function file(array $params = []): array
    {
        return $this->request('GET', '/file', $params);
    }

    /**
     * Publish through the generic HTTPS agent JSON endpoint.
     */
    public function publish(array $payload): array
    {
        return $this->request('POST', '/publish', $payload);
    }

    /**
     * List archives through the generic HTTPS agent endpoint.
     */
    public function archives(array $params = []): array
    {
        return $this->request('GET', '/archives', $params);
    }

    /**
     * Upload and deploy a tar.gz package file to the Admin server.
     *
     * @param string      $filePath Path to a local tar.gz package
     * @param string      $destPath Destination root on server (e.g., /srv/maxflex/public_html/apro)
     * @param string|null $postHook Optional shell post hook to run after sync
     * @return array      Decoded JSON payload on success (if agent returns JSON)
     */
    public function publishPackageFromFile(string $filePath, string $destPath, ?string $postHook = ''): array
    {
        $this->assertConfigured();

        if (!is_file($filePath) || !is_readable($filePath)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Deployment package not found or unreadable: ' . $filePath);
        }

        $url = $this->baseUrl . '/admin-api/publish';
        $fields = [
            'dest_path' => $destPath,
            'post_hook' => (string)($postHook ?? ''),
            'package' => new CURLFile($filePath, 'application/gzip', basename($filePath)),
        ];

        $resp = apro_server_http_post_multipart($url, $this->headers(), $fields, max(120, $this->timeout), $this->insecure);
        $json = json_decode($resp['body'], true);

        if (is_array($json)) {
            return $json;
        }

        return [
            'status_code' => $resp['status'],
            'body_snippet' => substr($resp['body'], 0, 2000),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Upload and deploy a tar.gz package given as raw bytes.
     * Writes to a temp file, calls publishPackageFromFile(), then removes temp.
     */
    public function publishPackageFromBytes(string $packageBytes, string $destPath, ?string $postHook = ''): array
    {
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'apro_pkg_');
        if ($tmp === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Could not allocate temp file for package.');
        }

        try {
            file_put_contents($tmp, $packageBytes);
            return $this->publishPackageFromFile($tmp, $destPath, $postHook);
        } finally {
            @unlink($tmp);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Update /.env.master content on the Admin server.
     *
     * @param string $envText Full text of the environment file
     * @param string $mode    replace|append (agent may support additional modes; default replace)
     */
    public function uploadEnv(string $envText, string $mode = 'replace'): array
    {
        $this->assertConfigured();

        $url = $this->baseUrl . '/admin-api/upload-env';
        $body = [
            'env_text' => $envText,
            'mode' => $mode,
        ];

        $resp = apro_server_http_post_json($url, $this->headers(), $body, max(45, $this->timeout), $this->insecure);
        $json = json_decode($resp['body'], true);

        if (is_array($json)) {
            return $json;
        }

        return [
            'status_code' => $resp['status'],
            'body_snippet' => substr($resp['body'], 0, 2000),
        ];
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_https_agent_connector')) {
    function apro_https_agent_connector(): AproHttpsAgentConnector
    {
        return new AproHttpsAgentConnector();
    }
}

if (!function_exists('apro_https_agent_request')) {
    function apro_https_agent_request(string $method, string $path, array $payload = []): array
    {
        return apro_https_agent_connector()->request($method, $path, $payload);
    }
}

    if (!is_array($models) || $models === []) { $models = [trim((string)($svc['model'] ?? $svc['id'] ?? ''))]; }
    foreach ($models as $rawModelId) {
        $modelId = trim((string)$rawModelId);
        if ($modelId === '' || isset($seenOptions[$modelId])) { continue; }
        $seenOptions[$modelId] = true;
        $baseName = trim((string)($svc['name'] ?? $svc['label'] ?? ucfirst($provider)));
        $label = apro_index_is_provider_label($baseName) ? $modelId : ($baseName . ' ' . $modelId);
        $selected = $modelRuntime === $modelId ? ' selected' : '';
        echo '<option value=' . chr(39) . apro_index_h($modelId) . chr(39) . ' data-provider=' . chr(39) . apro_index_h($provider) . chr(39) . $selected . '>' . apro_index_h($label) . '</option>' . chr(10);
    }
}
if ($modelRuntime !== '' && !isset($seenOptions[$modelRuntime])) {
    echo '<option value=' . chr(39) . apro_index_h($modelRuntime) . chr(39) . ' data-provider=' . chr(39) . apro_index_h($modelProvider) . chr(39) . ' selected>' . apro_index_h($modelDisplay) . '</option>' . chr(10);
}
?>

function normalizeExtension(extension) {
    if (typeof extension !== 'string') return '';
    let value = extension.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!value) return '';
    if (!value.startsWith('.')) value = `.${value}`;
    return value;

function uniqueSorted(values) {

}

function extensionsFromValue(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return uniqueSorted([value]);
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return [];
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return uniqueSorted(value);
    const extensions = [];

        else if (Array.isArray(raw)) extensions.push(...raw);
    });
    return uniqueSorted(extensions);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

if (!defined('ADMIN_SESSION_KEY')) {
    define('ADMIN_SESSION_KEY', 'axiamax_admin_auth');
}
if (!defined('ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY')) {
    define('ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY', 'axiamax_admin_username');
}
if (!defined('ADMIN_SESSION_LOGGED_IN_AT_KEY')) {
    define('ADMIN_SESSION_LOGGED_IN_AT_KEY', 'axiamax_admin_logged_in_at');
}

if (!function_exists('start_admin_session')) {
    function start_admin_session(): void
    {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            return;
        }

        $httpsEnabled = (
            (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off')
            || (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO']) && strtolower((string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO']) === 'https')
            || ((int)($_SERVER['SERVER_PORT'] ?? 0) === 443)
        );

        $sessionName = 'AXIAMAXADMINSESSID';
        if (function_exists('axiamax_env')) {
            $sessionName = (string)axiamax_env('ADMIN_SESSION_NAME', $sessionName);
        } elseif (function_exists('apro_env')) {
            $sessionName = (string)apro_env('ADMIN_SESSION_NAME', $sessionName);
        }

        if ($sessionName !== '') {
            session_name($sessionName);
        }

        if (PHP_VERSION_ID >= 70300) {
            session_set_cookie_params([
                'lifetime' => 0,
                'path' => '/',
                'domain' => '',
                'secure' => $httpsEnabled,
                'httponly' => true,
                'samesite' => 'Lax',
            ]);
        } else {
            session_set_cookie_params(0, '/', '', $httpsEnabled, true);
        }

        session_start();
    }
}

if (!function_exists('complete_admin_login')) {
    function complete_admin_login(string $username): void
    {
        start_admin_session();
        session_regenerate_id(true);

        $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_KEY] = true;
        $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY] = $username;
        $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_LOGGED_IN_AT_KEY] = time();

        $_SESSION['admin_authenticated'] = true;
        $_SESSION['admin_logged_in'] = true;
        $_SESSION['axiamax_admin_authenticated'] = true;
        $_SESSION['admin_username'] = $username;
        $_SESSION['username'] = $username;
        $_SESSION['admin_user'] = $username;
        $_SESSION['admin_login_time'] = time();

        unset($_SESSION['admin_login_error'], $_SESSION['admin_login_old_username']);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('is_admin_authenticated')) {
    function is_admin_authenticated(): bool
    {
        start_admin_session();

        $authenticated = !empty($_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_KEY])
            || !empty($_SESSION['admin_authenticated'])
            || !empty($_SESSION['admin_logged_in'])
            || !empty($_SESSION['axiamax_admin_authenticated'])
            || !empty($_SESSION['authenticated'])
            || !empty($_SESSION['logged_in']);

        if ($authenticated && empty($_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_KEY])) {
            $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_KEY] = true;
            if (empty($_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY])) {
                $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY] = get_authenticated_admin_username();
            }
            if (empty($_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_LOGGED_IN_AT_KEY])) {
                $_SESSION[ADMIN_SESSION_LOGGED_IN_AT_KEY] = (int)($_SESSION['admin_login_time'] ?? time());
            }
        }

        return $authenticated;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('get_authenticated_admin_username')) {
    function get_authenticated_admin_username(): string
    {
        start_admin_session();

        foreach ([ADMIN_SESSION_USERNAME_KEY, 'admin_username', 'username'] as $key) {
            if (!empty($_SESSION[$key]) && is_string($_SESSION[$key])) {
                return (string)$_SESSION[$key];
            }
        }

        if (!empty($_SESSION['admin_user'])) {
            if (is_string($_SESSION['admin_user'])) {
                return (string)$_SESSION['admin_user'];
            }
            if (is_array($_SESSION['admin_user'])) {
                foreach (['username', 'name', 'email'] as $key) {
                    if (!empty($_SESSION['admin_user'][$key])) {
                        return (string)$_SESSION['admin_user'][$key];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!empty($_SESSION['user']) && is_array($_SESSION['user'])) {
            foreach (['username', 'name', 'email'] as $key) {
                if (!empty($_SESSION['user'][$key])) {
                    return (string)$_SESSION['user'][$key];
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    }
}

if (!function_exists('admin_request_expects_json')) {
    function admin_request_expects_json(): bool
    {
        $uri = (string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '');
        $accept = strtolower((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? ''));
        $requestedWith = strtolower((string)($_SERVER['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] ?? ''));

        return strpos($uri, '/api/') !== false
            || strpos($accept, 'application/json') !== false
            || $requestedWith === 'xmlhttprequest';
    }
}

if (!function_exists('require_admin_authentication')) {
    function require_admin_authentication(): void
    {
        if (is_admin_authenticated()) {

        }

        if (admin_request_expects_json()) {
            if (!headers_sent()) {
                http_response_code(401);
                header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
                header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
            }
            echo json_encode([
                'status' => 'error',
                'message' => 'Authentication required.',
                'data' => [],
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
            exit;
        }

        $next = (string)($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/admin/dashboard.php');
        if ($next === '' || strpos($next, '://') !== false || strpos($next, '//') === 0 || $next[0] !== '/') {
            $next = '/admin/dashboard.php';
        }

        header('Location: /admin/login.php?next=' . rawurlencode($next));
        exit;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('logout_admin')) {
    function logout_admin(): void
    {
