                    'path' => $params['path'] ?? '/',
                    'domain' => $params['domain'] ?? '',
                    'secure' => (bool)($params['secure'] ?? false),
                    'httponly' => (bool)($params['httponly'] ?? true),
                    'samesite' => $params['samesite'] ?? 'Lax',

            } else {

                    $params['path'] ?? '/',
                    $params['domain'] ?? '',
                    (bool)($params['secure'] ?? false),
                    (bool)($params['httponly'] ?? true)

        }
    }

require_once __DIR__ . '/env.php';

if (!defined('AXIAMAX_ADMIN_BASE_URL')) {
    define('AXIAMAX_ADMIN_BASE_URL', axiamax_base_url(ltrim(AXIAMAX_ADMIN_BASE_PATH, '/')));
}

$timezone = axiamax_env('APP_TIMEZONE', axiamax_env('TZ', 'UTC'));
if (is_string($timezone) && $timezone !== '') {
    date_default_timezone_set($timezone);
}

$debug = (bool) axiamax_env('APP_DEBUG', false);
if ($debug) {
    error_reporting(E_ALL);

}
ini_set('log_errors', '1');

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {

    $sessionName = (string) axiamax_env('ADMIN_SESSION_NAME', 'AXIAMAXADMINSESSID');

    if ($sessionName !== '') {
        session_name($sessionName);
    }

    if (PHP_VERSION_ID >= 70300) {
        session_set_cookie_params([
            'lifetime' => 0,
            'path' => '/',
            'domain' => '',
            'secure' => $secure,
            'httponly' => true,
            'samesite' => 'Lax',
        ]);

<?php
if (!defined('AXIAMAX_SITE_ROOT')) {
    define('AXIAMAX_SITE_ROOT', dirname(__DIR__, 2));
}

if (!defined('AXIAMAX_ADMIN_ROOT')) {
    define('AXIAMAX_ADMIN_ROOT', dirname(__DIR__));
}

if (!defined('AXIAMAX_ENV_FILE')) {
    define('AXIAMAX_ENV_FILE', dirname(AXIAMAX_SITE_ROOT) . '/.env.master');
}

if (!function_exists('axiamax_load_env')) {
    function axiamax_load_env($path = null, $override = false)
    {
        $path = $path ?: AXIAMAX_ENV_FILE;

        if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
            return [];
        }

        $loaded = [];
        $lines = file($path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES);

        foreach ($lines as $line) {
            $line = trim($line);

            if ($line === '' || $line[0] === '#') {
                continue;
            }

            if (strncmp($line, 'export ', 7) === 0) {
                $line = trim(substr($line, 7));
            }

            $pos = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($pos === false) {
                continue;
            }

            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $pos));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $pos + 1));

            if ($key === '' || !preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/', $key)) {
                continue;
            }

            $first = $value[0] ?? '';
            $last = substr($value, -1);
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && (($first === '\'' && $last === '\'') || ($first === chr(34) && $last === chr(34)))) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }

            if (!$override && getenv($key) !== false) {
                $loaded[$key] = getenv($key);
                continue;
            }

            $_ENV[$key] = $value;
            $_SERVER[$key] = $value;
            putenv($key . '=' . $value);
            $loaded[$key] = $value;
        }

        return $loaded;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('axiamax_env')) {
    function axiamax_env($key, $default = null)
    {
        $value = $_ENV[$key] ?? $_SERVER[$key] ?? getenv($key);

        if ($value === false || $value === null || $value === '') {
            return $default;
        }

        $lower = strtolower((string) $value);
        if ($lower === 'true' || $lower === '(true)') {
            return true;
        }
        if ($lower === 'false' || $lower === '(false)') {
            return false;
        }
        if ($lower === 'null' || $lower === '(null)') {
            return null;
        }

        return $value;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('env')) {
    function env($key, $default = null)
    {
        return axiamax_env($key, $default);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('axiamax_is_https')) {
    function axiamax_is_https()
    {
        if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off') {
            return true;
        }

        if (!empty($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO']) && strtolower($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO']) === 'https') {
            return true;
        }

        if (!empty($_SERVER['SERVER_PORT']) && (int) $_SERVER['SERVER_PORT'] === 443) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('axiamax_base_url')) {
    function axiamax_base_url($path = '')
    {
        $configured = axiamax_env('APP_URL', axiamax_env('AXIAMAX_APP_URL', null));
        $base = $configured ?: ((axiamax_is_https() ? 'https' : 'http') . '://' . ($_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? 'apro.maxflex.ai'));
        $base = rtrim($base, '/');
        $path = ltrim((string) $path, '/');

        return $path === '' ? $base : $base . '/' . $path;
    }
}

axiamax_load_env(AXIAMAX_ENV_FILE);

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/includes/bootstrap.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/includes/auth.php';

if (!function_exists('admin_login_env')) {
    function admin_login_env(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        if (function_exists('axiamax_env')) {
            $value = axiamax_env($key, null);
            if ($value !== null && $value !== '') {
                return $value;
            }
        }
        if (function_exists('env')) {
            $value = env($key, null);
            if ($value !== null && $value !== '') {
                return $value;
            }
        }
        if (function_exists('get_env')) {
            $value = get_env($key, null);
            if ($value !== null && $value !== '') {
                return $value;
            }
        }
        $value = getenv($key);
        if ($value !== false && $value !== '') {
            return $value;
        }
        return $default;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('admin_login_first_env')) {
    function admin_login_first_env(array $keys, string $default = ''): string
    {
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            $value = admin_login_env((string)$key, null);
            if ($value !== null && $value !== '') {
                return (string)$value;
            }
        }
        return $default;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('admin_login_password_matches')) {
    function admin_login_password_matches(string $password, string $expectedPassword, string $expectedHash): bool
    {
        if ($expectedHash !== '') {
            if (password_verify($password, $expectedHash)) {
                return true;
            }

            if (strlen($expectedHash) === 64 && ctype_xdigit($expectedHash)) {
                return hash_equals(strtolower($expectedHash), hash('sha256', $password));
            }

            return false;
        }

        return $expectedPassword !== '' && hash_equals($expectedPassword, $password);
    }
}

if (!headers_sent()) {
    header('Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0');
    header('Pragma: no-cache');
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    header('X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN');
    header('Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
}

$dashboard = '/admin/dashboard.php';
$next = isset($_GET['next']) ? (string)$_GET['next'] : $dashboard;
if ($next === '' || strpos($next, '://') !== false || strpos($next, '//') === 0 || $next[0] !== '/') {
    $next = $dashboard;
}

if (is_admin_authenticated()) {
    header('Location: ' . $next);
    exit;
}

$error = '';
$oldUsername = '';

if (($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST') {
    $username = trim((string)($_POST['username'] ?? ''));
    $password = (string)($_POST['password'] ?? '');
    $oldUsername = $username;

    $expectedUser = admin_login_first_env([
        'ADMIN_USERNAME',
        'AXIAMAX_ADMIN_USERNAME',
        'MASTER_ADMIN_USERNAME',
    ]);

    $expectedPassword = admin_login_first_env([
        'ADMIN_PASSWORD',
        'AXIAMAX_ADMIN_PASSWORD',
        'MASTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD',
    ]);

    $expectedHash = admin_login_first_env([
        'ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH',
        'AXIAMAX_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH',
        'MASTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH',
    ]);

    if ($expectedUser === '' || ($expectedPassword === '' && $expectedHash === '')) {
        $error = 'Admin credentials are not configured.';
    } else {
        $userOk = hash_equals($expectedUser, $username);
        $passwordOk = admin_login_password_matches($password, $expectedPassword, $expectedHash);

        if ($userOk && $passwordOk) {
            complete_admin_login($username);
            header('Location: ' . $next);
            exit;
        }

        $error = 'Invalid username or password.';
    }
}

function admin_login_h(string $value): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
<title>Hands-Free Teleprompter Reader v4 Pro</title>

<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0b1220;
  --panel:#121c2e;
  --panel2:#0f172a;
  --text:#f8fafc;
  --muted:#9ca3af;
  --border:#22314f;
  --accent:#3b82f6;
  --accent2:#60a5fa;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  height:100vh;
  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
}

/* ===== TOP BAR ===== */
.topbar{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel),#0d1526);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:10px 14px;
  display:flex;
  gap:14px;
  align-items:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}

.block{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:6px;
  min-width:220px;
}
.labelrow{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  font-size:12px;
  color:var(--muted);
  user-select:none;
}
.valuepill{
  font-size:12px;
  padding:2px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
  border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.35);
  color:#dbeafe;
  font-weight:700;
}

textarea{
  width:340px;
  height:72px;
  resize:none;
  background:var(--panel2);
  color:var(--text);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px;
  outline:none;
}
textarea:focus{
  border-color:rgba(96,165,250,0.75);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.18);
}

.rangeRow{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
}
input[type=range]{
  width:220px;
  appearance:none;
  height:6px;
  background:#243554;
  border-radius:999px;
  outline:none;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  appearance:none;
  width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--accent);
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28);
  cursor:pointer;
}

.buttons{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
}
button{
  border:none;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:9px 12px;
  font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--text);
  background:#243554;
}
button.primary{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent),#2563eb);
}
button:hover{
  filter:brightness(1.06);
}
button:active{
  transform:translateY(1px);
}
button.tog{
  background:#1c2a45;
}
button.tog.on{
  background:rgba(59,130,246,0.20);
  border:1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.55);
}

/* ===== READER AREA ===== */
.reader{
  flex:1;
  overflow-y:auto;
  padding:0 14vw;
  position:relative;
  background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 50% 0%, rgba(96,165,250,0.08), transparent 60%);
}

/* Fade mask (top/bottom) */
.reader::before,
.reader::after{
  content:"";
  position:sticky;
  left:0; right:0;
  height:80px;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:5;
  display:block;
}
.reader::before{
  top:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg),rgba(11,18,32,0));
}
.reader::after{
  bottom:0;
  background:linear-gradient(0deg,var(--bg),rgba(11,18,32,0));
}

.spacer{width:100%}
.content{
  max-width:980px;
  margin:0 auto;
  font-size:34px;
  line-height:1.62;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
}

/* Center guide line */
.guide{
  position:absolute;
  left:0; right:0;
  top:50%;
  height:0;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.35);
  z-index:6;
  pointer-events:none;
  display:none;
}
.guide::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:-6px;
  width:10px;height:10px;
  transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border:1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.50);
  background:rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
}
.reader.show-guide .guide{display:block}

/* Tiny help footer */
.hint{
  margin-left:auto;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;
  user-select:none;
}
kbd{
  font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  font-size:11px;
  padding:2px 6px;
  border-radius:6px;
  border:1px solid #314567;
  background:#12203a;
  color:#e5e7eb;
}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="topbar">
  <textarea id="inputText" placeholder="Paste your text here... (saved automatically)"></textarea>

  <div class="block">
    <div class="labelrow">
      <span>Speed (WPM)</span>
      <span class="valuepill" id="speedValue">300 WPM</span>
    </div>
    <div class="rangeRow">
      <input type="range" id="speedSlider" min="50" max="2000" value="300" step="10" />
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="block">
    <div class="labelrow">
      <span>Text Size</span>
      <span class="valuepill" id="sizeValue">34 px</span>
    </div>
    <div class="rangeRow">
      <input type="range" id="sizeSlider" min="16" max="96" value="34" step="1" />
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="buttons">
    <button class="primary" id="btnStart">Start</button>
    <button id="btnPause">Pause</button>
    <button id="btnReset">Reset</button>
    <button class="tog" id="btnFullscreen" title="Toggle fullscreen (F)">Fullscreen</button>
    <button class="tog" id="btnGuide" title="Toggle guide line (G)">Guide</button>
  </div>

  <div class="hint">
    <span><kbd>Space</kbd> Pause/Resume</span>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;<span><kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> speed</span>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;<span><kbd>+</kbd>/<kbd>-</kbd> size</span>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;<span><kbd>F</kbd> fullscreen</span>
    &nbsp;·&nbsp;<span><kbd>G</kbd> guide</span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="reader" id="reader">
  <div class="guide"></div>
  <div class="spacer" id="topSpacer"></div>
  <div class="content" id="readerContent"></div>
  <div class="spacer" id="bottomSpacer"></div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  // ===== Elements =====
  const inputText = document.getElementById('inputText');
  const speedSlider = document.getElementById('speedSlider');
  const sizeSlider  = document.getElementById('sizeSlider');
  const speedValue  = document.getElementById('speedValue');
  const sizeValue   = document.getElementById('sizeValue');

  const btnStart = document.getElementById('btnStart');
  const btnPause = document.getElementById('btnPause');
  const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnReset');
  const btnFullscreen = document.getElementById('btnFullscreen');
  const btnGuide = document.getElementById('btnGuide');

  const reader = document.getElementById('reader');
  const readerContent = document.getElementById('readerContent');
  const topSpacer = document.getElementById('topSpacer');
  const bottomSpacer = document.getElementById('bottomSpacer');

  // ===== State =====
  let isScrolling = false;

  // Time-based scroll (stable for huge docs + slow speeds)
  let startTime = null;       // rAF timestamp when scroll started (or resumed)
  let rafId = null;

  // These let us do live speed changes without jumps:
  let durationMs = 1;         // current intended total duration for full scroll
  let scrollMaxPx = 0;        // max scrollTop value
  let baseScrollPx = 0;       // scrollTop at the moment we start/resume
  let remainingFraction = 1;  // remaining progress fraction at start/resume

  // Persisted toggles
  let guideEnabled = false;

  // ===== Helpers =====
  const LS_KEYS = {
    text: "tp_v4_text",
    wpm:  "tp_v4_wpm",
    size: "tp_v4_size",
    guide:"tp_v4_guide"
  };

  function clamp(n, a, b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n)); }

  function countWordsFast(s){
    // More memory-friendly than split for huge text
    const m = s.match(/\S+/g);
    return m ? m.length : 0;
  }

  function setupSpacers(){
    // Entry from bottom / exit past top
    const h = reader.clientHeight;
    topSpacer.style.height = h + "px";
    bottomSpacer.style.height = h + "px";
  }

  function applyTextSize(px){
    readerContent.style.fontSize = px + "px";
    sizeValue.textContent = px + " px";
  }

  function applySpeed(wpm){
    speedValue.textContent = wpm + " WPM";
  }

  function saveState(){
    try{
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.text, inputText.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.wpm, speedSlider.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.size, sizeSlider.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.guide, guideEnabled ? "1" : "0");
    }catch(e){}
  }

  function loadState(){
    try{
      const t = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.text);
      const w = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.wpm);
      const z = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.size);
      const g = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.guide);

      if (t !== null) inputText.value = t;
      if (w !== null) speedSlider.value = clamp(parseInt(w,10)||300, 50, 2000);
      if (z !== null) sizeSlider.value  = clamp(parseInt(z,10)||34, 16, 96);
      guideEnabled = (g === "1");

    }catch(e){}
  }

  function setGuide(on){
    guideEnabled = !!on;
    reader.classList.toggle("show-guide", guideEnabled);
    btnGuide.classList.toggle("on", guideEnabled);
    saveState();
  }

  function setFullscreenButtonState(){
    const fs = !!document.fullscreenElement;
    btnFullscreen.classList.toggle("on", fs);
  }

  // Calculate duration based on WPM and words
  function computeDurationMs(words, wpm){
    // total minutes = words / wpm; convert to ms
    // Keep as float; large durations are fine with time-based progress.
    const minutes = words / Math.max(1, wpm);
    return minutes * 60 * 1000;
  }

  // Rebuild content and scroll metrics
  function buildReaderFromInput(){
    const text = (inputText.value || "").trim();
    readerContent.textContent = text;
    applyTextSize(parseInt(sizeSlider.value,10));
    setupSpacers();

    // Must wait a tick for layout to settle when content is huge
    // (but no async promises; just compute immediately—browser has layout by now in most cases)
    scrollMaxPx = Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    return text;
  }

  function stopRAF(){
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    rafId = null;
  }

  // Map progress [0..1] to scrollTop, including base offset
  function setScrollByProgress(progress){
    // progress is "how far through remaining portion"
    const target = baseScrollPx + (scrollMaxPx - baseScrollPx) * progress;
    reader.scrollTop = target;
  }

  function startOrResume(){
    const text = buildReaderFromInput();
    if (!text){
      alert("Please paste or enter text first.");
      return;
    }

    // Start at the top: blank screen first, then text enters from bottom
    if (!isScrolling && reader.scrollTop === 0){
      // ok
    }

    const words = countWordsFast(text);
    const wpm = parseInt(speedSlider.value,10);

    // Determine how much is remaining from current scrollTop
    scrollMaxPx = Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    const currentPx = clamp(reader.scrollTop, 0, scrollMaxPx);

    baseScrollPx = currentPx;
    remainingFraction = (scrollMaxPx <= 0) ? 0 : (1 - (currentPx / scrollMaxPx));
    remainingFraction = clamp(remainingFraction, 0, 1);

    // duration for FULL scroll, then apply remaining fraction
    const fullDuration = computeDurationMs(words, wpm);

    // If remaining is tiny, finish quickly but visibly
    durationMs = Math.max(300, fullDuration * remainingFraction);

    startTime = null;
    isScrolling = true;

    // button label
    btnStart.textContent = "Resume";

    stopRAF();
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function tick(ts){
    if (!isScrolling) return;

    if (startTime === null) startTime = ts;
    const elapsed = ts - startTime;

    // progress through remaining portion
    const p = clamp(elapsed / durationMs, 0, 1);

    setScrollByProgress(p);

    if (p >= 1 || reader.scrollTop >= scrollMaxPx - 0.5){
      reader.scrollTop = scrollMaxPx;
      isScrolling = false;
      stopRAF();
      return;
    }

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function pause(){
    if (!isScrolling) return;
    isScrolling = false;
    stopRAF();
  }

  function reset(){
    isScrolling = false;
    stopRAF();
    startTime = null;
    reader.scrollTop = 0;
    btnStart.textContent = "Start";
  }

  // Live speed changes while scrolling (no jump)
  function onSpeedChange(){
    const wpm = parseInt(speedSlider.value,10);
    applySpeed(wpm);
    saveState();

    if (!isScrolling) return;

    // Recompute remaining duration from current position
    const text = (inputText.value || "").trim();
    const words = countWordsFast(text);
    scrollMaxPx = Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    const currentPx = clamp(reader.scrollTop, 0, scrollMaxPx);

    baseScrollPx = currentPx;
    remainingFraction = (scrollMaxPx <= 0) ? 0 : (1 - (currentPx / scrollMaxPx));
    remainingFraction = clamp(remainingFraction, 0, 1);

    const fullDuration = computeDurationMs(words, wpm);
    durationMs = Math.max(200, fullDuration * remainingFraction);

    // restart timing from "now" but continue from current position
    startTime = null;
  }

  // Live size changes (rebuild metrics + preserve proportional position)
  function onSizeChange(){
    const px = parseInt(sizeSlider.value,10);
    applyTextSize(px);
    saveState();

    // Keep "progress" approximately stable if user changes size mid-scroll
    const wasScrolling = isScrolling;
    const oldMax = scrollMaxPx || Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    const oldTop = reader.scrollTop;
    const ratio = oldMax > 0 ? (oldTop / oldMax) : 0;

    setupSpacers();
    // Layout may change; recompute max and set scroll based on ratio
    scrollMaxPx = Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    reader.scrollTop = scrollMaxPx * ratio;

    if (wasScrolling){
      // Continue with updated geometry and keep time-based stability
      onSpeedChange(); // recompute remaining duration based on new geometry
    }
  }

  function toggleFullscreen(){
    if (!document.fullscreenElement){
      document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.();
    }else{
      document.exitFullscreen?.();
    }
  }

  function nudgeSpeed(delta){
    const v = clamp((parseInt(speedSlider.value,10) || 300) + delta, 50, 2000);
    speedSlider.value = v;
    onSpeedChange();
  }

  function nudgeSize(delta){
    const v = clamp((parseInt(sizeSlider.value,10) || 34) + delta, 16, 96);
    sizeSlider.value = v;
    onSizeChange();
  }

  // ===== Events =====
  btnStart.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (isScrolling) return; // already going
    startOrResume();
  });

  btnPause.addEventListener('click', () => pause());
  btnReset.addEventListener('click', () => reset());

  btnFullscreen.addEventListener('click', () => toggleFullscreen());
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', setFullscreenButtonState);

  btnGuide.addEventListener('click', () => setGuide(!guideEnabled));

  // Sliders
  speedSlider.addEventListener('input', onSpeedChange);
  sizeSlider.addEventListener('input', onSizeChange);

  // Persist text changes (debounced)
  let saveTimer = null;
  inputText.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (saveTimer) clearTimeout(saveTimer);
    saveTimer = setTimeout(saveState, 200);
  });

  // Keyboard controls (ignore when typing in textarea)
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const target = e.target;
    const typing = target && (target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || target.tagName === "INPUT");

    // Allow ESC to exit fullscreen naturally; no handling needed.
    if (typing) return;

    if (e.code === "Space"){
      e.preventDefault();
      if (isScrolling) pause();
      else startOrResume();
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === "ArrowUp"){
      e.preventDefault();
      nudgeSpeed(+20);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown"){
      e.preventDefault();
      nudgeSpeed(-20);
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === "+" || e.key === "="){
      e.preventDefault();
      nudgeSize(+1);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === "-" || e.key === "_"){
      e.preventDefault();
      nudgeSize(-1);
      return;
    }

    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "f"){
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleFullscreen();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "g"){
      e.preventDefault();
      setGuide(!guideEnabled);
      return;
    }
  });

  // Resize: update spacers & maintain relative position
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    const oldMax = scrollMaxPx || Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    const ratio = oldMax > 0 ? (reader.scrollTop / oldMax) : 0;

    setupSpacers();
    scrollMaxPx = Math.max(0, reader.scrollHeight - reader.clientHeight);
    reader.scrollTop = scrollMaxPx * ratio;

    if (isScrolling){
      // Recompute remaining duration after geometry change
      onSpeedChange();
    }
  });

  // ===== Init =====
  loadState();
  applySpeed(parseInt(speedSlider.value,10));
  applyTextSize(parseInt(sizeSlider.value,10));
  setGuide(guideEnabled);
  setFullscreenButtonState();

  // Build initial (so sizes/spacers are correct even before start)
  buildReaderFromInput();
  reader.scrollTop = 0;

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

.buttons{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:center;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
button{
  border:none;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px 14px;
  font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--text);
  background:#243554;
}
button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent),#2563eb)}
button.good{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--good),#059669)}
button.warn{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--warn),#d97706)}
button:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)}
button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
button:disabled{
  opacity:0.45;
  cursor:not-allowed;
  filter:none;
}
.main{
  flex:1;
  overflow:auto;
  padding:18px 14px 28px;
}
.panel{
  max-width:1100px;
  margin:0 auto;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,28,46,0.92),rgba(10,18,33,0.92));
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:18px;
  padding:18px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
}
.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));
  gap:14px;
  margin-top:14px;
}
.statusbar{
  margin-top:16px;
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top:14px;
}
.status{
  font-weight:700;
}
.status.idle{color:#cbd5e1}
.status.speaking{color:#86efac}
.status.paused{color:#fcd34d}
.status.stopped{color:#fca5a5}
.meta{
  display:flex;
  gap:10px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.pill{
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:#0f172a;
  color:#dbeafe;
  border-radius:999px;
  padding:6px 10px;
  font-size:12px;
}
.help{
  margin-top:12px;
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.notice{
  margin-top:14px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.35);
  background:rgba(245,158,11,0.10);
  color:#fde68a;
  display:none;
}
.notice.show{display:block}
@media (max-width: 760px){
  .topbar{padding:12px}
  textarea{min-height:160px}
  .panel{padding:14px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="block" style="min-width:min(760px,100%)">
      <div class="labelrow">
        <span>Text to Read Aloud</span>
        <span class="valuepill" id="wordCount">0 words</span>
      </div>
      <textarea id="inputText" placeholder="Enter or paste text here..."></textarea>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="main">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="buttons">
        <button class="primary" id="btnSpeak">Speak</button>
        <button class="warn" id="btnPause">Pause</button>
        <button class="good" id="btnResume">Resume</button>
        <button id="btnStop">Stop</button>
      </div>

      <div class="grid">
        <div class="block">
          <div class="labelrow">
            <span>Voice</span>
            <span class="valuepill" id="voiceCount">0 loaded</span>
          </div>
          <select id="voiceSelect"></select>
        </div>

        <div class="block">
          <div class="labelrow">
            <span>Rate</span>
            <span class="valuepill" id="rateValue">1.00</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rangeRow">
            <input type="range" id="rateSlider" min="0.5" max="2" value="1" step="0.05" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="block">
          <div class="labelrow">
            <span>Pitch</span>
            <span class="valuepill" id="pitchValue">1.00</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rangeRow">
            <input type="range" id="pitchSlider" min="0" max="2" value="1" step="0.05" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="block">
          <div class="labelrow">
            <span>Volume</span>
            <span class="valuepill" id="volumeValue">1.00</span>
          </div>
          <div class="rangeRow">
            <input type="range" id="volumeSlider" min="0" max="1" value="1" step="0.05" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="statusbar">
        <div class="status idle" id="statusText">Status: Idle</div>
        <div class="meta">
          <div class="pill" id="chunkInfo">0 chunks queued</div>
          <div class="pill">Browser-native speech</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="notice" id="supportNotice"></div>

      <div class="help">
        This basic version uses the browser’s built-in speech synthesis voices. Voice availability and voice quality depend on the browser and operating system.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
(() => {
  const synth = window.speechSynthesis;

  const inputText = document.getElementById('inputText');
  const voiceSelect = document.getElementById('voiceSelect');
  const rateSlider = document.getElementById('rateSlider');
  const pitchSlider = document.getElementById('pitchSlider');
  const volumeSlider = document.getElementById('volumeSlider');

  const rateValue = document.getElementById('rateValue');
  const pitchValue = document.getElementById('pitchValue');
  const volumeValue = document.getElementById('volumeValue');
  const wordCount = document.getElementById('wordCount');
  const voiceCount = document.getElementById('voiceCount');
  const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
  const chunkInfo = document.getElementById('chunkInfo');
  const supportNotice = document.getElementById('supportNotice');

  const btnSpeak = document.getElementById('btnSpeak');
  const btnPause = document.getElementById('btnPause');
  const btnResume = document.getElementById('btnResume');
  const btnStop = document.getElementById('btnStop');

  const LS_KEYS = {
    text: 'tts_basic_text',
    voice: 'tts_basic_voice',
    rate: 'tts_basic_rate',
    pitch: 'tts_basic_pitch',
    volume: 'tts_basic_volume'
  };

  let voices = [];
  let activeUtterances = [];
  let totalChunks = 0;
  let chunksCompleted = 0;
  let isStarting = false;

  function clamp(value, min, max){
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
  }

  function updateStatus(text, cssClass){
    statusText.textContent = 'Status: ' + text;
    statusText.className = 'status ' + cssClass;
  }

  function updateButtons(){
    const speaking = synth && synth.speaking;
    const paused = synth && synth.paused;

    btnSpeak.disabled = isStarting;
    btnPause.disabled = !speaking || paused;
    btnResume.disabled = !paused;
    btnStop.disabled = !speaking && !paused && !isStarting;
  }

  function showNotice(message){
    supportNotice.textContent = message;
    supportNotice.classList.add('show');
  }

  function hideNotice(){
    supportNotice.textContent = '';
    supportNotice.classList.remove('show');
  }

  function countWords(text){
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return 0;
    const matches = trimmed.match(/\S+/g);
    return matches ? matches.length : 0;
  }

  function updateWordCount(){
    const count = countWords(inputText.value);
    wordCount.textContent = count + (count === 1 ? ' word' : ' words');
  }

  function saveState(){
    try{
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.text, inputText.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.voice, voiceSelect.value || '');
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.rate, rateSlider.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.pitch, pitchSlider.value);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_KEYS.volume, volumeSlider.value);
    }catch(err){}
  }

  function loadState(){
    try{
      const text = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.text);
      const voice = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.voice);
      const rate = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.rate);
      const pitch = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.pitch);
      const volume = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEYS.volume);

      if (text !== null) inputText.value = text;
      if (rate !== null) rateSlider.value = clamp(parseFloat(rate) || 1, 0.5, 2);
      if (pitch !== null) pitchSlider.value = clamp(parseFloat(pitch) || 1, 0, 2);
      if (volume !== null) volumeSlider.value = clamp(parseFloat(volume) || 1, 0, 1);

      voiceSelect.dataset.savedVoice = voice || '';
    }catch(err){}
  }

  function refreshSliderLabels(){
    rateValue.textContent = Number(rateSlider.value).toFixed(2);
    pitchValue.textContent = Number(pitchSlider.value).toFixed(2);
    volumeValue.textContent = Number(volumeSlider.value).toFixed(2);
  }

  function getVoiceLabel(voice){
    const lang = voice.lang ? ' (' + voice.lang + ')' : '';
    const defaultMarker = voice.default ? ' — Default' : '';
    return voice.name + lang + defaultMarker;
  }

  function populateVoices(){
    if (!synth) return;

    const loadedVoices = synth.getVoices().slice();
    if (!loadedVoices.length) {
      voiceCount.textContent = '0 loaded';
      voiceSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">Loading voices...</option>';
      return;
    }

    voices = loadedVoices.sort((a, b) => {
      const aLabel = getVoiceLabel(a).toLowerCase();
      const bLabel = getVoiceLabel(b).toLowerCase();
      return aLabel.localeCompare(bLabel);
    });

    const savedVoice = voiceSelect.dataset.savedVoice || '';
    const previousValue = voiceSelect.value || savedVoice;

    voiceSelect.innerHTML = '';
    voices.forEach((voice, index) => {
      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = String(index);
      option.textContent = getVoiceLabel(voice);
      voiceSelect.appendChild(option);
    });

    if (previousValue !== '' && voices[Number(previousValue)]) {
      voiceSelect.value = previousValue;
    } else {
      const defaultIndex = voices.findIndex(v => v.default);
      voiceSelect.value = String(defaultIndex >= 0 ? defaultIndex : 0);
    }

    voiceCount.textContent = voices.length + ' loaded';
    saveState();
  }

  function splitIntoChunks(text, maxLength = 180){
    const normalized = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').trim();
    if (!normalized) return [];

    const paragraphs = normalized
      .split(/\n{2,}/)
      .map(part => part.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const chunks = [];

    paragraphs.forEach((paragraph) => {
      if (paragraph.length <= maxLength) {
        chunks.push(paragraph);
        return;
      }

      const sentences = paragraph.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+|[^.!?]+$/g) || [paragraph];
      let current = '';

      sentences.forEach((sentenceRaw) => {
        const sentence = sentenceRaw.trim();
        if (!sentence) return;

        if (!current) {
          if (sentence.length <= maxLength) {
            current = sentence;
          } else {
            const words = sentence.split(/\s+/);
            let piece = '';
            words.forEach((word) => {
              const test = piece ? piece + ' ' + word : word;
              if (test.length > maxLength && piece) {
                chunks.push(piece);
                piece = word;
              } else {
                piece = test;
              }
            });
            if (piece) chunks.push(piece);
          }
          return;
        }

        const test = current + ' ' + sentence;
        if (test.length <= maxLength) {
          current = test;
        } else {
          chunks.push(current);
          if (sentence.length <= maxLength) {
            current = sentence;
          } else {
            const words = sentence.split(/\s+/);
            let piece = '';
            words.forEach((word) => {
              const trial = piece ? piece + ' ' + word : word;
              if (trial.length > maxLength && piece) {
                chunks.push(piece);
                piece = word;
              } else {
                piece = trial;
              }
            });
            current = piece;
          }
        }
      });

      if (current) chunks.push(current);
    });

    return chunks;
  }

  function getSelectedVoice(){
    const index = Number(voiceSelect.value);
    return Number.isInteger(index) && voices[index] ? voices[index] : null;
  }

  function stopSpeaking(){
    if (!synth) return;
    isStarting = false;
    synth.cancel();
    activeUtterances = [];
    totalChunks = 0;
    chunksCompleted = 0;
    chunkInfo.textContent = '0 chunks queued';
    updateStatus('Stopped', 'stopped');
    updateButtons();
  }

  function speakText(){
    hideNotice();

    if (!synth) {
      showNotice('Speech synthesis is not available in this browser.');
      return;
    }

    const text = inputText.value.trim();
    if (!text) {
      showNotice('Enter text before pressing Speak.');
      return;
    }

    const chunks = splitIntoChunks(text, 180);
    if (!chunks.length) {
      showNotice('Enter text before pressing Speak.');
      return;
    }

    synth.cancel();
    activeUtterances = [];
    totalChunks = chunks.length;
    chunksCompleted = 0;
    isStarting = true;
    chunkInfo.textContent = totalChunks + (totalChunks === 1 ? ' chunk queued' : ' chunks queued');
    updateStatus('Starting', 'idle');
    updateButtons();

    const selectedVoice = getSelectedVoice();
    const rate = Number(rateSlider.value);
    const pitch = Number(pitchSlider.value);
    const volume = Number(volumeSlider.value);

    chunks.forEach((chunk, index) => {
      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(chunk);
      if (selectedVoice) {
        utterance.voice = selectedVoice;
        if (selectedVoice.lang) utterance.lang = selectedVoice.lang;
      }
      utterance.rate = rate;
      utterance.pitch = pitch;
      utterance.volume = volume;

      utterance.onstart = () => {
        isStarting = false;
        updateStatus('Speaking', 'speaking');
        chunkInfo.textContent = 'Chunk ' + (index + 1) + ' of ' + totalChunks;
        updateButtons();
      };

      utterance.onend = () => {
        chunksCompleted += 1;
        if (chunksCompleted >= totalChunks) {
          activeUtterances = [];
          totalChunks = 0;
          chunksCompleted = 0;
          chunkInfo.textContent = '0 chunks queued';
          updateStatus('Idle', 'idle');
          updateButtons();
        }
      };

      utterance.onerror = (event) => {
        activeUtterances = [];
        totalChunks = 0;
        chunksCompleted = 0;
        chunkInfo.textContent = '0 chunks queued';
        updateStatus('Stopped', 'stopped');
        updateButtons();
        showNotice('Speech playback failed' + (event && event.error ? ': ' + event.error : '.') );
      };

      activeUtterances.push(utterance);
      synth.speak(utterance);
    });

    updateButtons();
  }

  function pauseSpeaking(){
    if (!synth || !synth.speaking || synth.paused) return;
    synth.pause();
    updateStatus('Paused', 'paused');
    updateButtons();
  }

  function resumeSpeaking(){
    if (!synth || !synth.paused) return;
    synth.resume();
    updateStatus('Speaking', 'speaking');
    updateButtons();
  }

  if (!('speechSynthesis' in window) || typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance === 'undefined') {
    showNotice('This browser does not support built-in text-to-speech for this page.');
  }

  btnSpeak.addEventListener('click', speakText);
  btnPause.addEventListener('click', pauseSpeaking);
  btnResume.addEventListener('click', resumeSpeaking);
  btnStop.addEventListener('click', stopSpeaking);

  inputText.addEventListener('input', () => {
    updateWordCount();
    saveState();
  });

  voiceSelect.addEventListener('change', saveState);

  [rateSlider, pitchSlider, volumeSlider].forEach((slider) => {
    slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
      refreshSliderLabels();
      saveState();
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    const target = event.target;
    const typing = target && (target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target.tagName === 'INPUT' || target.tagName === 'SELECT');
    if (typing && event.code !== 'Escape') return;

    if (event.code === 'Space') {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (synth.paused) {
        resumeSpeaking();
      } else if (synth.speaking) {
        pauseSpeaking();
      } else {
        speakText();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
      event.preventDefault();
      stopSpeaking();
    }
  });

  if (synth && typeof synth.addEventListener === 'function') {
    synth.addEventListener('voiceschanged', populateVoices);
  } else if (synth) {
    synth.onvoiceschanged = populateVoices;
  }

  loadState();
  refreshSliderLabels();
  updateWordCount();
  populateVoices();
  updateStatus('Idle', 'idle');
  updateButtons();

  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    if (synth && (synth.speaking || synth.paused)) {
      synth.cancel();
    }
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<?php
// sitemap.php - Dynamic Sitemap Generator
$baseUrl = 'https://apro.maxflex.ai';
$documentRoot = __DIR__;

$staticPages = [
    '/' => '1.0',
    '/index.php' => '0.8',
    '/handsfree-reader.html' => '0.6',
    '/read_aloud_basic.html' => '0.6',
    '/market-entry-strategy-sample.html' => '0.5',
];

$urls = [];

function addSitemapUrl(&$urls, $baseUrl, $path, $filePath, $priority, $changefreq) {
    if (!is_file($filePath) && !is_dir($filePath)) {
        return;
    }

    $urls[$path] = [
        'loc' => rtrim($baseUrl, '/') . $path,
        'lastmod' => gmdate('Y-m-d', filemtime($filePath)),
        'changefreq' => $changefreq,
        'priority' => $priority,
    ];
}

foreach ($staticPages as $path => $priority) {
    $filePath = $path === '/' ? $documentRoot . '/index.php' : $documentRoot . $path;
    addSitemapUrl(
        $urls,
        $baseUrl,
        $path,
        $filePath,
        $priority,
        $path === '/' ? 'weekly' : 'monthly'
    );
}

// Always include homepage if it was not already added and an index file exists.
if (!isset($urls['/'])) {
    if (is_file($documentRoot . '/index.php')) {
        addSitemapUrl($urls, $baseUrl, '/', $documentRoot . '/index.php', '1.0', 'weekly');
    } elseif (is_file($documentRoot . '/index.html')) {
        addSitemapUrl($urls, $baseUrl, '/', $documentRoot . '/index.html', '1.0', 'weekly');
    }
}

// Scan for directories containing index.php or index.html files.
$directories = glob($documentRoot . '/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR);
$skipDirectories = [
    'assets',
    'css',
    'js',
    'images',
    'img',
    'fonts',
    'vendor',
    'node_modules',
    '.git',
    'includes',
    'config',
    'admin',
    'wp-admin',
    'wp-content',
    'wp-includes',
];

foreach ($directories as $dir) {
    $dirName = basename($dir);

    if (substr($dirName, 0, 1) === '.' || in_array($dirName, $skipDirectories, true)) {
        continue;
    }

    $indexFile = null;
    if (is_file($dir . '/index.php')) {
        $indexFile = $dir . '/index.php';
    } elseif (is_file($dir . '/index.html')) {
        $indexFile = $dir . '/index.html';
    }

    if ($indexFile !== null) {
        $path = '/' . $dirName . '/';
        if (!isset($urls[$path])) {
            addSitemapUrl($urls, $baseUrl, $path, $indexFile, '0.8', 'monthly');
        }
    }
}

// Check for additional HTML/PHP files in root that should be included.
$rootFiles = array_merge(
    glob($documentRoot . '/*.html') ?: [],
    glob($documentRoot . '/*.php') ?: []
);

$skipRootFiles = [
    'index',
    'sitemap',
    'robots',
    'config',
    '.htaccess',
    'error_log',
];

foreach ($rootFiles as $file) {
    $fileName = basename($file);
    $fileNameNoExt = pathinfo($fileName, PATHINFO_FILENAME);

    if (in_array($fileNameNoExt, $skipRootFiles, true)) {
        continue;
    }

    $path = '/' . $fileName;
    if (!isset($urls[$path])) {
        addSitemapUrl($urls, $baseUrl, $path, $file, '0.7', 'monthly');
    }
}

header('Content-Type: application/xml; charset=UTF-8');
echo '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . "\n";
?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
<?php foreach ($urls as $url): ?>
  <url>
    <loc><?php echo htmlspecialchars($url['loc'], ENT_XML1 | ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8'); ?></loc>
    <lastmod><?php echo htmlspecialchars($url['lastmod'], ENT_XML1 | ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8'); ?></lastmod>
    <changefreq><?php echo htmlspecialchars($url['changefreq'], ENT_XML1 | ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8'); ?></changefreq>
    <priority><?php echo htmlspecialchars($url['priority'], ENT_XML1 | ENT_COMPAT, 'UTF-8'); ?></priority>
  </url>
<?php endforeach; ?>
</urlset>
